verses.text: And the twelve stones were engraved with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, each one with its several name.
verses.textLatin: Ipsique lapides duodecim sculpti erant nominibus duodecim tribuum Israël, singuli per nomina singulorum.

verses.text: They made also in the rational little chains linked one to another of the purest gold,
verses.textLatin: Fecerunt in rationali et catenulas sibi invicem cohærentes, de auro purissimo:

verses.text: And two hooks, and as many rings of gold. And they set the rings on either side of the rational,
verses.textLatin: et duos uncinos, totidemque annulos aureos. Porro annulos posuerunt in utroque latere rationalis,

verses.text: On which rings the two golden chains should hang, which they put into the hooks that stood out in the corners of the ephod.
verses.textLatin: e quibus penderent duæ catenæ aureæ, quas inseruerunt uncinis, qui in superhumeralis angulis eminebant.

verses.text: These both before and behind so answered one another, that the ephod and the rational were bound together,
verses.textLatin: Hæc et ante et retro ita conveniebant sibi, ut superhumerale et rationale mutuo necterentur,

verses.text: Being fastened to the girdle and strongly coupled with rings, which a violet fillet joined, lest they should flag loose, and be moved one from the other, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: stricta ad balteum et annulis fortius copulata, quos jungebat vitta hyacinthina, ne laxa fluerent, et a se invicem moverentur, sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: They made also the tunick of the ephod all of violet,
verses.textLatin: Feceruntque quoque tunicam superhumeralis totam hyacinthinam,

verses.text: And a hole for the head in the upper part at the middle, and a woven border round about the hole:
verses.textLatin: et capitium in superiori parte contra medium, oramque per gyrum capitii textilem:

verses.text: And beneath at the feet pomegranates of violet, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen:
verses.textLatin: deorsum autem ad pedes mala punica ex hyacintho, purpura, vermiculo, ac bysso retorta:

verses.text: And little bells of the purest gold, which they put between the pomegranates at the bottom of the tunick round about:
verses.textLatin: et tintinnabula de auro purissimo, quæ posuerunt inter malogranata, in extrema parte tunicæ per gyrum:

verses.text: To wit, a bell of gold, and a pomegranate, wherewith the high priest went adorned, when he discharged his ministry, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: tintinnabulum autem aureum, et malum punicum, quibus ornatus incedebat pontifex quando ministerio fungebatur, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: They made also fine linen tunicks with woven work for Aaron and his sons:
verses.textLatin: Fecerunt et tunicas byssinas opere textili Aaron et filiis ejus:

verses.text: And mitres with their little crowns of fine linen:
verses.textLatin: et mitras cum coronulis suis ex bysso:

verses.text: And linen breeches of fine linen:
verses.textLatin: feminalia quoque linea, byssina:

verses.text: And a girdle of fine twisted linen, violet, purple, and scarlet twice dyed, of embroidery work, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: cingulum vero de bysso retorta, hyacintho, purpura, ac vermiculo bis tincto, arte plumaria, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: They made also the plate of sacred veneration of the purest gold, and they wrote on it with the engraving of a lapidary, The Holy of the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Fecerunt et laminam sacræ venerationis de auro purissimo, scripseruntque in ea opere gemmario, Sanctum Domini:

verses.text: And they fastened it to the mitre with a violet fillet, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: et strinxerunt eam cum mitra vitta hyacinthina, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: So all the work of the tabernacle and of the roof of the testimony was finished: and the children of Israel did all things which the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: Perfectum est igitur omne opus tabernaculi et tecti testimonii: feceruntque filii Israël cuncta quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: And they offered the tabernacle and the roof and the whole furniture, the rings, the boards, the bars, the pillars, and their sockets,
verses.textLatin: Et obtulerunt tabernaculum et tectum et universam supellectilem, annulos, tabulas, vectes, columnas ac bases,

verses.text: The cover of rams’ skins dyed red, and the other cover of violet skins,
verses.textLatin: opertorium de pellibus arietum rubricatis, et aliud operimentum de janthinis pellibus,

verses.text: The veil, the ark, the bars, the propitiatory,
verses.textLatin: velum; arcam, vectes, propitiatorium,

verses.text: The table, with the vessels thereof, and the loaves of proposition:
verses.textLatin: mensam cum vasis suis et propositionis panibus;

verses.text: The candlestick, the lamps, and the furniture of them with the oil:
verses.textLatin: candelabrum, lucernas, et utensilia earum cum oleo;

verses.text: The altar of gold, and the ointment, and the incense of spices:
verses.textLatin: altare aureum, et unguentum, et thymiama ex aromatibus,

verses.text: And the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle:
verses.textLatin: et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi;

verses.text: The altar of brass, the grate, the bars, and all the vessels thereof: the laver with the foot thereof: the hangings of the court, and the pillars with their sockets:
verses.textLatin: altare æneum, retiaculum, vectes, et vasa ejus omnia; labrum cum basi sua; tentoria atrii, et columnas cum basibus suis;

verses.text: The hanging in the entry of the court, and the little cords, and the pins thereof. Nothing was wanting of the vessels, that were commanded to be made for the ministry of the tabernacle, and for the roof of the covenant.
verses.textLatin: tentorium in introitu atrii, funiculosque illius et paxillos. Nihil ex vasis defuit, quæ in ministerium tabernaculi, et in tectum fœderis jussa sunt fieri.

verses.text: The vestments also, which the priests, to wit, Aaron and his sons, used in the sanctuary,
verses.textLatin: Vestes quoque, quibus sacerdotes utuntur in sanctuario, Aaron scilicet et filii ejus,

verses.text: The children of Israel offered as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: obtulerunt filii Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus.

verses.text: And when Moses saw all things finished, he blessed them.
verses.textLatin: Quæ postquam Moyses cuncta vidit completa, benedixit eis.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: The first month, the first day of the month, thou shalt set up the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.textLatin: Mense primo, prima die mensis, eriges tabernaculum testimonii,

verses.text: And shalt put the ark in it, and shalt let down the veil before it:
verses.textLatin: et pones in eo arcam, dimittesque ante illam velum:

verses.text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set upon it the things that are commanded according to the rite. The candlestick shall stand with its lamps,
verses.textLatin: et illata mensa, pones super eam quæ rite præcepta sunt. Candelabrum stabit cum lucernis suis,

verses.text: And the altar of gold whereon the incense is burnt, before the ark of the testimony. Thou shalt put the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle,
verses.textLatin: et altare aureum, in quo adoletur incensum, coram arca testimonii. Tentorium in introitu tabernaculi pones,

verses.text: And before it the altar of holocaust:
verses.textLatin: et ante illud altare holocausti:

verses.text: The laver between the altar and the tabernacle, and thou shalt fill it with water.
verses.textLatin: labrum inter altare et tabernaculum, quod implebis aqua.

verses.text: And thou shalt encompass the court with hangings, and the entry thereof.
verses.textLatin: Circumdabisque atrium tentoriis, et ingressum ejus.

verses.text: And thou shalt take the oil of unction and anoint the tabernacle with its vessels, that they may be sanctified:
verses.textLatin: Et assumpto unctionis oleo unges tabernaculum cum vasis suis, ut sanctificentur:

verses.text: The altar of holocaust and all its vessels:
verses.textLatin: altare holocausti et omnia vasa ejus,

verses.text: The laver with its foot: thou shalt consecrate all with the oil of unction, that they may be most holy.
verses.textLatin: labrum cum basi sua: omnia unctionis oleo consecrabis, ut sint Sancta sanctorum.

verses.text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, and having washed them with water,
verses.textLatin: Applicabisque Aaron et filios ejus ad fores tabernaculi testimonii, et lotos aqua

verses.text: Thou shalt put on them the holy vestments, that they may minister to me, and that the unction of them may prosper to an everlasting priesthood.
verses.textLatin: indues sanctis vestibus, ut ministrent mihi, et unctio eorum in sacerdotium sempiternum proficiat.

verses.text: And Moses did all that the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: Fecitque Moyses omnia quæ præceperat Dominus.

verses.text: So in the first month of the second year, the first day of the month, the tabernacle was set up.
verses.textLatin: Igitur mense primo anni secundi, prima die mensis, collocatum est tabernaculum.

verses.text: And Moses reared it up, and placed the boards and the sockets and the bars, and set up the pillars,
verses.textLatin: Erexitque Moyses illud, et posuit tabulas ac bases et vectes, statuitque columnas,

verses.text: And spread the roof over the tabernacle, putting over it a cover, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: et expandit tectum super tabernaculum, imposito desuper operimento, sicut Dominus imperaverat.

verses.text: And he put the testimony in the ark, thrusting bars underneath, and the oracle above.
verses.textLatin: Posuit et testimonium in arca, subditis infra vectibus, et oraculum desuper.

verses.text: And when he had brought the ark into the tabernacle, he drew the veil before it to fulfil the commandment of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Cumque intulisset arcam in tabernaculum, appendit ante eam velum ut expleret Domini jussionem.

verses.text: And he set the table in the tabernacle of the testimony at the north side without the veil,
verses.textLatin: Posuit et mensam in tabernaculo testimonii ad plagam septentrionalem extra velum,

verses.text: Setting there in order the loaves of proposition, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: ordinatis coram propositionis panibus, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: He set the candlestick also in the tabernacle of the testimony over against the table on the south side,
verses.textLatin: Posuit et candelabrum in tabernaculo testimonii e regione mensæ in parte australi,

verses.text: Placing the lamps in order, according to the precept of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: locatis per ordinem lucernis, juxta præceptum Domini.

verses.text: He set also the altar of gold under the roof of the testimony over against the veil,
verses.textLatin: Posuit et altare aureum sub tecto testimonii contra velum,

verses.text: And burnt upon it the incense of spices, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: et adolevit super eo incensum aromatum, sicut jusserat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: And he put also the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.textLatin: Posuit et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi testimonii,

verses.text: And the altar of holocaust in the entry of the testimony, offering the holocaust, and the sacrifices upon it, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: et altare holocausti in vestibulo testimonii, offerens in eo holocaustum, et sacrificia, ut Dominus imperaverat.

verses.text: And he set the laver between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar, filling it with water.
verses.textLatin: Labrum quoque statuit inter tabernaculum testimonii et altare, implens illud aqua.

verses.text: And Moses and Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet,
verses.textLatin: Laveruntque Moyses et Aaron ac filii ejus manus suas et pedes,

verses.text: When they went into the tabernacle of the covenant, and went to the altar, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: cum ingrederentur tectum fœderis, et accederent ad altare, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: He set up also the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, drawing the hanging in the entry thereof. After all things were perfected,
verses.textLatin: Erexit et atrium per gyrum tabernaculi et altaris, ducto in introitu ejus tentorio. Postquam omnia perfecta sunt,

verses.text: The cloud covered the tabernacle of the testimony, and the glory of the Lord filled it.
verses.textLatin: operuit nubes tabernaculum testimonii, et gloria Domini implevit illud.

verses.text: Neither could Moses go into the tabernacle of the covenant, the cloud covering all things, and the majesty of the Lord shining, for the cloud had covered all.
verses.textLatin: Nec poterat Moyses ingredi tectum fœderis, nube operiente omnia, et majestate Domini coruscante, quia cuncta nubes operuerat.

verses.text: If at any time the cloud removed from the tabernacle, the children of Israel went forward by their troops:
verses.textLatin: Siquando nubes tabernaculum deserebat, proficiscebantur filii Israël per turmas suas:

verses.text: If it hung over, they remained in the same place.
verses.textLatin: si pendebat desuper, manebant in eodem loco.

verses.text: For the cloud of the Lord hung over the tabernacle by day, and a fire by night, in the sight of all the children of Israel throughout all their mansions.
verses.textLatin: Nubes quippe Domini incubabat per diem tabernaculo, et ignis in nocte, videntibus cunctis populis Israël per cunctas mansiones suas.

verses.text: And  the Lord called Moses, and spoke to him from the tabernacle of the testimony, saying:
verses.textLatin: Vocavit autem Moysen, et locutus est ei Dominus de tabernaculo testimonii, dicens:

verses.text: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them: The man among you that shall offer to the Lord a sacrifice of the cattle, that is, offering victims of oxen and sheep,
verses.textLatin: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos: Homo, qui obtulerit ex vobis hostiam Domino de pecoribus, id est, de bobus et ovibus offerens victimas,

verses.text: If his offering be a holocaust, and of the herd, he shall offer a male without blemish, at the door of the testimony, to make the Lord favourable to him:
verses.textLatin: si holocaustum fuerit ejus oblatio, ac de armento: masculum immaculatum offeret ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii, ad placandum sibi Dominum:

verses.text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the victim, and it shall be acceptable, and help to its expiation.
verses.textLatin: ponetque manum super caput hostiæ, et acceptabilis erit, atque in expiationem ejus proficiens.

verses.text: And he shall immolate the calf before the Lord, and the priests the sons of Aaron shall offer the blood thereof, pouring it round about the altar, which is before the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: Immolabitque vitulum coram Domino, et offerent filii Aaron sacerdotes sanguinem ejus, fundentes per altaris circuitum, quod est ante ostium tabernaculi:

verses.text: And when they have flayed the victim, they shall cut the joints into pieces,
verses.textLatin: detractaque pelle hostiæ, artus in frusta concident.

verses.text: And shall put fire on the altar, having before laid in order a pile of wood:
verses.textLatin: Et subjicient in altari ignem, strue lignorum ante composita:

verses.text: And they shall lay the parts that are cut out in order thereupon, to wit, the head, and all things that cleave to the liver,
verses.textLatin: et membra quæ sunt cæsa, desuper ordinantes, caput videlicet, et cuncta quæ adhærent jecori,

verses.text: The entrails and feet being washed with water: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for a holocaust, and a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: intestinis et pedibus lotis aqua: adolebitque ea sacerdos super altare in holocaustum et suavem odorem Domino.

verses.text: And if the offering be of the flocks, a holocaust of sheep or of goats, he shall offer a male without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Quod si de pecoribus oblatio est, de ovibus sive de capris holocaustum, masculum absque macula offeret:

verses.text: And he shall immolate it at the side of the altar that looketh to the north, before the Lord: but the sons of Aaron shall pour the blood thereof upon the altar round about:
verses.textLatin: immolabitque ad latus altaris, quod respicit ad aquilonem, coram Domino: sanguinem vero illius fundent super altare filii Aaron per circuitum:

verses.text: And they shall divide the joints, the head, and all that cleave to the liver: and shall lay them upon the wood, under which the fire is to be put:
verses.textLatin: dividentque membra, caput, et omnia quæ adhærent jecori, et ponent super ligna, quibus subjiciendus est ignis:

verses.text: But the entrails and the feet they shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer it all and burn it all upon the altar for a holocaust, and most sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: intestina vero et pedes lavabunt aqua. Et oblata omnia adolebit sacerdos super altare in holocaustum et odorem suavissimum Domino.

verses.text: But if the oblation of a holocaust to the Lord be of birds, of turtles, or of young pigeons,
verses.textLatin: Si autem de avibus, holocausti oblatio fuerit Domino, de turturibus, aut pullis columbæ,

verses.text: The priest shall offer it at the altar: and twisting back the neck, and breaking the place of the wound, he shall make the blood run down upon the brim of the altar.
verses.textLatin: offeret eam sacerdos ad altare: et retorto ad collum capite, ac rupto vulneris loco, decurrere faciet sanguinem super crepidinem altaris:

verses.text: But the crop of the throat, and the feathers he shall cast beside the altar at the east side, in the place where the ashes are wont to be poured out,
verses.textLatin: vesiculam vero gutturis, et plumas projiciet prope altare ad orientalem plagam, in loco in quo cineres effundi solent,

verses.text: And he shall break the pinions thereof, and shall not cut, nor divide it with a knife, and shall burn it upon the altar, putting fire under the wood. It is a holocaust and oblation of most sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: confringetque ascellas ejus, et non secabit, neque ferro dividet eam, et adolebit super altare, lignis igne supposito. Holocaustum est et oblatio suavissimi odoris Domino.

verses.text: When  any one shall offer an oblation of sacrifice to the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour, and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense,
verses.textLatin: Anima cum obtulerit oblationem sacrificii Domino, simila erit ejus oblatio; fundetque super eam oleum, et ponet thus,

verses.text: And shall bring it to the sons of Aaron the priests: and one of them shall take a handful of the flour and oil, and all the frankincense, and shall put it a memorial upon the altar for a most sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: ac deferet ad filios Aaron sacerdotes: quorum unus tollet pugillum plenum similæ et olei, ac totum thus, et ponet memoriale super altare in odorem suavissimum Domino.

verses.text: And the remnant of the sacrifice shall be Aaron’s, and his sons’, holy of holies of the offerings of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Quod autem reliquum fuerit de sacrificio, erit Aaron et filiorum ejus, Sanctum sanctorum de oblationibus Domini.

verses.text: But when thou offerest a sacrifice baked in the oven of flour, to wit, loaves without leaven, tempered with oil, and unleavened wafers, anointed with oil:
verses.textLatin: Cum autem obtuleris sacrificium coctum in clibano: de simila, panes scilicet absque fermento, conspersos oleo, et lagana azyma oleo lita.

verses.text: If thy oblation be from the fryingpan, of flour tempered with oil, and without leaven,
verses.textLatin: Si oblatio tua fuerit de sartagine, similæ conspersæ oleo et absque fermento,

verses.text: Thou shalt divide it into little pieces, and shalt pour oil upon it.
verses.textLatin: divides eam minutatim, et fundes super eam oleum.

verses.text: And if the sacrifice be from the gridiron, in like manner the flour shall be tempered with oil:
verses.textLatin: Sin autem de craticula fuerit sacrificium, æque simila oleo conspergetur:

verses.text: And when thou offerest it to the Lord, thou shalt deliver it to the hands of the priest.
verses.textLatin: quam offerens Domino, trades manibus sacerdotis.

verses.text: And when he hath offered it, he shall take a memorial out of the sacrifice, and burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Qui cum obtulerit eam, tollet memoriale de sacrificio, et adolebit super altare in odorem suavitatis Domino:

verses.text: And whatsoever is left, shall be Aaron’s, and his sons’, holy of holies of the offerings of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: quidquid autem reliquum est, erit Aaron, et filiorum ejus, Sanctum sanctorum de oblationibus Domini.

verses.text: Every oblation that is offered to the Lord shall be made without leaven, neither shall any leaven or honey be burnt in the sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Omnis oblatio quæ offeretur Domino, absque fermento fiet, nec quidquam fermenti ac mellis adolebitur in sacrificio Domino.

verses.text: You shall offer only the firstfruits of them and gifts: but they shall not be put upon the altar, for a savour of sweetness.
verses.textLatin: Primitias tantum eorum offeretis ac munera: super altare vero non imponentur in odorem suavitatis.

verses.text: Whatsoever sacrifice thou offerest, thou shalt season it with salt, neither shalt thou take away the salt of the covenant of thy God from thy sacrifice. In all thy oblations thou shalt offer salt.
verses.textLatin: Quidquid obtuleris sacrificii, sale condies, nec auferes sal fœderis Dei tui de sacrificio tuo: in omni oblatione tua offeres sal.

verses.text: But if thou offer a gift of the firstfruits of thy corn to the Lord, of the ears yet green, thou shalt dry it at the fire, and break it small like meal, and so shalt thou offer thy firstfruits to the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Si autem obtuleris munus primarum frugum tuarum Domino de spicis adhuc virentibus, torrebis igni, et confringes in morem farris, et sic offeres primitias tuas Domino,

verses.text: Pouring oil upon it and putting on frankincense, because it is the oblation of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: fundens supra oleum, et thus imponens, quia oblatio Domini est:

verses.text: Whereof the priest shall burn for a memorial of the gift, part of the corn broken small and of the oil, and all the frankincense.
verses.textLatin: de qua adolebit sacerdos in memoriam muneris partem farris fracti, et olei, ac totum thus.

verses.text: And  if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offerings, and he will offer of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer them without blemish before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Quod si hostia pacificorum fuerit ejus oblatio, et de bobus voluerit offerre, marem sive feminam, immaculata offeret coram Domino.

verses.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his victim, which shall be slain in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony, and the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour the blood round about upon the altar.
verses.textLatin: Ponetque manum super caput victimæ suæ, quæ immolabitur in introitu tabernaculi testimonii, fundentque filii Aaron sacerdotes sanguinem per altaris circuitum.

verses.text: And they shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings, for an oblation to the Lord, the fat that covereth the entrails, and all the fat that is within.
verses.textLatin: Et offerent de hostia pacificorum in oblationem Domino, adipem qui operit vitalia, et quidquid pinguedinis est intrinsecus:

verses.text: The two kidneys with the fat wherewith the flanks are covered, and the caul of the liver with the two little kidneys.
verses.textLatin: duos renes cum adipe quo teguntur ilia, et reticulum jecoris cum renunculis.

verses.text: And they shall burn them upon the altar, for a holocaust, putting fire under the wood: for an oblation of most sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Adolebuntque ea super altare in holocaustum, lignis igne supposito, in oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.

verses.text: But if his oblation and the sacrifice of peace offering be of the flock, whether he offer male or female, they shall be without blemish.
verses.textLatin: Si vero de ovibus fuerit ejus oblatio et pacificorum hostia, sive masculum obtulerit, sive feminam, immaculata erunt.

verses.text: If he offer a lamb before the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Si agnum obtulerit coram Domino,

verses.text: He shall put his hand upon the head of the victim: and it shall be slain in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony: and the sons of Aaron shall pour the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.textLatin: ponet manum suam super caput victimæ suæ: quæ immolabitur in vestibulo tabernaculi testimonii: fundentque filii Aaron sanguinem ejus per circuitum altaris.

verses.text: And they shall offer of the victim of peace offerings a sacrifice to the Lord: the fat and the whole rump,
verses.textLatin: Et offerent de pacificorum hostia sacrificium Domino: adipem et caudam totam

verses.text: With the kidneys, and the fat that covereth the belly and all the vitals and both the little kidneys, with the fat that is about the flanks, and the caul of the liver with the little kidneys.
verses.textLatin: cum renibus, et pinguedinem quæ operit ventrem atque universa vitalia, et utrumque renunculum cum adipe qui est juxta ilia, reticulumque jecoris cum renunculis.

verses.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar, for the food of the fire, and of the oblation of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et adolebit ea sacerdos super altare in pabulum ignis et oblationis Domini.

verses.text: If his offering be a goat, and he offer it to the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Si capra fuerit ejus oblatio, et obtulerit eam Domino,

verses.text: He shall put his hand upon the head thereof: and shall immolate it in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony. And the sons of Aaron shall pour the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.textLatin: ponet manum suam super caput ejus: immolabitque eam in introitu tabernaculi testimonii, et fundent filii Aaron sanguinem ejus per altaris circuitum.

verses.text: And they shall take of it for the food of the Lord’s fire, the fat that covereth the belly, and that covereth all the vital parts:
verses.textLatin: Tollentque ex ea in pastum ignis dominici, adipem qui operit ventrem, et qui tegit universa vitalia:

verses.text: The two little kidneys with the caul that is upon them which is by the flanks, and the fat of the liver with the little kidneys:
verses.textLatin: duos renunculos cum reticulo, quod est super eos juxta ilia, et arvinam jecoris cum renunculis:

verses.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar, for the food of the fire, and of a most sweet savour. All the fat shall be the Lord’s.
verses.textLatin: adolebitque ea super altare sacerdos in alimoniam ignis, et suavissimi odoris. Omnis adeps, Domini erit

verses.text: By a perpetual law for your generations, and in all your habitations: neither blood nor fat shall you eat at all.
verses.textLatin: jure perpetuo in generationibus, et cunctis habitaculis vestris: nec sanguinem nec adipem omnino comedetis.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Say to the children of Israel: The soul that sinneth through ignorance, and doth any thing concerning any of the commandments of the Lord, which he commanded not to be done:
verses.textLatin: Loquere filiis Israël: Anima, quæ peccaverit per ignorantiam, et de universis mandatis Domini, quæ præcepit ut non fierent, quippiam fecerit:

verses.text: If the priest that is anointed shall sin, making the people to offend, he shall offer to the Lord for his sin a calf without blemish.
verses.textLatin: si sacerdos, qui unctus est, peccaverit, delinquere faciens populum, offeret pro peccato suo vitulum immaculatum Domino:

verses.text: And he shall bring it to the door of the testimony before the Lord, and shall put his hand upon the head thereof, and shall sacrifice it to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et adducet illum ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii coram Domino, ponetque manum super caput ejus, et immolabit eum Domino.

verses.text: He shall take also of the blood of the calf, and carry it into the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: Hauriet quoque de sanguine vituli, inferens illum in tabernaculum testimonii.

verses.text: And having dipped his finger in the blood, he shall sprinkle with it seven times before the Lord, before the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.textLatin: Cumque intinxerit digitum in sanguine, asperget eo septies coram Domino contra velum sanctuarii.

verses.text: And he shall put some of the same blood upon the horns of the altar of the sweet incense most acceptable to the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of the testimony. And he shall pour all the rest of the blood at the foot of the altar of holocaust in the entry of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: Ponetque de eodem sanguine super cornua altaris thymiamatis gratissimi Domino, quod est in tabernaculo testimonii: omnem autem reliquum sanguinem fundet in basim altaris holocausti in introitu tabernaculi.

verses.text: And he shall take off the fat of the calf for the sin offering, as well that which covereth the entrails, as all the inwards:
verses.textLatin: Et adipem vituli auferet pro peccato, tam eum qui vitalia operit quam omnia quæ intrinsecus sunt:

verses.text: The two little kidneys, and the caul that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the fat of the liver with the little kidneys,
verses.textLatin: duos renunculos et reticulum quod est super eos juxta ilia, et adipem jecoris cum renunculis,

verses.text: As it is taken off from the calf of the sacrifice of peace offerings, and he shall burn them upon the altar of holocaust.
verses.textLatin: sicut aufertur de vitulo hostiæ pacificorum: et adolebit ea super altare holocausti.

verses.text: But the skin and all the flesh with the head and the feet and the bowels and the dung,
verses.textLatin: Pellem vero et omnes carnes, cum capite et pedibus et intestinis et fimo,

verses.text: And the rest of the body he shall carry forth without the camp into a clean place where the ashes are wont to be poured out, and he shall burn them upon a pile of wood, they shall be burnt in the place where the ashes are poured out.
verses.textLatin: et reliquo corpore, efferet extra castra in locum mundum, ubi cineres effundi solent: incendetque ea super lignorum struem, quæ in loco effusorum cinerum cremabuntur.

verses.text: And if all the multitude of Israel shall be ignorant, and through ignorance shall do that which is against the commandment of the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Quod si omnis turba Israël ignoraverit, et per imperitiam fecerit quod contra mandatum Domini est,

verses.text: And afterwards shall understand their sin, they shall offer for their sin a calf, and shall bring it to the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: et postea intellexerit peccatum suum, offeret pro peccato suo vitulum, adducetque eum ad ostium tabernaculi.

verses.text: And the ancients of the people shall put their hands upon the head thereof before the Lord. And the calf being immolated in the sight of the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Et ponent seniores populi manus super caput ejus coram Domino. Immolatoque vitulo in conspectu Domini,

verses.text: The priest that is anointed shall carry of the blood into the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: inferet sacerdos, qui unctus est, de sanguine ejus in tabernaculum testimonii,

verses.text: And shall dip his finger in it and sprinkle it seven times before the veil.
verses.textLatin: tincto digito aspergens septies contra velum.

verses.text: And he shall put of the same blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord, in the tabernacle of the testimony: and the rest of the blood he shall pour at the foot of the altar of holocaust, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: Ponetque de eodem sanguine in cornibus altaris, quod est coram Domino in tabernaculo testimonii: reliquum autem sanguinem fundet juxta basim altaris holocaustorum, quod est in ostio tabernaculi testimonii.

verses.text: And all the fat thereof he shall take off, and shall burn it upon the altar:
verses.textLatin: Omnemque ejus adipem tollet, et adolebit super altare:

verses.text: Doing so with this calf, as he did also with that before: and the priest praying for them, the Lord will be merciful unto them.
verses.textLatin: sic faciens et de hoc vitulo quomodo fecit et prius: et rogante pro eis sacerdote, propitius erit eis Dominus.

verses.text: But the calf itself he shall carry forth without the camp, and shall burn it as he did the former calf: because it is for the sin of the multitude.
verses.textLatin: Ipsum autem vitulum efferet extra castra, atque comburet sicut et priorem vitulum: quia est pro peccato multitudinis.

verses.text: If a prince shall sin, and through ignorance do any one of the things that the law of the Lord forbiddeth,
verses.textLatin: Si peccaverit princeps, et fecerit unum e pluribus per ignorantiam, quod Domini lege prohibetur:

verses.text: And afterwards shall come to know his sin, he shall offer a buck goat without blemish, a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et postea intellexerit peccatum suum, offeret hostiam Domino, hircum de capris immaculatum.

verses.text: And he shall put his hand upon the head thereof: and when he hath immolated it in the place where the holocaust is wont to be slain before the Lord, because it is for sin,
verses.textLatin: Ponetque manum suam super caput ejus: cumque immolaverit eum loco ubi solet mactari holocaustum coram Domino, quia pro peccato est,

verses.text: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the victim for sin, touching therewith the horns of the altar of holocaust, and pouring out the rest at the foot thereof.
verses.textLatin: tinget sacerdos digitum in sanguine hostiæ pro peccato, tangens cornua altaris holocausti, et reliquum fundens ad basim ejus.

verses.text: But the fat he shall burn upon it, as is wont to be done with the victims of peace offerings: and the priest shall pray for him, and for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textLatin: Adipem vero adolebit supra, sicut in victimis pacificorum fieri solet: rogabitque pro eo sacerdos, et pro peccato ejus, et dimittetur ei.

verses.text: And if any one of the people of the land shall sin through ignorance, doing any of those things that by the law of the Lord are forbidden, and offending,
verses.textLatin: Quod si peccaverit anima per ignorantiam, de populo terræ, ut faciat quidquam de his, quæ Domini lege prohibentur, atque delinquat,

verses.text: And shall come to know his sin, he shall offer a she goat without blemish.
verses.textLatin: et cognoverit peccatum suum, offeret capram immaculatam.

verses.text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the victim that is for sin, and shall immolate it in the place of the holocaust.
verses.textLatin: Ponetque manum super caput hostiæ quæ pro peccato est, et immolabit eam in loco holocausti.

verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood with his finger, and shall touch the horns of the altar of holocaust, and shall pour out the rest at the foot thereof.
verses.textLatin: Tolletque sacerdos de sanguine in digito suo: et tangens cornua altaris holocausti, reliquum fundet ad basim ejus.

verses.text: But taking off all the fat, as is wont to be taken away of the victims of peace offerings, he shall burn it upon the altar, for a sweet savour to the Lord: and he shall pray for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textLatin: Omnem autem adipem auferens, sicut auferri solet de victimis pacificorum, adolebit super altare in odorem suavitatis Domino: rogabitque pro eo, et dimittetur ei.

verses.text: But if he offer of the flock a victim for his sin, to wit, an ewe without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Sin autem de pecoribus obtulerit victimam pro peccato, ovem scilicet immaculatam:

verses.text: He shall put his hand upon the head thereof, and shall immolate it in the place where the victims of holocausts are wont to be slain.
verses.textLatin: ponet manum super caput ejus, et immolabit eam in loco ubi solent cædi holocaustorum hostiæ.

verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and shall touch the horns of the altar of holocaust, and the rest he shall pour out at the foot thereof.
verses.textLatin: Sumetque sacerdos de sanguine ejus digito suo, et tangens cornua altaris holocausti, reliquum fundet ad basim ejus.

verses.text: All the fat also he shall take off, as the fat of the ram that is offered for peace offerings is wont to be taken away: and shall burn it upon the altar, for a burnt sacrifice of the Lord: and he shall pray for him and for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textLatin: Omnem quoque adipem auferens, sicut auferri solet adeps arietis, qui immolatur pro pacificis, cremabit super altare in incensum Domini: rogabitque pro eo, et pro peccato ejus, et dimittetur ei.

verses.text: If  any one sin, and hear the voice of one swearing, and is a witness either because he himself hath seen, or is privy to it: if he do not utter it, he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.textLatin: Si peccaverit anima, et audierit vocem jurantis, testisque fuerit quod aut ipse vidit, aut conscius est: nisi indicaverit, portabit iniquitatem suam.

verses.text: Whosoever toucheth any unclean thing, either that which hath been killed by a beast, or died of itself, or any other creeping thing: and forgetteth his uncleanness, he is guilty, and hath offended:
verses.textLatin: Anima quæ tetigerit aliquid immundum, sive quod occisum a bestia est, aut per se mortuum, aut quodlibet aliud reptile: et oblita fuerit immunditiæ suæ, rea est, et deliquit:

verses.text: And if he touch any thing of the uncleanness of man, according to any uncleanness wherewith he is wont to be defiled, and having forgotten it, come afterwards to know it, he shall be guilty of an offence.
verses.textLatin: et si tetigerit quidquam de immunditia hominis juxta omnem impuritatem, qua pollui solet, oblitaque cognoverit postea, subjacebit delicto.

verses.text: The person that sweareth, and uttereth with his lips, that he would do either evil or good, and bindeth the same with an oath, and his word, and having forgotten it afterwards understandeth his offence,
verses.textLatin: Anima, quæ juraverit, et protulerit labiis suis, ut vel male quid faceret, vel bene, et idipsum juramento et sermone firmaverit, oblitaque postea intellexerit delictum suum,

verses.text: Let him do penance for his sin,
verses.textLatin: agat pœnitentiam pro peccato,

verses.text: And offer of the flocks an ewe lamb, or a she goat, and the priest shall pray for him and for his sin:
verses.textLatin: et offerat de gregibus agnam sive capram, orabitque pro ea sacerdos et pro peccato ejus.

verses.text: But if he be not able to offer a beast, let him offer two turtles, or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for sin, and the other for a holocaust,
verses.textLatin: Sin autem non potuerit offerre pecus, offerat duos turtures, vel duos pullos columbarum Domino, unum pro peccato, et alterum in holocaustum,

verses.text: And he shall give them to the priest: who shall offer the first for sin, and twist back the head of it to the little pinions, so that it stick to the neck, and be not altogether broken off.
verses.textLatin: dabitque eos sacerdoti: qui primum offerens pro peccato, retorquebit caput ejus ad pennulas, ita ut collo hæreat, et non penitus abrumpatur.

verses.text: And of its blood he shall sprinkle the side of the altar, and whatsoever is left, he shall let it drop at the bottom thereof, because it is for sin.
verses.textLatin: Et asperget de sanguine ejus parietem altaris; quidquid autem reliquum fuerit, faciet distillare ad fundamentum ejus, quia pro peccato est.

verses.text: And the other he shall burn for a holocaust, as is wont to be done: and the priest shall pray for him, and for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textLatin: Alterum vero adolebit in holocaustum, ut fieri solet: rogabitque pro eo sacerdos et pro peccato ejus, et dimittetur ei.

verses.text: And if his hand be not able to offer two turtles, or two young pigeons, he shall offer for his sin the tenth part of an ephi of flour. He shall not put oil upon it, nor put any frankincense thereon, because it is for sin:
verses.textLatin: Quod si non quiverit manus ejus duos offerre turtures, aut duos pullos columbarum, offeret pro peccato suo similæ partem ephi decimam: non mittet in eam oleum, nec thuris aliquid imponet, quia pro peccato est.

verses.text: And he shall deliver it to the priest: who shall take a handful thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar for a memorial of him that offered it:
verses.textLatin: Tradetque eam sacerdoti: qui plenum ex ea pugillum hauriens, cremabit super altare in monimentum ejus qui obtulerit,

verses.text: Praying for him and making atonement: but the part that is left, he himself shall have for a gift.
verses.textLatin: rogans pro illo et expians: reliquam vero partem ipse habebit in munere.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: If any one shall sin through mistake, transgressing the ceremonies in those things that are sacrificed to the Lord, he shall offer for his offence a ram without blemish out of the flocks, that may be bought for two sicles, according to the weight of the sanctuary:
verses.textLatin: Anima si prævaricans cæremonias, per errorem, in his quæ Domino sunt sanctificata, peccaverit, offeret pro delicto suo arietem immaculatum de gregibus, qui emi potest duobus siclis, juxta pondus sanctuarii:

verses.text: And he shall make good the damage itself which he hath done, and shall add the fifth part besides, delivering it to the priest, who shall pray for him, offering the ram, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textLatin: ipsumque quod intulit damni restituet, et quintam partem ponet supra, tradens sacerdoti, qui rogabit pro eo offerens arietem, et dimittetur ei.

verses.text: If any one sin through ignorance, and do one of those things which by the law of the Lord are forbidden, and being guilty of sin, understand his iniquity,
verses.textLatin: Anima si peccaverit per ignorantiam, feceritque unum ex his quæ Domini lege prohibentur, et peccati rea intellexerit iniquitatem suam,

verses.text: He shall offer of the flocks a ram without blemish to the priest, according to the measure and estimation of the sin: and the priest shall pray for him, because he did it ignorantly: and it shall be forgiven him,
verses.textLatin: offeret arietem immaculatum de gregibus sacerdoti, juxta mensuram æstimationemque peccati: qui orabit pro eo, quia nesciens fecerit: et dimittetur ei,

verses.text: Because by mistake he trespassed against the Lord.
verses.textLatin: quia per errorem deliquit in Dominum.

verses.text: The  Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Whosoever shall sin, and despising the Lord, shall deny to his neighbour the thing delivered to his keeping, which was committed to his trust; or shall by force extort any thing, or commit oppression;
verses.textLatin: Anima quæ peccaverit, et contempto Domino, negaverit proximo suo depositum quod fidei ejus creditum fuerat, vel vi aliquid extorserit, aut calumniam fecerit,

verses.text: Or shall find a thing lost, and denying it, shall also swear falsely, or shall do any other of the many things, wherein men are wont to sin:
verses.textLatin: sive rem perditam invenerit, et inficians insuper pejeraverit, et quodlibet aliud ex pluribus fecerit, in quibus solent peccare homines,

verses.text: Being convicted of the offence, he shall restore
verses.textLatin: convicta delicti,

verses.text: All that he would have gotten by fraud, in the principal, and the fifth part besides to the owner, whom he wronged.
verses.textLatin: reddet omnia, quæ per fraudem voluit obtinere, integra, et quintam insuper partem domino cui damnum intulerat.

verses.text: Moreover for his sin he shall offer a ram without blemish out of the flock, and shall give it to the priest, according to the estimation and measure of the offence:
verses.textLatin: Pro peccato autem suo offeret arietem immaculatum de grege, et dabit eum sacerdoti, juxta æstimationem mensuramque delicti:

verses.text: And he shall pray for him before the Lord, and he shall have forgiveness for every thing in doing of which he hath sinned.
verses.textLatin: qui rogabit pro eo coram Domino, et dimittetur illi pro singulis quæ faciendo peccavit.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Command Aaron and his sons: This is the law of a holocaust: It shall be burnt upon the altar, all night until morning: the fire shall be of the same altar.
verses.textLatin: Præcipe Aaron et filiis ejus: Hæc est lex holocausti: cremabitur in altari tota nocte usque mane: ignis ex eodem altari erit.

verses.text: The priest shall be vested with the tunick and the linen breeches, and he shall take up the ashes of that which the devouring fire hath burnt, and putting them beside the altar,
verses.textLatin: Vestietur tunica sacerdos et feminalibus lineis: tolletque cineres, quos vorans ignis exussit, et ponens juxta altare,

verses.text: Shall put off his former vestments, and being clothed with others, shall carry them forth without the camp, and shall cause them to be consumed to dust in a very clean place,
verses.textLatin: spoliabitur prioribus vestimentis, indutusque aliis, efferret eos extra castra, et in loco mundissimo usque ad favillam consumi faciet.

verses.text: And the fire on the altar shall always burn, and the priest shall feed it, putting wood on it every day in the morning, and laying on the holocaust, shall burn thereupon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textLatin: Ignis autem in altari semper ardebit, quem nutriet sacerdos subjiciens ligna mane per singulos dies, et imposito holocausto, desuper adolebit adipes pacificorum.

verses.text: This is the perpetual fire which shall never go out on the altar.
verses.textLatin: Ignis est iste perpetuus, qui numquam deficiet in altari.

verses.text: This is the law of the sacrifice and libations, which the children of Aaron shall offer before the Lord, and before the altar.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est lex sacrificii et libamentorum, quæ offerent filii Aaron coram Domino, et coram altari.

verses.text: The priest shall take a handful of the flour that is tempered with oil, and all the frankincense that is put upon the flour: and he shall burn it on the altar for a memorial of most sweet odour to the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Tollet sacerdos pugillum similæ, quæ conspersa est oleo, et totum thus, quod super similam positum est: adolebitque illud in altari in monimentum odoris suavissimi Domino:

verses.text: And the part of the flour that is left, Aaron and his sons shall eat, without leaven: and he shall eat it in the holy place of the court of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: reliquam autem partem similæ comedet Aaron cum filiis suis, absque fermento: et comedet in loco sancto atrii tabernaculi.

verses.text: And therefore it shall not be leavened, because part thereof is offered for the burnt sacrifice of the Lord. It shall be most holy, as that which is offered for sin and for trespass.
verses.textLatin: Ideo autem non fermentabitur, quia pars ejus in Domini offertur incensum. Sanctum sanctorum erit, sicut pro peccato atque delicto.

verses.text: The males only of the race of Aaron shall eat it. It shall be an ordinance everlasting in your generations concerning the sacrifices of the Lord: Every one that toucheth them shall be sanctified.
verses.textLatin: Mares tantum stirpis Aaron comedent illud. Legitimum ac sempiternum erit in generationibus vestris de sacrificiis Domini: omnis qui tetigerit illa, sanctificabitur.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: This is the oblation of Aaron, and of his sons, which they must offer to the Lord, in the day of their anointing: They shall offer the tenth part of an ephi of flour for a perpetual sacrifice, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening:
verses.textLatin: Hæc est oblatio Aaron, et filiorum ejus, quam offerre debent Domino in die unctionis suæ. Decimam partem ephi offerent similæ in sacrificio sempiterno, medium ejus mane, et medium ejus vespere:

verses.text: It shall be tempered with oil, and shall be fried in a fryingpan.
verses.textLatin: quæ in sartagine oleo conspersa frigetur. Offeret autem eam calidam in odorem suavissimum Domino

verses.text: And the priest that rightfully succeedeth his father, shall offer it hot, for a most sweet odour to the Lord, and it shall be wholly burnt on the altar.
verses.textLatin: sacerdos, qui jure patri successerit, et tota cremabitur in altari.

verses.text: For every sacrifice of the priest shall be consumed with fire, neither shall any man eat thereof.
verses.textLatin: Omne enim sacrificium sacerdotum igne consumetur, nec quisquam comedet ex eo.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutus est autem Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Say to Aaron and his sons: This is the law of the victim for sin: in the place where the holocaust is offered, it shall be immolated before the Lord. It is holy of holies.
verses.textLatin: Loquere Aaron et filiis ejus: Ista est lex hostiæ pro peccato: in loco ubi offertur holocaustum, immolabitur coram Domino. Sanctum sanctorum est.

verses.text: The priest that offereth it, shall eat it in a holy place, in the court of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdos, qui offert, comedet eam in loco sancto, in atrio tabernaculi.

verses.text: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof, shall be sanctified. If a garment be sprinkled with the blood thereof, it shall be washed in a holy place.
verses.textLatin: Quidquid tetigerit carnes ejus, sanctificabitur. Si de sanguine illius vestis fuerit aspersa, lavabitur in loco sancto.

verses.text: And the earthen vessel, wherein it was sodden, shall be broken, but if the vessel be of brass, it shall be scoured, and washed with water.
verses.textLatin: Vas autem fictile, in quo cocta est, confringetur; quod si vas æneum fuerit, defricabitur, et lavabitur aqua.

verses.text: Every male of the priestly race shall eat of the flesh thereof, because it is holy of holies.
verses.textLatin: Omnis masculus de genere sacerdotali vescetur de carnibus ejus, quia Sanctum sanctorum est.

verses.text: For the victim that is slain for sin, the blood of which is carried into the tabernacle of the testimony to make atonement in the sanctuary, shall not be eaten, but shall be burnt with fire.
verses.textLatin: Hostia enim quæ cæditur pro peccato, cujus sanguis infertur in tabernaculum testimonii ad expiandum in sanctuario, non comedetur, sed comburetur igni.

verses.text: This  also is the law of the sacrifice for a trespass, it is most holy:
verses.textLatin: Hæc quoque lex hostiæ pro delicto, Sancta sanctorum est:

verses.text: Therefore where the holocaust is immolated, the victim also for a trespass shall be slain: the blood thereof shall be poured round about the altar.
verses.textLatin: idcirco ubi immolabitur holocaustum, mactabitur et victima pro delicto: sanguis ejus per gyrum altaris fundetur.

verses.text: They shall offer thereof the rump and the fat that covereth the entrails:
verses.textLatin: Offerent ex ea caudam et adipem qui operit vitalia:

verses.text: The two little kidneys, and the fat which is by the flanks, and the caul of the liver with the little kidneys.
verses.textLatin: duos renunculos, et pinguedinem quæ juxta ilia est, reticulumque jecoris cum renunculis.

verses.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the burnt sacrifice of the Lord for a trespass.
verses.textLatin: Et adolebit ea sacerdos super altare: incensum est Domini pro delicto.

verses.text: Every male of the priestly race, shall eat this flesh in a holy place, because it is most holy.
verses.textLatin: Omnis masculus de sacerdotali genere, in loco sancto vescetur his carnibus, quia Sanctum sanctorum est.

verses.text: As the sacrifice for sin is offered, so is also that for a trespass: the same shall be the law of both these sacrifices: it shall belong to the priest that offereth it.
verses.textLatin: Sicut pro peccato offertur hostia, ita et pro delicto: utriusque hostiæ lex una erit: ad sacerdotem, qui eam obtulerit, pertinebit.

verses.text: The priest that offereth the victim of holocaust, shall have the skin thereof.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdos qui offert holocausti victimam, habebit pellem ejus.

verses.text: And every sacrifice of flour that is baked in the oven, and whatsoever is dressed on the gridiron, or in the fryingpan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it:
verses.textLatin: Et omne sacrificium similæ, quod coquitur in clibano, et quidquid in craticula, vel in sartagine præparatur, ejus erit sacerdotis a quo offertur:

verses.text: Whether they be tempered with oil, or dry, all the sons of Aaron shall have one as much as another.
verses.textLatin: sive oleo conspersa, sive arida fuerint, cunctis filiis Aaron mensura æqua per singulos dividetur.

verses.text: This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings that is offered to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est lex hostiæ pacificorum quæ offertur Domino.

verses.text: If the oblation be for thanksgiving, they shall offer loaves without leaven tempered with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and fine flour fried, and cakes tempered and mingled with oil:
verses.textLatin: Si pro gratiarum actione oblatio fuerit, offerent panes absque fermento conspersos oleo, et lagana azyma uncta oleo, coctamque similam, et collyridas olei admistione conspersas:

verses.text: Moreover loaves of leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanks, which is offered for peace offerings:
verses.textLatin: panes quoque fermentatos cum hostia gratiarum, quæ immolatur pro pacificis:

verses.text: Of which one shall be offered to the Lord for firstfruits, and shall be the priest’s that shall pour out the blood of the victim.
verses.textLatin: ex quibus unus pro primitiis offeretur Domino, et erit sacerdotis qui fundet hostiæ sanguinem,

verses.text: And the flesh of it shall be eaten the same day, neither shall any of it remain until the morning.
verses.textLatin: cujus carnes eadem comedentur die, nec remanebit ex eis quidquam usque mane.

verses.text: If any man by vow, or of his own accord offer a sacrifice, it shall in like manner be eaten the same day: and if any of it remain until the morrow, it is lawful to eat it:
verses.textLatin: Si voto, vel sponte quispiam obtulerit hostiam, eadem similiter edetur die: sed et si quid in crastinum remanserit, vesci licitum est:

verses.text: But whatsoever shall be found on the third day shall be consumed with fire.
verses.textLatin: quidquid autem tertius invenerit dies, ignis absumet.

verses.text: If any man eat of the flesh of the victim of peace offerings on the third day, the oblation shall be of no effect, neither shall it profit the offerer: yea rather whatsoever soul shall defile itself with such meat, shall be guilty of transgression.
verses.textLatin: Si quis de carnibus victimæ pacificorum die tertio comederit, irrita fiet oblatio, nec proderit offerenti: quin potius quæcumque anima tali se edulio contaminaverit, prævaricationis rea erit.

verses.text: The flesh that hath touched any unclean thing, shall not be eaten, but shall be burnt with fire: he that is clean shall eat of it.
verses.textLatin: Caro, quæ aliquid tetigerit immundum, non comedetur, sed comburetur igni: qui fuerit mundus, vescetur ex ea.

verses.text: If any one that is defiled shall eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which is offered to the Lord, he shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textLatin: Anima polluta quæ ederit de carnibus hostiæ pacificorum, quæ oblata est Domino, peribit de populis suis.

verses.text: And he that hath touched the uncleanness of man, or of beast, or of any thing that can defile, and shall eat of such kind of flesh, shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textLatin: Et quæ tetigerit immunditiam hominis, vel jumenti, sive omnis rei quæ polluere potest, et comederit de hujuscemodi carnibus, interibit de populis suis.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Say to the children of Israel: The fat of a sheep, and of an ox, and of a goat you shall not eat.
verses.textLatin: Loquere filiis Israël: Adipem ovis, et bovis, et capræ non comedetis.

verses.text: The fat of a carcass that hath died of itself, and of a beast that was caught by another beast, you shall have for divers uses.
verses.textLatin: Adipem cadaveris morticini, et ejus animalis, quod a bestia captum est, habebitis in varios usus.

verses.text: If any man eat the fat that should be offered for the burnt sacrifice of the Lord, he shall perish out of his people.
verses.textLatin: Si quis adipem, qui offerri debet in incensum Domini, comederit, peribit de populo suo.

verses.text: Moreover you shall not eat the blood of any creature whatsoever, whether of birds or beasts.
verses.textLatin: Sanguinem quoque omnis animalis non sumetis in cibo, tam de avibus quam de pecoribus.

verses.text: Every one that eateth blood, shall perish from among the people.
verses.textLatin: Omnis anima, quæ ederit sanguinem, peribit de populis suis.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying: He that offereth a victim of peace offerings to the Lord, let him offer therewith a sacrifice also, that is, the libations thereof.
verses.textLatin: Loquere filiis Israël, dicens: Qui offert victimam pacificorum Domino, offerat simul et sacrificium, id est, libamenta ejus.

verses.text: He shall hold in his hands the fat of the victim, and the breast: and when he hath offered and consecrated both to the Lord, he shall deliver them to the priest,
verses.textLatin: Tenebit manibus adipem hostiæ, et pectusculum: cumque ambo oblata Domino consecraverit, tradet sacerdoti,

verses.text: Who shall burn the fat upon the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.textLatin: qui adolebit adipem super altare, pectusculum autem erit Aaron et filiorum ejus.

verses.text: The right shoulder also of the victims of peace offerings shall fall to the priest for firstfruits.
verses.textLatin: Armus quoque dexter de pacificorum hostiis cedet in primitias sacerdotis.

verses.text: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood, and the fat, he shall have the right shoulder also for his portion.
verses.textLatin: Qui obtulerit sanguinem et adipem filiorum Aaron, ipse habebit et armum dextrum in portione sua.

verses.text: For the breast that is elevated and the shoulder that is separated I have taken of the children of Israel, from off their victims of peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest, and to his sons, by a law for ever, from all the people of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Pectusculum enim elevationis, et armum separationis, tuli a filiis Israël de hostiis eorum pacificis, et dedi Aaron sacerdoti, et filiis ejus, lege perpetua, ab omni populo Israël.

verses.text: This is the anointing of Aaron and his sons, in the ceremonies of the Lord, in the day when Moses offered them, that they might do the office of priesthood,
verses.textLatin: Hæc est unctio Aaron et filiorum ejus in cæremoniis Domini die qua obtulit eos Moyses, ut sacerdotio fungerentur,

verses.text: And the things that the Lord commanded to be given them by the children of Israel, by a perpetual observance in their generations.
verses.textLatin: et quæ præcepit eis dari Dominus a filiis Israël religione perpetua in generationibus suis.

verses.text: This is the law of holocaust, and of the sacrifice for sin, and for trespass, and for consecration, and the victims of peace offerings:
verses.textLatin: Ista est lex holocausti, et sacrificii pro peccato atque delicto, et pro consecratione et pacificorum victimis,

verses.text: Which the Lord appointed to Moses in mount Sinai, when he commanded the children of Israel, that they should offer their oblations to the Lord in the desert of Sinai.
verses.textLatin: quam constituit Dominus Moysi in monte Sinai, quando mandabit filiis Israël ut offerrent oblationes suas Domino in deserto Sinai.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Take Aaron with his sons, their vestments, and the oil of unction, a calf for sin, two rams, a basket with unleavened bread,
verses.textLatin: Tolle Aaron cum filiis suis, vestes eorum, et unctionis oleum, vitulum pro peccato, duos arietes, canistrum cum azymis:

verses.text: And thou shalt gather together all the congregation to the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: et congregabis omnem cœtum ad ostium tabernaculi.

verses.text: And Moses did as the Lord had commanded. And all the multitude being gathered together before the door of the tabernacle,
verses.textLatin: Fecit Moyses ut Dominus imperaverat. Congregataque omni turba ante fores tabernaculi,

verses.text: He said: This is the word that the Lord hath commanded to be done.
verses.textLatin: ait: Iste est sermo, quem jussit Dominus fieri.

verses.text: And immediately he offered Aaron and his sons: and when he had washed them,
verses.textLatin: Statimque obtulit Aaron et filios ejus. Cumque lavisset eos,

verses.text: He vested the high priest with the strait linen garment, girding him with the girdle, and putting on him the violet tunick, and over it he put the ephod,
verses.textLatin: vestivit pontificem subucula linea, accingens eum balteo, et induens eum tunica hyacinthina, et desuper humerale imposuit,

verses.text: And binding it with the girdle, he fitted it to the rational, on which was Doctrine and Truth.
verses.textLatin: quod astringens cingulo aptavit rationali, in quo erat Doctrina et Veritas.

verses.text: He put also the mitre upon his head: and upon the mitre over the forehead, he put the plate of gold, consecrated with sanctification, as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textLatin: Cidari quoque texit caput: et super eam, contra frontem, posuit laminam auream consecratam in sanctificatione, sicut præceperat ei Dominus.

verses.text: He took also the oil of unction, with which he anointed the tabernacle, with all the furniture thereof.
verses.textLatin: Tulit et unctionis oleum, quo linivit tabernaculum cum omni supellectili sua.

verses.text: And when he had sanctified and sprinkled the altar seven times, he anointed it, and all the vessels thereof, and the laver with the foot thereof, he sanctified with the oil.
verses.textLatin: Cumque sanctificans aspersisset altare septem vicibus, unxit illud, et omnia vasa ejus, labrumque cum basi sua sanctificavit oleo.

verses.text: And he poured it upon Aaron’s head, and he anointed and consecrated him:
verses.textLatin: Quod fundens super caput Aaron, unxit eum, et consecravit:

verses.text: And after he had offered his sons, he vested them with linen tunicks, and girded them with girdles, and put mitres on them as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: filios quoque ejus oblatos vestivit tunicis lineis, et cinxit balteis, imposuitque mitras, ut jusserat Dominus.

verses.text: He offered also the calf for sin: and when Aaron and his sons had put their hands upon the head thereof,
verses.textLatin: Obtulit et vitulum pro peccato: cumque super caput ejus posuisset Aaron et filii ejus manus suas,

verses.text: He immolated it: and took the blood, and dipping his finger in it, he touched the horns of the altar round about. Which being expiated, and sanctified, he poured the rest of the blood at the bottom thereof.
verses.textLatin: immolavit eum, hauriens sanguinem, et tincto digito, tetigit cornua altaris per gyrum: quo expiato et sanctificato, fudit reliquum sanguinem ad fundamenta ejus.

verses.text: But the fat that was upon the entrails, and the caul of the liver, and the two little kidneys, with their fat, he burnt upon the altar:
verses.textLatin: Adipem vero qui erat super vitalia, et reticulum jecoris, duosque renunculos, cum arvinulis suis, adolevit super altare:

verses.text: And the calf with the skin, and the flesh and the dung, he burnt without the camp, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: vitulum cum pelle, et carnibus, et fimo, cremans extra castra, sicut præceperat Dominus.

verses.text: He offered also a ram for holocaust: and when Aaron and his sons had put their hands upon its head,
verses.textLatin: Obtulit et arietem in holocaustum: super cujus caput cum imposuissent Aaron et filii ejus manus suas,

verses.text: He immolated it, and poured the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.textLatin: immolavit eum, et fudit sanguinem ejus per circuitum altaris.

verses.text: And cutting the ram into pieces, the head thereof, and the joints, and the fat he burnt in the fire,
verses.textLatin: Ipsumque arietem in frusta concidens, caput ejus, et artus, et adipem adolevit igni,

verses.text: Having first washed the entrails, and the feet, and the whole ram together he burnt upon the altar, because it was a holocaust of most sweet odour to the Lord, as he had commanded him.
verses.textLatin: lotis prius intestinis et pedibus: totumque simul arietem incendit super altare, eo quod esset holocaustum suavissimi odoris Domino, sicut præceperat ei.

verses.text: He offered also the second ram, in the consecration of priests: and Aaron, and his sons put their hands upon the head thereof:
verses.textLatin: Obtulit et arietem secundum in consecratione sacerdotum, posueruntque super caput ejus Aaron et filii ejus manus suas:

verses.text: And when Moses had immolated it, he took of the blood thereof, and touched the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and the thumb of his right hand, and in like manner also the great toe of his right foot.
verses.textLatin: quem cum immolasset Moyses, sumens de sanguine ejus, tetigit extremum auriculæ dextræ Aaron, et pollicem manus ejus dextræ, similiter et pedis.

verses.text: He offered also the sons of Aaron: and when with the blood of the ram that was immolated, he had touched the tip of the right ear of every one of them, and the thumbs of their right hands, and the great toes of their right feet, the rest he poured on the altar round about:
verses.textLatin: Obtulit et filios Aaron: cumque de sanguine arietis immolati tetigisset extremum auriculæ singulorum dextræ, et pollices manus ac pedis dextri, reliquum fudit super altare per circuitum:

verses.text: But the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that covereth the entrails, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and with the right shoulder, he separated.
verses.textLatin: adipem vero, et caudam, omnemque pinguedinem quæ operit intestina, reticulumque jecoris, et duos renes cum adipibus suis et armo dextro separavit.

verses.text: And taking out of the basket of unleavened bread, which was before the Lord, a loaf without leaven, and a cake tempered with oil and a wafer, he put them upon the fat, and the right shoulder,
verses.textLatin: Tollens autem de canistro azymorum, quod erat coram Domino, panem absque fermento, et collyridam conspersam oleo, laganumque, posuit super adipes, et armum dextrum,

verses.text: Delivering all to Aaron, and to his sons: who having lifted them up before the Lord,
verses.textLatin: tradens simul omnia Aaron et filiis ejus. Qui postquam levaverunt ea coram Domino,

verses.text: He took them again from their hands, and burnt them upon the altar of holocaust, because it was the oblation of consecration, for a sweet odour of sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: rursum suscepta de manibus eorum, adolevit super altare holocausti, eo quod consecrationis esset oblatio, in odorem suavitatis, sacrificii Domino.

verses.text: And he took of the ram of consecration, the breast for his portion, elevating it before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textLatin: Tulitque pectusculum, elevans illud coram Domino, de ariete consecrationis in partem suam, sicut præceperat ei Dominus.

verses.text: And taking the ointment, and the blood that was upon the altar, he sprinkled Aaron, and his vestments, and his sons, and their vestments with it.
verses.textLatin: Assumensque unguentum, et sanguinem qui erat in altari, aspersit super Aaron et vestimenta ejus, et super filios illius ac vestes eorum.

verses.text: And when he had sanctified them in their vestments, he commanded them, saying: Boil the flesh before the door of the tabernacle, and there eat it. Eat ye also the loaves of consecration, that are laid in the basket, as the Lord commanded me, saying: Aaron and his sons shall eat them:
verses.textLatin: Cumque sanctificasset eos in vestitu suo, præcepit eis, dicens: Coquite carnes ante fores tabernaculi, et ibi comedite eas; panes quoque consecrationis edite, qui positi sunt in canistro, sicut præcepit mihi Dominus, dicens: Aaron et filii ejus comedent eos:

verses.text: And whatsoever shall be left of the flesh and the loaves, shall be consumed with fire.
verses.textLatin: quidquid autem reliquum fuerit de carne et panibus, ignis absumet.

verses.text: And you shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle for seven days, until the day wherein the time of your consecration shall be expired. For in seven days the consecration is finished:
verses.textLatin: De ostio quoque tabernaculi non exibitis septem diebus, usque ad diem quo complebitur tempus consecrationis vestræ; septem enim diebus finitur consecratio:

verses.text: As at this present it hath been done, that the rite of the sacrifice might be accomplished.
verses.textLatin: sicut et impræsentiarum factum est, ut ritus sacrificii compleretur.

verses.text: Day and night shall you remain in the tabernacle observing the watches of the Lord, lest you die: for so it hath been commanded me.
verses.textLatin: Die ac nocte manebitis in tabernaculo observantes custodias Domini, ne moriamini: sic enim mihi præceptum est.

verses.text: And Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord spoke by the hand of Moses.
verses.textLatin: Feceruntque Aaron et filii ejus cuncta quæ locutus est Dominus per manum Moysi.

verses.text: And  when the eighth day was come, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the ancients of Israel, and said to Aaron:
verses.textLatin: Facto autem octavo die, vocavit Moyses Aaron, et filios ejus, ac majores natu Israël, dixitque ad Aaron:

verses.text: Take of the herd a calf for sin, and a ram for a holocaust, both without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Tolle de armento vitulum pro peccato, et arietem in holocaustum, utrumque immaculatum, et offer illos coram Domino.

verses.text: And to the children of Israel thou shalt say: Take ye a he goat for sin, and a calf, and a lamb, both of a year old, and without blemish for a holocaust,
verses.textLatin: Et ad filios Israël loqueris: Tollite hircum pro peccato, et vitulum, atque agnum, anniculos, et sine macula in holocaustum,

verses.text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings: and immolate them before the Lord, offering for the sacrifice of every one of them flour tempered with oil; for to day the Lord will appear to you.
verses.textLatin: bovem et arietem pro pacificis: et immolate eos coram Domino, in sacrificio singulorum similam conspersam oleo offerentes: hodie enim Dominus apparebit vobis.

verses.text: They brought therefore all things that Moses had commanded before the door of the tabernacle: where when all the multitude stood,
verses.textLatin: Tulerunt ergo cuncta quæ jusserat Moyses ad ostium tabernaculi: ubi cum omnis multitudo astaret,

verses.text: Moses said: This is the word, which the Lord hath commanded: do it, and his glory will appear to you.
verses.textLatin: ait Moyses: Iste est sermo, quem præcepit Dominus: facite, et apparebit vobis gloria ejus.

verses.text: And he said to Aaron: Approach to the altar, and offer sacrifice for thy sin: offer the holocaust, and pray for thyself and for the people: and when thou hast slain the people’s victim, pray for them, as the Lord hath commanded.
verses.textLatin: Et dixit ad Aaron: Accede ad altare, et immola pro peccato tuo: offer holocaustum, et deprecare pro te et pro populo: cumque mactaveris hostiam populi, ora pro eo, sicut præcepit Dominus.

verses.text: And forthwith Aaron, approaching to the altar, immolated the calf for his sin:
verses.textLatin: Statimque Aaron accedens ad altare, immolavit vitulum pro peccato suo:

verses.text: And his sons brought him the blood of it: and he dipped his finger therein, and touched the horns of the altar, and poured the rest at the foot thereof.
verses.textLatin: cujus sanguinem obtulerunt ei filii sui: in quo tingens digitum, tetigit cornua altaris, et fudit residuum ad basim ejus.

verses.text: And the fat, and the little kidneys, and the caul of the liver, which are for sin, he burnt upon the altar, as the Lord had commanded Moses:
verses.textLatin: Adipemque, et renunculos, ac reticulum jecoris, quæ sunt pro peccato, adolevit super altare, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi:

verses.text: But the flesh and skins thereof he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.textLatin: carnes vero et pellem ejus extra castra combussit igni.

verses.text: He immolated also the victim of holocaust: and his sons brought him the blood thereof, which he poured round about on the altar.
verses.textLatin: Immolavit et holocausti victimam: obtuleruntque ei filii sui sanguinem ejus, quem fudit per altaris circuitum.

verses.text: And the victim being cut into pieces, they brought to him the head and all the members, all which he burnt with fire upon the altar,
verses.textLatin: Ipsam etiam hostiam in frusta concisam, cum capite et membris singulis obtulerunt; quæ omnia super altare cremavit igni,

verses.text: Having first washed the entrails and the feet with water.
verses.textLatin: lotis aqua prius intestinis et pedibus.

verses.text: Then offering for the sin of the people, he slew the he goat: and expiating the altar,
verses.textLatin: Et pro peccato populi offerens, mactavit hircum: expiatoque altari,

verses.text: He offered the holocaust:
verses.textLatin: fecit holocaustum,

verses.text: Adding in the sacrifice the libations, which are offered withal, and burning them upon the altar, besides the ceremonies of the morning holocaust.
verses.textLatin: addens in sacrificio libamenta, quæ pariter offeruntur, et adolens ea super altare, absque cæremoniis holocausti matutini.

verses.text: He immolated also the bullock and the ram, the peace offerings of the people: and his sons brought him the blood, which he poured upon the altar round about.
verses.textLatin: Immolavit et bovem atque arietem, hostias pacificas populi: obtuleruntque ei filii sui sanguinem, quem fudit super altare in circuitum.

verses.text: The fat also of the bullock, and the rump of the ram, and the two little kidneys, with their fat, and the caul of the liver,
verses.textLatin: Adipem autem bovis, et caudam arietis, renunculosque cum adipibus suis, et reticulum jecoris,

verses.text: They put upon the breasts. And after the fat was burnt upon the altar,
verses.textLatin: posuerunt super pectora: cumque cremati essent adipes super altare,

verses.text: Aaron separated their breasts, and the right shoulders, elevating them before the Lord, as Moses had commanded.
verses.textLatin: pectora eorum, et armos dextros separavit Aaron, elevans coram Domino, sicut præceperat Moyses.

verses.text: And stretching forth his hands to the people, he blessed them. And so the victims for sin, and the holocausts, and the peace offerings being finished, he came down.
verses.textLatin: Et extendens manus ad populum, benedixit ei. Sicque completis hostiis pro peccato, et holocaustis, et pacificis, descendit.

verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the testimony, and afterwards came forth and blessed the people. And the glory of the Lord appeared to all the multitude:
verses.textLatin: Ingressi autem Moyses et Aaron in tabernaculum testimonii, et deinceps egressi, benedixerunt populo. Apparuitque gloria Domini omni multitudini:

verses.text: And behold a fire, coming forth from the Lord, devoured the holocaust, and the fat that was upon the altar: which when the multitude saw, they praised the Lord, falling on their faces.
verses.textLatin: et ecce egressus ignis a Domino, devoravit holocaustum, et adipes qui erant super altare. Quod cum vidissent turbæ, laudaverunt Dominum, ruentes in facies suas.

verses.text: And  Nadab and Abiu, the sons of Aaron, taking their censers, put fire therein, and incense on it, offering before the Lord strange fire: which was not commanded them.
verses.textLatin: Arreptisque Nadab et Abiu filii Aaron thuribulis, posuerunt ignem, et incensum desuper, offerentes coram Domino ignem alienum: quod eis præceptum non erat.

verses.text: And fire coming out from the Lord destroyed them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Egressusque ignis a Domino, devoravit eos, et mortui sunt coram Domino.

verses.text: And Moses said to Aaron: This is what the Lord hath spoken: I will be sanctified in them that approach to me, and I will be glorified in the sight of all the people. And when Aaron heard this, he held his peace.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Moyses ad Aaron: Hoc est quod locutus est Dominus: Sanctificabor in iis qui appropinquant mihi, et in conspectu omnis populi glorificabor. Quod audiens tacuit Aaron.

verses.text: And Moses called Misael and Elisaphan, the sons of Oziel, the uncle of Aaron, and said to them: Go and take away your brethren from before the sanctuary, and carry them without the camp.
verses.textLatin: Vocatis autem Moyses Misaële et Elisaphan filiis Oziel, patrui Aaron, ait ad eos: Ite, et tollite fratres vestros de conspectu sanctuarii, et asportate extra castra.

verses.text: And they went forthwith and took them as they lay, vested with linen tunicks, and cast them forth, as had been commanded them.
verses.textLatin: Confestimque pergentes, tulerunt eos sicut jacebant, vestitos lineis tunicis, et ejecerunt foras, ut sibi fuerat imperatum.

verses.text: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons: Uncover not your heads, and rend not your garments, lest perhaps you die, and indignation come upon all the congregation. Let your brethren, and all the house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord has kindled:
