verses.text: From one month until the fifth year, for a male shall be given five sicles: for a female three.
verses.textLatin: Ab uno mense usque ad annum quintum, pro masculo dabuntur quinque sicli: pro femina, tres.

verses.text: A man that is sixty years old or upward, shall give fifteen sicles: a woman ten.
verses.textLatin: Sexagenarius et ultra masculus dabit quindecim siclos: femina, decem.

verses.text: If he be poor, and not able to pay the estimation, he shall stand before the priest: and as much as he shall value him at, and see him able to pay, so much shall he give.
verses.textLatin: Si pauper fuerit, et æstimationem reddere non valebit, stabit coram sacerdote: et quantum ille æstimaverit, et viderit eum posse reddere, tantum dabit.

verses.text: But a beast that may be sacrificed to the Lord, if any one shall vow, shall be holy,
verses.textLatin: Animal autem, quod immolari potest Domino, si quis voverit, sanctum erit,

verses.text: And cannot be changed, that is to say, neither a better for a worse, nor a worse for a better. And if he shall change it: both that which was changed, and that for which it was changed, shall be consecrated to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et mutari non poterit, id est, nec melius malo, nec pejus bono: quod si mutaverit, et ipsum quod mutatum est, et illud pro quo mutatum est, consecratum erit Domino.

verses.text: An unclean beast, which cannot be sacrificed to the Lord, if any man shall vow, shall be brought before the priest:
verses.textLatin: Animal immundum, quod immolari Domino non potest, si quis voverit, adducetur ante sacerdotem:

verses.text: Who judging whether it be good or bad, shall set the price:
verses.textLatin: qui judicans utrum bonum an malum sit, statuet pretium.

verses.text: Which if he that offereth it will give, he shall add above the estimation the fifth part.
verses.textLatin: Quod si dare voluerit is qui offert, addet supra æstimationem quintam partem.

verses.text: If a man shall vow his house, and sanctify it to the Lord, the priest shall consider it, whether it be good or bad, and it shall be sold according to the price, which he shall appoint.
verses.textLatin: Homo si voverit domum suam, et sanctificaverit Domino, considerabit eam sacerdos utrum bona an mala sit, et juxta pretium, quod ab eo fuerit constitutum, venundabitur:

verses.text: But if he that vowed, will redeem it, he shall give the fifth part of the estimation over and above, and shall have the house.
verses.textLatin: sin autem ille qui voverat, voluerit redimere eam, dabit quintam partem æstimationis supra, et habebit domum.

verses.text: And if he vow the field of his possession, and consecrate it to the Lord, the price shall be rated according to the measure of the seed. If the ground be sowed with thirty bushels of barley, let it be sold for fifty sicles of silver.
verses.textLatin: Quod si agrum possessionis suæ voverit, et consecraverit Domino, juxta mensuram sementis æstimabitur pretium: si triginta modiis hordei seritur terra, quinquaginta siclis venundetur argenti.

verses.text: If he vow his field immediately from the year of jubilee that is beginning, as much as it may be worth, at so much it shall be rated.
verses.textLatin: Si statim ab anno incipientis jubilæi voverit agrum, quanto valere potest, tanto æstimabitur.

verses.text: But if some time after, the priest shall reckon the money according to the number of years that remain until the jubilee, and the price shall be abated.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem post aliquantum temporis, supputabit sacerdos pecuniam juxta annorum, qui reliqui sunt, numerum usque ad jubilæum, et detrahetur ex pretio.

verses.text: And if he that had vowed, will redeem his field, he shall add the fifth part of the money of the estimation, and shall possess it.
verses.textLatin: Quod si voluerit redimere agrum ille qui voverat, addet quintam partem æstimatæ pecuniæ, et possidebit eum.

verses.text: And if he will not redeem it, but it be sold to any other man, he that vowed it, may not redeem it any more:
verses.textLatin: Sin autem noluerit redimere, sed alteri cuilibet fuerit venundatus, ultra eum qui voverat redimere non poterit.

verses.text: For when the day of jubilee cometh, it shall be sanctified to the Lord, and as a possession consecrated, pertaineth to the right of the priests.
verses.textLatin: Quia cum jubilæi venerit dies, sanctificatus erit Domino, et possessio consecrata ad jus pertinet sacerdotum.

verses.text: If a field that was bought, and not of a man’s ancestors’ possession, be sanctified to the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Si ager emptus est, et non de possessione majorum sanctificatus fuerit Domino,

verses.text: The priest shall reckon the price according to the number of years: unto the jubilee: and he that had vowed, shall give that to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: supputabit sacerdos juxta annorum numerum usque ad jubilæum, pretium: et dabit ille qui voverat eum, Domino.

verses.text: But in the jubilee, it shall return to the former owner, who had sold it, and had it in the lot of his possession.
verses.textLatin: In jubilæo autem revertetur ad priorem dominum, qui vendiderat eum, et habuerat in sorte possessionis suæ.

verses.text: All estimation shall be made according to the sicle of the sanctuary. A sicle hath twenty obols.
verses.textLatin: Omnis æstimatio siclo sanctuarii ponderabitur. Siclus viginti obolos habet.

verses.text: The firstborn, which belong to the Lord, no man may sanctify and vow: whether it be bullock, or sheep, they are the Lord’s.
verses.textLatin: Primogenita, quæ ad Dominum pertinent, nemo sanctificare poterit et vovere: sive bos, sive ovis fuerit, Domini sunt.

verses.text: And if it be an unclean beast, he that offereth it shall redeem it, according to thy estimation, and shall add the fifth part of the price. If he will not redeem it, it shall be sold to another for how much soever it was estimated by thee.
verses.textLatin: Quod si immundum est animal, redimet qui obtulit, juxta æstimationem tuam, et addet quintam partem pretii: si redimere noluerit, vendetur alteri quantocumque a te fuerit æstimatum.

verses.text: Any thing that is devoted to the Lord, whether it be man, or beast, or field, shall not be sold, neither may it be redeemed. Whatsoever is once consecrated shall be holy of holies to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Omne quod Domino consecratur, sive homo fuerit, sive animal, sive ager, non vendetur, nec redimi poterit. Quidquid semel fuerit consecratum, Sanctum sanctorum erit Domino:

verses.text: And any consecration that is offered by man, shall not be redeemed, but dying shall die.
verses.textLatin: et omnis consecratio, quæ offertur ab homine, non redimetur, sed morte morietur.

verses.text: All tithes of the land, whether of corn, or of the fruits of trees, are the Lord’s, and are sanctified to him.
verses.textLatin: Omnes decimæ terræ, sive de frugibus, sive de pomis arborum, Domini sunt, et illi sanctificantur.

verses.text: And if any man will redeem his tithes, he shall add the fifth part of them.
verses.textLatin: Si quis autem voluerit redimere decimas suas, addet quintam partem earum.

verses.text: Of all the tithes of oxen, and sheep, and goats, that pass under the shepherd’s rod, every tenth that cometh shall be sanctified to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Omnium decimarum bovis et ovis et capræ, quæ sub pastoris virga transeunt, quidquid decimum venerit, sanctificabitur Domino.

verses.text: It shall not be chosen neither good nor bad, neither shall it be changed for another. If any man change it: both that which was changed, and that for which it was changed, shall be sanctified to the Lord, and shall not be redeemed.
verses.textLatin: Non eligetur nec bonum nec malum, nec altero commutabitur, si quis mutaverit: et quod mutatum est, et pro quo mutatum est, sanctificabitur Domino, et non redimetur.

verses.text: These are the precepts which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.textLatin: Hæc sunt præcepta, quæ mandavit Dominus Moysi ad filios Israël in monte Sinai.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai in the tabernacle of the covenant, the first day of the second month, the second year of their going out of Egypt, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in deserto Sinai in tabernaculo fœderis, prima die mensis secundi, anno altero egressionis eorum ex Ægypto, dicens:

verses.text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel by their families, and houses, and the names of every one, as many as are of the male sex,
verses.textLatin: Tollite summam universæ congregationis filiorum Israël per cognationes et domos suas, et nomina singulorum, quidquid sexus est masculini

verses.text: From twenty years old and upwards, of all the men of Israel fit for war, and you shall number them by their troops, thou and Aaron.
verses.textLatin: a vigesimo anno et supra, omnium virorum fortium ex Israël, et numerabitis eos per turmas suas, tu et Aaron.

verses.text: And there shall be with you the princes of the tribes, and of the houses in their kindreds,
verses.textLatin: Eruntque vobiscum principes tribuum ac domorum in cognationibus suis,

verses.text: Whose names are these: Of Ruben, Elisur the son of Sedeur.
verses.textLatin: quorum ista sunt nomina: de Ruben, Elisur, filius Sedeur;

verses.text: Of Simeon, Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
verses.textLatin: de Simeon, Salamiel filius Surisaddai;

verses.text: Of Juda, Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
verses.textLatin: de Juda, Nahasson filius Aminadab;

verses.text: Of Issachar, Nathanael the son of Suar.
verses.textLatin: de Issachar, Nathanaël filius Suar;

verses.text: Of Zabulon, Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.textLatin: de Zabulon, Eliab filius Helon;

verses.text: And of the sons of Joseph: of Ephraim, Elisama the son of Ammiud: of Manasses, Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
verses.textLatin: filiorum autem Joseph, de Ephraim, Elisama filius Ammiud; de Manasse, Gamaliel filius Phadassur;

verses.text: Of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gedeon.
verses.textLatin: de Benjamin, Abidan filius Gedeonis;

verses.text: Of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammisaddai.
verses.textLatin: de Dan, Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai;

verses.text: Of Aser, Phegiel the son of Ochran.
verses.textLatin: de Aser, Phegiel filius Ochran;

verses.text: Of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Duel.
verses.textLatin: de Gad, Eliasaph filius Duel;

verses.text: Of Nephtali, Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.textLatin: de Nephthali, Ahira filius Enan.

verses.text: These are the most noble princes of the multitude by their tribes and kindreds, and the chiefs of the army of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Hi nobilissimi principes multitudinis per tribus et cognationes suas, et capita exercitus Israël,

verses.text: Whom Moses and Aaron took with all the multitude of the common people:
verses.textLatin: quos tulerunt Moyses et Aaron cum omni vulgi multitudine:

verses.text: And assembled them on the first day of the second month, reckoning them up by the kindreds, and houses, and families, and heads, and names of every one from twenty years old and upward,
verses.textLatin: et congregaverunt primo die mensis secundi, recensentes eos per cognationes, et domos, ac familias, et capita, et nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra,

verses.text: As the Lord had commanded Moses. And they were numbered in the desert of Sinai.
verses.textLatin: sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi. Numeratique sunt in deserto Sinai.

verses.text: Of Ruben the eldest son of Israel, by their generations and families and houses and names of every head, all that were of the male sex, from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De Ruben primogenito Israëlis per generationes et familias ac domos suas, et nomina capitum singulorum, omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno et supra, procedentium ad bellum,

verses.text: Were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: quadraginta sex millia quingenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Simeon by their generations and families, and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names and heads of every one, all that were of the male sex, from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Simeon per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina et capita singulorum, omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno et supra, procedentium ad bellum,

verses.text: Fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.textLatin: quinquaginta novem millia trecenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Gad, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Gad per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui ad bella procederent,

verses.text: Forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.textLatin: quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti quinquaginta.

verses.text: Of the sons of Juda, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Juda per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum, per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Were reckoned up seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.textLatin: recensiti sunt septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Issachar, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that could go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Issachar, per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum, per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui ad bella procederent,

verses.text: Were reckoned up fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: recensiti sunt quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Zabulon, by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Zabulon per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: quinquaginta septem millia quadringenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Joseph, namely, of the sons of Ephraim, by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Joseph, filiorum Ephraim per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Forty thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: quadraginta millia quingenti.

verses.text: Moreover of the sons of Manasses, by the generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that could go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: Porro filiorum Manasse per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.textLatin: triginta duo millia ducenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Benjamin, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Benjamin per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: triginta quinque millia quadringenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Dan, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Dan per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.textLatin: sexaginta duo millia septingenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Aser, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Aser per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Forty-one thousand and five hundred.
verses.textLatin: quadraginta millia et mille quingenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Nephtali, by their generations and families and houses of their kindreds, were reckoned up by the names of every one from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Nephthali per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.

verses.text: These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron, and the twelve princes of Israel, every one by the houses of their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt, quos numeraverunt Moyses et Aaron, et duodecim principes Israël, singulos per domos cognationum suarum.

verses.text: And the whole number of the children of Israel by their houses and families, from twenty years old and upward, that were able to go to war,
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque omnis numerus filiorum Israël per domos et familias suas a vigesimo anno et supra, qui poterant ad bella procedere,

verses.text: Were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty men.
verses.textLatin: sexcenta tria millia virorum quingenti quinquaginta.

verses.text: But the Levites in the tribes of their families were not numbered with them.
verses.textLatin: Levitæ autem in tribu familiarum suarum non sunt numerati cum eis.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Number not the tribe of Levi, neither shalt thou put down the sum of them with the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Tribum Levi noli numerare, neque pones summam eorum cum filiis Israël:

verses.text: But appoint them over the tabernacle of the testimony, and all the vessels thereof, and whatsoever pertaineth to the ceremonies. They shall carry the tabernacle and all the furniture thereof: and they shall minister, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: sed constitue eos super tabernaculum testimonii et cuncta vasa ejus, et quidquid ad cæremonias pertinet. Ipsi portabunt tabernaculum et omnia utensilia ejus: et erunt in ministerio, ac per gyrum tabernaculi metabuntur.

verses.text: When you are to go forward, the Levites shall take down the tabernacle: when you are to camp, they shall set it up. What stranger soever cometh to it, shall be slain.
verses.textLatin: Cum proficiscendum fuerit, deponent Levitæ tabernaculum; cum castrametandum, erigent. Quisquis externorum accesserit, occidetur.

verses.text: And the children of Israel shall camp every man by his troops and bands and army.
verses.textLatin: Metabuntur autem castra filii Israël unusquisque per turmas et cuneos atque exercitum suum.

verses.text: But the Levites shall pitch their tents round about the tabernacle, lest there come indignation upon the multitude of the children of Israel, and they shall keep watch, and guard the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: Porro Levitæ per gyrum tabernaculi figent tentoria, ne fiat indignatio super multitudinem filiorum Israël, et excubabunt in custodiis tabernaculi testimonii.

verses.text: And the children of Israel did according to all things which the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: Fecerunt ergo filii Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:

verses.text: All the children of Israel shall camp by their troops, ensigns, and standards, and the houses of their kindreds, round about the tabernacle of the covenant.
verses.textLatin: Singuli per turmas, signa, atque vexilla, et domos cognationum suarum, castrametabuntur filii Israël, per gyrum tabernaculi fœderis.

verses.text: On the east Juda shall pitch his tents by the bands of his army: and the prince of his sons shall be Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
verses.textLatin: Ad orientem Judas figet tentoria per turmas exercitus sui: eritque princeps filiorum ejus Nahasson filius Aminadab.

verses.text: And the whole sum of the fighting men of his stock, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.textLatin: Et omnis de stirpe ejus summa pugnantium, septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.

verses.text: Next unto him they of the tribe of Issachar encamped, whose prince was Nathanael, the son of Suar.
verses.textLatin: Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Issachar, quorum princeps fuit Nathanaël filius Suar.

verses.text: And the whole number of his fighting men were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Et omnis numerus pugnatorum ejus quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.

verses.text: In the tribe of Zabulon the prince was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.textLatin: In tribu Zabulon princeps fuit Eliab filius Helon.

verses.text: And all the army of fighting men of his stock, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Omnis de stirpe ejus exercitus pugnatorum, quinquaginta septem millia quadringenti.

verses.text: All that were numbered in the camp of Juda, were a hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred: and they by their troops shall march first.
verses.textLatin: Universi qui in castris Judæ enumerati sunt, fuerunt centum octoginta sex millia quadringenti: et per turmas suas primi egredientur.

verses.text: In the camp of the sons of Ruben, on the south side, the prince shall be Elisur the son of Sedeur:
verses.textLatin: In castris filiorum Ruben ad meridianam plagam erit princeps Elisur filius Sedeur.

verses.text: And the whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt, quadraginta sex millia quingenti.

verses.text: Beside him camped they of the tribe of Simeon: whose prince was Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
verses.textLatin: Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Simeon: quorum princeps fuit Salamiel filius Surisaddai.

verses.text: And the whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.textLatin: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt, quinquaginta novem millia trecenti.

verses.text: In the tribe of Gad the prince was Eliasaph the son of Duel.
verses.textLatin: In tribu Gad princeps fuit Eliasaph filius Duel.

verses.text: And the whole army of his fighting men that were numbered, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.textLatin: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti quinquaginta.

verses.text: All that were reckoned up in the camp of Ruben, were a hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, by their troops: they shall march in the second place.
verses.textLatin: Omnes qui recensiti sunt in castris Ruben, centum quinquaginta millia et mille quadringenti quinquaginta per turmas suas: in secundo loco proficiscentur.

verses.text: And the tabernacle of the testimony shall be carried by the officers of the Levites and their troops. As it shall be set up, so shall it be taken down. Every one shall march according to their places, and ranks.
verses.textLatin: Levabitur autem tabernaculum testimonii per officia Levitarum, et turmas eorum: quomodo erigetur, ita et deponetur. Singuli per loca et ordines suos proficiscentur.

verses.text: On the west side shall be the camp of the sons of Ephraim, whose prince was Elisama the son of Ammiud.
verses.textLatin: Ad occidentalem plagam erunt castra filiorum Ephraim, quorum princeps fuit Elisama filius Ammiud.

verses.text: The whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta millia quingenti.

verses.text: And with them the tribe of the sons of Manasses, whose prince was Gamaliel the son of Phadassur.
verses.textLatin: Et cum eis tribus filiorum Manasse, quorum princeps fuit Gamaliel filius Phadassur.

verses.text: And the whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.textLatin: Cunctusque exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, triginta duo millia ducenti.

verses.text: In the tribe of the sons of Benjamin the prince was Abidan the son of Gedeon.
verses.textLatin: In tribu filiorum Benjamin princeps fuit Abidan filius Gedeonis.

verses.text: And the whole army of his fighting men, that were reckoned up, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui recensiti sunt, triginta quinque millia quadringenti.

verses.text: All that were numbered in the camp of Ephraim, were a hundred and eight thousand one hundred by their troops: they shall march in the third place.
verses.textLatin: Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Ephraim, centum octo millia centum per turmas suas: tertii proficiscentur.

verses.text: On the north side camped the sons of Dan: whose prince was Ahiezar the son of Ammisaddai.
verses.textLatin: Ad aquilonis partem castrametati sunt filii Dan: quorum princeps fuit Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai.

verses.text: The whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.textLatin: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, sexaginta duo millia septingenti.

verses.text: Beside him they of the tribe of Aser pitched their tents: whose prince was Phegiel the son of Ochran.
verses.textLatin: Juxta eum fixere tentoria de tribu Aser: quorum princeps fuit Phegiel filius Ochran.

verses.text: The whole army of his fighting men, that were numbered, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, qui numerati sunt, quadraginta millia et mille quingenti.

verses.text: Of the tribe of the sons of Nephtali the prince was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.textLatin: De tribu filiorum Nephthali princeps fuit Ahira filius Enan.

verses.text: The whole army of his fighting men, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.

verses.text: All that were numbered in the camp of Dan, were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred: and they shall march last.
verses.textLatin: Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Dan, fuerunt centum quinquaginta septem millia sexcenti: et novissimi proficiscentur.

verses.text: This is the number of the children of Israel, of their army divided according to the houses of their kindreds and their troops, six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
verses.textLatin: Hic numerus filiorum Israël, per domos cognationum suarum et turmas divisi exercitus, sexcenta tria millia quingenti quinquaginta.

verses.text: And the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel: for so the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: Levitæ autem non sunt numerati inter filios Israël: sic enim præceperat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: And the children of Israel did according to all things that the Lord had commanded. They camped by their troops, and marched by the families and houses of their fathers.
verses.textLatin: Feceruntque filii Israël juxta omnia quæ mandaverat Dominus. Castrametati sunt per turmas suas, et profecti per familias ac domos patrum suorum.

verses.text: These  are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spoke to Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt generationes Aaron et Moysi in die qua locutus est Dominus ad Moysen in monte Sinai.

verses.text: And these the names of the sons of Aaron: his firstborn Nadab, then Abiu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textLatin: Et hæc nomina filiorum Aaron: primogenitus ejus Nadab, deinde Abiu, et Eleazar, et Ithamar.

verses.text: These the names of the sons of Aaron the priests that were anointed, and whose hands were filled and consecrated, to do the functions of priesthood.
verses.textLatin: Hæc nomina filiorum Aaron sacerdotum qui uncti sunt, et quorum repletæ et consecratæ manus ut sacerdotio fungerentur.

verses.text: Now Nadab and Abiu died, without children, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the desert of Sinai: and Eleazar and Ithamar performed the priestly office in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.textLatin: Mortui sunt enim Nadab et Abiu cum offerrent ignem alienum in conspectu Domini in deserto Sinai, absque liberis: functique sunt sacerdotio Eleazar et Ithamar coram Aaron patre suo.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Bring the tribe of Levi, and make them stand in the sight of Aaron the priest to minister to him, and let them watch,
verses.textLatin: Applica tribum Levi, et fac stare in conspectu Aaron sacerdotis ut ministrent ei, et excubent,

verses.text: And observe whatsoever appertaineth to the service of the multitude before the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.textLatin: et observent quidquid ad cultum pertinet multitudinis coram tabernaculo testimonii,

verses.text: And let them keep the vessels of the tabernacle, serving in the ministry thereof.
verses.textLatin: et custodiant vasa tabernaculi, servientes in ministerio ejus.

verses.text: And thou shalt give the Levites for a gift,
verses.textLatin: Dabisque dono Levitas

verses.text: To Aaron and to his sons, to whom they are delivered by the children of Israel. But thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons over the service of priesthood. The stranger that approacheth to minister, shall be put to death.
verses.textLatin: Aaron et filiis ejus, quibus traditi sunt a filiis Israël. Aaron autem et filios ejus constitues super cultum sacerdotii. Externus, qui ad ministrandum accesserit, morietur.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: I have taken the Levites from the children of Israel, for every firstborn that openeth the womb among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.textLatin: Ego tuli Levitas a filiis Israël pro omni primogenito, qui aperit vulvam in filiis Israël, eruntque Levitæ mei.

verses.text: For every firstborn is mine: since I struck the firstborn in the land of Egypt: I have sanctified to myself whatsoever is firstborn in Israel both of man and beast, they are mine: I am the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Meum est enim omne primogenitum: ex quo percussi primogenitos in terra Ægypti, sanctificavi mihi quidquid primum nascitur in Israël: ab homine usque ad pecus, mei sunt. Ego Dominus.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in deserto Sinai, dicens:

verses.text: Number the sons of Levi by the houses of their fathers and their families, every male from one month and upward.
verses.textLatin: Numera filios Levi per domos patrum suorum et familias, omnem masculum ab uno mense et supra.

verses.text: Moses numbered them as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: Numeravit Moyses, ut præceperat Dominus,

verses.text: And there were found sons of Levi by their names, Gerson and Caath and Merari.
verses.textLatin: et inventi sunt filii Levi per nomina sua, Gerson et Caath et Merari.

verses.text: The sons of Gerson: Lebni and Semei.
verses.textLatin: Filii Gerson: Lebni et Semei.

verses.text: The sons of Caath: Amram, and Jesaar, Hebron and Oziel:
verses.textLatin: Filii Caath: Amram et Jesaar, Hebron et Oziel.

verses.text: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi.
verses.textLatin: Filii Merari: Moholi et Musi.

verses.text: Of Gerson were two families, the Lebnites, and the Semeites:
verses.textLatin: De Gerson fuere familiæ duæ, Lebnitica, et Semeitica:

verses.text: Of which were numbered, people of the male sex from one month and upward, seven thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: quarum numeratus est populus sexus masculini ab uno mense et supra, septem millia quingenti.

verses.text: These shall pitch behind the tabernacle on the west,
verses.textLatin: Hi post tabernaculum metabuntur ad occidentem,

verses.text: Under their prince Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.textLatin: sub principe Eliasaph filio Laël.

verses.text: And their charge shall be in the tabernacle of the covenant:
verses.textLatin: Et habebunt excubias in tabernaculo fœderis,

verses.text: The tabernacle itself and the cover thereof, the hanging that is drawn before the doors of the tabernacle of the covenant, and the curtains of the court: the hanging also that is hanged in the entry of the court of the tabernacle, and whatsoever belongeth to the rite of the altar, the cords of the tabernacle, and all the furniture thereof.
verses.textLatin: ipsum tabernaculum et operimentum ejus, tentorium quod trahitur ante fores tecti fœderis, et cortinas atrii: tentorium quoque quod appenditur in introitu atrii tabernaculi, et quidquid ad ritum altaris pertinet, funes tabernaculi et omnia utensilia ejus.

verses.text: Of the kindred of Caath come the families of the Amramites and Jesaarites and Hebronites and Ozielites. These are the families of the Caathites reckoned up by their names:
verses.textLatin: Cognatio Caath habebit populos Amramitas et Jesaaritas et Hebronitas et Ozielitas. Hæ sunt familiæ Caathitarum recensitæ per nomina sua.

verses.text: All of the male sex from one month and upward, eight thousand six hundred: they shall have the guard of the sanctuary,
verses.textLatin: Omnes generis masculini ab uno mense et supra, octo millia sexcenti habebunt excubias sanctuarii,

verses.text: And shall camp on the south side.
verses.textLatin: et castrametabuntur ad meridianam plagam.

verses.text: And their prince shall be Elisaphan the son of Oziel:
verses.textLatin: Princepsque eorum erit Elisaphan filius Oziel:

verses.text: And they shall keep the ark, and the table and the candlestick, the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary, wherewith they minister, and the veil, and all the furniture of this kind.
verses.textLatin: et custodient arcam, mensamque et candelabrum, altaria et vasa sanctuarii, in quibus ministratur, et velum, cunctamque hujuscemodi supellectilem.

verses.text: And the prince of the princes of the Levites, Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, shall be over them that watch for the guard of the sanctuary.
verses.textLatin: Princeps autem principum Levitarum Eleazar filius Aaron sacerdotis, erit super excubitores custodiæ sanctuarii.

verses.text: And of Merari are the families of the Moholites, and Musites, reckoned up by their names:
verses.textLatin: At vero de Merari erunt populi Moholitæ et Musitæ recensiti per nomina sua:

verses.text: All of the male kind from one month and upward, six thousand two hundred.
verses.textLatin: omnes generis masculini ab uno mense et supra, sex millia ducenti.

verses.text: Their prince Suriel the son of Abihaiel: they shall camp on the north side.
verses.textLatin: Princeps eorum Suriel filius Abihaiel: in plaga septentrionali castrametabuntur.

verses.text: Under their custody shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars, and the pillars and their sockets, and all things that pertain to this kind of service:
verses.textLatin: Erunt sub custodia eorum tabulæ tabernaculi et vectes, et columnæ ac bases earum, et omnia quæ ad cultum hujuscemodi pertinent:

verses.text: And the pillars of the court round about with their sockets, and the pins with their cords.
verses.textLatin: columnæque atrii per circuitum cum basibus suis, et paxilli cum funibus.

verses.text: Before the tabernacle of the covenant, that is to say on the east side, shall Moses and Aaron camp, with their sons, having the custody of the sanctuary, in the midst of the children of Israel. What stranger soever cometh unto it, shall be put to death.
verses.textLatin: Castrametabuntur ante tabernaculum fœderis, id est, ad orientalem plagam, Moyses et Aaron cum filiis suis, habentes custodiam sanctuarii in medio filiorum Israël. Quisquis alienus accesserit, morietur.

verses.text: All the Levites, that Moses and Aaron numbered according to the precept of the Lord, by their families, of the male kind from one month and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.textLatin: Omnes Levitæ, quos numeraverunt Moyses et Aaron juxta præceptum Domini per familias suas in genere masculino a mense uno et supra, fuerunt viginti duo millia.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Moses: Number the firstborn of the male sex of the children of Israel, from one month and upward, and thou shalt take the sum of them.
verses.textLatin: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen: Numera primogenitos sexus masculini de filiis Israël ab uno mense et supra, et habebis summam eorum.

verses.text: And thou shalt take the Levites to me for all the firstborn of the children of Israel, I am the Lord: and their cattle for all the firstborn of the cattle of the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Tollesque Levitas mihi pro omni primogenito filiorum Israël: ego sum Dominus: et pecora eorum pro universis primogenitis pecorum filiorum Israël.

verses.text: Moses reckoned up, as the Lord had commanded, the firstborn of the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Recensuit Moyses, sicut præceperat Dominus, primogenitos filiorum Israël:

verses.text: And the males by their names, from one month and upward, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
verses.textLatin: et fuerunt masculi per nomina sua, a mense uno et supra, viginti duo millia ducenti septuaginta tres.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Take the Levites for the firstborn of the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites for their cattle, and the Levites shall be mine. I am the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Tolle Levitas pro primogenitis filiorum Israël, et pecora Levitarum pro pecoribus eorum, eruntque Levitæ mei. Ego sum Dominus.

verses.text: But for the price of the two hundred and seventy-three, of the firstborn of the children of Israel, that exceed the number of the Levites,
verses.textLatin: In pretio autem ducentorum septuaginta trium, qui excedunt numerum Levitarum de primogenitis filiorum Israël,

verses.text: Thou shalt take five sicles for every head, according to the weight of the sanctuary. A sicle hath twenty obols.
verses.textLatin: accipies quinque siclos per singula capita ad mensuram sanctuarii (siclus habet viginti obolos):

verses.text: And thou shalt give the money to Aaron and his sons, the price of them that are above.
verses.textLatin: dabisque pecuniam Aaron et filiis ejus pretium eorum qui supra sunt.

verses.text: Moses therefore took the money of them that were above, and whom they had redeemed from the Levites,
verses.textLatin: Tulit igitur Moyses pecuniam eorum, qui fuerant amplius, et quos redemerant a Levitis,

verses.text: For the firstborn of the children of Israel, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five sicles, according to the weight of the sanctuary,
verses.textLatin: pro primogenitis filiorum Israël, mille trecentorum sexaginta quinque siclorum juxta pondus sanctuarii:

verses.text: And gave it to Aaron and his sons, according to the word that the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textLatin: et dedit eam Aaron et filiis ejus juxta verbum quod præceperat sibi Dominus.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, and Aaron, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:

verses.text: Take the sum of the sons of Caath from the midst of the Levites, by their houses and families.
verses.textLatin: Tolle summam filiorum Caath de medio Levitarum per domos et familias suas,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, to fifty years old, of all that go in to stand and to minister in the tabernacle of the covenant.
verses.textLatin: a trigesimo anno et supra, usque ad quinquagesimum annum, omnium qui ingrediuntur ut stent et ministrent in tabernaculo fœderis.

verses.text: This is the service of the sons of Caath:
verses.textLatin: Hic est cultus filiorum Caath: tabernaculum fœderis, et Sanctum sanctorum

verses.text: When the camp is to set forward, Aaron and his sons shall go into the tabernacle of the covenant, and the holy of holies, and shall take down the veil that hangeth before the door, and shall wrap up the ark of the testimony in it,
verses.textLatin: ingredientur Aaron et filii ejus, quando movenda sunt castra, et deponent velum quod pendet ante fores, involventque eo arcam testimonii,

verses.text: And shall cover it again with a cover of violet skins, and shall spread over it a cloth all of violet, and shall put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: et operient rursum velamine janthinarum pellium, extendentque desuper pallium totum hyacinthinum, et inducent vectes.

verses.text: They shall wrap up also the table of proposition in a cloth of violet, and shall put with it the censers and little mortars, the cups and bowls to pour out the libations: the loaves shall be always on it:
verses.textLatin: Mensam quoque propositionis involvent hyacinthino pallio, et ponent cum ea thuribula et mortariola, cyathos et crateras ad liba fundenda: panes semper in ea erunt:

verses.text: And they shall spread over it a cloth of scarlet, which again they shall cover with a covering of violet skins, and shall put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: extendentque desuper pallium coccineum, quod rursum operient velamento janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.

verses.text: They shall take also a cloth of violet wherewith they shall cover the candlestick with the lamps and tongs thereof and the snuffers and all the oil vessels, which are necessary for the dressing of the lamps:
verses.textLatin: Sument et pallium hyacinthinum, quo operient candelabrum cum lucernis et forcipibus suis et emunctoriis et cunctis vasis olei, quæ ad concinnandas lucernas necessaria sunt:

verses.text: And over all they shall put a cover of violet skins and put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: et super omnia ponent operimentum janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.

verses.text: And they shall wrap up the golden altar also in a cloth of violet, and shall spread over it a cover of violet skins, and put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: Necnon et altare aureum involvent hyacinthino vestimento, et extendent desuper operimentum janthinarum pellium, inducentque vectes.

verses.text: All the vessels wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, they shall wrap up in a cloth of violet, and shall spread over it a cover of violet skins, and put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: Omnia vasa, quibus ministratur in sanctuario, involvent hyacinthino pallio, et extendent desuper operimentum janthinarum pellium, inducentque vectes.

verses.text: They shall cleanse the altar also from the ashes, and shall wrap it up in a purple cloth,
verses.textLatin: Sed et altare mundabunt cinere, et involvent illud purpureo vestimento,

verses.text: And shall put it with all the vessels that they use in the ministry thereof, that is to say, firepans, fleshhooks and forks, pothooks and shovels. They shall cover all the vessels of the altar together with a covering of violet skins, and shall put in the bars.
verses.textLatin: ponentque cum eo omnia vasa, quibus in ministerio ejus utuntur, id est, ignium receptacula, fuscinulas ac tridentes, uncinos et batilla. Cuncta vasa altaris operient simul velamine janthinarum pellium, et inducent vectes.

verses.text: And when Aaron and his sons have wrapped up the sanctuary and the vessels thereof at the removing of the camp, then shall the sons of Caath enter in to carry the things wrapped up: and they shall not touch the vessels of the sanctuary, lest they die. These are the burdens of the sons of Caath: in the tabernacle of the covenant:
verses.textLatin: Cumque involverint Aaron et filii ejus sanctuarium et omnia vasa ejus in commotione castrorum, tunc intrabunt filii Caath ut portent involuta: et non tangent vasa sanctuarii, ne moriantur. Ista sunt onera filiorum Caath in tabernaculo fœderis:

verses.text: And over them shall be Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, to whose charge pertaineth the oil to dress the lamps, and the sweet incense, and the sacrifice, that is always offered, and the oil of unction, and whatsoever pertaineth to the service of the tabernacle, and of all the vessels that are in the sanctuary.
verses.textLatin: super quos erit Eleazar filius Aaron sacerdotis, ad cujus curam pertinet oleum ad concinnandas lucernas, et compositionis incensum, et sacrificium, quod semper offertur, et oleum unctionis, et quidquid ad cultum tabernaculi pertinet, omniumque vasorum, quæ in sanctuario sunt.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:

verses.text: Destroy not the people of Caath from the midst of the Levites:
verses.textLatin: Nolite perdere populum Caath de medio Levitarum:

verses.text: But do this to them, that they may live, and not die, by touching the holies of holies. Aaron and his sons shall go in, and they shall appoint every man his work, and shall divide the burdens that every man is to carry.
verses.textLatin: sed hoc facite eis, ut vivant, et non moriantur, si tetigerint Sancta sanctorum. Aaron et filii ejus intrabunt, ipsique disponent opera singulorum, et divident quid portare quis debeat.

verses.text: Let not others by any curiosity see the things that are in the sanctuary before they be wrapped up, otherwise they shall die.
verses.textLatin: Alii nulla curiositate videant quæ sunt in sanctuario priusquam involvantur, alioquin morientur.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Take the sum of the sons of Gerson also by their houses and families and kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Tolle summam etiam filiorum Gerson per domos ac familias et cognationes suas,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old. Number them all that go in and minister in the tabernacle of the covenant.
verses.textLatin: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annos quinquaginta. Numera omnes qui ingrediuntur et ministrant in tabernaculo fœderis.

verses.text: This is the office of the family of the Gersonites:
verses.textLatin: Hoc est officium familiæ Gersonitarum,

verses.text: To carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the roof of the covenant, the other covering, and the violet covering over all, and the hanging that hangeth in the entry of the tabernacle of the covenant,
verses.textLatin: ut portent cortinas tabernaculi et tectum fœderis, operimentum aliud, et super omnia velamen janthinum tentoriumque quod pendet in introitu tabernaculi fœderis,

verses.text: The curtains of the court, and the veil in the entry that is before the tabernacle. All things that pertain to the altar, the cords and the vessels of the ministry,
verses.textLatin: cortinas atrii, et velum in introitu quod est ante tabernaculum. Omnia quæ ad altare pertinent, funiculos, et vasa ministerii,

verses.text: The sons of Gerson shall carry, by the commandment of Aaron and his sons: and each man shall know to what burden he must be assigned.
verses.textLatin: jubente Aaron et filiis ejus, portabunt filii Gerson: et scient singuli cui debeant oneri mancipari.

verses.text: This is the service of the family of the Gersonites in the tabernacle of the covenant, and they shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textLatin: Hic est cultus familiæ Gersonitarum in tabernaculo fœderis, eruntque sub manu Ithamar filii Aaron sacerdotis.

verses.text: Thou shalt reckon up the sons of Merari also by the families and houses of their fathers,
verses.textLatin: Filios quoque Merari per familias et domos patrum suorum recensebis,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old, all that go in to the office of their ministry, and to the service of the covenant of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annos quinquaginta, omnes qui ingrediuntur ad officium ministerii sui et cultum fœderis testimonii.

verses.text: These are their burdens: They shall carry the boards of the tabernacle and the bars thereof, the pillars and their sockets,
verses.textLatin: Hæc sunt onera eorum: portabunt tabulas tabernaculi et vectes ejus, columnas ac bases earum,

verses.text: The pillars also of the court round about, with their sockets and pins and cords. They shall receive by account all the vessels and furniture, and so shall carry them.
verses.textLatin: columnas quoque atrii per circuitum cum basibus et paxillis et funibus suis. Omnia vasa et supellectilem ad numerum accipient, sicque portabunt.

verses.text: This is the office of the family of the Merarites, and their ministry in the tabernacle of the covenant: and they shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textLatin: Hoc est officium familiæ Meraritarum et ministerium in tabernaculo fœderis: eruntque sub manu Ithamar filii Aaron sacerdotis.

verses.text: So Moses and Aaron and the princes of the synagogue reckoned up the sons of Caath, by their kindreds and the houses of their fathers,
verses.textLatin: Recensuerunt igitur Moyses et Aaron et principes synagogæ filios Caath per cognationes et domos patrum suorum,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old, all that go in to the ministry of the tabernacle of the covenant:
verses.textLatin: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annum quinquagesimum, omnes qui ingrediuntur ad ministerium tabernaculi fœderis:

verses.text: And they were found two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.textLatin: et inventi sunt duo millia septingenti quinquaginta.

verses.text: This is the number of the people of Caath that go in to the tabernacle of the covenant: these did Moses and Aaron number according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.textLatin: Hic est numerus populi Caath qui intrant tabernaculum fœderis: hos numeravit Moyses et Aaron juxta sermonem Domini per manum Moysi.

verses.text: The sons of Gerson also were numbered by the kindreds and houses of their fathers,
verses.textLatin: Numerati sunt et filii Gerson per cognationes et domos patrum suorum,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old, all that go in to minister in the tabernacle of the covenant:
verses.textLatin: a triginta annos et supra, usque ad quinquagesimum annum, omnes qui ingrediuntur ut ministrent in tabernaculo fœderis:

verses.text: And they were found two thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.textLatin: et inventi sunt duo millia sexcenti triginta.

verses.text: This is the people of the Gersonites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Hic est populus Gersonitarum, quos numeraverunt Moyses et Aaron juxta verbum Domini.

verses.text: The sons of Merari also were numbered by the kindreds and houses of their fathers,
verses.textLatin: Numerati sunt et filii Merari per cognationes et domos patrum suorum,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, unto fifty years old, all that go in to fulfil the rites of the tabernacle of the covenant:
verses.textLatin: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annum quinquagesimum, omnes qui ingrediuntur ad explendos ritus tabernaculi fœderis:

verses.text: And they were found three thousand two hundred.
verses.textLatin: et inventi sunt tria millia ducenti.

verses.text: This is the number of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron reckoned up according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.textLatin: Hic est numerus filiorum Merari, quos recensuerunt Moyses et Aaron juxta imperium Domini per manum Moysi.

verses.text: All that were reckoned up of the Levites, and whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel took by name, by the kindreds and houses of their fathers,
verses.textLatin: Omnes qui recensiti sunt de Levitis, et quos recenseri fecit ad nomen Moyses et Aaron, et principes Israël per cognationes et domos patrum suorum,

verses.text: From thirty years old and upward, until fifty years old, that go into the ministry of the tabernacle, and to carry the burdens,
verses.textLatin: a triginta annis et supra, usque ad annum quinquagesimum, ingredientes ad ministerium tabernaculi, et onera portanda,

verses.text: Were in all eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
verses.textLatin: fuerunt simul octo millia quingenti octoginta.

verses.text: Moses reckoned them up according to the word of the Lord, every one according to their office and burdens, as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textLatin: Juxta verbum Domini recensuit eos Moyses, unumquemque juxta officium et onera sua, sicut præceperat ei Dominus.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Command the children of Israel, that they cast out of the camp every leper, and whosoever hath an issue of seed, or is defiled by the dead:
verses.textLatin: Præcipe filiis Israël, ut ejiciant de castris omnem leprosum, et qui semine fluit, pollutusque est super mortuo:

verses.text: Whether it be man or woman, cast ye them out of the camp, lest they defile it when I shall dwell with you.
verses.textLatin: tam masculum quam feminam ejicite de castris, ne contaminent ea cum habitaverint vobiscum.

verses.text: And the children of Israel did so, and they cast them forth without the camp, as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
verses.textLatin: Feceruntque ita filii Israël, et ejecerunt eos extra castra, sicut locutus erat Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Say to the children of Israel: When a man or woman shall have committed any of all the sins that men are wont to commit, and by negligence shall have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and offended,
verses.textLatin: Loquere ad filios Israël: Vir, sive mulier, cum fecerint ex omnibus peccatis, quæ solent hominibus accidere, et per negligentiam transgressi fuerint mandatum Domini, atque deliquerint,

verses.text: They shall confess their sin, and restore the principal itself, and the fifth part over and above, to him against whom they have sinned.
verses.textLatin: confitebuntur peccatum suum, et reddent ipsum caput, quintamque partem desuper, ei in quem peccaverint.

verses.text: But if there be no one to receive it, they shall give it to the Lord, and it shall be the priest’s, besides the ram that is offered for expiation, to be an atoning sacrifice.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem non fuerit qui recipiat, dabunt Domino, et erit sacerdotis, excepto ariete, qui offertur pro expiatione, ut sit placabilis hostia.

verses.text: All the firstfruits also, which the children of Israel offer, belong to the priest:
verses.textLatin: Omnes quoque primitiæ, quas offerunt filii Israël, ad sacerdotem pertinent:

verses.text: And whatsoever is offered into the sanctuary by every one, and is delivered into the hands of the priest, it shall be his.
verses.textLatin: et quidquid in sanctuarium offertur a singulis, et traditur manibus sacerdotis, ipsius erit.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them: The man whose wife shall have gone astray, and contemning her husband,
verses.textLatin: Loquere ad filios Israël, et dices ad eos: Vir cujus uxor erraverit, maritumque contemnens

verses.text: Shall have slept with another man, and her husband cannot discover it, but the adultery is secret, and cannot be proved by witnesses, because she was not found in the adultery:
verses.textLatin: dormierit cum altero viro, et hoc maritus deprehendere non quiverit, sed latet adulterium, et testibus argui non potest, quia non est inventa in stupro:

verses.text: If the spirit of jealousy stir up the husband against his wife, who either is defiled, or is charged with false suspicion,
verses.textLatin: si spiritus zelotypiæ concitaverit virum contra uxorem suam, quæ vel polluta est, vel falsa suspicione appetitur:

verses.text: He shall bring her to the priest, and shall offer an oblation for her, the tenth part of a measure of barley meal: he shall not pour oil thereon, nor put frankincense upon it: because it is a sacrifice of jealousy, and an oblation searching out adultery.
verses.textLatin: adducet eam ad sacerdotem, et offeret oblationem pro illa, decimam partem sati farinæ hordeaceæ: non fundet super eam oleum, nec imponet thus: quia sacrificium zelotypiæ est, et oblatio investigans adulterium.

verses.text: The priest therefore shall offer it, and set it before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Offeret igitur eam sacerdos, et statuet coram Domino,

verses.text: And he shall take holy water in an earthen vessel, and he shall cast a little earth of the pavement of the tabernacle into it.
verses.textLatin: assumetque aquam sanctam in vase fictili, et pauxillum terræ de pavimento tabernaculi mittet in eam.

verses.text: And when the woman shall stand before the Lord, he shall uncover her head, and shall put on her hands the sacrifice of remembrance, and the oblation of jealousy: and he himself shall hold the most bitter waters, whereon he hath heaped curses with execration.
verses.textLatin: Cumque steterit mulier in conspectu Domini, discooperiet caput ejus, et ponet super manus illius sacrificium recordationis, et oblationem zelotypiæ: ipse autem tenebit aquas amarissimas, in quibus cum execratione maledicta congessit.

verses.text: And he shall adjure her, and shall say: If another man hath not slept with thee, and if thou be not defiled by forsaking thy husband’s bed, these most bitter waters, on which I have heaped curses, shall not hurt thee.
verses.textLatin: Adjurabitque eam, et dicet: Si non dormivit vir alienus tecum, et si non polluta es deserto mariti thoro, non te nocebunt aquæ istæ amarissimæ, in quas maledicta congessi.

verses.text: But if thou hast gone aside from thy husband, and art defiled, and hast lain with another man:
verses.textLatin: Sin autem declinasti a viro tuo, atque polluta es, et concubuisti cum altero viro:

verses.text: These curses shall light upon thee: The Lord make thee a curse, and an example for all among his people: may he make thy thigh to rot, and may thy belly swell and burst asunder.
verses.textLatin: his maledictionibus subjacebis: det te Dominus in maledictionem, exemplumque cunctorum in populo suo: putrescere faciat femur tuum, et tumens uterus tuus disrumpatur.

verses.text: Let the cursed waters enter into thy belly, and may thy womb swell and thy thigh rot. And the woman shall answer, Amen, amen.
verses.textLatin: Ingrediantur aquæ maledictæ in ventrem tuum, et utero tumescente putrescat femur. Et respondebit mulier: Amen, amen.

verses.text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and shall wash them out with the most bitter waters, upon which he hath heaped the curses,
verses.textLatin: Scribetque sacerdos in libello ista maledicta, et delebit ea aquis amarissimis, in quas maledicta congessit,

verses.text: And he shall give them her to drink. And when she hath drunk them up,
verses.textLatin: et dabit ei bibere. Quas cum exhauserit,

verses.text: The priest shall take from her hand the sacrifice of jealousy, and shall elevate it before the Lord, and shall put it upon the altar: yet so as first,
verses.textLatin: tollet sacerdos de manu ejus sacrificium zelotypiæ, et elevabit illud coram Domino, imponetque illud super altare, ita dumtaxat ut prius:

verses.text: To take a handful of the sacrifice of that which is offered, and burn it upon the altar: and so give the most bitter waters to the woman to drink.
verses.textLatin: pugillum sacrificii tollat de eo, quod offertur, et incendat super altare: et sic potum det mulieri aquas amarissimas.

verses.text: And when she hath drunk them, if she be defiled, and having despised her husband be guilty of adultery, the malediction shall go through her, and her belly swelling, her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse, and an example to all the people.
verses.textLatin: Quas cum biberit, si polluta est, et contempto viro adulterii rea, pertransibunt eam aquæ maledictionis, et inflato ventre, computrescet femur: eritque mulier in maledictionem, et in exemplum omni populo.

verses.text: But if she be not defiled, she shall not be hurt, and shall bear children.
verses.textLatin: Quod si polluta non fuerit, erit innoxia, et faciet liberos.

verses.text: This is the law of jealousy. If a woman hath gone aside from her husband, and be defiled,
verses.textLatin: Ista est lex zelotypiæ. Si declinaverit mulier a viro suo, et si polluta fuerit,

verses.text: And the husband stirred up by the spirit of jealousy bring her before the Lord, and the priest do to her according to all things that are here written:
verses.textLatin: maritusque zelotypiæ spiritu concitatus adduxerit eam in conspectu Domini, et fecerit ei sacerdos juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt:

verses.text: The husband shall be blameless, and she shall bear her iniquity.
verses.textLatin: maritus absque culpa erit, et illa recipiet iniquitatem suam.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them: When a man, or woman, shall make a vow to be sanctified, and will consecrate themselves to the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Loquere ad filios Israël, et dices ad eos: Vir, sive mulier, cum fecerint votum ut sanctificentur, et se voluerint Domino consecrare:

verses.text: They shall abstain from wine, and from every thing that may make a man drunk. They shall not drink vinegar of wine, or of any other drink, nor any thing that is pressed out of the grape: nor shall they eat grapes either fresh or dried.
verses.textLatin: a vino, et omni quod inebriare potest, abstinebunt. Acetum ex vino, et ex qualibet alia potione, et quidquid de uva exprimitur, non bibent: uvas recentes siccasque non comedent

verses.text: All the days that they are consecrated to the Lord by vow: they shall eat nothing that cometh of the vineyard, from the raisin even to the kernel.
verses.textLatin: cunctis diebus quibus ex voto Domino consecrantur: quidquid ex vinea esse potest, ab uva passa usque ad acinum non comedent.

verses.text: All the time of his separation no razor shall pass over his head, until the day be fulfilled of his consecration to the Lord. He shall be holy, and shall let the hair of his head grow.
verses.textLatin: Omni tempore separationis suæ novacula non transibit per caput ejus usque ad completum diem, quo Domino consecratur. Sanctus erit, crescente cæsarie capitis ejus.

verses.text: All the time of his consecration he shall not go in to any dead,
verses.textLatin: Omni tempore consecrationis suæ, super mortuum non ingredietur,

verses.text: Neither shall he make himself unclean, even for his father, or for his mother, or for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.textLatin: nec super patris quidem et matris et fratris sororisque funere contaminabitur, quia consecratio Dei sui super caput ejus est.

verses.text: All the days of his separation he shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Omnibus diebus separationis suæ sanctus erit Domino.

verses.text: But if any man die suddenly before him: the head of his consecration shall be defiled: and he shall shave it forthwith on the same day of his purification, and again on the seventh day.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem mortuus fuerit subito quispiam coram eo, polluetur caput consecrationis ejus: quod radet illico in eadem die purgationis suæ, et rursum septima.

verses.text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons to the priest in the entry of the covenant of the testimony.
verses.textLatin: In octava autem die offeret duos turtures, vel duos pullos columbæ sacerdoti in introitu fœderis testimonii.

verses.text: And the priest shall offer one for sin, and the other for a holocaust, and shall pray for him, for that he hath sinned by the dead: and he shall sanctify his head that day:
verses.textLatin: Facietque sacerdos unum pro peccato, et alterum in holocaustum, et deprecabitur pro eo, quia peccavit super mortuo: sanctificabitque caput ejus in die illo:

verses.text: And shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his separation, offering a lamb of one year for sin: yet so that the former days be made void, because his sanctification was profaned.
verses.textLatin: et consecrabit Domino dies separationis illius, offerens agnum anniculum pro peccato: ita tamen ut dies priores irriti fiant, quoniam polluta est sanctificatio ejus.

verses.text: This is the law of consecration. When the days which he had determined by vow shall be expired, he shall bring him to the door of the tabernacle of the covenant,
verses.textLatin: Ista est lex consecrationis. Cum dies, quos ex voto decreverat, complebuntur, adducet eum ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis,

verses.text: And shall offer his oblation to the Lord: one he lamb of a year old without blemish for a holocaust, and one ewe lamb of a year old without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for a victim of peace offering,
verses.textLatin: et offeret oblationes ejus Domino, agnum anniculum immaculatum in holocaustum, et ovem anniculam immaculatam pro peccato, et arietem immaculatum, hostiam pacificam,

verses.text: A basket also of unleavened bread, tempered with oil, and wafers without leaven anointed with oil, and the libations of each:
verses.textLatin: canistrum quoque panum azymorum qui conspersi sint oleo, et lagana absque fermento uncta oleo, ac libamina singulorum:

verses.text: And the priest shall present them before the Lord, and shall offer both the sin offering and the holocaust.
verses.textLatin: quæ offeret sacerdos coram Domino, et faciet tam pro peccato, quam in holocaustum.

verses.text: But the ram he shall immolate for a sacrifice of peace offering to the Lord, offering at the same time the basket of unleavened bread, and the libations that are due by custom.
verses.textLatin: Arietem vero immolabit hostiam pacificam Domino, offerens simul canistrum azymorum, et libamenta quæ ex more debentur.

verses.text: Then shall the hair of the consecration of the Nazarite, be shaved off before the door of the tabernacle of the covenant: and he shall take his hair, and lay it upon the fire, which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.textLatin: Tunc radetur nazaræus ante ostium tabernaculi fœderis cæsarie consecrationis suæ: tolletque capillos ejus, et ponet super ignem, qui est suppositus sacrificio pacificorum:

verses.text: And shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and he shall deliver them into the hands of the Nazarite, after his head is shaven.
verses.textLatin: et armum coctum arietis, tortamque absque fermento unam de canistro, et laganum azymum unum, et tradet in manus nazaræi, postquam rasum fuerit caput ejus.

verses.text: And receiving them again from him, he shall elevate them in the sight of the Lord: and they being sanctified shall belong to the priest, as the breast, which was commanded to be separated, and the shoulder. After this the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.textLatin: Susceptaque rursum ab eo, elevabit in conspectu Domini: et sanctificata sacerdotis erunt, sicut pectusculum, quod separari jussum est, et femur. Post hæc, potest bibere nazaræus vinum.

verses.text: This is the law of the Nazarite, when he hath vowed his oblation to the Lord in the time of his consecration, besides those things which his hand shall find, according to that which he had vowed in his mind, so shall he do for the fulfilling of his sanctification.
verses.textLatin: Ista est lex nazaræi, cum voverit oblationem suam Domino tempore consecrationis suæ, exceptis his, quæ invenerit manus ejus: juxta quod mente devoverat, ita faciet ad perfectionem sanctificationis suæ.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Say to Aaron and his sons: Thus shall you bless the children of Israel, and you shall say to them:
verses.textLatin: Loquere Aaron et filiis ejus: Sic benedicetis filiis Israël, et dicetis eis:

verses.text: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee.
verses.textLatin: Benedicat tibi Dominus, et custodiat te.

verses.text: The Lord shew his face to thee, and have mercy on thee.
verses.textLatin: Ostendat Dominus faciem suam tibi, et misereatur tui.

verses.text: The Lord turn his countenance to thee, and give thee peace.
verses.textLatin: Convertat Dominus vultum suum ad te, et det tibi pacem.

verses.text: And they shall invoke my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.
verses.textLatin: Invocabuntque nomen meum super filios Israël, et ego benedicam eis.

verses.text: And  it came to pass in the day that Moses had finished the tabernacle, and set it up, and had anointed and sanctified it with all its vessels, the altar likewise and all the vessels thereof,
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem in die qua complevit Moyses tabernaculum, et erexit illud, unxitque et sanctificavit cum omnibus vasis suis, altare similiter et omnia vasa ejus:

verses.text: The princes of Israel and the heads of the families, in every tribe, who were the rulers of them who had been numbered, offered
verses.textLatin: obtulerunt principes Israël et capita familiarum, qui erant per singulas tribus, præfectique eorum, qui numerati fuerant,

verses.text: Their gifts before the Lord, six wagons covered, and twelve oxen. Two princes offered one wagon, and each one an ox, and they offered them before the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: munera coram Domino sex plaustra tecta cum duodecim bobus. Unum plaustrum obtulere duo duces, et unum bovem singuli, obtuleruntque ea in conspectu tabernaculi.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textLatin: Ait autem Dominus ad Moysen:

verses.text: Receive them from them to serve in the ministry of the tabernacle, and thou shalt deliver them to the Levites according to the order of their ministry.
verses.textLatin: Suscipe ab eis ut serviant in ministerio tabernaculi, et trades ea Levitis juxta ordinem ministerii sui.

verses.text: Moses therefore receiving the wagons and the oxen, delivered them to the Levites.
verses.textLatin: Itaque cum suscepisset Moyses plaustra et boves, tradidit eos Levitis.

verses.text: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gerson, according to their necessity.
verses.textLatin: Duo plaustra et quatuor boves dedit filiis Gerson, juxta id quod habebant necessarium.

verses.text: The other four wagons, and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their offices and service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textLatin: Quatuor alia plaustra et octo boves dedit filiis Merari secundum officia et cultum suum, sub manu Ithamar filii Aaron sacerdotis.

verses.text: But to the sons of Caath he gave no wagons or oxen: because they serve in the sanctuary and carry their burdens upon their own shoulders.
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Caath non dedit plaustra et boves: quia in sanctuario serviunt, et onera propriis portant humeris.

verses.text: And the princes offered for the dedication of the altar on the day when it was anointed, their oblation before the altar.
verses.textLatin: Igitur obtulerunt duces in dedicationem altaris, die qua unctum est, oblationem suam ante altare.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Moses: Let each of the princes one day after another offer their gifts for the dedication of the altar.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen: Singuli duces per singulos dies offerant munera in dedicationem altaris.

verses.text: The first day Nahasson the son of Aminadab of the tribe of Juda offered his offering:
verses.textLatin: Primo die obtulit oblationem suam Nahasson filius Aminadab de tribu Juda:

verses.text: And his offering was a silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty sicles, a silver bowl of seventy sicles according to the weight of the sanctuary, both full of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice:
verses.textLatin: fueruntque in ea acetabulum argenteum pondo centum triginta siclorum, phiala argentea habens septuaginta siclos, juxta pondus sanctuarii, utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:

verses.text: A little mortar of ten sicles of gold full of incense:
verses.textLatin: mortariolum ex decem siclis aureis plenum incenso:

verses.text: An ox of the herd, and a ram, and a lamb of a year old for a holocaust:
verses.textLatin: bovem de armento, et arietem, et agnum anniculum in holocaustum:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin:
verses.textLatin: hircumque pro peccato:

verses.text: And for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of a year old. This was the offering of Nahasson the son of Aminadab.
verses.textLatin: et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos, arietes quinque, hircos quinque, agnos anniculos quinque. Hæc est oblatio Nahasson filii Aminadab.

verses.text: The second day Nathanael the son of Suar, prince of the tribe of Issachar, made his offering,
verses.textLatin: Secundo die obtulit Nathanaël filius Suar, dux de tribu Issachar,

verses.text: A silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty sicles, a silver bowl of seventy sicles, according to the weight of the sanctuary, both full of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice:
verses.textLatin: acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos, phialam argenteam habentem septuaginta siclos, juxta pondus sanctuarii, utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:

verses.text: A little mortar of gold weighing ten sicles full of incense:
verses.textLatin: mortariolum aureum habens decem siclos plenum incenso:

verses.text: An ox of the herd, and a ram, and a lamb of a year old for a holocaust:
verses.textLatin: bovem de armento, et arietem, et agnum anniculum in holocaustum:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin:
verses.textLatin: hircumque pro peccato:

verses.text: And for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five buck goats, five lambs of a year old. This was the offering of Nathanael the son of Suar.
verses.textLatin: et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos, arietes quinque, hircos quinque, agnos anniculos quinque. Hæc fuit oblatio Nathanaël filii Suar.

verses.text: The third day the prince of the sons of Zabulon, Eliab the son of Helon,
verses.textLatin: Tertio die princeps filiorum Zabulon, Eliab filius Helon,

verses.text: Offered a silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty sicles, a silver bowl of seventy sicles by the weight of the sanctuary, both full of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice:
verses.textLatin: obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos, phialam argenteam habentem septuaginta siclos, ad pondus sanctuarii, utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:

verses.text: A little mortar of gold weighing ten sicles full of incense:
verses.textLatin: mortariolum aureum appendens decem siclos, plenum incenso:

verses.text: An ox of the herd, and a ram, and a lamb of a year old for a holocaust:
verses.textLatin: bovem de armento, et arietem, et agnum anniculum in holocaustum:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin:
verses.textLatin: hircumque pro peccato:

verses.text: And for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five buck goats, five lambs of a year old. This is the oblation of Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.textLatin: et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos, arietes quinque, hircos quinque, agnos anniculos quinque. Hæc est oblatio Eliab filii Helon.

verses.text: The fourth day the prince of the sons of Ruben, Elisur the son of Sedeur,
verses.textLatin: Die quarto princeps filiorum Ruben, Elisur filius Sedeur,

verses.text: Offered a silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty sicles, a silver bowl of seventy sicles according to the weight of the sanctuary, both full of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice:
verses.textLatin: obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos, phialam argenteam habentem septuaginta siclos, ad pondus sanctuarii, utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificum:

verses.text: A little mortar of gold weighing ten sicles full of incense:
verses.textLatin: mortariolum aureum appendens decem siclos, plenum incenso:

verses.text: An ox of the herd, and a ram, and a lamb of a year old, for a holocaust:
verses.textLatin: bovem de armento, et arietem, et agnum anniculum in holocaustum:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin:
verses.textLatin: hircumque pro peccato:

verses.text: And for victims of peace offerings two oxen, five rams, five buck goats, five lambs of a year old. This was the offering of Elisur the son of Sedeur.
verses.textLatin: et in hostias pacificorum boves duos, arietes quinque, hircos quinque, agnos anniculos quinque. Hæc fuit oblatio Elisur filii Sedeur.

verses.text: The fifth day the prince of the sons of Simeon, Salamiel the son of Surisaddai,
verses.textLatin: Die quinto princeps filiorum Simeon, Salamiel filius Surisaddai,

verses.text: Offered a silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty sicles, a silver bowl of seventy sicles after the weight of the sanctuary, both full of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice:
verses.textLatin: obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos, phialam argenteam habentem septuaginta siclos, ad pondus sanctuarii, utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificum:

verses.text: A little mortar of gold weighing ten sicles full of incense:
verses.textLatin: mortariolum aureum appendens decem siclos, plenum incenso:

verses.text: An ox of the herd, and a ram, and a lamb of a year old for a holocaust:
verses.textLatin: bovem de armento, et arietem, et agnum anniculum in holocaustum:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin:
verses.textLatin: hircumque pro peccato:

verses.text: And for sacrifices of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five buck goats, five lambs of a year old. This was the offering of Salamiel the son of Surisaddai.
