verses.textLatin: Ruben primogenitus Israël: hujus filius, Henoch, a quo familia Henochitarum: et Phallu, a quo familia Phalluitarum:

verses.text: And Hesron, of whom is the family of the Hesronites: and Charmi, of whom is the family of the Charmites.
verses.textLatin: et Hesron, a quo familia Hesronitarum: et Charmi, a quo familia Charmitarum.

verses.text: These are the families of the stock of Ruben: whose number was found to be forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Ruben: quarum numerus inventus est quadraginta tria millia, et septingenti triginta.

verses.text: The son of Phallu was Eliab.
verses.textLatin: Filius Phallu, Eliab:

verses.text: His sons, were Namuel and Dathan and Abiron. These are Dathan and Abiron the princes of the people, that rose against Moses and Aaron in the sedition of Core, when they rebelled against the Lord:
verses.textLatin: hujus filii, Namuel et Dathan et Abiron: isti sunt Dathan et Abiron principes populi, qui surrexerunt contra Moysen et Aaron in seditione Core, quando adversus Dominum rebellaverunt:

verses.text: And the earth opening her mouth swallowed up Core, many others dying, when the fire burned two hundred and fifty men. And there was a great miracle wrought,
verses.textLatin: et aperiens terra os suum devoravit Core, morientibus plurimis, quando combussit ignis ducentos quinquaginta viros. Et factum est grande miraculum,

verses.text: That when Core perished, his sons did not perish.
verses.textLatin: ut, Core pereunte, filii illius non perirent.

verses.text: The sons of Simeon by their kindreds: Namuel, of him is the family of the Namuelites: Jamin, of him is the family of the Jaminites: Jachin, of him is the family of the Jachinites:
verses.textLatin: Filii Simeon per cognationes suas: Namuel, ab hoc familia Namuelitarum: Jamin, ab hoc familia Jaminitarum: Jachin, ab hoc familia Jachinitarum:

verses.text: Zare, of him is the family of the Zarites: Saul, of him is the family of the Saulites.
verses.textLatin: Zare, ab hoc familia Zareitarum: Saul, ab hoc familia Saulitarum.

verses.text: These are the families of the stock of Simeon, of which the whole number was twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Simeon, quarum omnis numerus fuit viginti duo millia ducenti.

verses.text: The sons of Gad by their kindreds: Sephon, of him is the family of the Sephonites: Aggi, of him is the family of the Aggites: Suni, of him is the family of the Sunites:
verses.textLatin: Filii Gad per cognationes suas: Sephon, ab hoc familia Sephonitarum: Aggi, ab hoc familia Aggitarum: Suni, ab hoc familia Sunitarum:

verses.text: Ozni, of him is the family of the Oznites: Her, of him is the family of the Herites:
verses.textLatin: Ozni, ab hoc familia Oznitarum: Her, ab hoc familia Heritarum:

verses.text: Arod, of him is the family of the Arodites: Ariel, of him is the family of the Arielites.
verses.textLatin: Arod, ab hoc familia Aroditarum: Ariel, ab hoc familia Arielitarum.

verses.text: These are the families of Gad, of which the whole number was forty thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Istæ sunt familiæ Gad, quarum omnis numerus fuit quadraginta millia quingenti.

verses.text: The sons of Juda, Her and Onan, who both died in the land of Chanaan.
verses.textLatin: Filii Juda, Her et Onan, qui ambo mortui sunt in terra Chanaan.

verses.text: And the sons of Juda by their kindreds were: Sela, of whom is the family of the Selaites: Phares, of whom is the family of the Pharesites: Zare, of whom is the family of the Zarites.
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque filii Juda per cognationes suas: Sela, a quo familia Selaitarum: Phares, a quo familia Pharesitarum: Zare, a quo familia Zareitarum.

verses.text: Moreover the sons of Phares were: Hesron, of whom is the family of the Hesronites: and Hamul, of whom is the family of the Hamulites.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Phares: Hesron, a quo familia Hesronitarum: et Hamul, a quo familia Hamulitarum.

verses.text: These are the families of Juda, of which the whole number was seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Istæ sunt familiæ Juda, quarum omnis numerus fuit septuaginta sex millia quingenti.

verses.text: The sons of Issachar, by their kindreds: Thola, of whom is the family of the Tholaites: Phua, of whom is the family of the Phuaites:
verses.textLatin: Filii Issachar per cognationes suas: Thola, a quo familia Tholaitarum: Phua, a quo familia Phuaitarum:

verses.text: Jasub, of whom is the family of the Jasubites: Semran, of whom is the family of the Semranites.
verses.textLatin: Jasub, a quo familia Jasubitarum: Semran, a quo familia Semranitarum.

verses.text: These are the kindreds of Issachar, whose number was sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt cognationes Issachar, quarum numerus fuit sexaginta quatuor millia trecenti.

verses.text: The sons of Zabulon by their kindreds: Sared, of whom is the family of the Saredites: Elon, of whom is the family of the Elonites: Jalel, of whom is the family of the Jalelites.
verses.textLatin: Filii Zabulon per cognationes suas: Sared, a quo familia Sareditarum: Elon, a quo familia Elonitarum: Jalel, a quo familia Jalelitarum.

verses.text: These are the kindreds of Zabulon, whose number was sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt cognationes Zabulon, quarum numerus fuit sexaginta millia quingenti.

verses.text: The sons of Joseph by their kindred, Manasses and Ephraim.
verses.textLatin: Filii Joseph per cognationes suas, Manasse et Ephraim.

verses.text: Of Manasses was born Machir, of whom is the family of the Machirites. Machir begot Galaad, of whom is the family of the Galaadites.
verses.textLatin: De Manasse ortus est Machir, a quo familia Machiritarum. Machir genuit Galaad, a quo familia Galaaditarum.

verses.text: Galaad had sons: Jezer, of whom is the family of the Jezerites: and Helec, of whom is the family of the Helecites:
verses.textLatin: Galaad habuit filios: Jezer, a quo familia Jezeritarum: et Helec, a quo familia Helecitarum:

verses.text: And Asriel, of whom is the family of the Asrielites: and Sechem, of whom is the family of the Sechemites:
verses.textLatin: et Asriel, a quo familia Asrielitarum: et Sechem, a quo familia Sechemitarum:

verses.text: And Semida, of whom is the family of the Semidaites: and Hepher, of whom is the family of the Hepherites.
verses.textLatin: et Semida, a quo familia Semidaitarum: et Hepher, a quo familia Hepheritarum.

verses.text: And Hepher was the father of Salphaad, who had no sons, but only daughters, whose names are these: Maala, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Thersa.
verses.textLatin: Fuit autem Hepher pater Salphaad, qui filios non habebat, sed tantum filias: quarum ista sunt nomina: Maala, et Noa, et Hegla, et Melcha, et Thersa.

verses.text: These are the families of Manasses, and the number of them fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt familiæ Manasse, et numerus earum quinquaginta duo millia septingenti.

verses.text: And the sons of Ephraim by their kindreds were these: Suthala, of whom is the family of the Suthalaites: Becher, of whom is the family of the Becherites: Thehen, of whom is the family of the Thehenites.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Ephraim per cognationes suas fuerunt hi: Suthala, a quo familia Suthalaitarum: Becher, a quo familia Becheritarum: Thehen, a quo familia Thehenitarum.

verses.text: Now the son of Suthala was Heran, of whom is the family of the Heranites.
verses.textLatin: Porro filius Suthala fuit Heran, a quo familia Heranitarum.

verses.text: These are the kindreds of the sons of Ephraim: whose number was thirty-two thousand five hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt cognationes filiorum Ephraim: quarum numerus fuit triginta duo millia quingenti.

verses.text: These are the sons of Joseph by their families. The sons of Benjamin in their kindreds: Bela, of whom is the family of the Belaites: Asbel, of whom is the family of the Asbelites: Ahiram, of whom is the family of the Ahiramites:
verses.textLatin: Isti sunt filii Joseph per familias suas. Filii Benjamin in cognationibus suis: Bela, a quo familia Belaitarum: Asbel, a quo familia Asbelitarum: Ahiram, a quo familia Ahiramitarum:

verses.text: Supham, of whom is the family of the Suphamites: Hupham, of whom is the family of the Huphamites.
verses.textLatin: Supham, a quo familia Suphamitarum: Hupham, a quo familia Huphamitarum.

verses.text: The sons of Bela: Hered, and Noeman. Of Hered, is the family of the Heredites: of Noeman, the family of the Noemanites.
verses.textLatin: Filii Bela: Hered, et Noëman. De Hered, familia Hereditarum: de Noëman, familia Noëmanitarum.

verses.text: These are the sons of Benjamin by their kindreds, whose number was forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt filii Benjamin per cognationes suas: quorum numerus fuit quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti.

verses.text: The sons of Dan by their kindreds: Suham, of whom is the family of the Suhamites: These are the kindreds of Dan by their families.
verses.textLatin: Filii Dan per cognationes suas: Suham, a quo familia Suhamitarum. Hæ sunt cognationes Dan per familias suas.

verses.text: All were Suhamites, whose number was sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Omnes fuere Suhamitæ, quorum numerus erat sexaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.

verses.text: The sons of Aser by their kindreds: Jemna, of whom is the family of the Jemnaites: Jessui, of whom is the family of the Jessuites: Brie, of whom is the family of the Brieites.
verses.textLatin: Filii Aser per cognationes suas: Jemna, a quo familia Jemnaitarum: Jessui, a quo familia Jessuitarum: Brie, a quo familia Brieitarum.

verses.text: The sons of Brie: Heber, of whom is the family of the Heberites: and Melchiel, of whom is the family of the Melchielites.
verses.textLatin: Filii Brie: Heber, a quo familia Heberitarum: et Melchiel, a quo familia Melchielitarum.

verses.text: And the name of the daughter of Aser, was Sara.
verses.textLatin: Nomen autem filiæ Aser fuit Sara.

verses.text: These are the kindreds of the sons of Aser, and their number fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ cognationes filiorum Aser, et numerus eorum quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.

verses.text: The sons of Nephtali by their kindreds: Jesiel, of whom is the family of the Jesielites: Guni, of whom is the family of the Gunites:
verses.textLatin: Filii Nephthali per cognationes suas: Jesiel, a quo familia Jesielitarum: Guni, a quo familia Gunitarum:

verses.text: Jeser, of whom is the family of the Jeserites: Sellem, of whom is the family of the Sellemites.
verses.textLatin: Jeser, a quo familia Jeseritarum: Sellem, a quo familia Sellemitarum.

verses.text: These are the kindreds of the sons of Nephtali by their families: whose number was forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt cognationes filiorum Nephthali per familias suas: quorum numerus quadraginta quinque millia quadringenti.

verses.text: This is the sum of the children of Israel, that were reckoned up, six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.textLatin: Ista est summa filiorum Israël, qui recensiti sunt, sexcenta millia, et mille septingenti triginta.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: To these shall the land be divided for their possessions according to the number of names.
verses.textLatin: Istis dividetur terra juxta numerum vocabulorum in possessiones suas.

verses.text: To the greater number thou shalt give a greater portion, and to the fewer a less: to every one, as they have now been reckoned up, shall a possession be delivered:
verses.textLatin: Pluribus majorem partem dabis, et paucioribus minorem: singulis, sicut nunc recensiti sunt, tradetur possessio:

verses.text: Yet so that by lot the land be divided to the tribe and families.
verses.textLatin: ita dumtaxat ut sors terram tribubus dividat et familiis.

verses.text: Whatsoever shall fall by lot, that shall be taken by the more, or the fewer.
verses.textLatin: Quidquid sorte contigerit, hoc vel plures accipiant, vel pauciores.

verses.text: This also is the number of the sons of Levi by their families: Gerson, of whom is the family of the Gersonites: Caath, of whom is the family of the Caathites: Merari, of whom is the family of the Merarites.
verses.textLatin: Hic quoque est numerus filiorum Levi per familias suas: Gerson, a quo familia Gersonitarum: Caath, a quo familia Caathitarum: Merari, a quo familia Meraritarum.

verses.text: These are the families of Levi: The family of Lobni, the family of Hebroni, the family of Moholi, the family of Musi, the family of Core. Now Caath begot Amram:
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt familiæ Levi: familia Lobni, familia Hebroni, familia Moholi, familia Musi, familia Core. At vero Caath genuit Amram:

verses.text: Who had to wife Jochabed the daughter of Levi, who was born to him in Egypt. She bore to her husband Amram sons, Aaron and Moses, and Mary their sister.
verses.textLatin: qui habuit uxorem Jochabed filiam Levi, quæ nata est ei in Ægypto. Hæc genuit Amram viro suo filios, Aaron, et Moysen, et Mariam sororem eorum.

verses.text: Of Aaron were born Nadab and Abiu, and Eleazar and Ithamar:
verses.textLatin: De Aaron orti sunt Nadab et Abiu, et Eleazar et Ithamar:

verses.text: Of whom Nadab and Abiu died, when they had offered the strange fire before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: quorum Nadab et Abiu mortui sunt, cum obtulissent ignem alienum coram Domino.

verses.text: And all that were numbered, were twenty-three thousand males from one month old and upward: for they were not reckoned up among the children of Israel, neither was a possession given to them with the rest.
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque omnes qui numerati sunt, viginti tria millia generis masculini ab uno mense et supra: quia non sunt recensiti inter filios Israël, nec eis cum ceteris data possessio est.

verses.text: This is the number of the children of Israel, that were enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest, in the plains of Moab upon the Jordan, over against Jericho.
verses.textLatin: Hic est numerus filiorum Israël, qui descripti sunt a Moyse et Eleazaro sacerdote, in campestribus Moab supra Jordanem contra Jericho:

verses.text: Among whom there was not one of them that were numbered before by Moses and Aaron in the desert of Sinai.
verses.textLatin: inter quos, nullus fuit eorum qui ante numerati sunt a Moyse et Aaron in deserto Sinai:

verses.text: For the Lord had foretold that they should die in the wilderness. And none remained of them, but Caleb the son of Jephone, and Josue the son of Nun.
verses.textLatin: prædixerat enim Dominus quod omnes morerentur in solitudine. Nullusque remansit ex eis, nisi Caleb filius Jephone, et Josue filius Nun.

verses.text: Then  came the daughters of Salphaad, the son of Hepher, the son of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasses, who was the son of Joseph: and their names are Maala, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Thersa.
verses.textLatin: Accesserunt autem filiæ Salphaad, filii Hepher, filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse, qui fuit filius Joseph: quarum sunt nomina, Maala, et Noa, et Hegla, et Melcha, et Thersa.

verses.text: And they stood before Moses and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the people at the door of the tabernacle of the covenant, and said:
verses.textLatin: Steteruntque coram Moyse et Eleazaro sacerdote et cunctis principibus populi ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis, atque dixerunt:

verses.text: Our father died in the desert, and was not in the sedition, that was raised against the Lord under Core, but he died in his own sin: and he had no male children. Why is his name taken away out of his family, because he had no son? Give us a possession among the kinsmen of our father.
verses.textLatin: Pater noster mortuus est in deserto, nec fuit in seditione, quæ concitata est contra Dominum sub Core, sed in peccato suo mortuus est: hic non habuit mares filios. Cur tollitur nomen illius de familia sua, quia non habuit filium? date nobis possessionem inter cognatos patris nostri.

verses.text: And Moses referred their cause to the judgment of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Retulitque Moyses causam earum ad judicium Domini.

verses.text: And the Lord said to him:
verses.textLatin: Qui dixit ad eum:

verses.text: The daughters of Salphaad demand a just thing: Give them a possession among their father’s kindred, and let them succeed him in his inheritance.
verses.textLatin: Justam rem postulant filiæ Salphaad: da eis possessionem inter cognatos patris sui, et ei in hæreditatem succedant.

verses.text: And to the children of Israel thou shalt speak these things:
verses.textLatin: Ad filios autem Israël loqueris hæc:

verses.text: When a man dieth without a son, his inheritance shall pass to his daughter.
verses.textLatin: Homo cum mortuus fuerit absque filio, ad filiam ejus transibit hæreditas.

verses.text: If he have no daughter, his brethren shall succeed him.
verses.textLatin: Si filiam non habuerit, habebit successores fratres suos.

verses.text: And if he have no brethren, you shall give the inheritance to his father’s brethren.
verses.textLatin: Quod si et fratres non fuerint, dabitis hæreditatem fratribus patris ejus.

verses.text: But if he have no uncles by the father, the inheritance shall be given to them that are the next akin. And this shall be to the children of Israel sacred by a perpetual law, as the Lord hath commanded Moses.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem nec patruos habuerit, dabitur hæreditas his qui ei proximi sunt. Eritque hoc filiis Israël sanctum lege perpetua, sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.

verses.text: The Lord also said to Moses: Go up into this mountain Abarim, and view from thence the land which I will give to the children of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen: Ascende in montem istum Abarim, et contemplare inde terram, quam daturus sum filiis Israël.

verses.text: And when thou shalt have seen it, thou also shalt go to thy people, as thy brother Aaron is gone:
verses.textLatin: Cumque videris eam, ibis et tu ad populum tuum, sicut ivit frater tuus Aaron:

verses.text: Because you offended me in the desert of Sin in the contradiction of the multitude, neither would you sanctify me before them at the waters. These are the waters of contradiction in Cades of the desert of Sin.
verses.textLatin: quia offendistis me in deserto Sin in contradictione multitudinis, nec sanctificare me voluistis coram ea super aquas. Hæ sunt aquæ contradictionis in Cades deserti Sin.

verses.text: And Moses answered him:
verses.textLatin: Cui respondit Moyses:

verses.text: May the Lord the God of the spirits of all flesh provide a man, that may be over this multitude:
verses.textLatin: Provideat Dominus Deus spirituum omnis carnis hominem, qui sit super multitudinem hanc:

verses.text: And may go out and in before them, and may lead them out, or bring them in: lest the people of the Lord be as sheep without a shepherd.
verses.textLatin: et possit exire et intrare ante eos, et educere eos vel introducere: ne sit populus Domini sicut oves absque pastore.

verses.text: And the Lord said to him: Take Josue the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and put thy hand upon him.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Dominus ad eum: Tolle Josue filium Nun, virum in quo est spiritus, et pone manum tuam super eum.

verses.text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest and all the multitude:
verses.textLatin: Qui stabit coram Eleazaro sacerdote et omni multitudine:

verses.text: And thou shalt give him precepts in the sight of all, and part of thy glory, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may hear him.
verses.textLatin: et dabis ei præcepta cunctis videntibus, et partem gloriæ tuæ, ut audiat eum omnis synagoga filiorum Israël.

verses.text: If any thing be to be done, Eleazar the priest shall consult the Lord for him. He and all the children of Israel with him, and the rest of the multitude shall go out and go in at his word.
verses.textLatin: Pro hoc, si quid agendum erit, Eleazar sacerdos consulet Dominum. Ad verbum ejus egredietur et ingredietur ipse, et omnes filii Israël cum eo, et cetera multitudo.

verses.text: Moses did as the Lord had commanded. And when he had taken Josue, he set him before Eleazar the priest, and all the assembly of the people,
verses.textLatin: Fecit Moyses ut præceperat Dominus: cumque tulisset Josue, statuit eum coram Eleazaro sacerdote et omni frequentia populi.

verses.text: And laying his hands on his head, he repeated all things that the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: Et impositis capiti ejus manibus, cuncta replicavit quæ mandaverat Dominus.

verses.text: The  Lord also said to Moses:
verses.textLatin: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:

verses.text: Command the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them: Offer ye my oblation and my bread, and burnt sacrifice of most sweet odour, in their due seasons.
verses.textLatin: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dices ad eos: Oblationem meam et panes, et incensum odoris suavissimi offerte per tempora sua.

verses.text: These are the sacrifices which you shall offer: Two lambs of a year old without blemish every day for the perpetual holocaust:
verses.textLatin: Hæc sunt sacrificia quæ offerre debetis: agnos anniculos immaculatos duos quotidie in holocaustum sempiternum:

verses.text: One you shall offer in the morning, and the other in the evening:
verses.textLatin: unum offeretis mane, et alterum ad vesperum:

verses.text: And the tenth part of an ephi of flour, which shall be tempered with the purest oil, of the measure of the fourth part of a hin.
verses.textLatin: decimam partem ephi similæ, quæ conspersa sit oleo purissimo, et habeat quartam partem hin.

verses.text: It is the continual holocaust which you offered in mount Sinai for a most sweet odour of a sacrifice by fire to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Holocaustum juge est quod obtulistis in monte Sinai in odorem suavissimum incensi Domini.

verses.text: And for a libation you shall offer of wine the fourth part of a hin for every lamb in the sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et libabitis vini quartam partem hin per agnos singulos in sanctuario Domini.

verses.text: And you shall offer the other lamb in like manner in the evening according to all the rites of the morning sacrifice, and of the libations thereof, an oblation of most sweet odour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Alterumque agnum similiter offeretis ad vesperam juxta omnem ritum sacrificii matutini, et libamentorum ejus, oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.

verses.text: And on the sabbath day you shall offer two lambs of a year old without blemish, and two tenths of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice, and the libations,
verses.textLatin: Die autem sabbati offeretis duos agnos anniculos immaculatos, et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio, et liba:

verses.text: Which regularly are poured out every sabbath for the perpetual holocaust.
verses.textLatin: quæ rite funduntur per singula sabbata in holocaustum sempiternum.

verses.text: And on the first day of the month you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord, two calves of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish,
verses.textLatin: In calendis autem offeretis holocaustum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, agnos anniculos septem immaculatos,

verses.text: And three tenths of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice for every calf: and two tenths of flour tempered with oil for every ram:
verses.textLatin: et tres decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio per singulos vitulos: et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ per singulos arietes:

verses.text: And the tenth of a tenth of flour tempered with oil in sacrifice for every lamb. It is a holocaust of most sweet odour and an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et decimam decimæ similæ ex oleo in sacrificio per agnos singulos: holocaustum suavissimi odoris atque incensi est Domino.

verses.text: And these shall be the libations of wine that are to be poured out for every victim: Half a hin for every calf, a third for a ram, and a fourth for a lamb. This shall be the holocaust for every month, as they succeed one another in the course of the year.
verses.textLatin: Libamenta autem vini, quæ per singulas fundenda sunt victimas, ista erunt: media pars hin per singulos vitulos, tertia per arietem, quarta per agnum. Hoc erit holocaustum per omnes menses, qui sibi anno vertente succedunt.

verses.text: A buck goat also shall be offered to the Lord for a sin offering over and above the perpetual holocaust with its libations.
verses.textLatin: Hircus quoque offeretur Domino pro peccatis in holocaustum sempiternum cum libamentis suis.

verses.text: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, shall be the phase of the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Mense autem primo, quartadecima die mensis, Phase Domini erit,

verses.text: And on the fifteenth day the solemn feast: seven days shall they eat unleavened bread.
verses.textLatin: et quintadecima die solemnitas: septem diebus vescentur azymis.

verses.text: And the first day of them shall be venerable and holy: you shall not do any servile work therein.
verses.textLatin: Quarum dies prima venerabilis et sancta erit: omne opus servile non facietis in ea.

verses.text: And you shall offer a burnt sacrifice a holocaust to the Lord, two calves of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Offeretisque incensum holocaustum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:

verses.text: And for the sacrifices of every one three tenths of flour which shall be tempered with oil to every calf, and two tenths to every ram,
verses.textLatin: et sacrificia singulorum ex simila quæ conspersa sit oleo, tres decimas per singulos vitulos, et duas decimas per arietem,

verses.text: And the tenth of a tenth, to every lamb, that is to say, to all the seven lambs:
verses.textLatin: et decimam decimæ per agnos singulos, id est, per septem agnos.

verses.text: And one buck goat for sin, to make atonement for you,
verses.textLatin: Et hircum pro peccato unum, ut expietur pro vobis,

verses.text: Besides the morning holocaust which you shall always offer.
verses.textLatin: præter holocaustum matutinum, quod semper offeretis.

verses.text: So shall you do every day of the seven days for the food of the fire, and for a most sweet odour to the Lord, which shall rise from the holocaust, and from the libations of each.
verses.textLatin: Ita facietis per singulos dies septem dierum in fomitem ignis, et in odorem suavissimum Domino, qui surget de holocausto, et de libationibus singulorum.

verses.text: The seventh day also shall be most solemn and holy unto you: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.textLatin: Dies quoque septimus celeberrimus et sanctus erit vobis: omne opus servile non facietis in eo.

verses.text: The day also of firstfruits, when after the weeks are accomplished, you shall offer new fruits to the Lord, shall be venerable and holy: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.textLatin: Dies etiam primitivorum, quando offeretis novas fruges Domino, expletis hebdomadibus, venerabilis et sancta erit: omne opus servile non facietis in ea.

verses.text: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord, two calves of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulos de armento duos, arietem unum, et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:

verses.text: And in the sacrifices of them three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two to every ram,
verses.textLatin: atque in sacrificiis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, per arietes duas,

verses.text: The tenth of a tenth to every lamb, which in all are seven lambs: a buck goat also,
verses.textLatin: per agnos decimam decimæ, qui simul sunt agni septem. Hircum quoque,

verses.text: Which is slain for expiation: besides the perpetual holocaust and the libations thereof.
verses.textLatin: qui mactatur pro expiatione: præter holocaustum sempiternum et liba ejus.

verses.text: You shall offer them all without blemish with their libations.
verses.textLatin: Immaculata offeretis omnia cum libationibus suis.

verses.text: The  first day also of the seventh month shall be venerable and holy unto you; you shall do no servile work therein, because it is the day of the sounding and of trumpets.
verses.textLatin: Mensis etiam septimi prima dies venerabilis et sancta erit vobis. Omne opus servile non facietis in ea, quia dies clangoris est et tubarum.

verses.text: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord, one calf of the herd, one ram and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish.
verses.textLatin: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulum de armento unum, arietem unum, et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:

verses.text: And for their sacrifices, three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two tenths to a ram,
verses.textLatin: et in sacrificiis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, duas decimas per arietem,

verses.text: One tenth to a lamb, which in all are seven lambs:
verses.textLatin: unam decimam per agnum, qui simul sunt agni septem:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, which is offered for the expiation of the people,
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, qui offertur in expiationem populi,

verses.text: Besides the holocaust of the first day of the month with the sacrifices thereof, and the perpetual holocaust with the accustomed libations. With the same ceremonies you shall offer a burnt sacrifice for a most sweet odour to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: præter holocaustum calendarum cum sacrificiis suis, et holocaustum sempiternum cum libationibus solitis: eisdem cæremoniis offeretis in odorem suavissimum incensum Domino.

verses.text: The tenth day also of this seventh month shall be holy and venerable unto you, and you shall afflict your souls: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.textLatin: Decima quoque dies mensis hujus septimi erit vobis sancta atque venerabilis, et affligetis animas vestras: omne opus servile non facietis in ea.

verses.text: And you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord for a most sweet odour, one calf of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Offeretisque holocaustum Domino in odorem suavissimum, vitulum de armento unum, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:

verses.text: And for their sacrifices, three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, two tenths to a ram,
verses.textLatin: et in sacrificiis eorum similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos, duas decimas per arietem,

verses.text: The tenth of a tenth to every lamb, which are in all seven lambs:
verses.textLatin: decimam decimæ per agnos singulos, qui sunt simul agni septem:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the things that are wont to be offered for sin, for expiation, and for the perpetual holocaust with their sacrifice and libations.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque his quæ offerri pro delicto solent in expiationem, et holocaustum sempiternum, cum sacrificio et libaminibus eorum.

verses.text: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, which shall be unto you holy and venerable, you shall do no servile work, but shall celebrate a solemnity to the Lord seven days.
verses.textLatin: Quintadecima vero die mensis septimi, quæ vobis sancta erit atque venerabilis, omne opus servile non facietis in ea, sed celebrabitis solemnitatem Domino septem diebus.

verses.text: And you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord, thirteen calves of the herd, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulos de armento tredecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And for their libations three tenths of flour tempered with oil to every calf, being in all thirteen calves: and two tenths to each ram, being two rams,
verses.textLatin: et in libamentis eorum, similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per vitulos singulos, qui sunt simul vituli tredecim, et duas decimas arieti uno, id est, simul arietibus duobus,

verses.text: And the tenth of a tenth to every lamb, being in all fourteen lambs:
verses.textLatin: et decimam decimæ agnis singulis, qui sunt simul agni quatuordecim:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, et sacrificio, et libamine ejus.

verses.text: On the second day you shall offer twelve calves of the herd, two rams and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: In die altero offeretis vitulos de armento duodecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations for every one, for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall duly celebrate:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for a sin offering besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque et libamine ejus.

verses.text: The third day you shall offer eleven calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Die tertio offeretis vitulos undecim, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall offer according to the rite:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice, and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque et libamine ejus.

verses.text: The fourth day you shall offer ten calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Die quarto offeretis vitulos decem, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate in right manner:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.

verses.text: The fifth day you shall offer nine calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Die quinto offeretis vitulos novem, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.

verses.text: The sixth day you shall offer eight calves, two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Die sexto offeretis vitulos octo, arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.

verses.text: The seventh day you shall offer seven calves and two rams, and fourteen lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: Die septimo offeretis vitulos septem, et arietes duos, agnos anniculos immaculatos quatuordecim:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.

verses.text: On the eighth day, which is most solemn, you shall do no servile work:
verses.textLatin: Die octavo, qui est celeberrimus, omne opus servile non facietis,

verses.text: But you shall offer a holocaust for a most sweet odour to the Lord, one calf, one ram, and seven lambs of a year old, without blemish:
verses.textLatin: offerentes holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, vitulum unum, arietem unum, agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:

verses.text: And the sacrifices and the libations of every one for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs you shall celebrate according to the rite:
verses.textLatin: sacrificiaque et libamina singulorum, per vitulos, et arietes, et agnos rite celebrabitis:

verses.text: And a buck goat for sin, besides the perpetual holocaust, and the sacrifice and the libation thereof.
verses.textLatin: et hircum pro peccato, absque holocausto sempiterno, sacrificioque ejus et libamine.

verses.text: These things shall you offer to the Lord in your solemnities: besides your vows and voluntary oblations for holocaust, for sacrifice, for libation, and for victims of peace offerings.
verses.textLatin: Hæc offeretis Domino in solemnitatibus vestris: præter vota et oblationes spontaneas in holocausto, in sacrificio, in libamine, et in hostiis pacificis.

verses.text: And  Moses told the children of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him:
verses.textLatin: Narravitque Moyses filiis Israël omnia quæ ei Dominus imperarat.

verses.text: And he said to the princes of the tribes of the children of Israel: This is the word that the Lord hath commanded:
verses.textLatin: Et locutus est ad principes tribuum filiorum Israël: Iste est sermo quem præcepit Dominus:

verses.text: If any man make a vow to the Lord, or bind himself by an oath: he shall not make his word void but shall fulfil all that he promised.
verses.textLatin: Si quis virorum votum Domino voverit, aut se constrinxerit juramento: non faciet irritum verbum suum, sed omne quod promisit, implebit.

verses.text: If a woman vow any thing, and bind herself by an oath, being in her father’s house, and but yet a girl in age: if her father knew the vow that she hath promised, and the oath wherewith she hath bound her soul, and held his peace, she shall be bound by the vow:
verses.textLatin: Mulier si quippiam voverit, et se constrinxerit juramento, quæ est in domo patris sui, et in ætate adhuc puellari: si cognoverit pater votum quod pollicita est, et juramentum quo obligavit animam suam, et tacuerit, voti rea erit:

verses.text: Whatsoever she promised and swore, she shall fulfil in deed.
verses.textLatin: quidquid pollicita est, et juravit, opere complebit.

verses.text: But if her father, immediately as soon as he heard it, gainsaid it, both her vows and her oaths shall be void, neither shall she be bound to what she promised, because her father hath gainsaid it.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem statim ut audierit, contradixerit pater: et vota et juramenta ejus irrita erunt, nec obnoxia tenebitur sponsioni, eo quod contradixerit pater.

verses.text: If she have a husband, and shall vow any thing, and the word once going out of her mouth shall bind her soul by an oath:
verses.textLatin: Si maritum habuerit, et voverit aliquid, et semel de ore ejus verbum egrediens animam ejus obligaverit juramento:

verses.text: The day that her husband shall hear it, and not gainsay it, she shall be bound to the vow, and shall give whatsoever she promised.
verses.textLatin: quo die audierit vir, et non contradixerit, voti rea erit, reddetque quodcumque promiserat.

verses.text: But if as soon as he heareth he gainsay it, and make her promises and the words wherewith she had bound her soul of no effect: the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem audiens statim contradixerit, et irritas fecerit pollicitationes ejus, verbaque quibus obstrinxerat animam suam, propitius erit ei Dominus.

verses.text: The widow, and she that is divorced, shall fulfil whatsoever they vow.
verses.textLatin: Vidua et repudiata quidquid voverint, reddent.

verses.text: If the wife in the house of her husband, hath bound herself by vow and by oath,
verses.textLatin: Uxor in domo viri cum se voto constrinxerit et juramento,

verses.text: If her husband hear, and hold his peace, and doth not disallow the promise, she shall accomplish whatsoever she had promised.
verses.textLatin: si audierit vir, et tacuerit, nec contradixerit sponsioni, reddet quodcumque promiserat.

verses.text: But if forthwith he gainsay it, she shall not be bound by the promise: because her husband gainsaid it, and the Lord will be merciful to her.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem extemplo contradixerit, non tenebitur promissionis rea: quia maritus contradixit, et Dominus ei propitius erit.

verses.text: If she vow and bind herself by oath, to afflict her soul by fasting, or abstinence from other things, it shall depend on the will of her husband, whether she shall do it, or not do it.
verses.textLatin: Si voverit, et juramento se constrinxerit, ut per jejunium, vel ceterarum rerum abstinentiam affligat animam suam, in arbitrio viri erit ut faciat, sive non faciat.

verses.text: But if the husband hearing it hold his peace, and defer the declaring his mind till another day: whatsoever she had vowed and promised, she shall fulfil: because immediately as he heard it, he held his peace.
verses.textLatin: Quod si audiens vir tacuerit, et in alteram diem distulerit sententiam, quidquid voverat atque promiserat, reddet: quia statim ut audivit, tacuit.

verses.text: But if he gainsay it after that he knew it, he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem contradixerit postquam rescivit, portabit ipse iniquitatem ejus.

verses.text: These are the laws which the Lord appointed to Moses between the husband and the wife, between the father and the daughter that is as yet but a girl in age, or that abideth in her father’s house.
verses.textLatin: Istæ sunt leges, quas constituit Dominus Moysi inter virum et uxorem, inter patrem et filiam, quæ in puellari adhuc ætate est, vel quæ manet in parentis domo.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Revenge first the children of Israel on the Madianites, and so thou shalt be gathered to thy people.
verses.textLatin: Ulciscere prius filios Israël de Madianitis, et sic colligeris ad populum tuum.

verses.text: And Moses forthwith said: Arm of you men to fight, who may take the revenge of the Lord on the Madianites.
verses.textLatin: Statimque Moyses: Armate, inquit, ex vobis viros ad pugnam, qui possint ultionem Domini expetere de Madianitis.

verses.text: Let a thousand men be chosen out of every tribe of Israel to be sent to the war.
verses.textLatin: Mille viri de singulis tribubus eligantur ex Israël qui mittantur ad bellum.

verses.text: And they gave a thousand of every tribe, that is to say, twelve thousand men well appointed for battle.
verses.textLatin: Dederuntque millenos de singulis tribubus, id est, duodecim millia expeditorum ad pugnam:

verses.text: And Moses sent them with Phinees the son of Eleazar the priest, and he delivered to him the holy vessels, and the trumpets to sound.
verses.textLatin: quos misit Moyses cum Phinees filio Eleazari sacerdotis, vasa quoque sancta, et tubas ad clangendum tradidit ei.

verses.text: And when they had fought against the Madianites and had overcome them, they slew all the men.
verses.textLatin: Cumque pugnassent contra Madianitas atque vicissent, omnes mares occiderunt,

verses.text: And their kings Evi, and Recem, and Sur, and Hur, and Rebe, five princes of the nation: Balaam also the son of Beor they killed with the sword.
verses.textLatin: et reges eorum, Evi, et Recem, et Sur, et Hur, et Rebe, quinque principes gentis: Balaam quoque filium Beor interfecerunt gladio.

verses.text: And they took their women, and their children captives, and all their cattle, and all their goods: and all their possessions they plundered:
verses.textLatin: Ceperuntque mulieres eorum, et parvulos, omniaque pecora, et cunctam supellectilem: quidquid habere potuerant depopulati sunt:

verses.text: And all their cities, and their villages, and castles, they burned.
verses.textLatin: tam urbes quam viculos et castella flamma consumpsit.

verses.text: And they carried away the booty, and all that they had taken both of men and of beasts.
verses.textLatin: Et tulerunt prædam, et universa quæ ceperant tam ex hominibus quam ex jumentis,

verses.text: And they brought them to Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and to all the multitude of the children of Israel. But the rest of the things for use they carried to the camp on the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan over against Jericho.
verses.textLatin: et adduxerunt ad Moysen, et Eleazarum sacerdotem, et ad omnem multitudinem filiorum Israël: reliqua autem utensilia portaverunt ad castra in campestribus Moab juxta Jordanem contra Jericho.

verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the princes of the synagogue went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.textLatin: Egressi sunt autem Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos, et omnes principes synagogæ, in occursum eorum extra castra.

verses.text: And Moses being angry with the chief officers of the army, the tribunes, and the centurions that were come from the battle,
verses.textLatin: Iratusque Moyses principibus exercitus, tribunis, et centurionibus qui venerant de bello,

verses.text: Said: Why have you saved the women?
verses.textLatin: ait: Cur feminas reservastis?

verses.text: Are not these they, that deceived the children of Israel by the counsel of Balaam, and made you transgress against the Lord by the sin of Phogor, for which also the people was punished?
verses.textLatin: nonne istæ sunt, quæ deceperunt filios Israël ad suggestionem Balaam, et prævaricari vos fecerunt in Domino super peccato Phogor, unde et percussus est populus?

verses.text: Therefore kill all that are of the male sex, even of the children: and put to death the women, that have carnally known men.
verses.textLatin: ergo cunctos interficite quidquid est generis masculini, etiam in parvulis: et mulieres, quæ noverunt viros in coitu, jugulate:

verses.text: But the girls, and all the women that are virgins save for yourselves:
verses.textLatin: puellas autem et omnes feminas virgines reservate vobis:

verses.text: And stay without the camp seven days. He that hath killed a man, or touched one that is killed, shall be purified the third day and the seventh day.
verses.textLatin: et manete extra castra septem diebus. Qui occiderit hominem, vel occisum tetigerit, lustrabitur die tertio et septimo.

verses.text: And of all the spoil, every garment, or vessel, or any thing made for use, of the skins, or hair of goats, or of wood, shall be purified.
verses.textLatin: Et de omni præda, sive vestimentum fuerit, sive vas, et aliquid in utensilia præparatum, de caprarum pellibus, et pilis, et ligno, expiabitur.

verses.text: Eleazar also the priest spoke to the men of the army, that had fought, in this manner: This is the ordinance of the law, which the Lord hath commanded Moses:
verses.textLatin: Eleazar quoque sacerdos ad viros exercitus, qui pugnaverunt, sic locutus est: Hoc est præceptum legis, quod mandavit Dominus Moysi:

verses.text: Gold, and silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin,
verses.textLatin: aurum, et argentum, et æs, et ferrum, et plumbum, et stannum,

verses.text: And all that may pass through the fire, shall be purified by fire, but whatsoever cannot abide the fire, shall be sanctified with the water of expiation:
verses.textLatin: et omne, quod potest transire per flammas, igne purgabitur: quidquid autem ignem non potest sustinere, aqua expiationis sanctificabitur:

verses.text: And you shall wash your garments the seventh day, and being purified, you shall afterwards enter into the camp.
verses.textLatin: et lavabitis vestimenta vestra die septimo, et purificati postea castra intrabitis.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textLatin: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:

verses.text: Take the sum of the things that were taken both of man and beast, thou and Eleazar the priest and the princes of the multitude:
verses.textLatin: Tollite summam eorum quæ capta sunt, ab homine usque ad pecus, tu et Eleazar sacerdos et principes vulgi:

verses.text: And thou shalt divide the spoil equally, between them that fought and went out to the war, and between the rest of the multitude.
verses.textLatin: dividesque ex æquo prædam inter eos qui pugnaverunt egressique sunt ad bellum, et inter omnem reliquam multitudinem.

verses.text: And thou shalt separate a portion to the Lord from them that fought and were in the battle, one soul of five hundred as well of persons as of oxen and asses and sheep.
verses.textLatin: Et separabis partem Domino ab his qui pugnaverunt et fuerunt in bello, unam animam de quingentis, tam ex hominibus quam ex bobus et asinis et ovibus,

verses.text: And thou shalt give it to Eleazar the priest, because they are the firstfruits of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et dabis eam Eleazaro sacerdoti, quia primitiæ Domini sunt.

verses.text: Out of the moiety also of the children of Israel thou shalt take the fiftieth head of persons, and of oxen, and asses, and sheep, and of all beasts, and thou shalt give them to the Levites that watch in the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Ex media quoque parte filiorum Israël accipies quinquagesimum caput hominum, et boum, et asinorum, et ovium, cunctorum animantium, et dabis ea Levitis, qui excubant in custodiis tabernaculi Domini.

verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar did as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: Feceruntque Moyses et Eleazar sicut præceperat Dominus.

verses.text: And the spoil which the army had taken, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.textLatin: Fuit autem præda, quam exercitus ceperat, ovium sexcenta septuaginta quinque millia,

verses.text: Seventy-two thousand oxen,
verses.textLatin: boum septuaginta duo millia,

verses.text: Sixty-one thousand asses:
verses.textLatin: asinorum sexaginta millia et mille:

verses.text: And thirty-two thousand persons of the female sex, that had not known men.
verses.textLatin: animæ hominum sexus feminei, quæ non cognoverant viros, triginta duo millia.

verses.text: And one half was given to them that had been in the battle, to wit, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
verses.textLatin: Dataque est media pars his qui in prælio fuerant, ovium trecenta triginta septem millia quingentæ:

verses.text: Out of which, for the portion of the Lord, were reckoned six hundred seventy-five sheep.
verses.textLatin: e quibus in partem Domini supputatæ sunt oves sexcentæ septuaginta quinque:

verses.text: And out of the thirty-six thousand oxen, seventy-two oxen:
verses.textLatin: et de bobus triginta sex millibus, boves septuaginta et duo:

verses.text: Out of the thirty thousand five hundred asses, sixty-one asses:
verses.textLatin: de asinis triginta millibus quingentis, asini sexaginta unus:

verses.text: Out of the sixteen thousand persons, there fell to the portion of the Lord, thirty-two souls.
verses.textLatin: de animabus hominum sedecim millibus, cesserunt in partem Domini triginta duæ animæ.

verses.text: And Moses delivered the number of the firstfruits of the Lord to Eleazar the priest, as had been commanded him,
verses.textLatin: Tradiditque Moyses numerum primitiarum Domini Eleazaro sacerdoti, sicut fuerat ei imperatum,

verses.text: Out of the half of the children of Israel, which he had separated for them that had been in the battle.
verses.textLatin: ex media parte filiorum Israël, quam separaverat his qui in prælio fuerant.

verses.text: But out of the half that fell to the rest of the multitude, that is to say, out of the three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
verses.textLatin: De media vero parte, quæ contigerat reliquæ multitudini, id est, de ovibus trecentis triginta septem millibus quingentis,

verses.text: And out of the thirty-six thousand oxen,
verses.textLatin: et de bobus triginta sex millibus,

verses.text: And out of the thirty thousand five hundred asses,
verses.textLatin: et de asinis triginta millibus quingentis,

verses.text: And out of the sixteen thousand persons,
verses.textLatin: et de hominibus sedecim millibus,

verses.text: Moses took the fiftieth head, and gave it to the Levites that watched in the tabernacle of the Lord, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textLatin: tulit Moyses quinquagesimum caput, et dedit Levitis, qui excubabant in tabernaculo Domini, sicut præceperat Dominus.

verses.text: And when the commanders of the army, and the tribunes and centurions were come to Moses, they said:
verses.textLatin: Cumque accessissent principes exercitus ad Moysen, et tribuni, centurionesque, dixerunt:

verses.text: We thy servants have reckoned up the number of the fighting men, whom we had under our hand, and not so much as one was wanting.
verses.textLatin: Nos servi tui recensuimus numerum pugnatorum, quos habuimus sub manu nostra: et ne unus quidem defuit.

verses.text: Therefore we offer as gifts to the Lord what gold every one of us could find in the booty, in garters and tablets, rings and bracelets, and chains, that thou mayst pray to the Lord for us.
verses.textLatin: Ob hanc causam offerimus in donariis Domini singuli quod in præda auri potuimus invenire, periscelides et armillas, annulos et dextralia, ac murænulas, ut depreceris pro nobis Dominum.

verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received all the gold in divers kinds,
verses.textLatin: Susceperuntque Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos omne aurum in diversis speciebus,

verses.text: In weight sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty sicles, from the tribunes and from the centurions.
verses.textLatin: pondo sedecim millia septingentos quinquaginta siclos, a tribunis et centurionibus.

verses.text: For that which every one had taken in the booty was his own.
verses.textLatin: Unusquisque enim quod in præda rapuerat, suum erat.

verses.text: And that which was received they brought into the tabernacle of the testimony, for a memorial of the children of Israel before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et susceptum intulerunt in tabernaculum testimonii, in monimentum filiorum Israël coram Domino.

verses.text: And  the sons of Ruben and Gad had many flocks of cattle, and their substance in beasts was infinite. And when they saw the lands of Jazer and Galaad fit for feeding cattle,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Ruben et Gad habebant pecora multa, et erat illis in jumentis infinita substantia. Cumque vidissent Jazer et Galaad aptas animalibus alendis terras,

verses.text: They came to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and the princes of the multitude, and said:
verses.textLatin: venerunt ad Moysen, et ad Elezarum sacerdotem, et principes multitudinis, atque dixerunt:

verses.text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nemra, Hesebon, and Eleale, and Saban, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.textLatin: Ataroth, et Dibon, et Jazer, et Nemra, Hesebon, et Eleale, et Saban, et Nebo, et Beon,

verses.text: The land, which the Lord hath conquered in the sight of the children of Israel, is a very fertile soil for the feeding of beasts: and we thy servants have very much cattle:
verses.textLatin: terra, quam percussit Dominus in conspectu filiorum Israël, regio uberrima est ad pastum animalium: et nos servi tui habemus jumenta plurima,

verses.text: And we pray thee, if we have found favour in thy sight, that thou give it to us thy servants in possession, and make us not pass over the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: precamurque si invenimus gratiam coram te, ut des nobis famulis tuis eam in possessionem, nec facias nos transire Jordanem.

verses.text: And Moses answered them: What, shall your brethren go to fight, and will you sit here?
verses.textLatin: Quibus respondit Moyses: Numquid fratres vestri ibunt ad pugnam, et vos hic sedebitis?

verses.text: Why do ye overturn the minds of the children of Israel, that they may not dare to pass into the place which the Lord hath given them?
verses.textLatin: cur subvertitis mentes filiorum Israël, ne transire audeant in locum, quem eis daturus est Dominus?

verses.text: Was it not thus your fathers did, when I sent from Cadesbarne to view the land?
verses.textLatin: Nonne ita egerunt patres vestri, quando misi de Cadesbarne ad explorandam terram?

verses.text: And when they were come as far as the valley of the cluster, having viewed all the country, they overturned the hearts of the children of Israel, that they should not enter into the coasts, which the Lord gave them.
verses.textLatin: cumque venissent usque ad Vallem botri, lustrata omni regione, subverterunt cor filiorum Israël, ut non intrarent fines, quos eis Dominus dedit.

verses.text: And he swore in his anger, saying:
verses.textLatin: Qui iratus juravit, dicens:

verses.text: If these men, that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land, which I promised with an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: because they would not follow me,
verses.textLatin: Si videbunt homines isti, qui ascenderunt ex Ægypto a viginti annis et supra, terram, quam sub juramento pollicitus sum Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob: et noluerunt sequi me,

verses.text: Except Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite, and Josue the son of Nun: these have fulfilled my will.
verses.textLatin: præter Caleb filium Jephone Cenezæum, et Josue filium Nun: isti impleverunt voluntatem meam.

verses.text: And the Lord being angry against Israel, led them about through the desert forty years, until the whole generation, that had done evil in his sight, was consumed.
verses.textLatin: Iratusque Dominus adversum Israël, circumduxit eum per desertum quadraginta annis, donec consumeretur universa generatio, quæ fecerat malum in conspectu ejus.

verses.text: And behold, said he, you are risen up instead of your fathers, the increase and offspring of sinful men, to augment the fury of the Lord against Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et ecce, inquit, vos surrexistis pro patribus vestris, incrementa et alumni hominum peccatorum, ut augeretis furorem Domini contra Israël.

verses.text: For if you will not follow him, he will leave the people in the wilderness, and you shall be the cause of the destruction of all.
verses.textLatin: Quod si nolueritis sequi eum, in solitudine populum derelinquet, et vos causa eritis necis omnium.

verses.text: But they coming near, said: We will make sheepfolds, and stalls for our cattle, and strong cities for our children:
verses.textLatin: At illi prope accedentes, dixerunt: Caulas ovium fabricabimus, et stabula jumentorum, parvulis quoque nostris urbes munitas:

verses.text: And we ourselves will go armed and ready for battle before the children of Israel, until we bring them in unto their places. Our little ones, and all we have, shall be in walled cities, for fear of the ambushes of the inhabitants.
verses.textLatin: nos autem ipsi armati et accincti pergemus ad prælium ante filios Israël, donec introducamus eos ad loca sua. Parvuli nostri, et quidquid habere possumus, erunt in urbibus muratis, propter habitatorum insidias.

verses.text: We will not return into our houses until the children of Israel possess their inheritance:
verses.textLatin: Non revertemur in domos nostras, usque dum possideant filii Israël hæreditatem suam:

verses.text: Neither will we seek any thing beyond the Jordan, because we have already our possession on the east side thereof,
verses.textLatin: nec quidquam quæremus trans Jordanem, quia jam habemus nostram possessionem in orientali ejus plaga.

verses.text: And Moses said to them: If you do what you promise, go on well appointed for war before the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Quibus Moyses ait: Si facitis quod promittitis, expediti pergite coram Domino ad pugnam:

verses.text: And let every fighting man pass over the Jordan, until the Lord overthrow his enemies:
verses.textLatin: et omnis vir bellator armatus Jordanem transeat, donec subvertat Dominus inimicos suos,

verses.text: And all the land be brought under him, then shall you be blameless before the Lord and before Israel, and you shall obtain the countries that you desire, before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et subjiciatur ei omnis terra: tunc eritis inculpabiles apud Dominum et apud Israël, et obtinebitis regiones, quas vultis, coram Domino.

verses.text: But if you do not what you say, no man can doubt but you sin against God: and know ye, that your sin shall overtake you.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem quod dicitis, non feceritis, nulli dubium est quin peccetis in Deum: et scitote quoniam peccatum vestrum apprehendet vos.

verses.text: Build therefore cities for your children, and folds and stalls for your sheep and beasts, and accomplish what you have promised.
verses.textLatin: Ædificate ergo urbes parvulis vestris, et caulas, et stabula ovibus ac jumentis: et quod polliciti estis, implete.

verses.text: And the children of Gad and Ruben said to Moses: We are thy servants, we will do what my lord commandeth.
verses.textLatin: Dixeruntque filii Gad et Ruben ad Moysen: Servi tui sumus: faciemus quod jubet dominus noster.

verses.text: We will leave our children, and our wives and sheep and cattle in the cities of Galaad:
verses.textLatin: Parvulos nostros, et mulieres, et pecora, ac jumenta relinquemus in urbibus Galaad:

verses.text: And we thy servants all well appointed will march on to the war, as thou, my lord, speakest.
verses.textLatin: nos autem famuli tui omnes expediti pergemus ad bellum, sicut tu, domine, loqueris.

verses.text: Moses therefore commanded Eleazar the priest, and Josue the son of Nun, and the princes of the families of all the tribes of Israel, and said to them:
verses.textLatin: Præcepit ergo Moyses Eleazaro sacerdoti, et Josue filio Nun, et principibus familiarum per tribus Israël, et dixit ad eos:

verses.text: If the children of Gad, and the children of Ruben pass with you over the Jordan, all armed for war before the Lord, and the land be made subject to you: give them Galaad in possession.
verses.textLatin: Si transierint filii Gad et filii Ruben vobiscum Jordanem omnes armati ad bellum coram Domino, et vobis fuerit terra subjecta, date eis Galaad in possessionem.

verses.text: But if they will not pass armed with you into the land of Chanaan, let them receive places to dwell in among you.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem noluerint transire armati vobiscum in terram Chanaan, inter vos habitandi accipiant loca.

verses.text: And the children of Gad, and the children of Ruben answered: As the Lord hath spoken to his servants, so will we do:
verses.textLatin: Responderuntque filii Gad et filii Ruben: Sicut locutus est Dominus servis suis, ita faciemus:

verses.text: We will go armed before the Lord into the land of Chanaan, and we confess that we have already received our possession beyond the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: ipsi armati pergemus coram Domino in terram Chanaan, et possessionem jam suscepisse nos confitemur trans Jordanem.

verses.text: Moses therefore gave to the children of Gad and of Ruben, and to the half tribe of Manasses the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sehon king of the Amorrhites, and the kingdom of Og king of Basan, and their land and the cities thereof round about.
verses.textLatin: Dedit itaque Moyses filiis Gad et Ruben, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse filii Joseph, regnum Sehon regis Amorrhæi, et regnum Og regis Basan, et terram eorum cum urbibus suis per circuitum.

verses.text: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.textLatin: Igitur exstruxerunt filii Gad, Dibon, et Ataroth, et Aroër,

verses.text: And Etroth, and Sophan, and Jazer, and Jegbaa,
verses.textLatin: et Etroth, et Sophan, et Jazer, et Jegbaa,

verses.text: And Bethnemra, and Betharan, fenced cities, and folds for their cattle.
verses.textLatin: et Bethnemra, et Betharan, urbes munitas, et caulas pecoribus suis.

verses.text: But the children of Ruben built Hesebon, and Eleale, and Cariathaim,
verses.textLatin: Filii vero Ruben ædificaverunt Hesebon, et Eleale, et Cariathaim,

verses.text: And Nabo, and Baalmeon (their names being changed) and Sabama: giving names to the cities which they had built.
verses.textLatin: et Nabo, et Baalmeon versis nominibus, Sabama quoque: imponentes vocabula urbibus, quas exstruxerunt.

verses.text: Moreover the children of Machir, the son of Manasses, went into Galaad, and wasted it, cutting off the Amorrhites, the inhabitants thereof.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Machir filii Manasse, perrexerunt in Galaad, et vastaverunt eam interfecto Amorrhæo habitatore ejus.

verses.text: And Moses gave the land of Galaad to Machir the son of Manasses, and he dwelt in it.
verses.textLatin: Dedit ergo Moyses terram Galaad Machir filio Manasse, qui habitavit in ea.

verses.text: And Jair the son of Manasses went, and took the villages thereof, and he called them Havoth Jair, that is to say, the villages of Jair.
verses.textLatin: Jair autem filius Manasse abiit, et occupavit vicos ejus, quos appellavit Havoth Jair, id est, Villas Jair.

verses.text: Nobe also went, and took Canath with the villages thereof: and he called it by his own name, Nobe.
verses.textLatin: Nobe quoque perrexit, et apprehendit Chanath cum viculis suis: vocavitque eam ex nomine suo Nobe.

verses.text: These  are the mansions of the children of Israel, who went out of Egypt by their troops under the conduct of Moses and Aaron,
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt mansiones filiorum Israël, qui egressi sunt de Ægypto per turmas suas in manu Moysi et Aaron,

verses.text: Which Moses wrote down according to the places of their encamping, which they changed by the commandment of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: quas descripsit Moyses juxta castrorum loca, quæ Domini jussione mutabant.

verses.text: Now the children of Israel departed from Ramesses the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the phase, with a mighty hand, in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.textLatin: Profecti igitur de Ramesse mense primo, quintadecima die mensis primi, altera die Phase, filii Israël in manu excelsa, videntibus cunctis Ægyptiis,

verses.text: Who were burying their firstborn, whom the Lord had slain (upon their gods also he had executed vengeance,)
verses.textLatin: et sepelientibus primogenitos, quos percusserat Dominus (nam et in diis eorum exercuerat ultionem),

verses.text: And they camped in Soccoth.
verses.textLatin: castrametati sunt in Soccoth.

verses.text: And from Soccoth they came into Etham, which is in the uttermost borders of the wilderness.
verses.textLatin: Et de Soccoth venerunt in Etham, quæ est in extremis finibus solitudinis.

verses.text: Departing from thence they came over against Phihahiroth, which looketh towards Beelsephon, and they camped before Magdalum.
verses.textLatin: Inde egressi venerunt contra Phihahiroth, quæ respicit Beelsephon, et castrametati sunt ante Magdalum.

verses.text: And departing from Phihahiroth, they passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and having marched three days through the desert of Etham, they camped in Mara.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Phihahiroth, transierunt per medium mare in solitudinem: et ambulantes tribus diebus per desertum Etham, castrametati sunt in Mara.

verses.text: And departing from Mara, they came into Elim, where there were twelve fountains of waters, and seventy palm trees: and there they camped.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Mara, venerunt in Elim, ubi erant duodecim fontes aquarum, et palmæ septuaginta: ibique castrametati sunt.

verses.text: But departing from thence also, they pitched their tents by the Red Sea. And departing from the Red Sea,
verses.textLatin: Sed et inde egressi, fixerunt tentoria super mare Rubrum. Profectique de mari Rubro,

verses.text: They camped in the desert of Sin.
verses.textLatin: castrametati sunt in deserto Sin.

verses.text: And they removed from thence, and came to Daphca.
verses.textLatin: Unde egressi, venerunt in Daphca.

verses.text: And departing from Daphca, they camped in Alus.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Daphca, castrametati sunt in Alus.

verses.text: And departing from Alus, they pitched their tents in Raphidim, where the people wanted water to drink.
verses.textLatin: Egressique de Alus, in Raphidim fixere tentoria, ubi populo defuit aqua ad bibendum.

verses.text: And departing from Raphidim, they camped in the desert of Sinai.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Raphidim, castrametati sunt in deserto Sinai.

verses.text: But departing also from the desert of Sinai, they came to the graves of lust.
verses.textLatin: Sed et de solitudine Sinai egressi, venerunt ad sepulchra concupiscentiæ.

verses.text: And departing from the graves of lust, they camped in Haseroth.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de sepulchris concupiscentiæ, castrametati sunt in Haseroth.

verses.text: And from Haseroth they came to Rethma.
verses.textLatin: Et de Haseroth venerunt in Rethma.

verses.text: And departing from Rethma, they camped in Remmomphares.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Rethma, castrametati sunt in Remmomphares.

verses.text: And they departed from thence and came to Lebna.
verses.textLatin: Unde egressi venerunt in Lebna.

verses.text: Removing from Lebna they camped in Ressa.
verses.textLatin: De Lebna castrametati sunt in Ressa.

verses.text: And departing from Ressa, they came to Ceelatha.
verses.textLatin: Egressique de Ressa, venerunt in Ceelatha.

verses.text: And they removed from thence and camped in the mountain Sepher.
verses.textLatin: Unde profecti, castrametati sunt in monte Sepher.

verses.text: Departing from the mountain Sepher, they came to Arada.
verses.textLatin: Egressi de monte Sepher, venerunt in Arada.

verses.text: From thence they went and camped in Maceloth.
verses.textLatin: Inde proficiscentes, castrametati sunt in Maceloth.

verses.text: And departing from Maceloth, they came to Thahath.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Maceloth, venerunt in Thahath.

verses.text: Removing from Thahath they camped in Thare.
verses.textLatin: De Thahath, castrametati sunt in Thare.

verses.text: And they departed from thence, and pitched their tents in Methca.
verses.textLatin: Unde egressi, fixere tentoria in Methca.

verses.text: And removing from Methca, they camped in Hesmona.
verses.textLatin: Et de Methca, castrametati sunt in Hesmona.

verses.text: And departing from Hesmona, they came to Moseroth.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Hesmona, venerunt in Moseroth.

verses.text: And removing from Moseroth, they camped in Benejaacan.
verses.textLatin: Et de Moseroth, castrametati sunt in Benejaacan.

verses.text: And departing from Benejaacan, they came to mount Gadgad.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Benejaacan, venerunt in montem Gadgad.

verses.text: From thence they went and camped in Jetebatha.
verses.textLatin: Unde profecti, castrametati sunt in Jetebatha.

verses.text: And from Jetebatha they came to Hebrona.
verses.textLatin: Et de Jetebatha venerunt in Hebrona.

verses.text: And departing from Hebrona, they camped in Asiongaber.
verses.textLatin: Egressique de Hebrona, castrametati sunt in Asiongaber.

verses.text: They removed from thence and came into the desert of Sin, which is Cades.
verses.textLatin: Inde profecti, venerunt in desertum Sin, hæc est Cades.

verses.text: And departing from Cades, they camped in mount Hor, in the uttermost borders of the land of Edom.
verses.textLatin: Egressique de Cades, castrametati sunt in monte Hor, in extremis finibus terræ Edom.

verses.text: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord: and there he died in the fortieth year of the coming forth of the children of Israel out of Egypt, the fifth month, the first day of the month,
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque Aaron sacerdos in montem Hor jubente Domino: et ibi mortuus est anno quadragesimo egressionis filiorum Israël ex Ægypto, mense quinto, prima die mensis,

verses.text: When he was a hundred and twenty-three years old.
verses.textLatin: cum esset annorum centum viginti trium.

verses.text: And king Arad the Chanaanite, who dwelt towards the south, heard that the children of Israel were come to the land of Chanaan.
verses.textLatin: Audivitque Chananæus rex Arad, qui habitabat ad meridiem, in terram Chanaan venisse filios Israël.

verses.text: And they departed from mount Hor, and camped in Salmona.
verses.textLatin: Et profecti de monte Hor, castrametati sunt in Salmona.

verses.text: From whence they removed and came to Phunon.
verses.textLatin: Unde egressi, venerunt in Phunon.

verses.text: And departing from Phunon, they camped in Oboth.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Phunon, castrametati sunt in Oboth.

verses.text: And from Oboth they came to Ijeabarim, which is in the borders of the Moabites.
verses.textLatin: Et de Oboth venerunt in Ijeabarim, quæ est in finibus Moabitarum.

verses.text: And departing from Ijeabarim they pitched their tents in Dibongab.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de Ijeabarim, fixere tentoria in Dibongad.

verses.text: From thence they went and camped in Helmondeblathaim.
verses.textLatin: Unde egressi, castrametati sunt in Helmondeblathaim.

verses.text: And departing from Helmondeblathaim, they came to the mountains of Abarim over against Nabo.
verses.textLatin: Egressique de Helmondeblathaim, venerunt ad montes Abarim contra Nabo.

verses.text: And departing from the mountains of Abarim, they passed to the plains of Moab, by the Jordan, over against Jericho.
verses.textLatin: Profectique de montibus Abarim, transierunt ad campestria Moab, supra Jordanem, contra Jericho.

verses.text: And there they camped from Bethsimoth even to Ablesatim in the plains of the Moabites,
verses.textLatin: Ibique castrametati sunt de Bethsimoth usque ad Abelsatim in planioribus locis Moabitarum.

verses.text: Where the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textLatin: Ubi locutus est Dominus ad Moysen:

verses.text: Command the children of Israel, and say to them: When you shall have passed over the Jordan, entering into the land of Chanaan,
verses.textLatin: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dic ad eos: Quando transieritis Jordanem, intrantes terram Chanaan,

verses.text: Destroy all the inhabitants of that land: Beat down their pillars, and break in pieces their statues, and waste all their high places,
verses.textLatin: disperdite cunctos habitatores terræ illius: confringite titulos, et statuas comminuite, atque omnia excelsa vastate,

verses.text: Cleansing the land, and dwelling in it. For I have given it you for a possession.
verses.textLatin: mundantes terram, et habitantes in ea. Ego enim dedi vobis illam in possessionem,

verses.text: And you shall divide it among you by lot. To the more you shall give a larger part, and to the fewer a lesser. To every one as the lot shall fall, so shall the inheritance be given. The possession shall be divided by the tribes and the families.
verses.textLatin: quam dividetis vobis sorte. Pluribus dabitis latiorem, et paucis angustiorem. Singulis ut sors ceciderit, ita tribuetur hæreditas. Per tribus et familias possessio dividetur.

verses.text: But if you will not kill the inhabitants of the land: they that remain, shall be unto you as nails in your eyes, and spears in your sides, and they shall be your adversaries in the land of your habitation.
verses.textLatin: Sin autem nolueritis interficere habitatores terræ: qui remanserint, erunt vobis quasi clavi in oculis, et lanceæ in lateribus, et adversabuntur vobis in terra habitationis vestræ:

verses.text: And whatsoever I had thought to do to them, I will do to you.
verses.textLatin: et quidquid illis cogitaveram facere, vobis faciam.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:

verses.text: Command the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them: When you are entered into the land of Chanaan, and it shall be fallen into your possession by lot, it shall be bounded by these limits:
verses.textLatin: Præcipe filiis Israël, et dices ad eos: Cum ingressi fueritis terram Chanaan, et in possessionem vobis sorte ceciderit, his finibus terminabitur.

verses.text: The south side shall begin from the wilderness of Sin, which is by Edom: and shall have the most salt sea for its furthest limits eastward:
verses.textLatin: Pars meridiana incipiet a solitudine Sin, quæ est juxta Edom: et habebit terminos contra orientem mare salsissimum.

verses.text: Which limits shall go round on the south side by the ascent of the Scorpion and so into Senna, and reach toward the south as far as Cadesbarne, from whence the frontiers shall go out to the town called Adar, and shall reach as far as Asemona.
verses.textLatin: Qui circuibunt australem plagam per ascensum Scorpionis, ita ut transeant in Senna, et perveniant a meridie usque ad Cadesbarne, unde egredientur confinia ad villam nomine Adar, et tendent usque ad Asemona.

verses.text: And the limits shall fetch a compass from Asemona to the torrent of Egypt, and shall end in the shore of the great sea.
verses.textLatin: Ibitque per gyrum terminus ab Asemona usque ad torrentem Ægypti, et maris magni littore finietur.

verses.text: And the west side shall begin from the great sea, and the same shall be the end thereof.
verses.textLatin: Plaga autem occidentalis a mari magno incipiet, et ipso fine claudetur.

verses.text: But toward the north side the borders shall begin from the great sea, reaching to the most high mountain,
verses.textLatin: Porro ad septentrionalem plagam a mari magno termini incipient, pervenientes usque ad montem altissimum,

verses.text: From which they shall come to Emath, as far as the borders of Sedada:
verses.textLatin: a quo venient in Emath usque ad terminos Sedada:

verses.text: And the limits shall go as far as Zephrona, and the village of Enan. These shall be the borders on the north side.
verses.textLatin: ibuntque confinia usque ad Zephrona, et villam Enan. Hi erunt termini in parte aquilonis.

verses.text: From thence they shall mark out the bounds towards the east side from the village of Enan unto Sephama.
verses.textLatin: Inde metabuntur fines contra orientalem plagam de villa Enan usque Sephama,
