verses.text: And from the wilderness, to the sea of Ceneroth towards the east, and to the sea of the wilderness, which is the most salt sea, on the east side by the way that leadeth to Bethsimoth: and on the south side that lieth under Asedoth, Phasga.
verses.textLatin: Et a solitudine usque ad mare Ceneroth contra orientem, et usque ad mare deserti, quod est mare salsissimum, ad orientalem plagam per viam quæ ducit Bethsimoth: et ab australi parte, quæ subjacet Asedoth, Phasga.

verses.text: The border of Og the king of Basan, of the remnant of the Raphaims who dwelt in Astaroth, and in Edrai, and had dominion in mount Hermon, and in Salecha, and in all Basan, unto the borders
verses.textLatin: Terminus Og regis Basan, de reliquiis Raphaim, qui habitavit in Astaroth, et in Edrai, et dominatus est in monte Hermon, et in Salecha, atque in universa Basan, usque ad terminos

verses.text: Of Gessuri and Machati, and of half Galaad: the borders of Sehon the king of Hesebon.
verses.textLatin: Gessuri, et Machati, et dimidiæ partis Galaad: terminos Sehon regis Hesebon.

verses.text: Moses the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel slew them, and Moses delivered their land in possession to the Rubenites, and Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Moyses famulus Domini et filii Israël percusserunt eos, tradiditque terram eorum Moyses in possessionem Rubenitis, et Gaditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse.

verses.text: These are the kings of the land, whom Josue and the children of Israel slew beyond the Jordan on the west side from Baalgad in the field of Libanus, unto the mount, part of which goeth up into Seir: and Josue delivered it in possession to the tribes of Israel, to every one their divisions,
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt reges terræ, quos percussit Josue et filii Israël trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam, a Baalgad in campo Libani, usque ad montem cujus pars ascendit in Seir: tradiditque eam Josue in possessionem tribubus Israël, singulis partes suas,

verses.text: As well in the mountains as in the plains and the champaign countries. In Asedoth, and in the wilderness, and in the south was the Hethite and the Amorrhite, the Chanaanite and the Pherezite, the Hevite and the Jebusite.
verses.textLatin: tam in montanis quam in planis atque campestribus. In Asedoth, et in solitudine, ac in meridie, Hethæus fuit et Amorrhæus, Chananæus, et Pherezæus, Hevæus et Jebusæus.

verses.text: The king of Jericho one: the king of Hai, which is on the side of Bethel, one:
verses.textLatin: Rex Jericho unus: rex Hai, quæ est ex latere Bethel, unus:

verses.text: The king of Jerusalem one, the king of Hebron one,
verses.textLatin: rex Jerusalem unus, rex Hebron unus,

verses.text: The king of Jerimoth one, the king of Lachis one,
verses.textLatin: rex Jerimoth unus, rex Lachis unus,

verses.text: The king of Eglon one, the king of Gazer one,
verses.textLatin: rex Eglon unus, rex Gazer unus,

verses.text: The king of Dabir one, the king of Gader one,
verses.textLatin: rex Dabir unus, rex Gader unus,

verses.text: The king of Herma one, the king of Hered one,
verses.textLatin: rex Herma unus, rex Hered unus,

verses.text: The king of Lebna one, the king of Odullam one,
verses.textLatin: rex Lebna unus, rex Odullam unus,

verses.text: The king of Maceda one, the king of Bethel one,
verses.textLatin: rex Maceda unus, rex Bethel unus,

verses.text: The king of Taphua one, the king of Opher one,
verses.textLatin: rex Taphua unus, rex Opher unus,

verses.text: The king of Aphec one, the king of Saron one,
verses.textLatin: rex Aphec unus, rex Saron unus,

verses.text: The king of Madon one, the king of Asor one,
verses.textLatin: rex Madon unus, rex Asor unus,

verses.text: The king of Semeron one, the king of Achsaph one,
verses.textLatin: rex Semeron unus, rex Achsaph unus,

verses.text: The king of Thenac one, the king of Mageddo one,
verses.textLatin: rex Thenac unus, rex Mageddo unus,

verses.text: The king of Cades one, the king of Jachanan of Carmel one,
verses.textLatin: rex Cades unus, rex Jachanan Carmeli unus,

verses.text: The king of Dor, and of the province of Dor one, the king of the nations of Galgal one,
verses.textLatin: rex Dor et provinciæ Dor unus, rex gentium Galgal unus,

verses.text: The king of Thersa one: all the kings thirty and one.
verses.textLatin: rex Thersa unus: omnes reges triginta unus.

verses.text: Josue was old, and far advanced in years, and the Lord said to him: Thou art grown old, and advanced in age, and there is a very large country left, which is not yet divided by lot:
verses.textLatin: Josue senex provectæque ætatis erat, et dixit Dominus ad eum: Senuisti, et longævus es, terraque latissima derelicta est, quæ necdum sorte divisa est:

verses.text: To wit, all Galilee, Philistia, and all Gessuri.
verses.textLatin: omnis videlicet Galilæa, Philisthiim, et universa Gessuri.

verses.text: From the troubled river, that watereth Egypt, unto the borders of Accaron northward: the land of Chanaan, which is divided among the lords of the Philistines, the Gazites, the Azotians, the Ascalonites, the Gethites, and the Accronites.
verses.textLatin: A fluvio turbido, qui irrigat Ægyptum, usque ad terminos Accaron contra aquilonem: terra Chanaan, quæ in quinque regulos Philisthiim dividitur, Gazæos, et Azotios, Ascalonitas, Gethæos, et Accaronitas.

verses.text: And on the south side are the Hevites, all the land of Chanaan, and Maara of the Sidonians as far as Apheca, and the borders of the Amorrhite,
verses.textLatin: Ad meridiem vero sunt Hevæi, omnis terra Chanaan, et Maara Sidoniorum, usque Apheca et terminos Amorrhæi,

verses.text: And his confines. The country also of Libanus towards the east from Baalgad under mount Hermon to the entering into Emath.
verses.textLatin: ejusque confinia. Libani quoque regio contra orientem, a Baalgad sub monte Hermon, donec ingrediaris Emath;

verses.text: Of all that dwell in the mountains from Libanus, to the waters of Maserephoth, and all the Sidonians. I am he that will cut them off from before the face of the children of Israel. So let their land come in as a part of the inheritance of Israel, as I have commanded thee.
verses.textLatin: omnium qui habitant in monte a Libano usque ad aquas Maserephoth, universique Sidonii. Ego sum qui delebo eos a facie filiorum Israël. Veniat ergo in partem hæreditatis Israël, sicut præcepi tibi.

verses.text: And now divide the land in possession to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe of Manasses,
verses.textLatin: Et nunc divide terram in possessionem novem tribubus, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse,

verses.text: With whom Ruben and Gad have possessed the land, which Moses the servant of the Lord delivered to them beyond the river Jordan, on the east side.
verses.textLatin: cum qua Ruben et Gad possederunt terram, quam tradidit eis Moyses famulus Domini trans fluenta Jordanis, ad orientalem plagam.

verses.text: From Aroer, which is upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, and in the midst of the valley and all the plains of Medaba, as far as Dibon:
verses.textLatin: Ab Aroër, quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon, et in vallis medio, universaque campestria Medaba, usque Dibon,

verses.text: And all the cities of Sehon, king of the Amorrhites, who reigned in Hesebon, unto the borders of the children of Ammon.
verses.textLatin: et cunctas civitates Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui regnavit in Hesebon, usque ad terminos filiorum Ammon,

verses.text: And Galaad, and the borders of Gessuri and Machati, and all mount Hermon, and all Basan as far as Salecha,
verses.textLatin: et Galaad, ac terminum Gessuri et Machati, et omnem montem Hermon, et universam Basan, usque ad Salecha,

verses.text: All the kingdom of Og in Basan, who reigned in Astaroth and Edrai, he was of the remains of the Raphaims: and Moses overthrew and destroyed them.
verses.textLatin: omne regnum Og in Basan, qui regnavit in Astaroth et Edrai, ipse fuit de reliquiis Raphaim: percussitque eos Moyses, atque delevit.

verses.text: And the children of Israel would not destroy Gessuri and Machati: and they have dwelt in the midst of Israel, until this present day.
verses.textLatin: Nolueruntque disperdere filii Israël Gessuri et Machati: et habitaverunt in medio Israël usque in præsentem diem.

verses.text: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no possession: but the sacrifices and victims of the Lord God of Israel, are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
verses.textLatin: Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem: sed sacrificia et victimæ Domini Dei Israël, ipsa est ejus hæreditas, sicut locutus est illi.

verses.text: And Moses gave a possession to the children of Ruben according to their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Dedit ergo Moyses possessionem tribui filiorum Ruben juxta cognationes suas.

verses.text: And their border was from Aroer, which is on the bank of the torrent Arnon, and in the midst of the valley of the same torrent: all the plain, that leadeth to Medaba,
verses.textLatin: Fuitque terminus eorum ab Aroër, quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon, et in valle ejusdem torrentis media: universam planitiem, quæ ducit Medaba,

verses.text: And Hesebon, and all their villages, which are in the plains. Dibon also, and Bamothbaal, and the town of Baalmaon,
verses.textLatin: et Hesebon, cunctosque viculos earum, qui sunt in campestribus: Dibon quoque et Bamothbaal, et oppidum Baalmaon,

verses.text: And Jassa, and Cidimoth, and Mephaath,
verses.textLatin: et Jassa, et Cedimoth, et Mephaath,

verses.text: And Cariathaim, and Sabama, and Sarathasar in the mountain of the valley.
verses.textLatin: et Cariathaim, et Sabama, et Sarathasar in monte convallis.

verses.text: Bethphogor and Asedoth, Phasga and Bethiesimoth,
verses.textLatin: Bethphogor et Asedoth, Phasga et Bethiesimoth,

verses.text: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdoms of Sehon king of the Amorrhites, that reigned in Hesebon, whom Moses slew with the princes of Madian: Hevi, and Recem, and Sur and Hur, and Rebe, dukes of Sehon inhabitants of the land.
verses.textLatin: et omnes urbes campestres, universaque regna Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui regnavit in Hesebon, quem percussit Moyses cum principibus Madian: Hevæum, et Recem, et Sur, et Hur, et Rebe duces Sehon habitatores terræ.

verses.text: Balaam also the son of Beor the soothsayer, the children of Israel slew with the sword among the rest that were slain.
verses.textLatin: Et Balaam filium Beor ariolum occiderunt filii Israël gladio cum ceteris interfectis.

verses.text: And the river Jordan was the border of the children of Ruben. This is the possession of the Rubenites, by their kindreds, of cities and villages.
verses.textLatin: Factusque est terminus filiorum Ruben Jordanis fluvius. Hæc est possessio Rubenitarum per cognationes suas urbium et viculorum.

verses.text: And Moses gave to the tribe of Gad and to his children by their kindreds a possession, of which this is the division.
verses.textLatin: Deditque Moyses tribui Gad et filiis ejus per cognationes suas possessionem, cujus hæc divisio est.

verses.text: The border of Jaser, and all the cities of Galaad, and half the land of the children of Ammon: as far as Aroer which is over against Rabba:
verses.textLatin: Terminus Jaser, et omnes civitates Galaad, et dimidiam partem terræ filiorum Ammon, usque ad Aroër, quæ est contra Rabba,

verses.text: And from Hesebon unto Ramoth, Masphe and Betonim: and from Manaim unto the borders of Dabir.
verses.textLatin: et ab Hesebon usque Ramoth, Masphe et Betonim: et a Manaim usque ad terminos Dabir.

verses.text: And in the valley Betharan and Bethnemra, and Socoth, and Saphon the other part of the kingdom of Sehon king of Hesebon: the limit of this also is the Jordan, as far as the uttermost part of the sea of Cenereth beyond the Jordan on the east side.
verses.textLatin: In valle quoque Betharan, et Bethnemra, et Socoth, et Saphon reliquam partem regni Sehon regis Hesebon: hujus quoque finis, Jordanis est, usque ad extremam partem maris Cenereth trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam.

verses.text: This is the possession of the children of Gad by their families, their cities, and villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio filiorum Gad per familias suas, civitates et villæ earum.

verses.text: He gave also to the half tribe of Manasses and his children possession according to their kindreds,
verses.textLatin: Dedit et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, filiisque ejus juxta cognationes suas, possessionem,

verses.text: The beginning whereof is this: from Manaim all Basan, and all the kingdoms of Og king of Basan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Basan, threescore towns.
verses.textLatin: cujus hoc principium est: a Manaim universam Basan, et cuncta regna Og regis Basan, omnesque vicos Jair, qui sunt in Basan, sexaginta oppida:

verses.text: And half Galaad, and Astaroth, and Edrai, cities of the kingdom of Og in Basan: to the children of Machir, the son of Manasses, to one half of the children of Machir according to their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: et dimidiam partem Galaad, et Astaroth, et Edrai, urbes regni Og in Basan: filiis Machir, filii Manasse, dimidiæ parti filiorum Machir juxta cognationes suas.

verses.text: This possession Moses divided in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan, over against Jericho on the east side.
verses.textLatin: Hanc possessionem divisit Moyses in campestribus Moab trans Jordanem contra Jericho ad orientalem plagam.

verses.text: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no possession: because the Lord the God of Israel himself is their possession, as he spoke to them.
verses.textLatin: Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem: quoniam Dominus Deus Israël ipse est possessio ejus, ut locutus est illi.

verses.text: This  is what the children of Israel possessed in the land of Chanaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Josue the son of Nun, and the princes of the families by the tribes of Israel gave to them:
verses.textLatin: Hoc est quod possederunt filii Israël in terra Chanaan, quam dederunt eis Eleazar sacerdos, et Josue filius Nun, et principes familiarum per tribus Israël:

verses.text: Dividing all by lot, as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses, to the nine tribes, and the half tribe.
verses.textLatin: sorte omnia dividentes, sicut præceperat Dominus in manu Moysi, novem tribubus, et dimidiæ tribui.

verses.text: For to two tribes and a half Moses had given possession beyond the Jordan: besides the Levites, who received no land among their brethren:
verses.textLatin: Duabus enim tribubus, et dimidiæ, dederat Moyses trans Jordanem possessionem: absque Levitis, qui nihil terræ acceperunt inter fratres suos:

verses.text: But in their place succeeded the children of Joseph divided into two tribes, of Manasses and Ephraim: neither did the Levites receive other portion of land, but cities to dwell in, and their suburbs to feed their beasts and flocks.
verses.textLatin: sed in eorum successerunt locum filii Joseph in duas divisi tribus, Manasse et Ephraim: nec acceperunt Levitæ aliam in terra partem, nisi urbes ad habitandum, et suburbana earum ad alenda jumenta et pecora sua.

verses.text: As the Lord had commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel, and they divided the land.
verses.textLatin: Sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi, ita fecerunt filii Israël, et diviserunt terram.

verses.text: Then the children of Juda came to Josue in Galgal, and Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite spoke to him: Thou knowest what the Lord spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Cadesbarne.
verses.textLatin: Accesserunt itaque filii Juda ad Josue in Galgala, locutusque est ad eum Caleb filius Jephone Cenezæus: Nosti quid locutus sit Dominus ad Moysen hominem Dei de me et te in Cadesbarne.

verses.text: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Cadesbarne, to view the land, and I brought him word again as to me seemed true.
verses.textLatin: Quadraginta annorum eram quando misit me Moyses famulus Domini de Cadesbarne, ut considerarem terram, nuntiavique ei quod mihi verum videbatur.

verses.text: But my brethren, that had gone up with me, discouraged the heart of the people: and I nevertheless followed the Lord my God.
verses.textLatin: Fratres autem mei, qui ascenderant mecum, dissolverunt cor populi: et nihilominus ego secutus sum Dominum Deum meum.

verses.text: And Moses swore in that day, saying: The land which thy foot hath trodden upon shall be thy possession, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast followed the Lord my God.
verses.textLatin: Juravitque Moyses in die illo, dicens: Terra, quam calcavit pes tuus, erit possessio tua, et filiorum tuorum in æternum: quia secutus es Dominum Deum meum.

verses.text: The Lord therefore hath granted me life, as he promised until this present day. It is forty and five years since the Lord spoke this word to Moses, when Israel journeyed through the wilderness: this day I am eighty-five years old,
verses.textLatin: Concessit ergo Dominus vitam mihi, sicut pollicitus est, usque in præsentem diem. Quadraginta et quinque anni sunt, ex quo locutus est Dominus verbum istud ad Moysen, quando ambulabat Israël per solitudinem: hodie octoginta quinque annorum sum,

verses.text: As strong as I was at that time when I was sent to view the land: the strength of that time continueth in me until this day, as well to fight as to march.
verses.textLatin: sic valens ut eo valebam tempore quando ad explorandum missus sum: illius in me temporis fortitudo usque hodie perseverat, tam ad bellandum quam ad gradiendum.

verses.text: Give me therefore this mountain, which the Lord promised, in thy hearing also, wherein are the Enacims, and cities great and strong: if so be the Lord will be with me, and I shall be able to destroy them, as he promised me.
verses.textLatin: Da ergo mihi montem istum, quem pollicitus est Dominus, te quoque audiente, in quo Enacim sunt, et urbes magnæ atque munitæ: si forte sit Dominus mecum, et potuero delere eos, sicut promisit mihi.

verses.text: And Josue blessed him, and gave him Hebron in possession.
verses.textLatin: Benedixitque ei Josue, et tradidit ei Hebron in possessionem:

verses.text: And from that time Hebron belonged to Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite, until this present day: because he followed the Lord the God of Israel.
verses.textLatin: atque ex eo fuit Hebron Caleb filio Jephone Cenezæo usque in præsentem diem, quia secutus est Dominum Deum Israël.

verses.text: The name of Hebron before was called Cariath-Arbe: Adam the greatest among the Enacims was laid there: and the land rested from wars.
verses.textLatin: Nomen Hebron ante vocabatur Cariath Arbe: Adam maximus ibi inter Enacim situs est: et terra cessavit a præliis.

verses.text: Now  the lot of the children of Juda by their kindreds was this: From the frontier of Edom, to the desert of Sin southward, and to the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.textLatin: Igitur sors filiorum Judæ per cognationes suas ista fuit: a termino Edom, desertum Sin, contra meridiem, et usque ad extremam partem australis plagæ.

verses.text: Its beginning was from the top of the most salt sea, and from the bay thereof, that looketh to the south.
verses.textLatin: Initium ejus a summitate maris salsissimi, et a lingua ejus, quæ respicit meridiem.

verses.text: And it goeth out towards the ascent of the Scorpion, and passeth on to Sina: and ascendeth into Cadesbarne, and reacheth into Esron, going up to Addar, and compassing Carcaa.
verses.textLatin: Egrediturque contra ascensum Scorpionis, et pertransit in Sina: ascenditque in Cadesbarne, et pervenit in Esron, ascendens ad Addar, et circuiens Carcaa,

verses.text: And from thence passing along into Asemona, and reaching the torrent of Egypt: and the bounds thereof shall be the great sea, this shall be the limit of the south coast.
verses.textLatin: atque inde pertransiens in Asemona, et perveniens ad torrentem Ægypti: eruntque termini ejus mare magnum. Hic erit finis meridianæ plagæ.

verses.text: But on the east side the beginning shall be the most salt sea even to the end of the Jordan: and towards the north, from the bay of the sea unto the same river Jordan.
verses.textLatin: Ab oriente vero erit initium, mare salsissimum usque ad extrema Jordanis: et ea quæ respiciunt ad aquilonem, a lingua maris usque ad eumdem Jordanis fluvium.

verses.text: And the border goeth up into BethHagla, and passeth by the north into Beth-Araba: going up to the stone of Boen the son of Ruben.
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque terminus in Beth Hagla, et transit ab aquilone in Beth Araba, ascendens ad lapidem Boën filii Ruben:

verses.text: And reaching as far as the borders of Debara from the valley of Achor, and so northward looking towards Galgal, which is opposite to the ascent of Adommin, on the south side of the torrent: and the border passeth the waters that are called the fountain of the sun: and the goings out thereof shall be at the fountain Rogel.
verses.textLatin: et tendens usque ad terminos Debera de valle Achor, contra aquilonem respiciens Galgala, quæ est ex adverso ascensionis Adommim, ab australi parte torrentis: transitque aquas, quæ vocantur fons solis: et erunt exitus ejus ad fontem Rogel.

verses.text: And it goeth up by the valley of the son of Ennom on the side of the Jebusite towards the south, the same is Jerusalem: and thence ascending to the top of the mountain, which is over against Geennom to the west in the end of the valley of Raphaim, northward.
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque per convallem filii Ennom ex latere Jebusæi ad meridiem, hæc est Jerusalem: et inde se erigens ad verticem montis, qui est contra Geennom ad occidentem in summitate vallis Raphaim contra aquilonem:

verses.text: And it passeth on from the top of the mountain to the fountain of the water of Nephtoa: and reacheth to the towns of mount Ephron: and it bendeth towards Baala, which is Cariathiarim, that is to say, the city of the woods.
verses.textLatin: pertransitque a vertice montis usque ad fontem aquæ Nephtoa: et pervenit usque ad vicos montis Ephron: inclinaturque in Baala, quæ est Cariathiarim, id est, urbs silvarum.

verses.text: And it compasseth from Baala westward unto mount Seir: and passeth by the side of mount Jarim to the north into Cheslon: and goeth down into Bethsames, and passeth into Thamna.
verses.textLatin: Et circuit de Baala contra occidentem, usque ad montem Seir: transitque juxta latus montis Jarim ad aquilonem in Cheslon: et descendit in Bethsames, transitque in Thamna.

verses.text: And it reacheth northward to a part of Accaron at the side: and bendeth to Sechrona, and passeth mount Baala: and cometh into Jebneel, and is bounded westward with the great sea.
verses.textLatin: Et pervenit contra aquilonem partis Accaron ex latere: inclinaturque Sechrona, et transit montem Baala: pervenitque in Jebneel, et magni maris contra occidentem fine concluditur.

verses.text: These are the borders round about of the children of Juda in their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt termini filiorum Juda per circuitum in cognationibus suis.

verses.text: But to Caleb the son of Jephone he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Juda, as the Lord had commanded him: Cariath-Arbe the father of Enac, which is Hebron.
verses.textLatin: Caleb vero filio Jephone dedit partem in medio filiorum Juda, sicut præceperat ei Dominus: Cariath Arbe patris Enac, ipsa est Hebron.

verses.text: And Caleb destroyed out of it the three sons of Enac, Sesai and Ahiman, and Tholmai of the race of Enac.
verses.textLatin: Delevitque ex ea Caleb tres filios Enac, Sesai et Ahiman et Tholmai de stirpe Enac.

verses.text: And going up from thence he came to the inhabitants of Dabir, which before was called Cariath-Sepher, that is to say, the city of letters.
verses.textLatin: Atque inde conscendens venit ad habitatores Dabir, quæ prius vocabatur Cariath Sepher, id est, civitas litterarum.

verses.text: And Caleb said: He that shall smite Cariath-Sepher, and take it, I will give him Axa my daughter to wife.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Caleb: Qui percusserit Cariath Sepher, et ceperit eam, dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.

verses.text: And Othoniel the son of Cenez, the younger brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Axa his daughter to wife.
verses.textLatin: Cepitque eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb junior: deditque ei Axam filiam suam uxorem.

verses.text: And as they were going together, she was moved by her husband to ask a field of her father, and she sighed as she sat on her ass. And Caleb said to her: What aileth thee?
verses.textLatin: Quæ, cum pergerent simul, suasa est a viro suo ut peteret a patre suo agrum. Suspiravitque ut sedebat in asino: cui Caleb: Quid habes? inquit.

verses.text: But she answered: Give me a blessing: thou hast given me a southern and dry land, give me also a land that is watered. And Caleb gave her the upper and the nether watery ground.
verses.textLatin: At illa respondit: Da mihi benedictionem: terram australem et arentem dedisti mihi; junge et irriguam. Dedit itaque ei Caleb irriguum superius et inferius.

verses.text: This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Juda by their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Juda per cognationes suas.

verses.text: And the cities from the uttermost parts of the children of Juda by the borders of Edom to the south, were Cabseel and Eder and Jagur,
verses.textLatin: Erantque civitates ab extremis partibus filiorum Juda juxta terminos Edom a meridie: Cabseel et Eder et Jagur,

verses.text: And Cina and Dimona and Adada,
verses.textLatin: et Cyna et Dimona et Adada,

verses.text: And Cades and Asor and Jethnam,
verses.textLatin: et Cades et Asor et Jethnam,

verses.text: Ziph and Telem and Baloth,
verses.textLatin: Ziph et Telem et Baloth,

verses.text: New Asor and Carioth, Hesron, which is Asor.
verses.textLatin: Asor nova et Carioth, Hesron, hæc est Asor;

verses.text: Amam, Sama and Molada,
verses.textLatin: Amam, Sama, et Molada,

verses.text: And Asergadda and Hassemon and Bethphelet,
verses.textLatin: et Asergadda et Hassemon et Bethphelet,

verses.text: And Hasersual and Bersabee and Baziothia,
verses.textLatin: et Hasersual et Bersabee et Baziothia,

verses.text: And Baala and Jim and Esem,
verses.textLatin: et Baala et Jim et Esem,

verses.text: And Eltholad and Cesil and Harma,
verses.textLatin: et Eltholad et Cesil et Harma,

verses.text: And Siceleg and Medemena and Sensenna,
verses.textLatin: et Siceleg et Medemena et Sensenna,

verses.text: Lebaoth and Selim and Aen and Remmon: all the cities twenty-nine, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Lebaoth et Selim et Aën et Remon. Omnes civitates viginti novem, et villæ earum.

verses.text: But in the plains: Estaol and Sarea and Asena,
verses.textLatin: In campestribus vero: Estaol et Sarea et Asena,

verses.text: And Zanoe and Engannim and Taphua and Enaim,
verses.textLatin: et Zanoë et Ængannim et Taphua et Enaim,

verses.text: And Jerimoth and Adullam, Socho and Azeca,
verses.textLatin: et Jerimoth et Adullam, Socho et Azeca,

verses.text: And Saraim and Adithaim and Gedera and Gederothaim: fourteen cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Saraim et Adithaim et Gedera et Gederothaim: urbes quatuordecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Sanan and Hadassa and Magdalgad,
verses.textLatin: Sanan et Hadassa et Magdalgad,

verses.text: Delean and Masepha and Jecthel,
verses.textLatin: Delean et Masepha et Jecthel,

verses.text: Lachis and Bascath and Eglon,
verses.textLatin: Lachis et Bascath et Eglon,

verses.text: Chebbon and Leheman and Cethlis,
verses.textLatin: Chebbon et Leheman et Cethlis,

verses.text: And Gideroth and Bethdagon and Naama and Maceda: sixteen cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Gideroth et Bethdagon et Naama et Maceda: civitates sedecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Labana and Ether and Asan,
verses.textLatin: Labana et Ether et Asan,

verses.text: Jephtha and Esna and Nesib,
verses.textLatin: Jephtha et Esna et Nesib,

verses.text: And Ceila and Achzib and Maresa: nine cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Ceila et Achzib et Maresa: civitates novem, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Accaron with the towns and villages thereof.
verses.textLatin: Accaron cum vicis et villulis suis.

verses.text: From Accaron even to the sea: all places that lie towards Azotus and the villages thereof.
verses.textLatin: Ab Accaron usque ad mare: omnia quæ vergunt ad Azotum et viculos ejus.

verses.text: Azotus with its towns and villages. Gaza with its towns and villages, even to the torrent of Egypt, and the great sea that is the border thereof.
verses.textLatin: Azotus cum vicis et villulis suis. Gaza cum vicis et villulis suis, usque ad torrentem Ægypti, et mare magnum terminus ejus.

verses.text: And in the mountain Samir and Jether and Socoth,
verses.textLatin: Et in monte: Samir et Jether et Socoth

verses.text: And Danna and Cariath-senna, this is Dabir:
verses.textLatin: et Danna et Cariathsenna, hæc est Dabir:

verses.text: Anab and Istemo and Anim,
verses.textLatin: Anab et Istemo et Anim,

verses.text: Gosen and Olon and Gilo: eleven cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Gosen et Olon et Gilo: civitates undecim et villæ earum.

verses.text: Arab and Ruma and Esaan,
verses.textLatin: Arab et Ruma et Esaan,

verses.text: And Janum and Beththaphua and Apheca,
verses.textLatin: et Janum et Beththaphua et Apheca,

verses.text: Athmatha and Cariath-Arbe, this is Hebron and Sior: nine cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Athmatha, et Cariath Arbe, hæc est Hebron, et Sior: civitates novem, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Maon and Carmel and Ziph and Jota,
verses.textLatin: Maon et Carmel et Ziph et Jota,

verses.text: Jezrael and Jucadam and Zanoe,
verses.textLatin: Jezraël et Jucadam et Zanoë,

verses.text: Accain, Gabaa and Thamna: ten cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Accain, Gabaa et Thamna: civitates decem et villæ earum.

verses.text: Halhul, and Bessur, and Gedor,
verses.textLatin: Halhul, et Besur, et Gedor,

verses.text: Mareth, and Bethanoth, and Eltecon: six cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Mareth, et Bethanoth, et Eltecon: civitates sex et villæ earum.

verses.text: Cariathbaal, the same is Cariathiarim, the city of woods, and Arebba: two cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Cariathbaal, hæc est Cariathiarim urbs silvarum, et Arebba: civitates duæ, et villæ earum.

verses.text: In the desert Betharaba, Meddin and Sachacha,
verses.textLatin: In deserto Betharaba, Meddin, et Sachacha,

verses.text: And Nebsan, and the city of salt, and Engaddi: six cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Nebsan, et civitas salis, et Engaddi: civitates sex, et villæ earum.

verses.text: But the children of Juda could not destroy the Jebusite that dwelt in Jerusalem: and the Jebusite dwelt with the children of Juda in Jerusalem until this present day.
verses.textLatin: Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non potuerunt filii Juda delere: habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Juda in Jerusalem usque in præsentem diem.

verses.text: And  the lot of the sons of Joseph fell from the Jordan over against Jericho and the waters thereof, on the east: the wilderness which goeth up from Jericho to the mountain of Bethel:
verses.textLatin: Cecidit quoque sors filiorum Joseph ab Jordane contra Jericho et aquas ejus ab oriente: solitudo quæ ascendit de Jericho ad montem Bethel:

verses.text: And goeth out from Bethel to Luza: and passeth the border of Archi, to Ataroth,
verses.textLatin: et egreditur de Bethel Luza: transitque terminum Archi, Ataroth:

verses.text: And goeth down westward, by the border of Jephleti, unto the borders of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gazer: and the countries of it are ended by the great sea:
verses.textLatin: et descendit ad occidentem juxta terminum Jephleti, usque ad terminos Beth-horon inferioris, et Gazer: finiunturque regiones ejus mari magno:

verses.text: And Manasses and Ephraim the children of Joseph possessed it.
verses.textLatin: possederuntque filii Joseph, Manasses et Ephraim.

verses.text: And the border of the children of Ephraim was according to their kindreds: and their possession towards the east was Ataroth-addar unto Beth-horon the upper.
verses.textLatin: Et factus est terminus filiorum Ephraim per cognationes suas: et possessio eorum contra orientem Ataroth Addar usque Beth-horon superiorem.

verses.text: And the confines go out unto the sea: but Machmethath looketh to the north, and it goeth round the borders eastward into Thanath-selo: and passeth along on the east side to Janoe.
verses.textLatin: Egrediunturque confinia in mare: Machmethath vero aquilonem respicit, et circuit terminos contra orientem in Thanathselo: et pertransit ab oriente Janoë.

verses.text: And it goeth down from Janoe into Ataroth and Naaratha: and it cometh to Jericho, and goeth out to the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: Descenditque de Janoë in Ataroth et Naaratha: et pervenit in Jericho, egrediturque ad Jordanem.

verses.text: From Taphua it passeth on towards the sea into the valley of reeds, and the goings out thereof are at the most salt sea. This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.textLatin: De Taphua pertransit contra mare in vallem arundineti, suntque egressus ejus in mare salsissimum. Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Ephraim per familias suas.

verses.text: And there were cities with their villages separated for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the possession of the children of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Urbesque separatæ sunt filiis Ephraim in medio possessionis filiorum Manasse, et villæ earum.

verses.text: And the children of Ephraim slew not the Chanaanite, who dwelt in Gazer: and the Chanaanite dwelt in the midst of Ephraim until this day, paying tribute.
verses.textLatin: Et non interfecerunt filii Ephraim Chananæum, qui habitabat in Gazer: habitavitque Chananæus in medio Ephraim usque in diem hanc tributarius.

verses.text: And  this lot fell to the tribe of Manasses (for he is the firstborn of Joseph) to Machir the firstborn of Manasses the father of Galaad, who was a warlike man, and had for possession Galaad and Basan.
verses.textLatin: Cecidit autem sors tribui Manasse (ipse enim est primogenitus Joseph): Machir primogenito Manasse patri Galaad, qui fuit vir pugnator, habuitque possessionem Galaad et Basan:

verses.text: And to the rest of the children of Manasses according to their families: to the children of Abiezer, and to the children of Helec, and to the children of Esriel, and to the children of Sechem, and to the children of Hepher, and to the children of Semida: these are the male children of Manasses the son of Joseph, by their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: et reliquis filiorum Manasse juxta familias suas, filiis Abiezer, et filiis Helec, et filiis Esriel, et filiis Sechem, et filiis Hepher, et filiis Semida. Isti sunt filii Manasse filii Joseph, mares, per cognationes suas.

verses.text: But Salphaad the son of Hepher the son of Galaad the son of Machir the son of Manasses had no sons, but only daughters: whose names are these, Maala and Noa and Hegla and Melcha and Thersa.
verses.textLatin: Salphaad vero filio Hepher filii Galaad filii Machir filii Manasse non erant filii, sed solæ filiæ: quarum ista sunt nomina: Maala et Noa et Hegla et Melcha et Thersa.

verses.text: And they came in the presence of Eleazar the priest and of Josue the son of Nun, and of the princes, saying: The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, that a possession should be given us in the midst of our brethren. And he gave them according to the commandment of the Lord a possession amongst the brethren of their father.
verses.textLatin: Veneruntque in conspectu Eleazari sacerdotis, et Josue filii Nun, et principum, dicentes: Dominus præcepit per manum Moysi, ut daretur nobis possessio in medio fratrum nostrorum. Deditque eis juxta imperium Domini possessionem in medio fratrum patris earum.

verses.text: And there fell ten portions to Manasses, beside the land of Galaad and Basan beyond the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: Et ceciderunt funiculi Manasse, decem, absque terra Galaad et Basan trans Jordanem.

verses.text: For the daughters of Manasses possessed inheritance in the midst of his sons. And the land of Galaad fell to the lot of the rest of the children of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Filiæ enim Manasse possederunt hæreditatem in medio filiorum ejus. Terra autem Galaad cecidit in sortem filiorum Manasse qui reliqui erant.

verses.text: And the border of Manasses was from Aser, Machmethath which looketh towards Sichem: and it goeth out on the right hand by the inhabitants of the fountain of Taphua.
verses.textLatin: Fuitque terminus Manasse ab Aser, Machmethath quæ respicit Sichem: et egreditur ad dexteram juxta habitatores fontis Taphuæ.

verses.text: For the lot of Manasses took in the land of Taphua, which is on the borders of Manasses, and belongs to the children of Ephraim.
verses.textLatin: Etenim in sorte Manasse ceciderat terra Taphuæ, quæ est juxta terminos Manasse filiorum Ephraim.

verses.text: And the border goeth down to the valley of the reeds, to the south of the torrent of the cities of Ephraim, which are in the midst of the cities of Manasses: the border of Manasses is on the north side of the torrent, and the outgoings of it are at the sea:
verses.textLatin: Descenditque terminus vallis arundineti in meridiem torrentis civitatum Ephraim, quæ in medio sunt urbium Manasse: terminus Manasse ab aquilone torrentis, et exitus ejus pergit ad mare:

verses.text: So that the possession of Ephraim is on the south, and on the north that of Manasses, and the sea is the border of both, and they are joined together in the tribe of Aser on the north, and in the tribe of Issachar on the east.
verses.textLatin: ita ut possessio Ephraim sit ab austro, et ab aquilone Manasse, et utramque claudat mare, et conjungantur sibi in tribu Aser ab aquilone, et in tribu Issachar ab oriente.

verses.text: And the inheritance of Manasses in Issachar and in Aser, was Bethsan and its villages, and Jeblaam with its villages, and the inhabitants of Dor, with the towns thereof: the inhabitants also of Endor with the villages thereof: and in like manner the inhabitants of Thenac with the villages thereof: and the inhabitants of Mageddo with their villages, and the third part of the city of Nopheth.
verses.textLatin: Fuitque hæreditas Manasse in Issachar et in Aser, Bethsan et viculi ejus, et Jeblaam cum viculis suis, et habitatores Dor cum oppidis suis, habitatores quoque Endor cum viculis suis: similiterque habitatores Thenac cum viculis suis, et habitatores Mageddo cum viculis suis, et tertia pars urbis Nopheth.

verses.text: Neither could the children of Manasses overthrow these cities, but the Chanaanite began to dwell in his land.
verses.textLatin: Nec potuerunt filii Manasse has civitates subvertere, sed cœpit Chananæus habitare in terra sua.

verses.text: But after that the children of Israel were grown strong, they subdued the Chanaanites, and made them their tributaries, and they did not kill them.
verses.textLatin: Postquam autem convaluerunt filii Israël, subjecerunt Chananæos, et fecerunt sibi tributarios, nec interfecerunt eos.

verses.text: And the children of Joseph spoke to Josue, and said: Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to possess, whereas I am of so great a multitude, and the Lord hath blessed me?
verses.textLatin: Locutique sunt filii Joseph ad Josue, et dixerunt: Quare dedisti mihi possessionem sortis et funiculi unius, cum sim tantæ multitudinis, et benedixerit mihi Dominus?

verses.text: And Josue said to them: If thou be a great people, go up into the woodland, and cut down room for thyself in the land of the Pherezite and the Raphaims: because the possession of mount Ephraim is too narrow for thee.
verses.textLatin: Ad quos Josue ait: Si populus multus es, ascende in silvam, et succide tibi spatia in terra Pherezæi et Raphaim: quia angusta est tibi possessio montis Ephraim.

verses.text: And the children of Joseph answered him: We cannot go up to the mountains, for the Chanaanites that dwell in the low lands, wherein are situate Bethsan with its towns, and Jezrael in the midst of the valley, have chariots of iron.
verses.textLatin: Cui responderunt filii Joseph: Non poterimus ad montana conscendere, cum ferreis curribus utantur Chananæi, qui habitant in terra campestri, in qua sitæ sunt Bethsan cum viculis suis, et Jezraël mediam possidens vallem.

verses.text: And Josue said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasses: Thou art a great people, and of great strength, thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Josue ad domum Joseph, Ephraim et Manasse: Populus multus es, et magnæ fortitudinis: non habebis sortem unam,

verses.text: But thou shalt pass to the mountain, and shalt cut down the wood, and make thyself room to dwell in: and mayst proceed farther, when thou hast destroyed the Chanaanites, who as thou sayest have iron chariots, and are very strong.
verses.textLatin: sed transibis ad montem, et succides tibi, atque purgabis ad habitandum spatia: et poteris ultra procedere cum subverteris Chananæum, quem dicis ferreos habere currus, et esse fortissimum.

verses.text: And  all the children of Israel assembled together in Silo, and there they set up the tabernacle of the testimony, and the land was subdued before them.
verses.textLatin: Congregatique sunt omnes filii Israël in Silo, ibique fixerunt tabernaculum testimonii, et fuit eis terra subjecta.

verses.text: But there remained seven tribes of the children of Israel, which as yet had not received their possessions.
verses.textLatin: Remanserant autem filiorum Israël septem tribus, quæ necdum acceperant possessiones suas.

verses.text: And Josue said to them: How long are you indolent and slack, and go not in to possess the land which the Lord the God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.textLatin: Ad quos Josue ait: Usquequo marcetis ignavia, et non intratis ad possidendam terram, quam Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum dedit vobis?

verses.text: Choose of every tribe three men, that I may send them, and they may go and compass the land, and mark it out according to the number of each multitude: and bring back to me what they have marked out.
verses.textLatin: Eligite de singulis tribubus ternos viros, ut mittam eos, et pergant atque circumeant terram, et describant eam juxta numerum uniuscujusque multitudinis: referantque ad me quod descripserint.

verses.text: Divide to yourselves the land into seven parts: let Juda be in his bounds on the south side, and the house of Joseph on the north.
verses.textLatin: Dividite vobis terram in septem partes: Judas sit in terminis suis ab australi plaga, et domus Joseph ab aquilone.

verses.text: The land in the midst between these mark ye out into seven parts; and you shall come hither to me, that I may cast lots for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textLatin: Mediam inter hos terram in septem partes describite: et huc venietis ad me, ut coram Domino Deo vestro mittam vobis hic sortem:

verses.text: For the Levites have no part among you, but the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad and Ruben, and the half tribe of Manasses have already received their possessions beyond the Jordan eastward: which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
verses.textLatin: quia non est inter vos pars Levitarum, sed sacerdotium Domini est eorum hæreditas. Gad autem et Ruben, et dimidia tribus Manasse, jam acceperant possessiones suas trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam, quas dedit eis Moyses famulus Domini.

verses.text: And when the men were risen up, to go to mark out the land, Josue commanded them, saying: Go round the land and mark it out, and return to me: that I may cast lots for you before the Lord in Silo.
verses.textLatin: Cumque surrexissent viri, ut pergerent ad describendam terram, præcepit eis Josue, dicens: Circuite terram, et describite eam, ac revertimini ad me: ut hic coram Domino, in Silo, mittam vobis sortem.

verses.text: So they went: and surveying it divided it into seven parts, writing them down in a book. And they returned to Josue, to the camp in Silo.
verses.textLatin: Itaque perrexerunt: et lustrantes eam, in septem partes diviserunt, scribentes in volumine. Reversique sunt ad Josue in castra Silo.

verses.text: And he cast lots before the Lord in Silo, and divided the land to the children of Israel into seven parts.
verses.textLatin: Qui misit sortes coram Domino in Silo, divisitque terram filiis Israël in septem partes.

verses.text: And first came up the lot of the children of Benjamin by their families, to possess the land between the children of Juda, and the children of Joseph.
verses.textLatin: Et ascendit sors prima filiorum Benjamin per familias suas, ut possiderent terram inter filios Juda et filios Joseph.

verses.text: And their border northward was from the Jordan: going along by the side of Jericho on the north side, and thence going up westward to the mountains, and reaching to the wilderness of Bethaven,
verses.textLatin: Fuitque terminus eorum contra aquilonem a Jordane: pergens juxta latus Jericho septentrionalis plagæ, et inde contra occidentem ad montana conscendens et perveniens ad solitudinem Bethaven,

verses.text: And passing along southward by Luza, the same is Bethel: and it goeth down into Ataroth-addar to the mountain, that is on the south of the nether Beth-horon.
verses.textLatin: atque pertransiens juxta Luzam ad meridiem, ipsa est Bethel: descenditque in Ataroth Addar, in montem qui est ad meridiem Beth-horon inferioris:

verses.text: And it bendeth thence going round towards the sea, south of the mountain that looketh towards Beth-horon to the southwest: and the outgoings thereof are into Cariathbaal, which is called also Cariathiarim, a city of the children of Juda. This is their coast towards the sea, westward.
verses.textLatin: et inclinatur circuiens contra mare ad meridiem montis qui respicit Beth-horon contra Africum: suntque exitus ejus in Cariath-baal, quæ vocatur et Cariathiarim, urbem filiorum Juda. Hæc est plaga contra mare, ad occidentem.

verses.text: But on the south side the border goeth out from part of Cariathiarim towards the sea, and cometh to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoa.
verses.textLatin: A meridie autem ex parte Cariathiarim egreditur terminus contra mare, et pervenit usque ad fontem aquarum Nephtoa.

verses.text: And it goeth down to that part of the mountain that looketh on the valley of the children of Ennom: and is over against the north quarter in the furthermost part of the valley of Raphaim, and it goeth down into Geennom (that is the valley of Ennom) by the side of the Jebusite to the south: and cometh to the fountain of Rogel,
verses.textLatin: Descenditque in partem montis, qui respicit vallem filiorum Ennom: et est contra septentrionalem plagam in extrema parte vallis Raphaim. Descenditque in Geennom (id est, vallem Ennom) juxta latus Jebusæi ad austrum: et pervenit ad fontem Rogel,

verses.text: Passing thence to the north, and going out to Ensemes, that is to say, the fountain of the sun:
verses.textLatin: transiens ad aquilonem, et egrediens ad Ensemes, id est, fontem solis:

verses.text: And it passeth along to the hills that are over against the ascent of Adommim: and it goeth down to Abenboen, that is, the stone of Boen the son of Ruben: and it passeth on the north side to the champaign countries; and goeth down into the plain,
verses.textLatin: et pertransit usque ad tumulos, qui sunt e regione ascensus Adommim: descenditque ad Abenboën, id est, lapidem Boën filii Ruben: et pertransit ex latere aquilonis ad campestria: descenditque in planitiem,

verses.text: And it passeth by Bethhagla northward: and the outgoings thereof are towards the north of the most salt sea at the south end of the Jordan:
verses.textLatin: et prætergreditur contra aquilonem Beth Hagla: suntque exitus ejus contra linguam maris salsissimi ab aquilone in fine Jordanis ad australem plagam:

verses.text: Which is the border of it on the east side. This is the possession of the children of Benjamin by their borders round about, and their families.
verses.textLatin: qui est terminus illius ab oriente. Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin per terminos suos in circuitu, et familias suas.

verses.text: And their cities were, Jericho and Bethhagla and Vale-Casis,
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque civitates ejus, Jericho et Beth Hagla et vallis Casis,

verses.text: Betharaba and Samaraim and Bethel,
verses.textLatin: Beth Araba et Samaraim et Bethel

verses.text: And Avim and Aphara and Ophera,
verses.textLatin: et Avim et Aphara et Ophera,

verses.text: The town Emona and Ophni and Gabee: twelve cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: villa Emona et Ophni et Gabee: civitates duodecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Gabam and Rama and Beroth,
verses.textLatin: Gabaon et Rama et Beroth,

verses.text: And Mesphe, and Caphara, and Amosa,
verses.textLatin: et Mesphe et Caphara, et Amosa

verses.text: And Recem, Jarephel and Tharela,
verses.textLatin: et Recem, Jarephel et Tharela,

verses.text: And Sela, Eleph and Jebus, which is Jerusalem, Gabaath and Cariath: fourteen cities, and their villages. This is the possession of the children of Benjamin by their families.
verses.textLatin: et Sela, Eleph, et Jebus, quæ est Jerusalem, Gabaath et Cariath: civitates quatuordecim, et villæ earum. Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin juxta familias suas.

verses.text: And  the second lot came forth for the children of Simeon by their kindreds: and their inheritance was
verses.textLatin: Et egressa est sors secunda filiorum Simeon per cognationes suas: fuitque hæreditas

verses.text: In the midst of the possession of the children of Juda: Bersabee and Sabee and Molada,
verses.textLatin: eorum in medio possessionis filiorum Juda: Bersabee et Sabee et Molada

verses.text: And Hasersual, Bala and Asem,
verses.textLatin: et Hasersual, Bala et Asem

verses.text: And Eltholad, Bethul and Harma,
verses.textLatin: et Eltholad, Bethul et Harma

verses.text: And Siceleg and Bethmarchaboth and Hasersusa,
verses.textLatin: et Siceleg et Bethmarchaboth et Hasersusa

verses.text: And Bethlebaoth and Sarohen: thirteen cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Bethlebaoth et Sarohen: civitates tredecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: Ain and Remmon and Athor and Asan: four cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Ain et Remmon et Athar et Asan: civitates quatuor, et villæ earum:

verses.text: And all the villages round about these cities to Baalath Beer Ramath to the south quarter. This is the inheritance of the children of Simeon according to their kindreds,
verses.textLatin: omnes viculi per circuitum urbium istarum usque ad Baalath Beer Ramath contra australem plagam. Hæc est hæreditas filiorum Simeon juxta cognationes suas,

verses.text: In the possession and lot of the children of Juda: because it was too great, and therefore the children of Simeon had their possession in the midst of their inheritance.
verses.textLatin: in possessione et funiculo filiorum Juda: quia major erat, et idcirco filii Simeon possederunt in medio hæreditatis eorum.

verses.text: And the third lot fell to the children of Zabulon by their kindreds: and the border of their possession was unto Sarid.
verses.textLatin: Ceciditque sors tertia filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas: factus est terminus possessionis eorum usque Sarid.

verses.text: And it went up from the sea and from Merala, and came to Debbaseth: as far as the torrent, which is over against Jeconam.
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque de mari et Merala, et pervenit in Debbaseth, usque ad torrentem qui est contra Jeconam.

verses.text: And it returneth from Sarid eastward to the borders of Ceseleththabor: and it goeth out to Dabereth, and ascendeth towards Japhie.
verses.textLatin: Et revertitur de Sared contra orientem in fines Ceseleththabor: et egreditur ad Dabereth, ascenditque contra Japhie.

verses.text: And it passeth along from thence to the east side of Gethhepher and Thacasin: and goeth out to Remmon, Amthar and Noa.
verses.textLatin: Et inde pertransit usque ad orientalem plagam Gethepher et Thacasin: et egreditur in Remmon, Amthar et Noa.

verses.text: And it turneth about to the north of Hanathon: and the outgoings thereof are the valley of Jephtahel,
verses.textLatin: Et circuit ad aquilonem Hanathon: suntque egressus ejus vallis Jephthaël,

verses.text: And Cateth and Naalol and Semeron and Jedala and Bethlehem: twelve cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Cateth et Naalol et Semeron et Jerala et Bethlehem: civitates duodecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Zabulon by their kindreds, the cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est hæreditas tribus filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.

verses.text: The fourth lot came out to Issachar by their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Issachar egressa est sors quarta per cognationes suas:

verses.text: And his inheritance was Jezrael and Casaloth and Sunem,
verses.textLatin: fuitque ejus hæreditas Jezraël et Casaloth et Sunem

verses.text: And Hapharaim and Seon and Anaharath,
verses.textLatin: et Hapharaim et Seon, et Anaharath

verses.text: And Rabboth and Cesion, Abes,
verses.textLatin: et Rabboth et Cesion, Abes,

verses.text: And Rameth and Engannim and Enhadda and Bethpheses.
verses.textLatin: et Rameth, et Engannim, et Enhadda et Bethpheses.

verses.text: And the border thereof cometh to Thabor and Sehesima and Bethsames: and the outgoings thereof shall be at the Jordan: sixteen cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Et pervenit terminus ejus usque Thabor et Sehesima et Bethsames, eruntque exitus ejus Jordanis: civitates sedecim, et villæ earum.

verses.text: This is the possession of the sons of Issachar by their kindreds, the cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio filiorum Issachar per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.

verses.text: And the fifth lot fell to the tribe of the children of Aser by their kindreds:
verses.textLatin: Ceciditque sors quinta tribui filiorum Aser per cognationes suas:

verses.text: And their border was Halcath and Chali and Beten and Axaph,
verses.textLatin: fuitque terminus eorum Halcath et Chali et Beten et Axaph

verses.text: And Elmelech and Amaad and Messal: and it reacheth to Carmel by the sea and Sihor and Labanath,
verses.textLatin: et Elmelech et Amaad et Messal: et pervenit usque ad Carmelum maris et Sihor et Labanath,

verses.text: And it returneth towards the east to Bethdagon: and passeth along to Zabulon and to the valley of Jephthael towards the north to Bethemec and Nehiel. And it goeth out to the left side of Cabul,
verses.textLatin: ac revertitur contra orientem Bethdagon: et pertransit usque Zabulon et vallem Jephthaël contra aquilonem in Bethemec et Nehiel. Egrediturque ad lævam Cabul,

verses.text: And to Abaran and Rohob and Hamon and Cana, as far as the great Sidon.
verses.textLatin: et Abran et Rohob et Hamon et Cana, usque ad Sidonem magnam.

verses.text: And it returneth to Horma to the strong city of Tyre, and to Hosa: and the outgoings thereof shall be at the sea from the portion of Achziba:
verses.textLatin: Revertiturque in Horma usque ad civitatem munitissimam Tyrum, et usque Hosa: eruntque exitus ejus in mare de funiculo Achziba:

verses.text: And Amma and Aphec and Rohob: twenty-two cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Amma et Aphec et Rohob: civitates viginti duæ, et villæ earum.

verses.text: This is the possession of the children of Aser by their kindreds, and the cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio filiorum Aser per cognationes suas, urbesque et viculi earum.

verses.text: The sixth lot came out to the sons of Nephtali by their families:
verses.textLatin: Filiorum Nephthali sexta sors cecidit per familias suas:

verses.text: And the border began from Heleph and Elon to Saananim, and Adami, which is Neceb, and Jebnael even to Lecum: and their outgoings unto the Jordan:
verses.textLatin: et cœpit terminus de Heleph et Elon in Saananim, et Adami, quæ est Neceb, et Jebnaël usque Lecum: et egressus eorum usque ad Jordanem:

verses.text: And the border returneth westward to Azanotthabor, and goeth out from thence to Hucuca, and passeth along to Zabulon southward, and to Aser westward, and to Juda upon the Jordan towards the rising of the sun.
verses.textLatin: revertiturque terminus contra occidentem in Azanotthabor, atque inde egreditur in Hucuca, et pertransit in Zabulon contra meridiem, et in Aser contra occidentem, et in Juda ad Jordanem contra ortum solis:

verses.text: And the strong cities are Assedim, Ser, and Emath, and Reccath and Cenereth,
verses.textLatin: civitates munitissimæ, Assedim, Ser, et Emath, et Reccath et Cenereth,

verses.text: And Edema and Arama, Asor,
verses.textLatin: et Edema et Arama, Asor

verses.text: And Cedes and Edri, Enhasor,
verses.textLatin: et Cedes et Edrai, Enhasor,

verses.text: And Jeron and Magdalel, Horem, and Bethanath and Bethsames: nineteen cities, and their villages.
verses.textLatin: et Jeron et Magdalel, Horem et Bethanath et Bethsames: civitates decem et novem, et villæ earum.

verses.text: This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Nephtali by their kindreds, the cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Nephthali per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.

verses.text: The seventh lot came out to the tribe of the children of Dan by their families:
verses.textLatin: Tribui filiorum Dan per familias suas egressa est sors septima:

verses.text: And the border of their possession was Saraa and Esthaol, and Hirsemes, that is, the city of the sun.
verses.textLatin: et fuit terminus possessionis ejus Sara et Esthaol, et Hirsemes, id est, civitas solis.

verses.text: Selebin and Aialon and Jethela,
verses.textLatin: Selebin et Ajalon et Jethela,

verses.text: Elon and Themna and Acron,
verses.textLatin: Elon et Themna et Acron,

verses.text: Elthece, Gebbethon and Balaath,
verses.textLatin: Elthece, Gebbethon et Balaath,

verses.text: And Jud and Bane and Barach and Gethremmon:
verses.textLatin: et Jud et Bane et Barach et Gethremmon:

verses.text: And Mejarcon and Arecon, with the border that looketh towards Joppe,
verses.textLatin: et Mejarcon et Arecon, cum termino qui respicit Joppen,

verses.text: And is terminated there. And the children of Dan went up and fought against Lesem, and took it: and they put it to the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt in it, calling the name of it Lesem Dan, by the name of Dan their father.
verses.textLatin: et ipso fine concluditur. Ascenderuntque filii Dan, et pugnaverunt contra Lesem, ceperuntque eam: et percusserunt eam in ore gladii, et possederunt, et habitaverunt in ea, vocantes nomen ejus Lesem Dan, ex nomine Dan patris sui.

verses.text: This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Dan, by their kindreds, the cities and their villages.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Dan, per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.

verses.text: And when he had made an end of dividing the land by lot to each one by their tribes, the children of Israel gave a possession to Josue the son of Nun in the midst of them,
verses.textLatin: Cumque complesset sorte dividere terram singulis per tribus suas, dederunt filii Israël possessionem Josue filio Nun in medio sui,

verses.text: According to the commandment of the Lord, the city which he asked for, Thamnath Saraa, in mount Ephraim: and he built up the city, and dwelt in it.
verses.textLatin: juxta præceptum Domini, urbem quam postulavit Thamnath Saraa in monte Ephraim: et ædificavit civitatem, habitavitque in ea.

verses.text: These are the possessions which Eleazar the priest, and Josue the son of Nun, and the princes of the families, and of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed by lot in Silo, before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, and they divided the land.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt possessiones, quas sorte diviserunt Eleazar sacerdos, et Josue filius Nun, et principes familiarum ac tribuum filiorum Israël in Silo, coram Domino ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii: partitique sunt terram.

verses.text: And  the Lord spoke to Josue, saying: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them:
verses.textLatin: Et locutus est Dominus ad Josue, dicens: Loquere filiis Israël, et dic eis:

verses.text: Appoint cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moses:
verses.textLatin: Separate urbes fugitivorum, de quibus locutus sum ad vos per manum Moysi:

verses.text: That whosoever shall kill a person unawares may flee to them: and may escape the wrath of the kinsman, who is the avenger of blood:
verses.textLatin: ut confugiat ad eas quicumque animam percusserit nescius, et possit evadere iram proximi, qui ultor est sanguinis:

verses.text: And when he shall flee to one of these cities: he shall stand before the gate of the city, and shall speak to the ancients of that city, such things as prove him innocent: and so shall they receive him, and give him a place to dwell in.
verses.textLatin: cum ad unam harum confugerit civitatum, stabit ante portam civitatis, et loquetur senioribus urbis illius ea quæ se comprobent innocentem: sicque suscipient eum, et dabunt ei locum ad habitandum.

verses.text: And when the avenger of blood shall pursue him, they shall not deliver him into his hands, because he slew his neighbour unawares, and is not proved to have been his enemy two or three days before.
verses.textLatin: Cumque ultor sanguinis eum fuerit persecutus, non tradent in manus ejus: quia ignorans percussit proximum ejus, nec ante biduum triduumve ejus probatur inimicus.

verses.text: And he shall dwell in that city, till he stand before judgment to give an account of his fact, and till the death of the high priest, who shall be at that time: then shall the manslayer return, and go into his own city and house from whence he fled.
verses.textLatin: Et habitabit in civitate illa, donec stet ante judicium, causam reddens facti sui, et moriatur sacerdos magnus, qui fuerit in illo tempore: tunc revertetur homicida, et ingredietur civitatem et domum suam de qua fugerat.

verses.text: And they appointed Cedes in Galilee of mount Nephtali, and Sichem in mount Ephraim, and Cariath-Arbe, the same is Hebron in the mountain of Juda.
verses.textLatin: Decreveruntque Cedes in Galilæa montis Nephthali, et Sichem in monte Ephraim, et Cariatharbe, ipsa est Hebron in monte Juda.

verses.text: And beyond the Jordan to the east of Jericho, they appointed Bosor, which is upon the plain of the wilderness of the tribe of Ruben, and Ramoth in Galaad of the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in Basan of the tribe of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Et trans Jordanem contra orientalem plagam Jericho, statuerunt Bosor, quæ sita est in campestri solitudine de tribu Ruben, et Ramoth in Galaad de tribu Gad, et Gaulon in Basan de tribu Manasse.

verses.text: These cities were appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the strangers, that dwelt among them: that whosoever had killed a person unawares might flee to them, and not die by the hand of the kinsman, coveting to revenge the blood that was shed, until he should stand before the people to lay open his cause.
verses.textLatin: Hæ civitates constitutæ sunt cunctis filiis Israël, et advenis qui habitabant inter eos, ut fugeret ad eas qui animam nescius percussisset, et non moreretur in manu proximi, effusum sanguinem vindicare cupientis, donec staret ante populum expositurus causam suam.

verses.text: Then  the princes of the families of Levi came to Eleazar the priest, and to Josue the son of Nun, and to the princes of the kindreds of all the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Accesseruntque principes familiarum Levi ad Eleazarum sacerdotem, et Josue filium Nun, et ad duces cognationum per singulas tribus filiorum Israël:

verses.text: And they spoke to them in Silo in the land of Chanaan, and said: The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, that cities should be given us to dwell in, and their suburbs to feed our cattle.
verses.textLatin: locutique sunt ad eos in Silo terræ Chanaan, atque dixerunt: Dominus præcepit per manum Moysi, ut darentur nobis urbes ad habitandum, et suburbana earum ad alenda jumenta.

verses.text: And the children of Israel gave out of their possessions according to the commandment of the Lord, cities and their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Dederuntque filii Israël de possessionibus suis juxta imperium Domini, civitates et suburbana earum.

verses.text: And the lot came out for the family of Caath of the children of Aaron the priest out of the tribes of Juda, and of Simeon, and of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.textLatin: Egressaque est sors in familiam Caath filiorum Aaron sacerdotis, de tribubus Juda, et Simeon, et Benjamin, civitates tredecim:

verses.text: And to the rest of the children of Caath, that is, to the Levites, who remained, out of the tribes of Ephraim, and of Dan, and the half tribe of Manasses, ten cities.
verses.textLatin: et reliquis filiorum Caath, id est Levitis, qui superfuerant, de tribubus Ephraim, et Dan, et dimidia tribu Manasse, civitates decem.

verses.text: And the lot came out to the children of Gerson, that they should take of the tribes of Issachar and of Aser and of Nephtali, and of the half tribe of Manasses in Basan, thirteen cities.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Gerson egressa est sors, ut acciperent de tribubus Issachar et Aser et Nephthali, dimidiaque tribu Manasse in Basan, civitates numero tredecim.

verses.text: And to the sons of Merari by their kindreds, of the tribes of Ruben and of Gad and of Zabulon, twelve cities.
verses.textLatin: Et filiis Merari per cognationes suas de tribubus Ruben et Gad et Zabulon urbes duodecim.

verses.text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, giving to every one by lot.
verses.textLatin: Dederuntque filii Israël Levitis civitates et suburbana earum, sicut præcepit Dominus per manum Moysi, singulis sorte tribuentes.

verses.text: Of the tribes of the children of Juda and of Simeon Josue gave cities: whose names are these,
verses.textLatin: De tribubus filiorum Juda et Simeon dedit Josue civitates, quarum ista sunt nomina,

verses.text: To the sons of Aaron, of the families of Caath of the race of Levi (for the first lot came out for them)
verses.textLatin: filiis Aaron per familias Caath Levitici generis (prima enim sors illis egressa est),

verses.text: The city of Arbe the father of Enac, which is called Hebron, in the mountain of Juda, and the suburbs thereof round about.
verses.textLatin: Cariatharbe patris Enac, quæ vocatur Hebron, in monte Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum.

verses.text: But the fields and the villages thereof he had given to Caleb the son of Jephone for his possession.
verses.textLatin: Agros vero et villas ejus dederat Caleb filio Jephone ad possidendum.

verses.text: He gave therefore to the children of Aaron the priest, Hebron a city of refuge, and the suburbs thereof: and Lobna with the suburbs thereof,
verses.textLatin: Dedit ergo filiis Aaron sacerdotis Hebron confugii civitatem, ac suburbana ejus: et Lobnam cum suburbanis suis:

verses.text: And Jether and Estemo,
verses.textLatin: et Jether, et Esthemo,

verses.text: And Holon, and Dabir,
verses.textLatin: et Holon, et Dabir,

verses.text: And Ain, and Jeta, and Bethsames, with their suburbs: nine cities out of the two tribes, as hath been said.
verses.textLatin: et Ain, et Jeta, et Bethsames, cum suburbanis suis: civitates novem de tribubus, ut dictum est, duabus.

verses.text: And out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, Gabaon, and Gabae,
verses.textLatin: De tribu autem filiorum Benjamin, Gabaon, et Gabæ,

verses.text: And Anathoth and Almon, with their suburbs: four cities.
verses.textLatin: et Anathoth et Almon, cum suburbanis suis: civitates quatuor.

verses.text: All the cities together of the children of Aaron the priest, were thirteen, with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Omnes simul civitates filiorum Aaron sacerdotis, tredecim, cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: And to the rest of the families of the children of Caath of the race of Levi was given this possession.
verses.textLatin: Reliquis vero per familias filiorum Caath Levitici generis, hæc est data possessio.

verses.text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Sichem one of the cities of refuge, with the suburbs thereof in mount Ephraim, and Gazer,
verses.textLatin: De tribu Ephraim urbes confugii, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer

verses.text: And Cibsaim, and Beth-horon, with their suburbs, four cities.
verses.textLatin: et Cibsaim et Beth-horon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.

verses.text: And of he tribe of Dan, Eltheco and Gabathon,
verses.textLatin: De tribu quoque Dan, Eltheco et Gabathon,

verses.text: And Aialon and Gethremmon, with their suburbs, four cities.
verses.textLatin: et Ajalon et Gethremmon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.

verses.text: And of the half tribe of Manasses, Thanac and Gethremmon, with their suburbs, two cities.
verses.textLatin: Porro de dimidia tribu Manasse, Thanach et Gethremmon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates duæ.

verses.text: All the cities were ten, with their suburbs, which were given to the children of Caath, of the inferior degree.
verses.textLatin: Omnes civitates decem, et suburbana earum, datæ sunt filiis Caath inferioris gradus.

verses.text: To the children of Gerson also of the race of Levi out of the half tribe of Manasses, Gaulon in Basan, one of the cities of refuge, and Bosra, with their suburbs, two cities.
verses.textLatin: Filiis quoque Gerson Levitici generis dedit de dimidia tribu Manasse confugii civitates, Gaulon in Basan, et Bosram, cum suburbanis suis, civitates duas.

verses.text: And of the tribe of Issachar, Cesion, and Dabereth,
verses.textLatin: Porro de tribu Issachar, Cesion, et Dabereth,

verses.text: And Jaramoth, and Engannim, with their suburbs, four cities.
verses.textLatin: et Jaramoth, et Engannim, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.

verses.text: And of the tribe of Aser, Masal and Abdon,
verses.textLatin: De tribu autem Aser, Masal et Abdon,

verses.text: And Helcath, and Rohob, with their suburbs, four cities.
verses.textLatin: et Helcath, et Rohob, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.

verses.text: Of the tribe also of Nephtali, Cedes in Galilee, one of the cities of refuge: and Hammoth Dor, and Carthan, with their suburbs, three cities.
verses.textLatin: De tribu quoque Nephthali civitates confugii, Cedes in Galilæa, et Hammoth Dor, et Carthan, cum suburbanis suis, civitates tres.

verses.text: All the cities of the families of Gerson, were thirteen, with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Omnes urbes familiarum Gerson, tredecim, cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: And to the children of Merari, Levites of the inferior degree, by their families were given of the tribe of Zabulon, Jecnam and Cartha,
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Merari Levitis inferioris gradus per familias suas data est de tribu Zabulon, Jecnam, et Cartha

verses.text: And Damna and Naalol, four cities with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: et Damna et Naalol, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: Of the tribe of Ruben beyond the Jordan over against Jericho, Bosor in the wilderness, one of the cities of refuge, Misor and Jaser and Jethson and Mephaath, four cities with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: De tribu Ruben ultra Jordanem contra Jericho civitates refugii, Bosor in solitudine, Misor et Jaser et Jethson et Mephaath, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: Of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Galaad, one of the cities of refuge, and Manaim and Hesebon and Jaser, four cities with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: De tribu Gad civitates confugii, Ramoth in Galaad, et Manaim et Hesebon et Jazer, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: All the cities of the children of Merari by their families and kindreds, were twelve.
verses.textLatin: Omnes urbes filiorum Merari per familias et cognationes suas, duodecim.

verses.text: So all the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty-eight,
verses.textLatin: Itaque civitates universæ Levitarum in medio possessionis filiorum Israël fuerunt quadraginta octo

verses.text: With their suburbs, each distributed by the families.
verses.textLatin: cum suburbanis suis, singulæ per familias distributæ.

verses.text: And the Lord God gave to Israel all the land that he had sworn to give to their fathers: and they possessed it and dwelt in it.
verses.textLatin: Deditque Dominus Deus Israëli omnem terram, quam traditurum se patribus eorum juraverat: et possederunt illam, atque habitaverunt in ea.

verses.text: And he gave them peace from all nations round about: and none of their enemies durst stand against them, but were brought under their dominion.
verses.textLatin: Dataque est ab eo pax in omnes per circuitum nationes: nullusque eis hostium resistere ausus est, sed cuncti in eorum ditionem redacti sunt.

verses.text: Not so much as one word, which he had promised to perform unto them, was made void, but all came to pass.
verses.textLatin: Ne unum quidem verbum, quod illis præstiturum se esse promiserat, irritum fuit, sed rebus expleta sunt omnia.

verses.text: At  the same time Josue called the Rubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasses,
verses.textLatin: Eodem tempore vocavit Josue Rubenitas, et Gaditas, et dimidiam tribum Manasse,

verses.text: And said to them: You have done all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you: you have also obeyed me in all things,
verses.textLatin: dixitque ad eos: Fecistis omnia quæ præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini: mihi quoque in omnibus obedistis,

verses.text: Neither have you left your brethren this long time, until this present day, keeping the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.textLatin: nec reliquistis fratres vestros longo tempore, usque in præsentem diem, custodientes imperium Domini Dei vestri.

verses.text: Therefore as the Lord your God hath given your brethren rest and peace, as he promised: return, and go to your dwellings, and to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you beyond the Jordan:
verses.textLatin: Quia igitur dedit Dominus Deus vester fratribus vestris quietem et pacem, sicut pollicitus est: revertimini, et ite in tabernacula vestra, et in terram possessionis, quam tradidit vobis Moyses famulus Domini trans Jordanem:

verses.text: Yet so that you observe attentively, and in work fulfil the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you: that you love the Lord your God, and walk in all his ways, and keep all his commandments, and cleave to him, and serve him with all your heart, and with all your soul.
verses.textLatin: ita dumtaxat ut custodiatis attente, et opere compleatis mandatum et legem quam præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini, ut diligatis Dominum Deum vestrum, et ambuletis in omnibus viis ejus, et observetis mandata illius, adhæreatisque ei, ac serviatis in omni corde, et in omni anima vestra.

verses.text: And Josue blessed them, and sent them away, and they returned to their dwellings.
verses.textLatin: Benedixitque eis Josue, et dimisit eos. Qui reversi sunt in tabernacula sua.

verses.text: Now to half the tribe of Manasses, Moses had given a possession in Basan: and therefore to the half that remained, Josue gave a lot among the rest of their brethren beyond the Jordan to the west. And when he sent them away to their dwellings and had blessed them,
verses.textLatin: Dimidiæ autem tribui Manasse possessionem Moyses dederat in Basan: et idcirco mediæ, quæ superfuit, dedit Josue sortem inter ceteros fratres suos trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam. Cumque dimitteret eos in tabernacula sua, et benedixisset eis,

verses.text: He said to them: With much substance and riches, you return to your settlements, with silver and gold, brass and iron, and variety of raiment: divide the prey of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.textLatin: dixit ad eos: In multa substantia atque divitiis revertimini ad sedes vestras, cum argento et auro, ære ac ferro, et veste multiplici: dividite prædam hostium cum fratribus vestris.

verses.text: So the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasses returned, and parted from the children of Israel in Silo, which is in Chanaan, to go into Galaad the land of their possession, which they had obtained according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.textLatin: Reversique sunt, et abierunt filii Ruben, et filii Gad, et dimidia tribus Manasse, a filiis Israël de Silo, quæ sita est in Chanaan, ut intrarent Galaad terram possessionis suæ, quam obtinuerant juxta imperium Domini in manu Moysi.

verses.text: And when they were come to the banks of the Jordan, in the land of Chanaan, they built an altar immensely great near the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: Cumque venissent ad tumulos Jordanis in terram Chanaan, ædificaverunt juxta Jordanem altare infinitæ magnitudinis.

verses.text: And when the children of Israel had heard of it, and certain messengers had brought them an account that the children of Ruben, and of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasses had built an altar in the land of Chanaan, upon the banks of the Jordan, over against the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Quod cum audissent filii Israël, et ad eos certi nuntii detulissent, ædificasse filios Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse, altare in terra Chanaan, super Jordanis tumulos, contra filios Israël:

verses.text: They all assembled in Silo, to go up and fight against them.
verses.textLatin: convenerunt omnes in Silo, ut ascenderent, et dimicarent contra eos.

verses.text: And in the mean time they sent to them into the land of Galaad, Phinees the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.textLatin: Et interim miserunt ad illos in terram Galaad Phinees filium Eleazari sacerdotis,

verses.text: And ten princes with him, one of every tribe.
verses.textLatin: et decem principes cum eo, singulos de singulis tribubus.

verses.text: Who came to the children of Ruben, and of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasses, into the land of Galaad, and said to them:
verses.textLatin: Qui venerunt ad filios Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse in terram Galaad, dixeruntque ad eos:

verses.text: Thus saith all the people of the Lord: What meaneth this transgression? Why have you forsaken the Lord the God of Israel, building a sacrilegious altar, and revolting from the worship of him?
verses.textLatin: Hæc mandat omnis populus Domini: Quæ est ista transgressio? cur reliquistis Dominum Deum Israël, ædificantes altare sacrilegum, et a cultu illius recedentes?

verses.text: Is it a small thing to you that you sinned with Beelphegor, and the stain of that crime remaineth in us to this day? and many of the people perished.
verses.textLatin: an parum vobis est quod peccastis in Beelphegor, et usque in præsentem diem macula hujus sceleris in nobis permanet, multique de populo corruerunt?

verses.text: And you have forsaken the Lord to day, and to morrow his wrath will rage against all Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et vos hodie reliquistis Dominum, et cras in universum Israël ira ejus desæviet.
