verses.text: And it came to pass that night, that an angel of the Lord came, and slew in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand. And when he arose early in the morning, he saw all the bodies of the dead.
verses.textLatin: Factum est igitur in nocte illa, venit angelus Domini, et percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia. Cumque diluculo surrexisset, vidit omnia corpora mortuorum: et recedens abiit,

verses.text: And Sennacherib king of the Assyrians departing went away, and he returned and abode in Ninive.
verses.textLatin: et reversus est Sennacherib rex Assyriorum, et mansit in Ninive.

verses.text: And as he was worshipping in the temple of Nesroch his god, Adramelech and Sarasar his sons slew him with the sword, and they fled into the land of the Armenians, and Asarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Cumque adoraret in templo Nesroch deum suum, Adramelech et Sarasar filii ejus percusserunt eum gladio, fugeruntque in terram Armeniorum: et regnavit Asarhaddon filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: In  those days Ezechias was sick unto death: and Isaias the son of Amos the prophet came and said to him: Thus saith the Lord God: Give charge concerning thy house, for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.textLatin: In diebus illis ægrotavit Ezechias usque ad mortem: et venit ad eum Isaias filius Amos propheta, dixitque ei: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus: Præcipe domui tuæ: morieris enim tu, et non vives.

verses.text: And he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying:
verses.textLatin: Qui convertit faciem suam ad parietem, et oravit Dominum, dicens:

verses.text: I beseech thee, O Lord, remember how I have walked before thee in truth, and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is pleasing before thee. And Ezechias wept with much weeping.
verses.textLatin: Obsecro, Domine: memento, quæso, quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate, et in corde perfecto, et quod placitum est coram te fecerim. Flevit itaque Ezechias fletu magno.

verses.text: And before Isaias was gone out of the middle of the court, the word of the Lord came to him, saying:
verses.textLatin: Et antequam egrederetur Isaias mediam partem atrii, factus est sermo Domini ad eum, dicens:

verses.text: Go back, and tell Ezechias the captain of my people: Thus saith the Lord the God of David thy father: I have heard thy prayer, and I have seen thy tears: and behold I have healed thee; on the third day thou shalt go up to the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Revertere, et dic Ezechiæ duci populi mei: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus David patris tui: Audivi orationem tuam, et vidi lacrimas tuas, et ecce sanavi te: die tertio ascendes templum Domini.

verses.text: And I will add to thy days fifteen years: and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians, and I will protect this city for my own sake, and for David my servant’s sake.
verses.textLatin: Et addam diebus tuis quindecim annos: sed et de manu regis Assyriorum liberabo te, et civitatem hanc: et protegam urbem istam propter me, et propter David servum meum.

verses.text: And Isaias said: Bring me a lump of figs. And when they had brought it, and laid it upon his boil, he was healed.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Isaias: Afferte massam ficorum. Quam cum attulissent, et posuissent super ulcus ejus, curatus est.

verses.text: And Ezechias had said to Isaias: What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up to the temple of the Lord the third day?
verses.textLatin: Dixerat autem Ezechias ad Isaiam: Quod erit signum, quia Dominus me sanabit, et quia ascensurus sum die tertia templum Domini?

verses.text: And Isaias said to him: This shall be the sign from the Lord, that the Lord will do the word which he hath spoken: Wilt thou that the shadow go forward ten lines, or that it go back so many degrees?
verses.textLatin: Cui ait Isaias: Hoc erit signum a Domino quod facturus sit Dominus sermonem quem locutus est: vis ut ascendat umbra decem lineis, an ut revertatur totidem gradibus?

verses.text: And Ezechias said: It is an easy matter for the shadow to go forward ten lines: and I do not desire that this be done, but let it return back ten degrees.
verses.textLatin: Et ait Ezechias: Facile est umbram crescere decem lineis: nec hoc volo ut fiat, sed ut revertatur retrorsum decem gradibus.

verses.text: And Isaias the prophet called upon the Lord, and he brought the shadow ten degrees backwards by the lines, by which it had already gone down in the dial of Achaz.
verses.textLatin: Invocavit itaque Isaias propheta Dominum, et reduxit umbram per lineas quibus jam descenderat in horologio Achaz, retrorsum decem gradibus.

verses.text: At that time Berodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, king of the Babylonians, sent letters and presents to Ezechias: for he had heard that Ezechias had been sick.
verses.textLatin: In tempore illo misit Berodach Baladan, filius Baladan, rex Babyloniorum, litteras et munera ad Ezechiam: audierat enim quod ægrotasset Ezechias.

verses.text: And Ezechias rejoiced at their coming, and he showed them the house of his aromatical spices, and the gold and the silver, and divers precious odours, and ointments, and the house of his vessels, and all that he had in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominions that Ezechias shewed them not.
verses.textLatin: Lætatus est autem in adventu eorum Ezechias, et ostendit eis domum aromatum, et aurum et argentum, et pigmenta varia, unguenta quoque, et domum vasorum suorum, et omnia quæ habere poterat in thesauris suis. Non fuit quod non monstraret eis Ezechias in domo sua, et in omni potestate sua.

verses.text: And Isaias the prophet came to king Ezechias, and said to him: What said these men? or from whence came they to thee? And Ezechias said to him: From a far country they came to me out of Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Venit autem Isaias propheta ad regem Ezechiam, dixitque ei: Quid dixerunt viri isti? aut unde venerunt ad te? Cui ait Ezechias: De terra longinqua venerunt ad me, de Babylone.

verses.text: And he said: What did they see in thy house? Ezechias said: They saw all the things that are in my house: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewn them.
verses.textLatin: At ille respondit: Quid viderunt in domo tua? Ait Ezechias: Omnia quæcumque sunt in domo mea, viderunt: nihil est quod non monstraverim eis in thesauris meis.

verses.text: And Isaias said to Ezechias: Hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Dixit itaque Isaias Ezechiæ: Audi sermonem Domini:

verses.text: Behold the days shall come, that all that is in thy house, and that thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Ecce dies venient, et auferentur omnia quæ sunt in domo tua, et quæ condiderunt patres tui usque in diem hanc, in Babylonem: non remanebit quidquam, ait Dominus.

verses.text: And of thy sons also that shall issue from thee, whom thou shalt beget, they shall take away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Sed et de filiis tuis qui egredientur ex te, quos generabis, tollentur, et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.

verses.text: Ezechias said to Isaias: The word of the Lord, which thou hast spoken, is good: let peace and truth be in my days.
verses.textLatin: Dixit Ezechias ad Isaiam: Bonus sermo Domini quem locutus es: sit pax et veritas in diebus meis.

verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Ezechias and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought waters into the city, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda?
verses.textLatin: Reliqua autem sermonum Ezechiæ, et omnis fortitudo ejus, et quomodo fecerit piscinam et aquæductum, et introduxerit aquas in civitatem, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?

verses.text: And Ezechias slept with his fathers, and Manasses his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Dormivitque Ezechias cum patribus suis, et regnavit Manasses filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: Manasses  was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned five and fifty years in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Haphsiba.
verses.textLatin: Duodecim annorum erat Manasses cum regnare cœpisset, et quinquaginta quinque annis regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Haphsiba.

verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to the idols of the nations, which the Lord destroyed from before the face of the children of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Fecitque malum in conspectu Domini, juxta idola gentium quas delevit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.

verses.text: And he turned, and built up the high places which Ezechias his father had destroyed: and he set up altars to Baal, and made groves, as Achab the king of Israel had done: and he adored all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.textLatin: Conversusque est, et ædificavit excelsa quæ dissipaverat Ezechias pater ejus: et erexit aras Baal, et fecit lucos sicut fecerat Achab rex Israël, et adoravit omnem militiam cæli, et coluit eam.

verses.text: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said: In Jerusalem I will put my name.
verses.textLatin: Exstruxitque aras in domo Domini, de qua dixit Dominus: In Jerusalem ponam nomen meum.

verses.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et exstruxit altaria universæ militiæ cæli in duobus atriis templi Domini.

verses.text: And he made his son pass through fire: and he used divination, and observed omens, and appointed pythons, and multiplied soothsayers to do evil before the Lord, and to provoke him.
verses.textLatin: Et traduxit filium suum per ignem: et ariolatus est, et observavit auguria, et fecit pythones, et aruspices multiplicavit, ut faceret malum coram Domino, et irritaret eum.

verses.text: He set also an idol of the grove, which he had made, in the temple of the Lord: concerning which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son: In this temple, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever.
verses.textLatin: Posuit quoque idolum luci quem fecerat, in templo Domini, super quod locutus est Dominus ad David, et ad Salomonem filium ejus: In templo hoc, et in Jerusalem quam elegi de cunctis tribubus Israël, ponam nomen meum in sempiternum.

verses.text: And I will no more make the feet of Israel to be moved out of the land, which I gave to their fathers: only if they will observe to do all that I have commanded them according to the law which my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.textLatin: Et ultra non faciam commoveri pedem Israël de terra quam dedi patribus eorum: si tamen custodierint opere omnia quæ præcepi eis, et universam legem quam mandavit eis servus meus Moyses.

verses.text: But they hearkened not: but were seduced by Manasses, to do evil more than the nations which the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Illi vero non audierunt: sed seducti sunt a Manasse, ut facerent malum super gentes quas contrivit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke in the hand of his servants, the prophets, saying:
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est Dominus in manu servorum suorum prophetarum, dicens:

verses.text: Because Manasses king of Juda hath done these most wicked abominations, beyond all that the Amorrhites did before him, and hath made Juda also to sin with his filthy doings:
verses.textLatin: Quia fecit Manasses rex Juda abominationes istas pessimas, super omnia quæ fecerunt Amorrhæi ante eum, et peccare fecit etiam Judam in immunditiis suis:

verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord the God of Israel: Behold I will bring on evils upon Jerusalem and Juda: that whosoever shall hear of them, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.textLatin: propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël: Ecce ego inducam mala super Jerusalem et Judam, ut quicumque audierit, tinniant ambæ aures ejus.

verses.text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the weight of the house of Achab: and I will efface Jerusalem, as tables are wont to be effaced, and I will erase and turn it, and draw the pencil often over the face thereof.
verses.textLatin: Et extendam super Jerusalem funiculum Samariæ, et pondus domus Achab: et delebo Jerusalem, sicut deleri solent tabulæ: et delens vertam, et ducam crebrius stylum super faciem ejus.

verses.text: And I will leave the remnants of my inheritance, and will deliver them into the hands of their enemies: and they shall become a prey, and a spoil to all their enemies.
verses.textLatin: Dimittam vero reliquias hæreditatis meæ, et tradam eas in manus inimicorum ejus, eruntque in vastitatem, et in rapinam cunctis adversariis suis:

verses.text: Because they have done evil before me, and have continued to provoke me, from the day that their fathers came out of Egypt, even unto this day.
verses.textLatin: eo quod fecerint malum coram me, et perseveraverint irritantes me, ex die qua egressi sunt patres eorum ex Ægypto usque ad hanc diem.

verses.text: Moreover Manasses shed also very much innocent blood, till he filled Jerusalem up to the mouth: besides his sins, wherewith he made Juda to sin, to do evil before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Insuper et sanguinem innoxium fudit Manasses multum nimis, donec impleret Jerusalem usque ad os: absque peccatis suis quibus peccare fecit Judam, ut faceret malum coram Domino.

verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasses, and all that he did, and his sin which he sinned, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda?
verses.textLatin: Reliqua autem sermonum Manasse, ut universa quæ fecit, et peccatum ejus quod peccavit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?

verses.text: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Oza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Dormivitque Manasses cum patribus suis, et sepultus est in horto domus suæ, in horto Oza: et regnavit Amon filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: Two and twenty years old was Amon when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Messalemeth the daughter of Harus of Jeteba.
verses.textLatin: Viginti duorum annorum erat Amon cum regnare cœpisset: duobus quoque annis regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Messalemeth filia Harus de Jeteba.

verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as Manasses his father had done.
verses.textLatin: Fecitque malum in conspectu Domini, sicut fecerat Manasses pater ejus.

verses.text: And he walked in all the way in which his father had walked: and he served the abominations which his father had served, and he adored them;
verses.textLatin: Et ambulavit in omni via per quam ambulaverat pater ejus, servivitque immunditiis quibus servierat pater ejus, et adoravit eas:

verses.text: And forsook the Lord the God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: et dereliquit Dominum Deum patrum suorum, et non ambulavit in via Domini.

verses.text: And his servants plotted against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.textLatin: Tetenderuntque ei insidias servi sui, et interfecerunt regem in domo sua.

verses.text: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon: and made Josias his son their king in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Percussit autem populus terræ omnes qui conjuraverant contra regem Amon, et constituerunt sibi regem Josiam filium ejus pro eo.

verses.text: But the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda?
verses.textLatin: Reliqua autem sermonum Amon quæ fecit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?

verses.text: And they buried him in his sepulchre in the garden of Oza: and his son Josias reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Sepelieruntque eum in sepulchro suo, in horto Oza: et regnavit Josias filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: Josias  was eight years old when he began to reign: he reigned one and thirty years in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Idida, the daughter of Hadaia, of Besecath.
verses.textLatin: Octo annorum erat Josias cum regnare cœpisset: triginta et uno anno regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Idida filia Hadaia de Besecath.

verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the ways of David his father: he turned not aside to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.textLatin: Fecitque quod placitum erat coram Domino, et ambulavit per omnes vias David patris sui: non declinavit ad dexteram, sive ad sinistram.

verses.text: And in the eighteenth year of king Josias, the king sent Saphan the son of Assia, the son of Messulam, the scribe of the temple of the Lord, saying to him:
verses.textLatin: Anno autem octavodecimo regis Josiæ, misit rex Saphan filium Aslia filii Messulam scribam templi Domini, dicens ei:

verses.text: Go to Helcias the high priest, that the money may be put together which is brought into the temple of the Lord, which the doorkeepers of the temple have gathered of the people.
verses.textLatin: Vade ad Helciam sacerdotem magnum, ut confletur pecunia quæ illata est in templum Domini, quam collegerunt janitores templi a populo:

verses.text: And let it be given to the workmen by the overseers of the house of the Lord: and let them distribute it to those that work in the temple of the Lord, to repair the temple:
verses.textLatin: deturque fabris per præpositos domus Domini, qui et distribuant eam his qui operantur in templo Domini, ad instauranda sartatecta templi:

verses.text: That is, to carpenters and masons, and to such as mend breaches: and that timber may be bought, and stones out of the quarries, to repair the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: tignariis videlicet et cæmentariis, et iis qui interrupta componunt: et ut emantur ligna, et lapides de lapicidinis, ad instaurandum templum Domini.

verses.text: But let there be no reckoning made with them of the money which they receive, but let them have it in their power, and in their trust.
verses.textLatin: Verumtamen non supputetur eis argentum quod accipiunt, sed in potestate habeant, et in fide.

verses.text: And Helcias the high priest said to Saphan the scribe: I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord: and Helcias gave the book to Saphan, and he read it.
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Helcias pontifex ad Saphan scribam: Librum legis reperi in domo Domini. Deditque Helcias volumen Saphan, qui et legit illud.

verses.text: And Saphan the scribe came to the king, and brought him word again concerning that which he had commanded, and said: Thy servants have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and they have given it to be distributed to the workmen, by the overseers of the works of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Venit quoque Saphan scriba ad regem, et renuntiavit ei quod præceperat, et ait: Conflaverunt servi tui pecuniam quæ reperta est in domo Domini, et dederunt ut distribueretur fabris a præfectis operum templi Domini.

verses.text: And Saphan the scribe told the king, saying: Helcias the priest hath delivered to me a book. And when Saphan had read it before the king,
verses.textLatin: Narravit quoque Saphan scriba regi, dicens: Librum dedit mihi Helcias sacerdos. Quem cum legisset Saphan coram rege,

verses.text: And the king had heard the words of the law of the Lord, he rent his garments.
verses.textLatin: et audisset rex verba libri legis Domini, scidit vestimenta sua.

verses.text: And he commanded Helcias the priest, and Ahicam the son of Saphan, and Achobor the son of Micha, and Saphan the scribe, and Asaia the king’s servant, saying:
verses.textLatin: Et præcepit Helciæ sacerdoti, et Ahicam filio Saphan, et Achobor filio Micha, et Saphan scribæ, et Asaiæ servo regis, dicens:

verses.text: Go and consult the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Juda, concerning the words of this book which is found: for the great wrath of the Lord is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened to the words of this book, to do all that is written for us.
verses.textLatin: Ite et consulite Dominum super me, et super populo, et super omni Juda, de verbis voluminis istius, quod inventum est: magna enim ira Domini succensa est contra nos, quia non audierunt patres nostri verba libri hujus, ut facerent omne quod scriptum est nobis.

verses.text: So Helcias the priest, and Ahicam, and Achobor, and Saphan, and Asaia went to Holda the prophetess the wife of Sellum the son of Thecua, the son of Araas keeper of the wardrobe, who dwelt in Jerusalem in the Second: and they spoke to her.
verses.textLatin: Ierunt itaque Helcias sacerdos, et Ahicam, et Achobor, et Sapham, et Asaia, ad Holdam prophetidem, uxorem Sellum filii Thecuæ filii Araas custodis vestium, quæ habitabat in Jerusalem in Secunda: locutique sunt ad eam.

verses.text: And she said to them: Thus saith the Lord the God of Israel: Tell the man that sent you to me:
verses.textLatin: Et illa respondit eis: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël: Dicite viro qui misit vos ad me:

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord: Behold, I will bring evils upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, all the words of the law which the king of Juda hath read:
verses.textLatin: Hæc dicit Dominus: Ecce ego adducam mala super locum istum, et super habitatores ejus, omnia verba legis quæ legit rex Juda:

verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have sacrificed to strange gods, provoking me by all the works of their hands: therefore my indignation shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.textLatin: quia dereliquerunt me, et sacrificaverunt diis alienis, irritantes me in cunctis operibus manuum suarum: et succendetur indignatio mea in loco hoc, et non extinguetur.

verses.text: But to the king of Juda, who sent you to consult the Lord, thus shall you say: Thus saith the Lord the God of Israel: Forasmuch as thou hast heard the words of the book,
verses.textLatin: Regi autem Juda, qui misit vos ut consuleretis Dominum, sic dicetis: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël: Pro eo quod audisti verba voluminis,

verses.text: And thy heart hath been moved to fear, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, hearing the words against this place, and the inhabitants thereof, to wit, that they should become a wonder and a curse: and thou hast rent thy garments, and wept before me, I also have heard thee, saith the Lord:
verses.textLatin: et perterritum est cor tuum, et humiliatus es coram Domino, auditis sermonibus contra locum istum et habitatores ejus, quod videlicet fierent in stuporem et in maledictum: et scidisti vestimenta tua, et flevisti coram me, et ego audivi, ait Dominus:

verses.text: Therefore I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy sepulchre in peace, that thy eyes may not see all the evils which I will bring upon this place.
verses.textLatin: idcirco colligam te ad patres tuos, et colligeris ad sepulchrum tuum in pace, ut non videant oculi tui omnia mala quæ inducturus sum super locum istum.

verses.text: And  they brought the king word again what she had said. And he sent: and all the ancients of Juda and Jerusalem were assembled to him.
verses.textLatin: Et renuntiaverunt regi quod dixerat. Qui misit: et congregati sunt ad eum omnes senes Juda et Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the king went up to the temple of the Lord, and all the men of Juda, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, the priests and the prophets, and all the people both little and great: and in the hearing of them all he read all the words of the book of the covenant, which was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque rex templum Domini, et omnes viri Juda, universique qui habitabant in Jerusalem cum eo sacerdotes et prophetæ, et omnis populus a parvo usque ad magnum: legitque, cunctis audientibus, omnia verba libri fœderis, qui inventus est in domo Domini.

verses.text: And the king stood upon the step: and made a covenant with the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies and his ceremonies, with all their heart, and with all their soul, and to perform the words of this covenant, which were written in that book: and the people agreed to the covenant.
verses.textLatin: Stetitque rex super gradum: et fœdus percussit coram Domino, ut ambularent post Dominum, et custodirent præcepta ejus, et testimonia, et cæremonias in omni corde, et in tota anima, et suscitarent verba fœderis hujus, quæ scripta erant in libro illo: acquievitque populus pacto.

verses.text: And the king commanded Helcias the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the doorkeepers, to cast out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that had been made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burnt them without Jerusalem in the valley of Cedron, and he carried the ashes of them to Bethel.
verses.textLatin: Et præcepit rex Helciæ pontifici, et sacerdotibus secundi ordinis, et janitoribus, ut projicerent de templo Domini omnia vasa quæ facta fuerant Baal, et in luco, et universæ militiæ cæli: et combussit ea foris Jerusalem in convalle Cedron, et tulit pulverem eorum in Bethel.

verses.text: And he destroyed the soothsayers, whom the kings of Juda had appointed to sacrifice in the high places in the cities of Juda, and round about Jerusalem: them also that burnt incense to Baal, and to the sun, and to the moon, and to the twelve signs, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.textLatin: Et delevit aruspices quos posuerant reges Juda ad sacrificandum in excelsis per civitates Juda, et in circuitu Jerusalem: et eos qui adolebant incensum Baal, et soli, et lunæ, et duodecim signis, et omni militiæ cæli.

verses.text: And he caused the grove to be carried out from the house of the Lord without Jerusalem to the valley of Cedron, and he burnt it there, and reduced it to dust, and cast the dust upon the graves of the common people.
verses.textLatin: Et efferri fecit lucum de domo Domini foras Jerusalem in convalle Cedron, et combussit eum ibi, et redegit in pulverem, et projecit super sepulchra vulgi.

verses.text: He destroyed also the pavilions of the effeminate, which were in the house of the Lord, for which the women wove as it were little dwellings for the grove.
verses.textLatin: Destruxit quoque ædiculas effeminatorum quæ erant in domo Domini, pro quibus mulieres texebant quasi domunculas luci.

verses.text: And he gathered together all the priests out of the cities of Juda: and he defiled the high places, where the priests offered sacrifice, from Gabaa to Bersabee: and he broke down the altars of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Josue governor of the city, which was on the left hand of the gate of the city.
verses.textLatin: Congregavitque omnes sacerdotes de civitatibus Juda, et contaminavit excelsa ubi sacrificabant sacerdotes de Gabaa usque Bersabee, et destruxit aras portarum in introitu ostii Josue principis civitatis, quod erat ad sinistram portæ civitatis.

verses.text: However the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem: but only ate of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.textLatin: Verumtamen non ascendebant sacerdotes excelsorum ad altare Domini in Jerusalem: sed tantum comedebant azyma in medio fratrum suorum.

verses.text: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Ennom: that no man should consecrate there his son or his daughter through fire to Moloch.
verses.textLatin: Contaminavit quoque Topheth, quod est in convalle filii Ennom, ut nemo consecraret filium suum aut filiam per ignem, Moloch.

verses.text: And he took away the horses which the kings of Juda had given to the sun, at the entering in of the temple of the Lord, near the chamber of Nathanmelech the eunuch, who was in Pharurim: and he burnt the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.textLatin: Abstulit quoque equos quos dederant reges Juda soli in introitu templi Domini juxta exedram Nathanmelech eunuchi, qui erat in Pharurim: currus autem solis combussit igni.

verses.text: And the altars that were upon the top of the upper chamber of Achaz, which the kings of Juda had made, and the altars which Manasses had made in the two courts of the temple of the Lord, the king broke down: and he ran from thence, and cast the ashes of them into the torrent Cedron.
verses.textLatin: Altaria quoque quæ erant super tecta cœnaculi Achaz, quæ fecerant reges Juda, et altaria quæ fecerat Manasses in duobus atriis templi Domini, destruxit rex, et cucurrit inde, et dispersit cinerem eorum in torrentem Cedron.

verses.text: The high places also that were at Jerusalem on the right side of the Mount of Offence, which Solomon king of Israel had built to Astaroth the idol of the Sidonians, and to Chamos the scandal of Moab, and to Melchom the abomination of the children of Ammon, the king defiled.
verses.textLatin: Excelsa quoque, quæ erant in Jerusalem ad dexteram partem montis offensionis, quæ ædificaverat Salomon rex Israël Astaroth idolo Sidoniorum, et Chamos offensioni Moab, et Melchom abominationi filiorum Ammon, polluit rex.

verses.text: And he broke in pieces the statues, and cut down the groves: and he filled their places with the bones of dead men.
verses.textLatin: Et contrivit statuas, et succidit lucos: replevitque loca eorum ossibus mortuorum.

verses.text: Moreover the altar also that was at Bethel, and the high place, which Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin, had made: both the altar, and the high place he broke down and burnt, and reduced to powder, and burnt the grove.
verses.textLatin: Insuper et altare quod erat in Bethel, et excelsum quod fecerat Jeroboam filius Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël: et altare illud, et excelsum destruxit, atque combussit, et comminuit in pulverem, succenditque etiam lucum.

verses.text: And as Josias turned himself, he saw there the sepulchres that were in the mount: and he sent and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burnt them upon the altar, and defiled it according to the word of the Lord, which the man of God spoke, who had foretold these things.
verses.textLatin: Et conversus Josias, vidit ibi sepulchra quæ erant in monte: misitque et tulit ossa de sepulchris, et combussit ea super altare, et polluit illud juxta verbum Domini quod locutus est vir Dei, qui prædixerat verba hæc.

verses.text: And he said: What is that monument which I see? And the men of that city answered: It is the sepulchre of the man of God, who came from Juda, and foretold these things which thou hast done upon the altar of Bethel.
verses.textLatin: Et ait: Quis est titulus ille, quem video? Responderuntque ei cives urbis illius: Sepulchrum est hominis Dei, qui venit de Juda, et prædixit verba hæc, quæ fecisti super altare Bethel.

verses.text: And he said: Let him alone, let no man move his bones. So his bones were left untouched with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.textLatin: Et ait: Dimitte eum: nemo commoveat ossa ejus. Et intacta manserunt ossa illius cum ossibus prophetæ qui venerat de Samaria.

verses.text: Moreover all the temples of the high places, which were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord, Josias took away: and he did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
verses.textLatin: Insuper et omnia fana excelsorum quæ erant in civitatibus Samariæ, quæ fecerant reges Israël ad irritandum Dominum, abstulit Josias: et fecit eis secundum omnia opera quæ fecerat in Bethel.

verses.text: And he slew all the priests of the high places, that were there, upon the altars: and he burnt men’s bones upon them: and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et occidit universos sacerdotes excelsorum qui erant ibi super altaria, et combussit ossa humana super ea: reversusque est Jerusalem.

verses.text: And he commanded all the people, saying: Keep the phase to the Lord your God, according as it is written in the book of this covenant.
verses.textLatin: Et præcepit omni populo, dicens: Facite Phase Domino Deo vestro, secundum quod scriptum est in libro fœderis hujus.

verses.text: Now there was no such a phase kept from the days of the judges, who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, and of the kings of Juda,
verses.textLatin: Nec enim factum est Phase tale a diebus judicum qui judicaverunt Israël, et omnium dierum regum Israël et regum Juda,

verses.text: As was this phase that was kept to the Lord in Jerusalem, in the eighteenth year of king Josias.
verses.textLatin: sicut in octavodecimo anno regis Josiæ factum est Phase istud Domino in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Moreover the diviners by spirits, and soothsayers, and the figures of idols, and the uncleannesses, and the abominations, that had been in the land of Juda and Jerusalem, Josias took away: that he might perform the words of the law, that were written in the book which Helcias the priest had found in the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Sed et pythones, et ariolos, et figuras idolorum, et immunditias, et abominationes, quæ fuerant in terra Juda et Jerusalem, abstulit Josias: ut statueret verba legis quæ scripta sunt in libro quem invenit Helcias sacerdos in templo Domini.

verses.text: There was no king before him like unto him, that returned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his strength, according to all the law of Moses: neither after him did there arise any like him.
verses.textLatin: Similis illi non fuit ante eum rex, qui reverteretur ad Dominum in omni corde suo, et in tota anima sua, et in universa virtute sua juxta omnem legem Moysi: neque post eum surrexit similis illi.

verses.text: But yet the Lord turned not away from the wrath of his great indignation, wherewith his anger was kindled against Juda: because of the provocations, wherewith Manasses had provoked him.
verses.textLatin: Verumtamen non est aversus Dominus ab ira furoris sui magni quo iratus est furor ejus contra Judam propter irritationes quibus provocaverat eum Manasses.

verses.text: And the Lord said: I will remove Juda also from before my face, as I have removed Israel: and I will cast off this city Jerusalem, which I chose, and the house, of which I said: My name shall be there.
verses.textLatin: Dixit itaque Dominus: Etiam Judam auferam a facie mea, sicut abstuli Israël: et projiciam civitatem hanc quam elegi Jerusalem, et domum de qua dixi: Erit nomen meum ibi.

verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Josias, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda?
verses.textLatin: Reliqua autem sermonum Josiæ, et universa quæ fecit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?

verses.text: In his days Pharao Nechao king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josias went to meet him: and was slain at Mageddo, when he had seen him.
verses.textLatin: In diebus ejus ascendit Pharao Nechao rex Ægypti contra regem Assyriorum ad flumen Euphraten, et abiit Josias rex in occursum ejus: et occisus est in Mageddo cum vidisset eum.

verses.text: And his servants carried him dead from Mageddo: and they brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Joachaz the son of Josias: and they anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.
verses.textLatin: Et portaverunt eum servi sui mortuum de Mageddo: et pertulerunt in Jerusalem, et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro suo. Tulitque populus terræ Joachaz filium Josiæ: et unxerunt eum, et constituerunt eum regem pro patre suo.

verses.text: Joachaz was three and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Jeremias of Lobna.
verses.textLatin: Viginti trium annorum erat Joachaz cum regnare cœpisset, et tribus mensibus regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Amital filia Jeremiæ de Lobna.

verses.text: And he did evil before the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textLatin: Et fecit malum coram Domino, juxta omnia quæ fecerant patres ejus.

verses.text: And Pharao Nechao bound him at Rebla, which is in the land of Emath, that he should not reign in Jerusalem: and he set a fine upon the land, of a hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.textLatin: Vinxitque eum Pharao Nechao in Rebla, quæ est in terra Emath, ne regnaret in Jerusalem: et imposuit mulctam terræ centum talentis argenti, et talento auri.

verses.text: And Pharao Nechao made Eliacim the son of Josias king in the room of Josias his father: and turned his name to Joakim. And he took Joachaz away and carried him into Egypt, and he died there.
verses.textLatin: Regemque constituit Pharao Nechao Eliacim filium Josiæ pro Josia patre ejus: vertitque nomen ejus Joakim. Porro Joachaz tulit, et duxit in Ægyptum, et mortuus est ibi.

verses.text: And Joakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharao, after he had taxed the land for every man, to contribute according to the commandment of Pharao: and he exacted both the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every man according to his ability: to give to Pharao Nechao.
verses.textLatin: Argentum autem et aurum dedit Joakim Pharaoni, cum indixisset terræ per singulos, ut conferretur juxta præceptum Pharaonis: et unumquemque juxta vires suas exegit, tam argentum quam aurum, de populo terræ, ut daret Pharaoni Nechao.

verses.text: Joakim was five and twenty years old when he began to reign: and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Zebida the daughter of Phadaia of Ruma.
verses.textLatin: Viginti quinque annorum erat Joakim cum regnare cœpisset, et undecim annis regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Zebida filia Phadaia de Ruma.

verses.text: And he did evil before the Lord according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textLatin: Et fecit malum coram Domino juxta omnia quæ fecerant patres ejus.

verses.text: In  his days Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came up, and Joakim became his servant three years: then again he rebelled against him.
verses.textLatin: In diebus ejus ascendit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et factus est ei Joakim servus tribus annis: et rursum rebellavit contra eum.

verses.text: And the Lord sent against him the rovers of the Chaldees, and the rovers of Syria, and the rovers of Moab, and the rovers of the children of Ammon: and he sent them against Juda, to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he had spoken by his servants the prophets.
verses.textLatin: Immisitque ei Dominus latrunculos Chaldæorum, et latrunculos Syriæ, et latrunculos Moab, et latrunculos filiorum Ammon: et immisit eos in Judam ut disperderent eum, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat per servos suos prophetas.

verses.text: And this came by the word of the Lord against Juda, to remove them from before him for all the sins of Manasses which he did.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem hoc per verbum Domini contra Judam, ut auferret eum coram se propter peccata Manasse universa quæ fecit,

verses.text: And for the innocent blood that he shed, filling Jerusalem with innocent blood: and therefore the Lord would not be appeased.
verses.textLatin: et propter sanguinem innoxium quem effudit, et implevit Jerusalem cruore innocentium: et ob hanc rem noluit Dominus propitiari.

verses.text: But the rest of the acts of Joakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda? And Joakim slept with his fathers:
verses.textLatin: Reliqua autem sermonum Joakim, et universa quæ fecit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda? Et dormivit Joakim cum patribus suis:

verses.text: And Joachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: et regnavit Joachin filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his own country: for the king of Babylon had taken all that had belonged to the king of Egypt, from the river of Egypt, unto the river Euphrates.
verses.textLatin: Et ultra non addidit rex Ægypti ut egrederetur de terra sua: tulerat enim rex Babylonis, a rivo Ægypti usque ad fluvium Euphraten, omnia quæ fuerant regis Ægypti.

verses.text: Joachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Nohesta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Decem et octo annorum erat Joachin cum regnare cœpisset, et tribus mensibus regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Nohesta filia Elnathan de Jerusalem.

verses.text: And he did evil before the Lord, according to all that his father had done.
verses.textLatin: Et fecit malum coram Domino, juxta omnia quæ fecerat pater ejus.

verses.text: At that time the servants of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was surrounded with their forts.
verses.textLatin: In tempore illo ascenderunt servi Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis in Jerusalem, et circumdata est urbs munitionibus.

verses.text: And Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came to the city with his servants to assault it.
verses.textLatin: Venitque Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis ad civitatem cum servis suis ut oppugnarent eam.

verses.text: And Joachin king of Juda went out to the king of Babylon, he and his mother, and his servants, and his nobles, and his eunuchs: and the king of Babylon received him in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.textLatin: Egressusque est Joachin rex Juda ad regem Babylonis, ipse et mater ejus, et servi ejus, et principes ejus, et eunuchi ejus: et suscepit eum rex Babylonis anno octavo regni sui.

verses.text: And he brought out from thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house: and he cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et protulit inde omnes thesauros domus Domini, et thesauros domus regiæ: et concidit universa vasa aurea quæ fecerat Salomon rex Israël in templo Domini juxta verbum Domini.

verses.text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the valiant men of the army, to the number of ten thousand into captivity: and every artificer and smith: and none were left, but the poor sort of the people of the land.
verses.textLatin: Et transtulit omnem Jerusalem, et universos principes, et omnes fortes exercitus, decem millia, in captivitatem, et omnem artificem et clusorem: nihilque relictum est, exceptis pauperibus populi terræ.

verses.text: And he carried away Joachin into Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his eunuchs: and the judges of the land he carried into captivity from Jerusalem into Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Transtulit quoque Joachin in Babylonem, et matrem regis, et uxores regis, et eunuchos ejus: et judices terræ duxit in captivitatem de Jerusalem in Babylonem.

verses.text: And all the strong men, seven thousand, and the artificers, and the smiths a thousand, all that were valiant men and fit for war: and the king of Babylon led them captives into Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Et omnes viros robustos, septem millia, et artifices, et clusores mille, omnes viros fortes et bellatores: duxitque eos rex Babylonis captivos in Babylonem.

verses.text: And he appointed Matthanias his uncle in his stead: and called his name Sedecias.
verses.textLatin: Et constituit Matthaniam patruum ejus pro eo: imposuitque nomen ei Sedeciam.

verses.text: Sedecias was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Jeremias of Lobna.
verses.textLatin: Vigesimum et primum annum ætatis habebat Sedecias cum regnare cœpisset, et undecim annis regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus erat Amital filia Jeremiæ de Lobna.

verses.text: And he did evil before the Lord, according to all that Joakim had done.
verses.textLatin: Et fecit malum coram Domino, juxta omnia quæ fecerat Joakim.

verses.text: For the Lord was angry against Jerusalem and against Juda, till he cast them out from his face: and Sedecias revolted from the king of Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Irascebatur enim Dominus contra Jerusalem et contra Judam, donec projiceret eos a facie sua: recessitque Sedecias a rege Babylonis.

verses.text: And  it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, the tenth day of the month, that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came, he and all his army against Jerusalem: and they surrounded it: and raised works round about it.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem anno nono regni ejus, mense decimo, decima die mensis, venit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, ipse et omnis exercitus ejus, in Jerusalem, et circumdederunt eam: et exstruxerunt in circuitu ejus munitiones.

verses.text: And the city was shut up and besieged till the eleventh year of king Sedecias,
verses.textLatin: Et clausa est civitas atque vallata usque ad undecimum annum regis Sedeciæ,

verses.text: The ninth day of the month: and a famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.textLatin: nona die mensis: prævaluitque fames in civitate, nec erat panis populo terræ.

verses.text: And a breach was made into the city: and all the men of war fled in the night between the two walls by the king’s garden, (now the Chaldees besieged the city round about,) and Sedecias fled by the way that leadeth to the plains of the wilderness.
verses.textLatin: Et interrupta est civitas: et omnes viri bellatores nocte fugerunt per viam portæ quæ est inter duplicem murum ad hortum regis. Porro Chaldæi obsidebant in circuitu civitatem. Fugit itaque Sedecias per viam quæ ducit ad campestria solitudinis.

verses.text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all the warriors that were with him were scattered, and left him:
verses.textLatin: Et persecutus est exercitus Chaldæorum regem, comprehenditque eum in planitie Jericho: et omnes bellatores qui erant cum eo, dispersi sunt, et reliquerunt eum.

verses.text: So they took the king, and brought him to the king of Babylon to Reblatha, and he gave judgment upon him.
verses.textLatin: Apprehensum ergo regem duxerunt ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha: qui locutus est cum eo judicium.

verses.text: And he slew the sons of Sedecias before his face, and he put out his eyes, and bound him with chains, and brought him to Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Filios autem Sedeciæ occidit coram eo, et oculos ejus effodit, vinxitque eum catenis, et adduxit in Babylonem.

verses.text: In the fifth month, the seventh day of the month, that is, the nineteenth year of the king of Babylon, came Nabuzardan commander of the army, a servant of the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Mense quinto, septima die mensis, ipse est annus nonusdecimus regis Babylonis, venit Nabuzardan princeps exercitus, servus regis Babylonis, in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king’s house, and the houses of Jerusalem, and every house he burnt with fire.
verses.textLatin: Et succendit domum Domini, et domum regis: et domos Jerusalem, omnemque domum combussit igni.

verses.text: And all the army of the Chaldees, which was with the commander of the troops, broke down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.textLatin: Et muros Jerusalem in circuitu destruxit omnis exercitus Chaldæorum, qui erat cum principe militum.

verses.text: And Nabuzardan the commander of the army, carried away the rest of the people that remained in the city, and the fugitives that had gone over to the king of Babylon, and the remnant of the common people.
verses.textLatin: Reliquam autem populi partem quæ remanserat in civitate, et perfugas qui transfugerant ad regem Babylonis, et reliquum vulgus transtulit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ.

verses.text: But of the poor of the land he left some dressers of vines and husbandmen.
verses.textLatin: Et de pauperibus terræ reliquit vinitores et agricolas.

verses.text: And the pillars of brass that were in the temple of the Lord, and the bases, and the sea of brass which was in the house of the Lord, the Chaldees broke in pieces, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Columnas autem æreas quæ erant in templo Domini, et bases, et mare æreum quod erat in domo Domini, confregerunt Chaldæi, et transtulerunt æs omne in Babylonem.

verses.text: They took away also the pots of brass, and the mazers, and the forks, and the cups, and the mortars, and all the vessels of brass with which they ministered.
verses.textLatin: Ollas quoque æreas, et trullas, et tridentes, et scyphos, et mortariola, et omnia vasa ærea, in quibus ministrabant, tulerunt.

verses.text: Moreover also the censers, and the bowls, such as were of gold in gold, and such as were of silver in silver, the general of the army took away.
verses.textLatin: Necnon et thuribula, et phialas: quæ aurea, aurea, et quæ argentea, argentea tulit princeps militiæ,

verses.text: That is, two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made in the temple of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.textLatin: id est, columnas duas, mare unum, et bases quas fecerat Salomon in templo Domini: non erat pondus æris omnium vasorum.

verses.text: One pillar was eighteen cubits high, and the chapiter of brass which was upon it was three cubits high: and the network, and the pomegranates that were upon the chapiter of the pillar, were all of brass: and the second pillar had the like adorning.
verses.textLatin: Decem et octo cubitos altitudinis habebat columna una: et capitellum æreum super se altitudinis trium cubitorum: et retiaculum, et malogranata super capitellum columnæ, omnia ærea: similem et columna secunda habebat ornatum.

verses.text: And the general of the army took Seraias the chief priest, and Sophonias the second priest, and three doorkeepers.
verses.textLatin: Tulit quoque princeps militiæ Saraiam sacerdotem primum, et Sophoniam sacerdotem secundum, et tres janitores.

verses.text: And out of the city one eunuch, who was captain over the men of war: and five men of them that had stood before the king, whom he found in the city, and Sopher the captain of the army who exercised the young soldiers of the people of the land: and threescore men of the common people, who were found in the city.
verses.textLatin: Et de civitate eunuchum unum, qui erat præfectus super bellatores viros: et quinque viros de his qui steterant coram rege, quos reperit in civitate: et Sopher principem exercitus, qui probabat tyrones de populo terræ: et sexaginta viros e vulgo, qui inventi fuerant in civitate.

verses.text: These Nabuzardan the general of the army took away, and carried them to the king of Babylon to Reblatha.
verses.textLatin: Quos tollens Nabuzardan princeps militum, duxit ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha.

verses.text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Reblatha in the land of Emath: so Juda was carried away out of their land.
verses.textLatin: Percussitque eos rex Babylonis, et interfecit eos in Reblatha in terra Emath: et translatus est Juda de terra sua.

verses.text: But over the people that remained in the land of Juda, which Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had left, he gave the government to Godolias the son of Ahicam the son of Saphan.
verses.textLatin: Populo autem qui relictus erat in terra Juda, quem dimiserat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, præfecit Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan.

verses.text: And when all the captains of the soldiers had heard this, they and the men that were with them, to wit, that the king of Babylon had made Godolias governor, they came to Godolias to Maspha, Ismael the son of Nathanias, and Johanan the son of Caree, and Saraia the son of Thanehumeth the Netophathite, and Jezonias the son of Maachathi, they and their men.
verses.textLatin: Quod cum audissent omnes duces militum, ipsi et viri qui erant cum eis, videlicet quod constituisset rex Babylonis Godoliam, venerunt ad Godoliam in Maspha, Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et Johanan filius Caree, et Saraia filius Thanehumeth Netophathites, et Jezonias filius Maachathi, ipsi et socii eorum.

verses.text: And Godolias swore to them and to their men, saying: Be not afraid to serve the Chaldees: stay in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
verses.textLatin: Juravitque Godolias ipsis et sociis eorum, dicens: Nolite timere servire Chaldæis: manete in terra, et servite regi Babylonis, et bene erit vobis.

verses.text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ismael the son of Nathanias, the son of Elisama of the seed royal came, and ten men with him: and smote Godolias so that he died: and also the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him in Maspha.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem in mense septimo, venit Ismahel filius Nathaniæ filii Elisama de semine regio, et decem viri cum eo: percusseruntque Godoliam, qui et mortuus est: sed et Judæos et Chaldæos qui erant cum eo in Maspha.

verses.text: And all the people both little and great, and the captains of the soldiers, rising up went to Egypt, fearing the Chaldees.
verses.textLatin: Consurgensque omnis populus a parvo usque ad magnum, et principes militum, venerunt in Ægyptum timentes Chaldæos.

verses.text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Joachin king of Juda, in the twelfth month the seven and twentieth day of the month: Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, lifted up the head of Joachin king of Juda out of prison.
verses.textLatin: Factum est vero in anno trigesimo septimo transmigrationis Joachin regis Juda, mense duodecimo, vigesima septima die mensis: sublevavit Evilmerodach rex Babylonis, anno quo regnare cœperat, caput Joachin regis Juda de carcere.

verses.text: And he spoke kindly to him: and he set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon.
verses.textLatin: Et locutus est ei benigne, et posuit thronum ejus super thronum regum qui erant cum eo in Babylone.

verses.text: And he changed his garments which he had in prison, and he ate bread always before him, all the days of his life.
verses.textLatin: Et mutavit vestes ejus quas habuerat in carcere, et comedebat panem semper in conspectu ejus cunctis diebus vitæ suæ.

verses.text: And he appointed him a continual allowance, which was also given him by the king day by day, all the days of his life.
verses.textLatin: Annonam quoque constituit ei sine intermissione, quæ et dabatur ei a rege per singulos dies omnibus diebus vitæ suæ.

verses.text: Adam,  Seth, Enos,
verses.textLatin: Adam, Seth, Enos,

verses.text: Cainan, Malaleel, Jared,
verses.textLatin: Cainan, Malaleel, Jared,

verses.text: Henoc, Mathusale, Lamech,
verses.textLatin: Henoch, Mathusale, Lamech,

verses.text: Noe, Sem, Cham, and Japheth.
verses.textLatin: Noë, Sem, Cham, et Japtheth.

verses.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, Thubal, Mosoch, Thiras.
verses.textLatin: Filii Japheth: Gomer, et Magog, et Madai, et Javan, Thubal, Mosoch, Thiras.

verses.text: And the sons of Gomer: Ascenez, and Riphath, and Thogorma.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Gomer: Ascenez, et Riphath, et Thogorma.

verses.text: And the sons of Javan: Elisa and Tharsis, Cethim and Dodanim.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Javan: Elisa et Tharsis, Cethim et Dodanim.

verses.text: The sons of Cham: Chus, and Mesrai, and Phut, and Chanaan.
verses.textLatin: Filii Cham: Chus, et Mesraim, et Phut, et Chanaan.

verses.text: And the sons of Chus: Saba, and Hevila, Sabatha, and Regma, and Sabathaca. And the sons of Regma: Saba, and Dadan.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Chus: Saba, et Hevila, Sabatha, et Regma, et Sabathacha. Porro filii Regma: Saba, et Dadan.

verses.text: Now Chus begot Nemrod: he began to be mighty upon earth.
verses.textLatin: Chus autem genuit Nemrod: iste cœpit esse potens in terra.

verses.text: But Mesraim begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Laabim, and Nephtuim,
verses.textLatin: Mesraim vero genuit Ludim, et Anamim, et Laabim, et Nephtuim,

verses.text: Phetrusim also, and Casluim: from whom came the Philistines, and Caphtorim.
verses.textLatin: Phetrusim quoque, et Casluim: de quibus egressi sunt Philisthiim, et Caphtorim.

verses.text: And Chanaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and the Hethite,
verses.textLatin: Chanaan vero genuit Sidonem primogenitum suum, Hethæum quoque,

verses.text: And the Jebusite, and the Amorrhite, and the Gergesite,
verses.textLatin: et Jebusæum, et Amorrhæum, et Gergesæum,

verses.text: And the Hevite, and the Aracite, and the Sinite,
verses.textLatin: Hevæumque et Aracæum, et Sinæum.

verses.text: And the Aradian, and the Samarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.textLatin: Aradium quoque, et Samaræum, et Hamathæum.

verses.text: The sons of Sem: Elam and Asur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Hus, and Hul, and Gether, and Mosoch.
verses.textLatin: Filii Sem: Ælam, et Assur, et Arphaxad, et Lud, et Aram, et Hus, et Hul, et Gether, et Mosoch.

verses.text: And Arphaxad begot Sale, and Sale begot Heber.
verses.textLatin: Arphaxad autem genuit Sale, qui et ipse genuit Heber.

verses.text: And to Heber were born two sons, the name of the one was Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Jectan.
verses.textLatin: Porro Heber nati sunt duo filii: nomen uni Phaleg, quia in diebus ejus divisa est terra; et nomen fratris ejus Jectan.

verses.text: And Jectan begot Elmodad, and Saleph, and Asarmoth, and Jare,
verses.textLatin: Jectan autem genuit Elmodad, et Saleph, et Asarmoth, et Jare,

verses.text: And Adoram, and Usal, and Decla,
verses.textLatin: Adoram quoque, et Huzal, et Decla,

verses.text: And Hebal, and Abimael, and Saba,
verses.textLatin: Hebal etiam, et Abimaël, et Saba, necnon

verses.text: And Ophir, and Hevila, and Jobab. All these are the sons of Jectan.
verses.textLatin: et Ophir, et Hevila, et Jobab: omnes isti filii Jectan.

verses.text: Sem, Arphaxad, Sale,
verses.textLatin: Sem, Arphaxad, Sale,

verses.text: Heber, Phaleg, Ragau,
verses.textLatin: Heber, Phaleg, Ragau,

verses.text: Serug, Nachor, Thare,
verses.textLatin: Serug, Nachor, Thare,

verses.text: Abram, this is Abraham.
verses.textLatin: Abram: iste est Abraham.

verses.text: And the sons of Abraham, Isaac and Ismahel.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Abraham, Isaac et Ismahel.

verses.text: And these are the generations of them. The firstborn of Ismahel, Nabajoth, then Cedar, and Adbeel, and Mabsam,
verses.textLatin: Et hæ generationes eorum. Primogenitus Ismahelis, Nabaioth, et Cedar, et Adbeel, et Mabsam,

verses.text: And Masma, and Duma, Massa, Hadad, and Thema,
verses.textLatin: et Masma, et Duma, Massa, Hadad, et Thema,

verses.text: Jetur, Naphis, Cedma: these are the sons of Ismahel.
verses.textLatin: Jetur, Naphis, Cedma: hi sunt filii Ismahelis.

verses.text: And the sons of Cetura, Abraham’s concubine, whom she bore: Zamran, Jecsan, Madan, Madian, Jesboc, and Sue. And the sons of Jecsan, Saba, and Dadan. And the sons of Dadan: Assurim, and Latussim, and Laomin.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Ceturæ concubinæ Abraham, quos genuit: Zamran, Jecsan, Madan, Madian, Jesboc, et Sue. Porro filii Jecsan: Saba, et Dadan. Filii autem Dadan: Assurim, et Latussim, et Laomim.

verses.text: And the sons of Madian: Epha, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa. All these are the sons of Cetura.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Madian: Epha, et Epher, et Henoch, et Abida, et Eldaa: omnes hi filii Ceturæ.

verses.text: And Abraham begot Isaac: and his sons were Esau and Israel.
verses.textLatin: Genuit autem Abraham Isaac: cujus fuerunt filii Esau, et Israël.

verses.text: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Rahuel, Jehus, Ihelom, and Core.
verses.textLatin: Filii Esau: Eliphaz, Rahuel, Jehus, Ihelom, et Core.

verses.text: The sons of Eliphaz: Theman, Omar, Sephi, Gathan, Cenez, and by Thamna, Amalec.
verses.textLatin: Filii Eliphaz: Theman, Omar, Sephi, Gathan, Cenez, Thamna, Amalec.

verses.text: The sons of Rahuel: Nahath, Zara, Samma, Meza.
verses.textLatin: Filii Rahuel: Nahath, Zara, Samma, Meza.

verses.text: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, Disan.
verses.textLatin: Filii Seir: Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, Disan.

verses.text: The sons of Lotan: Hori, Homam. And the sister of Lotan was Thamna.
verses.textLatin: Filii Lotan: Hori, Homam. Soror autem Lotan fuit Thamna.

verses.text: The sons of Sobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Sephi, and Onam. The sons of Sebeon: Aia, and Ana. The son of Ana: Dison.
verses.textLatin: Filii Sobal: Alian, et Manahath, et Ebal, Sephi et Onam. Filii Sebeon: Aja et Ana. Filii Ana: Dison.

verses.text: The sons of Dison: Hamram, and Eseban, and Jethran, and Charan.
verses.textLatin: Filii Dison: Hamram, et Heseban, et Jethran, et Charan.

verses.text: The sons of Eser: Balaan, and Zavan, and Jacan. The sons of Disan: Hus and Aran.
verses.textLatin: Filii Eser: Balaan, et Zavan, et Jacan. Filii Disan: Hus et Aran.

verses.text: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there was a king over the children of Israel: Bale the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Denaba.
verses.textLatin: Isti sunt reges qui imperaverunt in terra Edom, antequam esset rex super filios Israël. Bale filius Beor: et nomen civitatis ejus, Denaba.

verses.text: And Bale died, and Jobab the son of Zare of Bosra, reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Mortuus est autem Bale, et regnavit pro eo Jobab filius Zare de Bosra.

verses.text: And when Jobab also was dead, Husam of the land of the Themanites reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Cumque et Jobab fuisset mortuus, regnavit pro eo Husam de terra Themanorum.

verses.text: And Husam also died, and Adad the son of Badad reigned in his stead, and he defeated the Madianites in the land of Moab: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.textLatin: Obiit quoque et Husam, et regnavit pro eo Adad filius Badad, qui percussit Madian in terra Moab: et nomen civitatis ejus Avith.

verses.text: And when Adad also was dead, Semla of Masreca reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Cumque et Adad fuisset mortuus, regnavit pro eo Semla de Masreca.

verses.text: Semla also died, and Saul of Rohoboth, which is near the river, reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Sed et Semla mortuus est, et regnavit pro eo Saul de Rohoboth, quæ juxta amnem sita est.

verses.text: And when Saul was dead, Balanan the son of Achobor reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Mortuo quoque Saul, regnavit pro eo Balanan filius Achobor.

verses.text: He also died, and Adad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Phau, and his wife was called Meetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezaab.
verses.textLatin: Sed et hic mortuus est, et regnavit pro eo Adad: cujus urbis nomen fuit Phau, et appellata est uxor ejus Meetabel filia Matred filiæ Mezaab.

verses.text: And after the death of Adad, there began to be dukes in Edom instead of kings: duke Thamna, duke Alva, duke Jetheth,
verses.textLatin: Adad autem mortuo, duces pro regibus in Edom esse cœperunt: dux Thamna, dux Alva, dux Jetheth,

verses.text: Duke Oolibama, duke Ela, duke Phinon,
verses.textLatin: dux Oolibama, dux Ela, dux Phinon,

verses.text: Duke Cenez, duke Theman, duke Mabsar,
verses.textLatin: dux Cenez, dux Theman, dux Mabsar,

verses.text: Duke Magdiel, duke Hiram. These are the dukes of Edom.
verses.textLatin: dux Magdiel, dux Hiram: hi duces Edom.

verses.text: And  these are the sons of Israel: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issachar, and Zabulon,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Israël: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issachar, et Zabulon,

verses.text: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Nephtali, Gad, and Aser.
verses.textLatin: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Nephthali, Gad, et Aser.

verses.text: The sons of Juda: Her, Onan and Sela. These three were born to him of the Chanaanitess the daughter of Sue. And Her the firstborn of Juda, was wicked in the sight of the Lord, and he slew him.
verses.textLatin: Filii Juda: Her, Onan, et Sela: hi tres nati sunt ei de filia Sue Chananitide. Fuit autem Her primogenitus Juda malus coram Domino, et occidit eum.

verses.text: And Thamar his daughter in law bore him Phares and Zara. So all the sons of Juda were five.
verses.textLatin: Thamar autem nurus ejus peperit ei Phares et Zara: omnes ergo filii Juda, quinque.

verses.text: And the sons of Phares, were Hesron and Hamul.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Phares: Hesron et Hamul.

verses.text: And the sons also of Zare: Zamri, and Ethan, and Eman, and Chalchal, and Dara, five in all.
verses.textLatin: Filii quoque Zaræ: Zamri, et Ethan, et Eman, Chalchal quoque, et Dara, simul quinque.

verses.text: And the sons of Charmi: Achar, who troubled Israel, and sinned by the theft of the anathema.
verses.textLatin: Filii Charmi: Achar, qui turbavit Israël, et peccavit in furto anathematis.

verses.text: The sons of Ethan: Azarias,
verses.textLatin: Filii Ethan: Azarias.

verses.text: And the sons of Hesron that were born to him: Jerameel, and Ram, and Calubi.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Hesron qui nati sunt ei: Jerameel, et Ram, et Calubi.

verses.text: And Ram begot Aminadab, and Aminadab begot Nahasson, prince of the children of Juda.
verses.textLatin: Porro Ram genuit Aminadab. Aminadab autem genuit Nahasson, principem filiorum Juda.

verses.text: And Nahasson begot Salma, the father of Booz.
verses.textLatin: Nahasson quoque genuit Salma, de quo ortus est Booz.

verses.text: And Booz begot Obed, and Obed begot Isai.
verses.textLatin: Booz vero genuit Obed, qui et ipse genuit Isai.

verses.text: And Isai begot Eliab his firstborn, the second Abinadab, the third Simmaa,
verses.textLatin: Isai autem genuit primogenitum Eliab, secundum Abinadab, tertium Simmaa,

verses.text: The fourth, Nathanael, the fifth Raddai,
verses.textLatin: quartum Nathanaël, quintum Raddai,

verses.text: The sixth Asom, the seventh David.
verses.textLatin: sextum Asom, septimum David.

verses.text: And their sisters were Sarvia, and Abigail. The sons of Sarvia: Abisai, Joab, and Asael, three.
verses.textLatin: Quorum sorores fuerunt Sarvia et Abigail. Filii Sarviæ: Abisai, Joab, et Asaël, tres.

verses.text: And Abigail bore Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ismahelite.
verses.textLatin: Abigail autem genuit Amasa, cujus pater fuit Jether Ismahelites.

verses.text: And Caleb the son of Hesron took a wife named Azuba, of whom he had Jerioth: and her sons were Jaser, and Sobab, and Ardon.
verses.textLatin: Caleb vero filius Hesron accepit uxorem nomine Azuba, de qua genuit Jerioth: fueruntque filii ejus Jaser, et Sobab, et Ardon.

verses.text: And when Azuba was dead, Caleb took to wife Ephrata: who bore him Hur.
verses.textLatin: Cumque mortua fuisset Azuba, accepit uxorem Caleb Ephratha, quæ peperit ei Hur.

verses.text: And Hur begot Uri: and Uri begot Bezeleel.
verses.textLatin: Porro Hur genuit Uri, et Uri genuit Bezeleel.

verses.text: And afterwards Hesron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Galaad, and took her to wife when he was threescore years old: and she bore him Segub.
verses.textLatin: Post hæc ingressus est Hesron ad filiam Machir patris Galaad, et accepit eam cum esset annorum sexaginta: quæ peperit ei Segub.

verses.text: And Segub begot Jair, and he had three and twenty cities in the land of Galaad.
verses.textLatin: Sed et Segub genuit Jair, et possedit viginti tres civitates in terra Galaad.

verses.text: And he took Gessur, and Aram the towns of Jair, and Canath, and the villages thereof, threescore cities. All these, the sons of Machir father of Galaad.
verses.textLatin: Cepitque Gessur et Aram oppida Jair, et Canath, et viculos ejus sexaginta civitatum: omnes isti filii Machir patris Galaad.

verses.text: And when Hesron was dead, Caleb went in to Ephrata. Hesron also had to wife Abia who bore him Ashur the father of Thecua.
verses.textLatin: Cum autem mortuus esset Hesron, ingressus est Caleb ad Ephratha. Habuit quoque Hesron uxorem Abia, quæ peperit ei Assur patrem Thecuæ.

verses.text: And the sons of Jerameel the firstborn of Hesron, were Ram his firstborn, and Buna, and Aram, and Asom, and Achia.
verses.textLatin: Nati sunt autem filii Jerameel primogeniti Hesron, Ram primogenitus ejus, et Buna, et Aram, et Asom, et Achia.

verses.text: And Jerameel married another wife, named Atara, who was the mother of Onam.
verses.textLatin: Duxit quoque uxorem alteram Jerameel, nomine Atara, quæ fuit mater Onam.

verses.text: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerameel, were Moos, Jamin, and Achar.
verses.textLatin: Sed et filii Ram primogeniti Jerameel fuerunt Moos, Jamin, et Achar.

verses.text: And Onam had sons Semei, and Jada. And the sons of Semei: Nadab, and Abisur.
verses.textLatin: Onam autem habuit filios Semei et Jada. Filii autem Semei: Nadab et Abisur.

verses.text: And the name of Abisur’s wife was Abihail, who bore him Ahobban, and Molid.
verses.textLatin: Nomen vero uxoris Abisur, Abihail, quæ peperit ei Ahobban et Molid.

verses.text: And the sons of Nadab were Saled, and Apphaim. And Saled died without children.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Nadab fuerunt Saled et Apphaim. Mortuus est autem Saled absque liberis.

verses.text: But the son of Apphaim was Jesi: and Jesi begot Sesan. And Sesan begot Oholai.
verses.textLatin: Filius vero Apphaim, Jesi: qui Jesi genuit Sesan. Porro Sesan genuit Oholai.

verses.text: And the sons of Jada the brother of Semei: Jether and Jonathan. And Jether also died without children.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Jada fratris Semei: Jether, et Jonathan. Sed et Jether mortuus est absque liberis.

verses.text: But Jonathan begot Phaleth, and Ziza. These were the sons of Jerameel.
verses.textLatin: Porro Jonathan genuit Phaleth, et Ziza. Isti fuerunt filii Jerameel.

verses.text: And Sesan had no sons, but daughters and a servant an Egyptian, named Jeraa.
verses.textLatin: Sesan autem non habuit filios, sed filias: et servum ægyptium nomine Jeraa.

verses.text: And he gave him his daughter to wife: and she bore him Ethei.
verses.textLatin: Deditque ei filiam suam uxorem: quæ peperit ei Ethei.

verses.text: And Ethei begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad.
verses.textLatin: Ethei autem genuit Nathan, et Nathan genuit Zabad.

verses.text: And Zabad begot Ophlal, and Ophlal begot Obed.
verses.textLatin: Zabad quoque genuit Ophlal, et Ophlal genuit Obed.

verses.text: Obed begot Jehu, Jehu begot Azarias.
verses.textLatin: Obed genuit Jehu, Jehu genuit Azariam,

verses.text: Azarias begot Helles, and Helles begot Elasa.
verses.textLatin: Azarias genuit Helles, et Helles genuit Elasa.

verses.text: Elasa begot Sisamoi, Sisamoi begot Sellum,
verses.textLatin: Elasa genuit Sisamoi, Sisamoi genuit Sellum,

verses.text: Sellum begot Icamia, and Icamia begot Elisama.
verses.textLatin: Sellum genuit Icamiam, Icamia autem genuit Elisama.

verses.text: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerameel were Mesa his firstborn, who was the father of Siph: and the sons of Maresa father of Hebron.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Caleb fratris Jerameel: Mesa primogenitus ejus; ipse est pater Ziph: et filii Maresa patris Hebron.

verses.text: And the sons of Hebron, Core, and Thaphua, and Recem, and Samma.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Hebron, Core, et Taphua, et Recem, et Samma.

verses.text: And Samma begot Raham, the father of Jercaam, and Recem begot Sammai.
verses.textLatin: Samma autem genuit Raham, patrem Jercaam, et Recem genuit Sammai.

verses.text: The son of Sammai, Maon: and Maon the father of Bethsur.
verses.textLatin: Filius Sammai, Maon: et Maon pater Bethsur.

verses.text: And Epha the concubine of Caleb bore Haran, and Mosa, and Gezez. And Haran begot Gezez.
verses.textLatin: Epha autem concubina Caleb peperit Haran, et Mosa, et Gezez. Porro Haran genuit Gezez.

verses.text: And the sons of Jahaddai, Rogom, and Joathan, and Gesan, and Phalet, and Epha, and Saaph.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Jahaddai, Regom, et Joathan, et Gesan, et Phalet, et Epha, et Saaph.

verses.text: And Maacha the concubine of Caleb bore Saber, and Tharana.
verses.textLatin: Concubina Caleb Maacha, peperit Saber, et Tharana.

verses.text: And Saaph the father of Madmena begot Sue the father of Machbena, and the father of Gabaa. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
verses.textLatin: Genuit autem Saaph pater Madmena Sue, patrem Machbena et patrem Gabaa. Filia vero Caleb fuit Achsa.

verses.text: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur the firstborn of Ephrata, Sobal the father of Cariathiarim.
verses.textLatin: Hi erant filii Caleb, filii Hur primogeniti Ephratha, Sobal pater Cariathiarim.

verses.text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hariph the father of Bethgader.
verses.textLatin: Salma pater Bethlehem, Hariph pater Bethgader.

verses.text: And Sobal the father of Cariathiarim had sons: he that saw half of the places of rest.
verses.textLatin: Fuerunt autem filii Sobal patris Cariathiarim, qui videbat dimidium requietionum.

verses.text: And of the kindred of Cariathiarim, the Jethrites, and Aphuthites, and Semathites, and Maserites. Of them came the Saraites, and Esthaolites.
verses.textLatin: Et de cognatione Cariathiarim, Jethrei, et Aphuthei, et Semathei, et Maserei. Ex his egressi sunt Saraitæ, et Esthaolitæ.

verses.text: The sons of Salma, Bethlehem, and Netophathi, the crowns of the house of Joab, and half of the place of rest of Sarai.
verses.textLatin: Filii Salma, Bethlehem, et Netophathi, coronæ domus Joab, et dimidium requietionis Sarai:

verses.text: And the families of the scribes that dwell in Jabes, singing and making melody, and abiding in tents. These are the Cinites, who came of Calor (Chamath) father of the house of Rechab.
verses.textLatin: cognationes quoque scribarum habitantium in Jabes, canentes atque resonantes, et in tabernaculis commorantes. Hi sunt Cinæi, qui venerunt de Calore patris domus Rechab.

verses.text: Now  these were the sons of David that were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon of Achinoam the Jezrahelitess, the second Daniel of Abigail the Carmelitess.
verses.textLatin: David vero hos habuit filios, qui ei nati sunt in Hebron: primogenitum Amnon ex Achinoam Jezrahelitide, secundum Daniel de Abigail Carmelitide,

verses.text: The third Absalom the son of Maacha the daughter of Tolmai king of Gessur, the fourth Adonias the son of Aggith,
verses.textLatin: tertium Absalom filium Maacha filiæ Tholmai regis Gessur, quartum Adoniam filium Aggith,

verses.text: The fifth Saphatias of Abital, the sixth Jethrahem of Egla his wife.
verses.textLatin: quintum Saphathiam ex Abital, sextum Jethraham de Egla uxore sua.

verses.text: So six sons were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned three and thirty years.
verses.textLatin: Sex ergo nati sunt ei in Hebron, ubi regnavit septem annis et sex mensibus. Triginta autem et tribus annis regnavit in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Simmaa, and Sobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four of Bethsabee the daughter of Ammiel.
verses.textLatin: Porro in Jerusalem nati sunt ei filii, Simmaa, et Sobab, et Nathan, et Salomon, quatuor de Bethsabee filia Ammiel:

verses.text: Jebaar also and Elisama,
verses.textLatin: Jebaar quoque et Elisama,

verses.text: And Eliphaleth, and Noge, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.textLatin: et Eliphaleth, et Noge, et Nepheg, et Japhia,

verses.text: And Elisama, and Eliada, and Elipheleth, nine:
verses.textLatin: necnon Elisama, et Eliada, et Elipheleth, novem:

verses.text: All these the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines: and they had a sister Thamar.
verses.textLatin: omnes hi, filii David absque filiis concubinarum: habueruntque sororem Thamar.

verses.text: And Solomon’s son was Roboam: whose son Abia begot Asa. And his son was Josaphat,
verses.textLatin: Filius autem Salomonis, Roboam: cujus Abia filius genuit Asa. De hoc quoque natus est Josaphat,

verses.text: The father of Joram: and Joram begot Ochozias, of whom was born Joas:
verses.textLatin: pater Joram: qui Joram genuit Ochoziam, ex quo ortus est Joas:

verses.text: And his son Amasias begot Azarias. And Joathan the son of Azarias
verses.textLatin: et hujus Amasias filius genuit Azariam. Porro Azariæ filius Joatham

verses.text: Begot Achaz, the father of Ezechias, of whom was born Manasses.
verses.textLatin: procreavit Achaz patrem Ezechiæ, de quo natus est Manasses.

verses.text: And Manasses begot Amon the father of Josias.
verses.textLatin: Sed et Manasses genuit Amon patrem Josiæ.

verses.text: And the sons of Josias were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Joakim, the third Sedecias, the fourth Sellum.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Josiæ fuerunt: primogenitus Johanan, secundus Joakim, tertius Sedecias, quartus Sellum.

verses.text: Of Joakim was born Jechonias, and Sedecias.
verses.textLatin: De Joakim natus est Jechonias, et Sedecias.

verses.text: The sons of Jechonias were Asir, Salathiel,
verses.textLatin: Filii Jechoniæ fuerunt: Asir, Salathiel,

verses.text: Melchiram, Phadaia, Senneser and Jecemia, Sama, and Nadabia.
verses.textLatin: Melchiram, Phadaia, Senneser, et Jecemia, Sama, et Nadabia.

verses.text: Of Phadaia were born Zorobabel and Semei. Zorobabel begot Mosollam, Hananias, and Salomith their sister:
verses.textLatin: De Phadaia orti sunt Zorobabel et Semei. Zorobabel genuit Mosollam, Hananiam, et Salomith sororem eorum:

verses.text: Hasaba also, and Ohol, and Barachias, and Hasadias, Josabhesed, five.
verses.textLatin: Hasaban quoque, et Ohol, et Barachian, et Hasadian, Josabhesed, quinque.

verses.text: And the son of Hananias was Phaltias the father of Jeseias, whose son was Raphaia. And his son was Arnan, of whom was born Obdia, whose son was Sechenias.
verses.textLatin: Filius autem Hananiæ, Phaltias pater Jeseiæ, cujus filius Raphaia: hujus quoque filius, Arnan, de quo natus est Obdia, cujus filius fuit Sechenias.

verses.text: The son of Sechenias, was Semeia, whose sons were Hattus, and Jegaal, and Baria, and Naaria, and Saphat, six in number.
verses.textLatin: Filius Secheniæ, Semeia: cujus filii Hattus, et Jegaal, et Baria, et Naaria, et Saphat, sex numero.

verses.text: The sons of Naaria, Elioenai, and Ezechias, and Ezricam, three.
verses.textLatin: Filius Naariæ, Elioënai, et Ezechias, et Ezricam, tres.

verses.text: The sons of Elioenai, Oduia, and Eliasub, and Pheleia, and Accub, and Johanan, and Dalaia, and Anani, seven.
verses.textLatin: Filii Elioënai, Oduia, et Eliasub, et Pheleia, et Accub, et Johanan, et Dalaia, et Anani, septem.

verses.text: The  sons of Juda: Phares, Hesron, and Charmi, and Hur, and Sobal.
verses.textLatin: Filii Juda: Phares, Hesron, et Charmi, et Hur, et Sobal.

verses.text: And Raia the son of Sobal begot Jahath, of whom were born Ahumai, and Laad. These are the families of Sarathi.
verses.textLatin: Raia vero filius Sobal genuit Jahath, de quo nati sunt Ahumai, et Laad: hæ cognationes Sarathi.

verses.text: And this is the posterity of Etam: Jezrahel, and Jesema, and Jedebos: and the name of their sister was Asalelphuni.
