verses.textLatin: Ista quoque stirps Etam: Jezrahel, et Jesema, et Jedebos. Nomen quoque sororis eorum, Asalelphuni.

verses.text: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Ezar the father of Hosa, these are the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephratha the father of Bethlehem.
verses.textLatin: Phanuel autem pater Gedor, et Ezer pater Hosa: isti sunt filii Hur primogeniti Ephratha patris Bethlehem.

verses.text: And Assur the father of Thecua had two wives, Halaa and Naara:
verses.textLatin: Assur vero patri Thecuæ erant duæ uxores, Halaa et Naara.

verses.text: And Naara bore him Ozam, and Hepher, and Themani, and Ahasthari: these are the sons of Naara.
verses.textLatin: Peperit autem ei Naara, Oozam, et Hepher, et Themani, et Ahasthari: isti sunt filii Naara.

verses.text: And the sons of Halaa, Sereth, Isaar, and Ethnan.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Halaa, Sereth, Isaar et Ethnan.

verses.text: And Cos begot Anob, and Soboba, and the kindred of Aharehel the son of Arum.
verses.textLatin: Cos autem genuit Anob, et Soboba, et cognationem Aharehel filii Arum.

verses.text: And Jabes was more honourable than any of his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabes, saying: Because I bore him with sorrow.
verses.textLatin: Fuit autem Jabes inclytus præ fratribus suis, et mater ejus vocavit nomen illius Jabes, dicens: Quia peperi eum in dolore.

verses.text: And Jabes called upon the God of Israel, saying: If blessing thou wilt bless me, and wilt enlarge my borders, and thy hand be with me, and thou save me from being oppressed by evil. And God granted him the things he prayed for.
verses.textLatin: Invocavit vero Jabes Deum Israël, dicens: Si benedicens benedixeris mihi, et dilataveris terminos meos, et fuerit manus tua mecum, et feceris me a malitia non opprimi. Et præstitit Deus quæ precatus est.

verses.text: And Caleb the brother of Sua begot Mahir, who was the father of Esthon.
verses.textLatin: Caleb autem frater Sua genuit Mahir, qui fuit pater Esthon.

verses.text: And Esthon begot Bethrapha, and Phesse, and Tehinna father of the city of Naas: these are the men of Recha.
verses.textLatin: Porro Esthon genuit Bethrapha, et Phesse, et Tehinna patrem urbis Naas: hi sunt viri Recha.

verses.text: And the sons of Cenez were Othoniel, and Saraia. And the sons of Othoniel, Hathath, and Maonathi.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Cenez, Othoniel, et Saraia. Porro filii Othoniel, Hathath, et Maonathi.

verses.text: Maonathi begot Ophra, and Saraia begot Joab the father of the Valley of artificers: for artificers were there.
verses.textLatin: Maonathi genuit Ophra, Saraia autem genuit Joab patrem Vallis artificum: ibi quippe artifices erant.

verses.text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephone, were Hir, and Ela, and Naham. And the sons of Ela: Cenez.
verses.textLatin: Filii vero Caleb filii Jephone, Hir, et Ela, et Naham. Filii quoque Ela: Cenez.

verses.text: The sons also of Jaleleel: Ziph, and Zipha, Thiria, and Asrael.
verses.textLatin: Filii quoque Jaleleel: Ziph, et Zipha, Thiria, et Asraël.

verses.text: And the sons of Esra, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon, and he begot Mariam, and Sammai, and Jesba the father of Esthamo.
verses.textLatin: Et filii Ezra, Jether, et Mered, et Epher, et Jalon, genuitque Mariam, et Sammai, et Jesba patrem Esthamo.

verses.text: And his wife Judaia, bore Jared the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Icuthiel the father of Zanoe. And these are the sons of Bethia the daughter of Pharao, whom Mered took to wife.
verses.textLatin: Uxor quoque ejus Judaia, peperit Jared patrem Gedor, et Heber patrem Socho, et Icuthiel patrem Zanoë: hi autem filii Bethiæ filiæ Pharaonis, quam accepit Mered.

verses.text: And the sons of his wife Odaia the sister of Naham the father of Celia, Garmi, and Esthamo, who was of Machathi.
verses.textLatin: Et filii uxoris Odaiæ sororis Naham patris Ceila, Garmi, et Esthamo, qui fuit de Machathi.

verses.text: The sons also of Simon, Amnon, and Rinna the son of Hanan, and Thilon. And the sons of Jesi Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.textLatin: Filii quoque Simon, Amnon, et Rinna filius Hanan, et Thilon. Et filii Jesi, Zoheth, et Benzoheth.

verses.text: The sons of Sela the son of Juda: Her the father of Lecha, and Laada the father of Maresa, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen in the House of oath.
verses.textLatin: Filii Sela, filii Juda: Her pater Lecha, et Laada pater Maresa, et cognationes domus operantium byssum in domo juramenti.

verses.text: And he that made the sun to stand, and the men of Lying, and Secure, and Burning, who were princes in Moab, and who returned into Lahem. Now these are things of old.
verses.textLatin: Et qui stare fecit solem, virique Mendacii, et Securus, et Incendens, qui principes fuerunt in Moab, et qui reversi sunt in Lahem: hæc autem verba vetera.

verses.text: These are the potters, and they dwelt in Plantations, and Hedges, with the king for his works, and they abode there.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt figuli habitantes in plantationibus et in sepibus, apud regem in operibus ejus: commoratique sunt ibi.

verses.text: The sons of Simeon: Namuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zara, Saul:
verses.textLatin: Filii Simeon: Namuel et Jamin, Jarib, Zara, Saul.

verses.text: Sellum his son, Mapsam his son, Masma his son.
verses.textLatin: Sellum filius ejus, Mapsam filius ejus, Masma filius ejus.

verses.text: The sons of Masma: Hamuel his son, Zachur his son, Semei his son.
verses.textLatin: Filii Masma: Hamuel filius ejus, Zachur filius ejus, Semei filius ejus.

verses.text: The sons of Semei were sixteen, and six daughters: but his brethren had not many sons, and the whole kindred could not reach to the sum of the children of Juda.
verses.textLatin: Filii Semei sedecim, et filiæ sex: fratres autem ejus non habuerunt filios multos, et universa cognatio non potuit adæquare summam filiorum Juda.

verses.text: And they dwelt in Bersabee, and Molada, and Hasarsuhal,
verses.textLatin: Habitaverunt autem in Bersabee, et Molada, et Hasarsuhal,

verses.text: And in Bala, and in Asom, and in Tholad,
verses.textLatin: et in Bala, et in Asom, et in Tholad,

verses.text: And in Bathuel, and in Horma, and in Siceleg,
verses.textLatin: et in Bathuel, et in Horma, et in Siceleg,

verses.text: And in Bethmarchaboth, and in Hasarsusim, and in Bethberai, and in Saarim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.textLatin: et in Bethmarchaboth, et in Hasarsusim, et in Bethberai, et in Saarim: hæ civitates eorum usque ad regem David.

verses.text: Their towns also were Etam, and Aen, Remmon, and Thochen, and Asan, five cities.
verses.textLatin: Villæ quoque eorum: Etam, et Aën, Remmon, et Thochen, et Asan, civitates quinque.

verses.text: And all their villages round about these cities as far as Baal. This was their habitation, and the distribution of their dwellings.
verses.textLatin: Et universi viculi eorum per circuitum civitatum istarum usque ad Baal: hæc est habitatio eorum, et sedium distributio.

verses.text: And Mosabab and Jemlech, and Josa, the son of Amasias,
verses.textLatin: Mosobab quoque et Jemlech, et Josa filius Amasiæ,

verses.text: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josabia the son of Saraia, the son of Asiel,
verses.textLatin: et Joël, et Jehu filius Josabiæ filii Saraiæ filii Asiel,

verses.text: And Elioenai, and Jacoba, and Isuhaia, and Asaia, and Adiel, and Ismiel, and Banaia,
verses.textLatin: et Elioënai, et Jacoba, et Isuhaia, et Asaia, et Adiel, et Ismiel, et Banaia,

verses.text: Ziza also the son of Sephei the son of Allon the son of Idaia the son of Semri the son of Samaia.
verses.textLatin: Ziza quoque filius Sephei filii Allon filii Idaia filii Semri filii Samaia.

verses.text: These were named princes in their kindreds, and in the houses of their families were multiplied exceedingly.
verses.textLatin: Isti sunt nominati principes in cognationibus suis, et in domo affinitatum suarum multiplicati sunt vehementer.

verses.text: And they went forth to enter into Gador as far as to the east side of the valley, to seek pastures for their flocks.
verses.textLatin: Et profecti sunt ut ingrederentur in Gador usque ad orientem vallis, et ut quærerent pascua gregibus suis.

verses.text: And they found fat pastures, and very good, and a country spacious, and quiet, and fruitful, in which some of the race of Cham had dwelt before.
verses.textLatin: Inveneruntque pascuas uberes, et valde bonas, et terram latissimam et quietam et fertilem, in qua ante habitaverant de stirpe Cham.

verses.text: And these whose names are written above, came in the days of Ezechias king of Juda: and they beat down their tents, and slew the inhabitants that were found there, and utterly destroyed them unto this day: and they dwelt in their place, because they found there fat pastures.
verses.textLatin: Hi ergo venerunt, quos supra descripsimus nominatim, in diebus Ezechiæ regis Juda: et percusserunt tabernacula eorum, et habitatores qui inventi fuerant ibi, et deleverunt eos usque in præsentem diem: habitaveruntque pro eis, quoniam uberrimas pascuas ibidem repererunt.

verses.text: Some also of the children of Simeon, five hundred men, went into mount Seir, having for their captains Phaltias and Naaria and Raphaia and Oziel the sons of Jesi:
verses.textLatin: De filiis quoque Simeon abierunt in montem Seir viri quingenti, habentes principes Phalthiam et Naariam et Raphaiam et Oziel filios Jesi:

verses.text: And they slew the remnant of the Amalecites, who had been able to escape, and they dwelt there in their stead unto this day.
verses.textLatin: et percusserunt reliquias, quæ evadere potuerant, Amalecitarum, et habitaverunt ibi pro eis usque ad diem hanc.

verses.text: Now  the sons of Ruben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was his firstborn: but forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his first birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, and he was not accounted for the firstborn.
verses.textLatin: Filii quoque Ruben primogeniti Israël. (Ipse quippe fuit primogenitus ejus: sed cum violasset thorum patris sui, data sunt primogenita ejus filiis Joseph filii Israël, et non est ille reputatus in primogenitum.

verses.text: But of the race of Juda, who was the strongest among his brethren, came the princes: but the first birthright was accounted to Joseph.)
verses.textLatin: Porro Judas, qui erat fortissimus inter fratres suos, de stirpe ejus principes germinati sunt: primogenita autem reputata sunt Joseph.)

verses.text: The sons then of Ruben the firstborn of Israel were Enoch, and Phallu, Esron, and Charmi.
verses.textLatin: Filii ergo Ruben primogeniti Israël: Enoch, et Phallu, Esron, et Carmi.

verses.text: The sons of Joel: Samaia his son, Gog his son, Semei his son,
verses.textLatin: Filii Joël: Samia filius ejus, Gog filius ejus, Semei filius ejus,

verses.text: Micha his son, Reia his son, Baal his son,
verses.textLatin: Micha filius ejus, Reia filius ejus, Baal filius ejus,

verses.text: Beera his son, whom Thelgathphalnasar king of the Assyrians carried away captive, and he was prince in the tribe of Ruben.
verses.textLatin: Beera filius ejus, quem captivum duxit Thelgathphalnasar rex Assyriorum, et fuit princeps in tribu Ruben.

verses.text: And his brethren, and all his kindred, when they were numbered by their families, had for princes Jehiel, and Zacharias.
verses.textLatin: Fratres autem ejus, et universa cognatio ejus, quando numerabantur per familias suas, habuerunt principes Jehiel, et Zachariam.

verses.text: And Bala the son of Azaz, the son of Samma, the son of Joel, dwelt in Aroer as far as Nebo, and Beelmeon.
verses.textLatin: Porro Bala filius Azaz filii Samma filii Joël, ipse habitavit in Aroër usque ad Nebo, et Beelmeon.

verses.text: And eastward he had his habitation as far as the entrance of the desert, and the river Euphrates. For they possessed a great number of cattle in the land of Galaad.
verses.textLatin: Contra orientalem quoque plagam habitavit usque ad introitum eremi, et flumen Euphraten. Multum quippe jumentorum numerum possidebant in terra Galaad.

verses.text: And in the days of Saul they fought against the Agarites, and slew them, and dwelt in their tents in their stead, in all the country, that looketh to the east of Galaad.
verses.textLatin: In diebus autem Saul præliati sunt contra Agareos, et interfecerunt illos, habitaveruntque pro eis in tabernaculis eorum, in omni plaga quæ respicit ad orientem Galaad.

verses.text: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them in the land of Basan, as far as Selcha:
verses.textLatin: Filii vero Gad e regione eorum habitaverunt in terra Basan usque Selcha:

verses.text: Johel the chief, and Saphan the second: and Janai, and Saphat in Basan.
verses.textLatin: Joël in capite, et Saphan secundus: Janai autem et Saphat in Basan.

verses.text: And their brethren according to the houses of their kindreds, were Michael, and Mosollam, and Sebe, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zie, and Heber, seven.
verses.textLatin: Fratres vero eorum secundum domos cognationum suarum, Michaël, et Mosollam, et Sebe, et Jorai, et Jachan, et Zie, et Heber, septem.

verses.text: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jara, the son of Galaad, the son of Michael, the son of Jesisi, the son of Jeddo, the son of Buz.
verses.textLatin: Hi filii Abihail, filii Huri, filii Jara, filii Galaad, filii Michaël, filii Jesesi, filii Jeddo, filii Buz.

verses.text: And their brethren the sons of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house in their families,
verses.textLatin: Fratres quoque, filii Abdiel filii Guni, princeps domus in familiis suis.

verses.text: And they dwelt in Galaad, and in Basan and in the towns thereof, and in all the suburbs of Saron, unto the borders.
verses.textLatin: Et habitaverunt in Galaad, et in Basan, et in viculis ejus, et in cunctis suburbanis Saron, usque ad terminos.

verses.text: All these were numbered in the days of Joathan king of Juda, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Omnes hi numerati sunt in diebus Joathan regis Juda, et in diebus Jeroboam regis Israël.

verses.text: The sons of Ruben, and of Gad, and of the half tribe of Manasses, fighting men, bearing shields, and swords, and bending the bow, and trained up to battles, four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore that went out to war.
verses.textLatin: Filii Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse, viri bellatores, scuta portantes et gladios, et tendentes arcum, eruditique ad prælia, quadraginta quatuor millia et septingenti sexaginta, procedentes ad pugnam.

verses.text: They fought against the Agarites: but the Itureans, and Naphis, and Nodab,
verses.textLatin: Dimicaverunt contra Agareos: Ituræi vero, et Naphis, et Nodab

verses.text: Gave them help. And the Agarites were delivered into their hands, and all that were with them, because they called upon God in the battle: and he heard them, because they had put their faith in him.
verses.textLatin: præbuerunt eis auxilium. Traditique sunt in manus eorum Agarei, et universi qui fuerant cum eis, quia Deum invocaverunt cum præliarentur: et exaudivit eos, eo quod credidissent in eum.

verses.text: And they took all that they possessed, of camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand souls.
verses.textLatin: Ceperuntque omnia quæ possederant, camelorum quinquaginta millia, et ovium ducenta quinquaginta millia, et asinos duo millia, et animas hominum centum millia.

verses.text: And many fell down slain: for it was the battle of the Lord. And they dwelt in their stead till the captivity.
verses.textLatin: Vulnerati autem multi corruerunt: fuit enim bellum Domini. Habitaveruntque pro eis usque ad transmigrationem.

verses.text: And the children of the half tribe of Manasses possessed the land, from the borders of Basan unto Baal, Hermon, and Sanir, and mount Hermon, for their number was great.
verses.textLatin: Filii quoque dimidiæ tribus Manasse possederunt terram a finibus Basan usque Baal, Hermon, et Sanir, et montem Hermon: ingens quippe numerus erat.

verses.text: And these were the heads of the house of their kindred, Epher, and Jesi, and Eliel, and Esriel, and Jeremia, and Odoia, and Jediel, most valiant and powerful men, and famous chiefs in their families.
verses.textLatin: Et hi fuerunt principes domus cognationis eorum: Epher, et Jesi, et Eliel, et Ezriel, et Jeremia, et Odoia, et Jediel, viri fortissimi et potentes, et nominati duces in familiis suis.

verses.text: But they forsook the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.textLatin: Reliquerunt autem Deum patrum suorum, et fornicati sunt post deos populorum terræ, quos abstulit Deus coram eis.

verses.text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phul king of the Assyrians, and the spirit of Thelgathphalnasar king of Assur: and he carried away Ruben, and Gad, and the half tribe of Manasses, and brought them to Lahela, and to Habor, and to Ara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.
verses.textLatin: Et suscitavit Deus Israël spiritum Phul regis Assyriorum, et spiritum Thelgathphalnasar regis Assur: et transtulit Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiam tribum Manasse, et adduxit eos in Lahela, et in Habor, et Ara, et fluvium Gozan, usque ad diem hanc.

verses.text: The  sons of Levi were Gerson, Caath, and Merari.
verses.textLatin: Filii Levi: Gerson, Caath, et Merari.

verses.text: The sons of Caath: Amram, Isaar, Hebron, and Oziel.
verses.textLatin: Filii Caath: Amram, Isaar, Hebron, et Oziel.

verses.text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Mary. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abiu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textLatin: Filii Amram: Aaron, Moyses, et Maria. Filii Aaron: Nadab et Abiu, Eleazar, et Ithamar.

verses.text: Eleazar begot Phinees, and Phinees begot Abisue,
verses.textLatin: Eleazar genuit Phinees, et Phinees genuit Abisue.

verses.text: And Abisue begot Bocci, and Bocci begot Ozi.
verses.textLatin: Abisue vero genuit Bocci, et Bocci genuit Ozi.

verses.text: Ozi begot Zaraias, and Zaraias begot Maraioth.
verses.textLatin: Ozi genuit Zaraiam, et Zaraias genuit Meraioth.

verses.text: And Maraioth begot Amarias, and Amarias begot Achitob.
verses.textLatin: Porro Meraioth genuit Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob.

verses.text: Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Achimaas.
verses.textLatin: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Achimaas,

verses.text: Achimaas begot Azarias, Azarias begot Johanan,
verses.textLatin: Achimaas genuit Azariam, Azarias genuit Johanan,

verses.text: Johanan begot Azarias. This is he that executed the priestly office in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Johanan genuit Azariam: ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam ædificavit Salomon in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And Azarias begot Amarias, and Amarias begot Achitob.
verses.textLatin: Genuit autem Azarias Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob,

verses.text: And Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Sellum,
verses.textLatin: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Sellum,

verses.text: Sellum begot Helcias, and Helcias begot Azarias,
verses.textLatin: Sellum genuit Helciam, et Helcias genuit Azariam,

verses.text: Azarias begot Saraias, and Saraias begot Josedec.
verses.textLatin: Azarias genuit Saraiam, et Saraias genuit Josedec.

verses.text: Now Josedec went out, when the Lord carried away Juda, and Jerusalem, by the hands of Nabuchodonosor.
verses.textLatin: Porro Josedec egressus est, quando transtulit Dominus Judam et Jerusalem per manus Nabuchodonosor.

verses.text: So the sons of Levi were Gerson, Caath, and Merari.
verses.textLatin: Filii ergo Levi: Gersom, Caath, et Merari.

verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Gerson: Lobni and Semei.
verses.textLatin: Et hæc nomina filiorum Gersom: Lobni, et Semei.

verses.text: The sons of Caath: Amram, and Isaar, and Hebron, and Oziel.
verses.textLatin: Filii Caath: Amram, et Isaar, et Hebron, et Oziel.

verses.text: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi. And these are the kindreds of Levi according to their families.
verses.textLatin: Filii Merari: Moholi et Musi. Hæ autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum.

verses.text: Of Gerson: Lobni his son, Jahath his son, Zamma his son,
verses.textLatin: Gersom: Lobni filius ejus, Jahath filius ejus, Zamma filius ejus,

verses.text: Joah his son, Addo his son, Zara his son, Jethrai his son.
verses.textLatin: Joah filius ejus, Addo filius ejus, Zara filius ejus, Jethrai filius ejus.

verses.text: The sons of Caath, Aminadab his son, Core his son, Asir his son,
verses.textLatin: Filii Caath: Aminadab filius ejus, Core filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,

verses.text: Elcana his son, Abiasaph his son, Asir his son,
verses.textLatin: Elcana filius ejus, Abiasaph filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,

verses.text: Thahath his son, Uriel his son, Ozias his son, Saul his son.
verses.textLatin: Thahath filius ejus, Uriel filius ejus, Ozias filius ejus, Saul filius ejus.

verses.text: The sons of Elcana: Amasai, and Achimoth.
verses.textLatin: Filii Elcana, Amasai et Achimoth

verses.text: And Elcana. The sons of Elcana: Sophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.textLatin: et Elcana. Filii Elcana: Sophai filius ejus, Nahath filius ejus,

verses.text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elcana his son.
verses.textLatin: Eliab filius ejus, Jeroham filius ejus, Elcana filius ejus.

verses.text: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vasseni, and Abia.
verses.textLatin: Filii Samuel: primogenitus Vasseni, et Abia.

verses.text: And the sons of Merari, Moholi: Lobni his son, Semei his son, Oza his son,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Merari, Moholi: Lobni filius ejus, Semei filius ejus, Oza filius ejus,

verses.text: Sammaa his son, Haggia his son, Asaia his son.
verses.textLatin: Sammaa filius ejus, Haggia filius ejus, Asaia filius ejus.

verses.text: These are they, whom David set over the singing men of the house of the Lord, after that the ark was placed:
verses.textLatin: Isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini, ex quo collocata est arca:

verses.text: And they ministered before the tabernacle of the testimony, with singing, until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they stood according to their order in the ministry.
verses.textLatin: et ministrabant coram tabernaculo testimonii, canentes donec ædificaret Salomon domum Domini in Jerusalem: stabant autem juxta ordinem suum in ministerio.

verses.text: And these are they that stood with their sons, of the sons of Caath, Hemam a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Sammuel,
verses.textLatin: Hi vero sunt qui assistebant cum filiis suis, de filiis Caath, Hemam cantor filius Johel, filii Samuel,

verses.text: The son of Elcana, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Thohu,
verses.textLatin: filii Elcana, filii Jeroham, filii Eliel, filii Thohu,

verses.text: The son of Suph, the son of Elcana, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.textLatin: filii Suph, filii Elcana, filii Mahath, filii Amasai,

verses.text: The son of Elcana, the son of Johel, the son of Azarias, the son of Sophonias,
verses.textLatin: filii Elcana, filii Johel, filii Azariæ, filii Sophoniæ,

verses.text: The son of Thahath, the son of Asir, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core,
verses.textLatin: filii Thahath, filii Asir, filii Abiasaph, filii Core,

verses.text: The son of Isaar, the son of Caath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.textLatin: filii Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, filii Israël.

verses.text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, Asaph the son of Barachias, the son of Samaa.
verses.textLatin: Et frater ejus Asaph, qui stabat a dextris ejus, Asaph filius Barachiæ, filii Samaa,

verses.text: The son of Michael, the son of Basaia, the son of Melchia.
verses.textLatin: filii Michaël, filii Basaiæ, filii Melchiæ,

verses.text: The son of Athanai, the son of Zara, the son of Adaia.
verses.textLatin: filii Athanai, filii Zara, filii Adaia,

verses.text: The son of Ethan, the son of Zamma, the son of Semei.
verses.textLatin: filii Ethan, filii Zamma, filii Semei,

verses.text: The son of Jeth, the son of Gerson, the son of Levi.
verses.textLatin: filii Jeth, filii Gersom, filii Levi.

verses.text: And the sons of Merari their brethren, on the left hand, Ethan the son of Cusi, the son of Abdi, the son of Meloch,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Merari fratres eorum, ad sinistram, Ethan filius Cusi, filii Abdi, filii Maloch,

verses.text: The son of Hasabia, the son of Amasai, the son of Helcias,
verses.textLatin: filii Hasabiæ, filii Amasiæ, filii Helciæ,

verses.text: The son of Amasai, the son of Boni, the son of Somer,
verses.textLatin: filii Amasai, filii Boni, filii Somer,

verses.text: The son of Moholi, the son of Musi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.textLatin: filii Moholi, filii Musi, filii Merari, filii Levi.

verses.text: Their brethren also the Levites, who were appointed for all the ministry of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Fratres quoque eorum Levitæ, qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini.

verses.text: But Aaron and his sons offered burnt offerings upon the altar of holocausts, and upon the altar of incense, for every work of the holy of holies: and to pray for Israel according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.textLatin: Aaron vero et filii ejus adolebant incensum super altare holocausti, et super altare thymiamatis, in omne opus Sancti sanctorum: et ut precarentur pro Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Moyses servus Dei.

verses.text: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinees his son, Abisue his son,
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt autem filii Aaron: Eleazar filius ejus, Phinees filius ejus, Abisue filius ejus,

verses.text: Bocci his son, Ozi his son, Zarahia his son,
verses.textLatin: Bocci filius ejus, Ozi filius ejus, Zarahia filius ejus,

verses.text: Meraioth his son, Amarias his son, Achitob his son,
verses.textLatin: Meraioth filius ejus, Amarias filius ejus, Achitob filius ejus,

verses.text: Sadoc his son, Achimaas his son.
verses.textLatin: Sadoc filius ejus, Achimaas filius ejus.

verses.text: And these are their dwelling places by the towns and confines, to wit, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Caathites: for they fell to them by lot.
verses.textLatin: Et hæc habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia, filiorum scilicet Aaron, juxta cognationes Caathitarum: ipsis enim sorte contigerant.

verses.text: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Juda, and the suburbs thereof round about:
verses.textLatin: Dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum:

verses.text: But the fields of the city, and the villages to Caleb son of Jephone.
verses.textLatin: agros autem civitatis, et villas, Caleb filio Jephone.

verses.text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities for refuge Hebron, and Lobna, and the suburbs thereof,
verses.textLatin: Porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron, et Lobna, et suburbana ejus,

verses.text: And Jether and Esthemo, with their suburbs, and Helon, and Dabir with their suburbs:
verses.textLatin: Jether quoque, et Esthemo cum suburbanis suis, sed et Helon, et Dabir cum suburbanis suis,

verses.text: Asan also, and Bethsames, with their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Asan quoque, et Bethsemes, et suburbana earum.

verses.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin: Gabee and its suburbs, Almath with its suburbs, Anathoth also with its suburbs: all their cities throughout their families were thirteen.
verses.textLatin: De tribu autem Benjamin, Gabee et suburbana ejus, et Almath cum suburbanis suis, Anathoth quoque cum suburbanis suis: omnes civitates, tredecim, per cognationes suas.

verses.text: And to the sons of Caath that remained of their kindred they gave out of the half tribe of Manasses ten cities in possession.
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem.

verses.text: And to the sons of Gerson by their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Aser, and out of the tribe of Nephtali, and out of the tribe of Manasses in Basan, thirteen cities.
verses.textLatin: Porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Issachar, et de tribu Aser, et de tribu Nephthali, et de tribu Manasse in Basan, urbes tredecim.

verses.text: And to the sons of Merari by their families out of the tribe of Ruben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zabulon, they gave by lot twelve cities.
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben, et de tribu Gad, et de tribu Zabulon, dederunt sorte civitates duodecim.

verses.text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities, and their suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Dederunt quoque filii Israël Levitis civitates, et suburbana earum:

verses.text: And they gave them by lot, out of the tribe of the sons of Juda, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which they called by their names.
verses.textLatin: dederuntque per sortem, ex tribu filiorum Juda, et ex tribu filiorum Simeon, et ex tribu filiorum Benjamin urbes has, quas vocaverunt nominibus suis,

verses.text: And to them that were of the kindred of the sons of Caath, and the cities in their borders were of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textLatin: et his, qui erant de cognatione filiorum Caath, fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim.

verses.text: And they gave the cities of refuge Sichem with its suburbs in mount Ephraim, and Gazer with its suburbs,
verses.textLatin: Dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer cum suburbanis suis,

verses.text: Jecmaan also with its suburbs, and Beth-horon in like manner,
verses.textLatin: Jecmaam quoque cum suburbanis suis, et Bethoron similiter,

verses.text: Helon also with its suburbs, and Gethremmon in like manner,
verses.textLatin: necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis, et Gethremmon in eumdem modum.

verses.text: And out of the half tribe of Manasses, Aner and its suburbs, Baalam and its suburbs: to wit, to them that were left of the family of the sons of Caath.
verses.textLatin: Porro ex dimidia tribu Manasse, Aner et suburbana ejus, Balaam et suburbana ejus: his videlicet, qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant.

verses.text: And to the sons of Gersom, out of the kindred of the half tribe of Manasses, Gaulon, in Basan, and its suburbs, and Astharoth with its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidiæ tribus Manasse, Gaulon in Basan, et suburbana ejus, et Astaroth cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Cedes and its suburbs, and Dabereth with its suburbs;
verses.textLatin: De tribu Issachar, Cedes et suburbanis suis, et Dabereth cum suburbanis suis,

verses.text: Ramoth also and its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Ramoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Anem cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: And out of the tribe of Aser: Masal with its suburbs, and Abdon in like manner;
verses.textLatin: De tribu vero Aser: Masal cum suburbanis suis, et Abdon similiter,

verses.text: Hucac also and its suburbs, and Rohol with its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Hucac quoque et suburbana ejus, et Rohob cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: And out of the tribe of Nephtali, Cedes in Galilee and its suburbs, Hamon with its suburbs, and Cariathaim, and its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Porro de tribu Nephthali, Cedes in Galilæa et suburbana ejus, Hamon cum suburbanis suis, et Cariathaim et suburbana ejus.

verses.text: And to the sons of Merari that remained: out of the tribe of Zabulon, Remmono and its suburbs, and Thabor with its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: Filiis autem Merari residuis: de tribu Zabulon, Remmono et suburbana ejus, et Thabor cum suburbanis sus:

verses.text: Beyond the Jordan also over against Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, out of the tribe of Ruben, Bosor in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jassa with its suburbs;
verses.textLatin: trans Jordanem quoque ex adverso Jericho contra orientem Jordanis, de tribu Ruben, Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis, et Jassa cum suburbanis suis,

verses.text: Cademoth also and its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;
verses.textLatin: Cademoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Mephaat cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: Moreover also out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Galaad and its suburbs, and Manaim with its suburbs;
verses.textLatin: Necnon et de tribu Gad, Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana ejus, et Manaim cum suburbanis suis,

verses.text: Hesebon also with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.
verses.textLatin: sed et Hesebon cum suburbanis suis, et Jezer cum suburbanis suis.

verses.text: Now  the sons of Issachar were Thola, and Phua, Jasub and Simeron, four.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Issachar: Thola, et Phua, Jasub, et Simeron, quatuor.

verses.text: The sons of Thola: Ozi and Raphaia, and Jeriel, and Jemai, and Jebsem, and Samuel, chiefs of the houses of their kindreds. Of the posterity of Thola were numbered in the days of David, two and twenty thousand six hundred most valiant men.
verses.textLatin: Filii Thola: Ozi, et Raphaia, et Jeriel, et Jemai, et Jebsem, et Samuel, principes per domos cognationum suarum. De stirpe Thola viri fortissimi numerati sunt in diebus David, viginti duo millia sexcenti.

verses.text: The sons of Ozi: Izrahia, of whom were born Michael, and Obadia, and Joel, and Jesia, five all great men.
verses.textLatin: Filii Ozi: Izrahia, de quo nati sunt Michaël, et Obadia, et Joël, et Jesia, quinque omnes principes.

verses.text: And there were with them by their families and peoples, six and thirty thousand most valiant men ready for war: for they had many wives and children.
verses.textLatin: Cumque eis per familias et populos suos, accincti ad prælium, viri fortissimi, triginta sex millia: multas enim habuerunt uxores, et filios.

verses.text: Their brethren also throughout all the house of Issachar, were numbered fourscore and seven thousand most valiant men for war.
verses.textLatin: Fratres quoque eorum per omnem cognationem Issachar robustissimi ad pugnandum, octoginta septem millia numerati sunt.

verses.text: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, and Bechor, and Jadihel, three.
verses.textLatin: Filii Benjamin: Bela, et Bechor, et Jadihel, tres.

verses.text: The sons of Bela: Esbon, and Ozi, and Ozial, and Jerimoth and Urai, five chiefs of their families, and most valiant warriors, and their number was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
verses.textLatin: Filii Bela: Esbon, et Ozi, et Oziel, et Jerimoth, et Urai, quinque principes familiarum, et ad pugnandum robustissimi: numerus autem eorum, viginti duo millia et triginta quatuor.

verses.text: And the sons of Bechor were Zamira, and Joas, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Amai, and Jerimoth, and Abia, and Anathoth, and Almath: all these were the sons of Bechor.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Bechor: Zamira, et Joas, et Eliezer, et Elioënai, et Amri, et Jerimoth, et Abia, et Anathoth, et Almath: omnes hi filii Bechor.

verses.text: And they were numbered by the families, heads of their kindreds, most valiant men for war, twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.textLatin: Numerati sunt autem per familias suas principes cognationum suarum ad bella fortissimi, viginti millia et ducenti.

verses.text: And the son of Jadihel: Balan. And the sons of Balan: Jehus and Benjamin and Aod, and Chanana, and Zethan and Tharsis, and Ahisahar.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Jadihel: Balan. Filii autem Balan: Jehus, et Benjamin, et Aod, et Chanana, et Zethan, et Tharsis, et Ahisahar:

verses.text: All these were sons of Jadihel, heads of their kindreds, most valiant men, seventeen thousand and two hundred fit to go out to war.
verses.textLatin: omnes hi filii Jadihel, principes cognationum suarum viri fortissimi, decem et septem millia et ducenti ad prælium procedentes.

verses.text: Sepham also and Hapham the sons of Hir: and Hasim the sons of Aher.
verses.textLatin: Sepham quoque et Hapham filii Hir: et Hasim filii Aher.

verses.text: And the sons of Nephtali were Jasiel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Sellum, sons of Bala.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Nephthali: Jaziel, et Guni, et Jeser, et Sellum, filii Bala.

verses.text: And the son of Manasses, Ezriel: and his concubine the Syrian bore Machir the father of Galaad.
verses.textLatin: Porro filius Manasse, Esriel: concubinaque ejus Syra peperit Machir patrem Galaad.

verses.text: And Machir took wives for his sons Happhim, and Saphan: and he had a sister named Maacha: the name of the second was Salphaad, and Salphaad had daughters.
verses.textLatin: Machir autem accepit uxores filiis suis Happhim, et Saphan: et habuit sororem nomine Maacha: nomen autem secundi, Salphaad, natæque sunt Salphaad filiæ.

verses.text: And Maacha the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Phares: and the name of his brother was Sares: and his sons were Ulam and Recen.
verses.textLatin: Et peperit Maacha uxor Machir filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Phares: porro nomen fratris ejus, Sares: et filii ejus, Ulam, et Recen.

verses.text: And the son of Ulam, Baden. These are the sons of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Filius autem Ulam, Badan: hi sunt filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse.

verses.text: And his sister named Queen bore Goodlyman, and Abiezer, and Mohola.
verses.textLatin: Soror autem ejus Regina peperit Virum decorum, et Abiezer, et Mohola.

verses.text: And the sons of Semida were Ahiu, and Sechem, and Leci and Aniam.
verses.textLatin: Erant autem filii Semida, Ahin, et Sechem, et Leci, et Aniam.

verses.text: And the sons of Ephraim were Suthala, Bared his son, Thahath his son, Elada his son, Thahath his son, and his son Zabad,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Ephraim: Suthala, Bared filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, Elada filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, hujus filius Zabad,

verses.text: And his son Suthala, and his son Ezer, and Elad: and the men of Geth born in the land slew them, because they came down to invade their possessions.
verses.textLatin: et hujus filius Suthula, et hujus filius Ezer et Elad: occiderunt autem eos viri Geth indigenæ, quia descenderant ut invaderent possessiones eorum.

verses.text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.textLatin: Luxit igitur Ephraim pater eorum multis diebus, et venerunt fratres ejus ut consolarentur eum.

verses.text: And he went in to his wife: and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Beria, because he was born when it went evil with his house:
verses.textLatin: Ingressusque est ad uxorem suam: quæ concepit, et peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Beria, eo quod in malis domus ejus ortus esset:

verses.text: And his daughter was Sara, who built Bethoron, the nether and the upper, and Ozensara.
verses.textLatin: filia autem ejus fuit Sara, quæ ædificavit Bethoron inferiorem et superiorem, et Ozensara.

verses.text: And Rapha was his son, and Reseph, and Thale, of whom was born Thaan,
verses.textLatin: Porro filius ejus Rapha, et Reseph, et Thale, de quo natus est Thaan,

verses.text: Who begot Laadan: and his son was Ammiud, who begot Elisama,
verses.textLatin: qui genuit Laadan: hujus quoque filius Ammiud, qui genuit Elisama,

verses.text: Of whom was born Nun, who had Josue for his son.
verses.textLatin: de quo ortus est Nun, qui habuit filium Josue.

verses.text: And their possessions and habitations were Bethel with her daughters, and eastward Noran, and westward Gazer and her daughters, Sichem also with her daughters, as far as Asa with her daughters.
verses.textLatin: Possessio autem eorum et habitatio, Bethel cum filiabus suis, et contra orientem Noran, ad occidentalem plagam Gazer et filiæ ejus, Sichem quoque cum filiabus suis, usque ad Aza cum filiabus ejus.

verses.text: And by the borders of the sons of Manasses Bethsan and her daughters, Thanach and her daughters, Mageddo and her daughters: Dor and her daughters: in these dwelt the children of Joseph, the son of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Juxta filios quoque Manasse, Bethsan et filias ejus, Thanach et filias ejus, Mageddo et filias ejus, Dor et filias ejus: in his habitaverunt filii Joseph, filii Israël.

verses.text: The children of Aser were Jemna, and Jesua, and Jessui, and Baria, and Sara their sister.
verses.textLatin: Filii Aser: Jemna, et Jesua, et Jessui, et Baria, et Sara soror eorum.

verses.text: And the sons of Baria: Haber, and Melchiel: he is the father of Barsaith.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Baria: Heber, et Melchiel: ipse est pater Barsaith.

verses.text: And Heber begot Jephlat, and Somer, and Hotham, and Suaa their sister.
verses.textLatin: Heber autem genuit Jephlat, et Somer, et Hotham, et Suaa sororem eorum.

verses.text: The sons of Jephlat: Phosech, and Chamaal, and Asoth: these are the sons of Jephlat.
verses.textLatin: Filii Jephlat: Phosech, et Chamaal, et Asoth: hi filii Jephlat.

verses.text: And the sons of Somer: Ahi, and Roaga, and Haba, and Aram.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Somer: Ahi, et Roaga, et Haba, et Aram.

verses.text: And the sons of Helem his brother: Supha, and Jemna, and Selles, and Amal.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Helem fratris ejus: Supha, et Jemna, et Selles, et Amal.

verses.text: The sons of Supha: Sue, Hernapher, and Sual, and Beri, and Jamra.
verses.textLatin: Filii Supha: Sue, Harnapher, et Sual, et Beri, et Jamra,

verses.text: Bosor and Hod, and Samma, and Salusa, and Jethran, and Bera.
verses.textLatin: Bosor, et Hod, et Samma, et Salusa, et Jethran, et Bera.

verses.text: The sons of Jether: Jephone, and Phaspha, and Ara.
verses.textLatin: Filii Jether: Jephone, et Phaspha, et Ara.

verses.text: And the sons of Olla: Aree, and Haniel, and Resia.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Olla: Aree, et Haniel, et Resia.

verses.text: All these were sons of Aser, heads of their families, choice and most valiant captains of captains: and the number of them that were of the age that was fit for war, was six and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Omnes hi filii Aser, principes cognationum, electi atque fortissimi duces ducum: numerus autem eorum ætatis quæ apta esset ad bellum, viginti sex millia.

verses.text: Now  Benjamin begot Bale his firstborn, Asbel the second, Ahara the third,
verses.textLatin: Benjamin autem genuit Bale primogenitum suum, Asbel secundum, Ahara tertium,

verses.text: Nohaa the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.textLatin: Nohaa quartum, et Rapha quintum.

verses.text: And the sons of Bale were Addar, and Gera, and Abiud,
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque filii Bale: Addar, et Gera, et Abiud,

verses.text: And Abisue, and Naaman, and Ahoe,
verses.textLatin: Abisue quoque et Naaman, et Ahoë,

verses.text: And Gera, and Sephuphan, and Huram.
verses.textLatin: sed et Gera, et Sephuphan, et Huram.

verses.text: These are the sons of Ahod, heads of families that dwelt in Gabaa, who were removed into Manahath.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt filii Ahod, principes cognationum habitantium in Gabaa, qui translati sunt in Manahath.

verses.text: And Naaman, and Achia, and Gera he removed them, and begot Oza, and Ahiud.
verses.textLatin: Naaman autem, et Achia, et Gera, ipse transtulit eos, et genuit Osa, et Ahiud.

verses.text: And Saharim begot in the land of Moab, after he sent away Husim and Bara his wives.
verses.textLatin: Porro Saharaim genuit in regione Moab, postquam dimisit Husim et Bara uxores suas.

verses.text: And he begot of Hodes his wife Jobab, and Sebia, and Mosa, and Molchom,
verses.textLatin: Genuit autem de Hodes uxore sua Jobab, et Sebia, et Mosa, et Molchom,

verses.text: And Jehus and Sechia, and Marma. These were his sons heads of their families.
verses.textLatin: Jehus quoque, et Sechia, et Marma: hi sunt filii ejus principes in familiis suis.

verses.text: And Mehusim begot Abitob, and Elphaal.
verses.textLatin: Mehusim vero genuit Abitob et Elphaal.

verses.text: And the sons of Elphaal were Heber, and Misaam, and Samad: who built Ono, and Lod, and its daughters.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Elphaal: Heber, et Misaam, et Samad: hic ædificavit Ono, et Lod, et filias ejus.

verses.text: And Baria, and Sama were heads of their kindreds that dwelt in Aialon: these drove away the inhabitants of Geth.
verses.textLatin: Baria autem et Sama principes cognationum habitantium in Ajalon: hi fugaverunt habitatores Geth.

verses.text: And Ahio, and Sesac, and Jerimoth,
verses.textLatin: Et Ahio, et Sesac, et Jerimoth,

verses.text: And Zabadia, and Arod, and Heder,
verses.textLatin: et Zabadia, et Arod, et Heder,

verses.text: And Michael, and Jespha, and Joha, the sons of Baria.
verses.textLatin: Michaël quoque, et Jespha, et Joha filii Baria.

verses.text: And Zabadia, and Mosollam, and Hezeci, and Heber,
verses.textLatin: Et Zabadia, et Mosollam, et Hezeci, et Heber,

verses.text: And Jesamari, and Jezlia, and Jobab, sons of Elphaal,
verses.textLatin: et Jesamari, et Jezlia, et Jobab filii Elphaal,

verses.text: And Jacim, and Zechri, and Zabdi,
verses.textLatin: et Jacim, et Zechri, et Zabdi,

verses.text: And Elioenai, and Selethai, and Elial,
verses.textLatin: et Elioënai, et Selethai, et Eliel,

verses.text: And Adaia, and Baraia, and Samareth, the sons of Semei.
verses.textLatin: et Adaia, et Baraia, et Samarath, filii Semei.

verses.text: And Jespham, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.textLatin: Et Jespham, et Heber, et Eliel,

verses.text: And Abdon, and Zechri, and Hanan,
verses.textLatin: et Abdon, et Zechri, et Hanan,

verses.text: And Hanania, and Elam, and Anathothia.
verses.textLatin: et Hanania, et Ælam, et Anathothia,

verses.text: And Jephdaia, and Phanuel the sons of Sesac.
verses.textLatin: et Jephdaia, et Phanuel, filii Sesac.

verses.text: And Samsari, and Sohoria and Otholia,
verses.textLatin: Et Samsari, et Sohoria, et Otholia,

verses.text: And Jersia, and Elia, and Zechri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.textLatin: et Jersia, et Elia, et Zechri, filii Jeroham.

verses.text: These were the chief fathers, and heads of their families who dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Hi patriarchæ, et cognationum principes, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And at Gabaon dwelt Abigabaon, and the name of his wife was Maacha:
verses.textLatin: In Gabaon autem habitaverunt Abigabaon, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha:

verses.text: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.textLatin: filiusque ejus primogenitus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Nadab,

verses.text: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher, and Macelloth:
verses.textLatin: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacher, et Macelloth:

verses.text: And Macelloth begot Samaa: and they dwelt over against their brethren in Jerusalem with their brethren.
verses.textLatin: et Macelloth genuit Samaa: habitaveruntque ex adverso fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.

verses.text: And Ner begot Cis, and Cis begot Saul. And Saul begot Jonathan and Melchisua, and Abinadab, and Esbaal.
verses.textLatin: Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul. Porro Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.

verses.text: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begot Micha.
verses.textLatin: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal: et Meribbaal genuit Micha.

verses.text: And the sons of Micha were Phithon, and Melech, and Tharaa, and Ahaz.
verses.textLatin: Filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.

verses.text: And Ahaz begot Joada: and Joada begot Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri: and Zamri begot Mosa,
verses.textLatin: Et Ahaz genuit Joada, et Joada genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri: porro Zamri genuit Mosa,

verses.text: And Mosa begot Banaa, whose son was Rapha, of whom was born Elasa, who begot Asel.
verses.textLatin: et Mosa genuit Banaa, cujus filius fuit Rapha, de quo ortus est Elasa, qui genuit Asel.

verses.text: And Asel had six sons whose names were Ezricam, Bochru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Asel.
verses.textLatin: Porro Asel sex filii fuerunt his nominibus: Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, et Hanan: omnes hi filii Asel.

verses.text: And the sons of Esec, his brother, were Ulam the firstborn, and Jehus the second, and Eliphalet the third.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Esec fratris ejus, Ulam primogenitus, et Jehus secundus, et Eliphalet tertius.

verses.text: And the sons of Ulam were most valiant men, and archers of great strength: and they had many sons and grandsons, even to a hundred and fifty. All these were children of Benjamin.
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi, et magno robore tendentes arcum: et multos habentes filios ac nepotes, usque ad centum quinquaginta. Omnes hi filii Benjamin.

verses.text: And  all Israel was numbered: and the sum of them was written in the book of the kings of Israel, and Juda: and they were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.textLatin: Universus ergo Israël dinumeratus est, et summa eorum scripta est in libro regum Israël et Juda: translatique sunt in Babylonem propter delictum suum.

verses.text: Now the first that dwelt in their possessions, and in their cities, were the Israelites, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Nathineans.
verses.textLatin: Qui autem habitaverunt primi in possessionibus et in urbibus suis: Israël, et sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et Nathinæi.

verses.text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Juda, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and of Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Commorati sunt in Jerusalem de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin, de filiis quoque Ephraim, et Manasse.

verses.text: Othei the son of Ammiud, the son of Amri, the son of Omrai, the son of Bonni, of the sons of Phares the son of Juda.
verses.textLatin: Othei filius Ammiud, filii Amri, filii Omrai, filii Bonni, de filiis Phares filii Juda.

verses.text: And of Siloni: Asaia the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.textLatin: Et de Siloni: Asaia primogenitus, et filii ejus.

verses.text: And of the sons of Zara: Jehuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.textLatin: De filiis autem Zara, Jehuel, et fratres eorum, sexcenti nonaginta.

verses.text: And of the sons of Benjamin: Salo the son of Mosollam, the son of Oduia, the son of Asana:
verses.textLatin: Porro de filiis Benjamin: Salo filius Mosollam, filii Oduia, filii Asana,

verses.text: And Jobania the son of Jeroham: and Ela the son of Ozi, the son of Mochori: and Mosallam the son of Saphatias, the son of Rahuel, the son of Jebania:
verses.textLatin: et Jobania filius Jeroham, et Ela filius Ozi, filii Mochori, et Mosollam filius Saphatiæ, filii Rahuel, filii Jebaniæ,

verses.text: And their brethren by their families, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these were heads of their families, by the houses of their fathers.
verses.textLatin: et fratres eorum per familias suas, nongenti quinquaginta sex. Omnes hi principes cognationum per domos patrum suorum.

verses.text: And of the priests: Jedaia, Joiarib, and Jachin:
verses.textLatin: De sacerdotibus autem: Jedaia, Jojarib, et Jachin:

verses.text: And Azarias the son of Helcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Maraioth, the son of Achitob, high priest of the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Azarias quoque filius Helciæ, filii Mosollam, filii Sadoc, filii Maraioth, filii Achitob, pontifex domus Dei.

verses.text: And Adaias the son of Jeroham, the son of Phassur, the son of Melchias, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jezra, the son of Mosollam, the son of Mosollamith, the son of Emmer.
verses.textLatin: Porro Adaias filius Jeroham, filii Phassur, filii Melchiæ, et Maasai filius Adiel filii Jezra, filii Mosollam, filii Mosollamith, filii Emmer.

verses.text: And their brethren heads in their families a thousand seven hundred and threescore, very strong and able men for the work of the ministry in the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Fratres quoque eorum principes per familias suas, mille septingenti sexaginta, fortissimi robore ad faciendum opus ministerii in domo Dei.

verses.text: And of the Levites: Semeia the son of Hassub the son of Ezricam, the son of Hasebia of the sons of Merari.
verses.textLatin: De Levitis autem: Semeia filius Hassub filii Ezricam, filii Hasebia de filiis Merari.

verses.text: And Bacbacar the carpenter, and Galal, and Mathania the son of Micha, the son of Zechri the son of Asaph:
verses.textLatin: Bacbacar quoque carpentarius, et Galal, et Mathania filius Micha, filii Zechri, filii Asaph:

verses.text: And Obdia the son of Semeia, the son of Galal, the son of Idithum: and Barachia the son of Asa, the son of Elcana, who dwelt in the suburbs of Netophati.
verses.textLatin: et Obdia filius Semeiæ, filii Galal, filii Idithun: et Barachia filius Asa, filii Elcana, qui habitavit in atriis Netophati.

verses.text: And the porters were Sellum, and Accub, and Telmon, and Ahiman: and their brother Sellum was the prince,
verses.textLatin: Janitores autem: Sellum, et Accub, et Telmon, et Ahimam: et frater eorum Sellum princeps,

verses.text: Until that time, in the king’s gate eastward, the sons of Levi waited by their turns.
verses.textLatin: usque ad illud tempus, in porta regis ad orientem, observabant per vices suas de filiis Levi.

verses.text: But Sellum the son of Core, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core, with his brethren and his father’s house, the Corites were over the works of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their families in turns were keepers of the entrance of the camp of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Sellum vero filius Core filii Abiasaph, filii Core, cum fratribus suis, et domo patris sui, hi sunt Coritæ super opera ministerii, custodes vestibulorum tabernaculi: et familiæ eorum per vices castrorum Domini custodientes introitum.

verses.text: And Phinees the son of Eleazar, was their prince before the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Phinees autem filius Eleazari erat dux eorum coram Domino.

verses.text: And Zacharias the son of Mosollamia, was porter of the gate of the tabernacle of the testimony:
verses.textLatin: Porro Zacharias filius Mosollamia, janitor portæ tabernaculi testimonii.

verses.text: All these that were chosen to be porters at the gates, were two hundred and twelve: the they were registered in their proper towns: whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their trust.
verses.textLatin: Omnes hi electi in ostiarios per portas, ducenti duodecim: et descripti in villis propriis, quos constituerunt David, et Samuel videns, in fide sua,

verses.text: As well them as their sons, to keep the gates of the house of the Lord, and the tabernacle by their turns.
verses.textLatin: tam ipsos quam filios eorum, in ostiis domus Domini et in tabernaculo vicibus suis.

verses.text: In four quarters were the porters: that is to say, toward the east, and west, and north, and south.
verses.textLatin: Per quatuor ventos erant ostiarii: id est, ad orientem, et ad occidentem, et ad aquilonem, et ad austrum.

verses.text: And their brethren dwelt in villages, and came upon their sabbath days from time to time.
verses.textLatin: Fratres autem eorum in viculis morabantur, et veniebant in sabbatis suis de tempore usque ad tempus.

verses.text: To these four Levites were committed the whole number of the porters, and they were over the chambers, and treasures, of the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: His quatuor Levitis creditus erat omnis numerus janitorum, et erant super exedras et thesauros domus Domini.

verses.text: And they abode in their watches round about the temple of the Lord: that when it was time, they might open the gates in the morning.
verses.textLatin: Per gyrum quoque templi Domini morabantur in custodiis suis: ut cum tempus fuisset, ipsi mane aperirent fores.

verses.text: And some of their stock had the charge of the vessels for the ministry: for the vessels were both brought in and carried out by number.
verses.textLatin: De horum genere erant et super vasa ministerii: ad numerum enim et inferebantur vasa, et efferebantur.

verses.text: Some of them also had the instruments of the sanctuary committed unto them, and the charge of the fine flour, and wine, and oil, and frankincense, and spices.
verses.textLatin: De ipsis et qui credita habebant utensilia sanctuarii, præerant similæ, et vino, et oleo, et thuri, et aromatibus.

verses.text: And the sons of the priests made the ointments of the spices.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem sacerdotum unguenta ex aromatibus conficiebant.

verses.text: And Mathathias a Levite, the firstborn of Sellum the Corite, was overseer of such things as were fried in the fryingpan.
verses.textLatin: Et Mathathias Levites primogenitus Sellum Coritæ, præfectus erat eorum quæ in sartagine frigebantur.

verses.text: And some of the sons of Caath their brethren, were over the loaves of proposition, to prepare always new for every sabbath.
verses.textLatin: Porro de filiis Caath fratribus eorum, super panes erant propositionis, ut semper novos per singula sabbata præpararent.

verses.text: These are the chief of the singing men of the families of the Levites, who dwelt in the chambers, by the temple, that they might serve continually day and night in their ministry.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt principes cantorum per familias Levitarum, qui in exedris morabantur, ut die ac nocte jugiter suo ministerio deservirent.

verses.text: The heads of the Levites, princes in their families, abode in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Capita Levitarum, per familias suas principes, manserunt in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And in Gabaon dwelt Jehiel the father of Gabaon, and the name of his wife was Maacha:
verses.textLatin: In Gabaon autem commorati sunt pater Gabaon Jehiel, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha.

verses.text: His firstborn son Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.textLatin: Filius primogenitus ejus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Ner, et Nadab,

verses.text: Gedor also, and Ahio, and Zacharias, and Macelloth.
verses.textLatin: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacharias, et Macelloth.

verses.text: And Macelloth begot Samaan: these dwelt over against their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.textLatin: Porro Macelloth genuit Samaan: isti habitaverunt e regione fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.

verses.text: Now Ner begot Cis: and Cis begot Saul: and Saul begot Jonathan and Melchisua, and Abinadab, and Esbaal.
verses.textLatin: Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul, et Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.

verses.text: And the son of Jonathan, was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begot Micha.
verses.textLatin: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal: et Meribbaal genuit Micha.

verses.text: And the sons of Micha, were Phithon, and Melech, and Tharaa, and Ahaz.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.

verses.text: And Ahaz begot Jara, and Jara begot Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri. And Zamri begot Mosa.
verses.textLatin: Ahaz autem genuit Jara, et Jara genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri. Zamri autem genuit Mosa.

verses.text: And Mosa begot Banaa: whose son Raphaia begot Elasa: of whom was born Asel.
verses.textLatin: Mosa vero genuit Banaa, cujus filius Raphaia, genuit Elasa, de quo ortus est Asel.

verses.text: And Asel had six sons whose names are, Ezricam, Bochru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, Hanan: these are the sons of Asel.
verses.textLatin: Porro Asel sex filios habuit, his nominibus: Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, Hanan: hi sunt filii Asel.

verses.text: Now  the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down wounded in mount Gelboe.
verses.textLatin: Philisthiim autem pugnabant contra Israël, fugeruntque viri Israël Palæsthinos, et ceciderunt vulnerati in monte Gelboë.

verses.text: And the Philistines drew near pursuing after Saul, and his sons, and they killed Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchisua the sons of Saul.
verses.textLatin: Cumque appropinquassent Philisthæi, persequentes Saul et filios ejus, percusserunt Jonathan, et Abinadab, et Melchisua filios Saul.

verses.text: And the battle grew hard against Saul, and the archers reached him, and wounded him with arrows.
verses.textLatin: Et aggravatum est prælium contra Saul, inveneruntque eum sagittarii, et vulneraverunt jaculis.

verses.text: And Saul said to his armourbearer: Draw thy sword, and kill me: lest these uncircumcised come, and mock me. But his armourbearer would not, for he was struck with fear: so Saul took his sword, and fell upon it.
verses.textLatin: Et dixit Saul ad armigerum suum: Evagina gladium tuum, et interfice me, ne forte veniant incircumcisi isti, et illudant mihi. Noluit autem armiger ejus hoc facere, timore perterritus: arripuit ergo Saul ensem, et irruit in eum.

verses.text: And when his armourbearer saw it, to wit, that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died.
verses.textLatin: Quod cum vidisset armiger ejus, videlicet mortuum esse Saul, irruit etiam ipse in gladium suum, et mortuus est.

verses.text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house fell together.
verses.textLatin: Interiit ergo Saul: et tres filii ejus, et omnis domus illius pariter concidit.

verses.text: And when the men of Israel, that dwelt in the plains, saw this, they fled: and Saul and his sons being dead, they forsook their cities, and were scattered up and down: and the Philistines came, and dwelt in them.
verses.textLatin: Quod cum vidissent viri Israël qui habitabant in campestribus, fugerunt: et Saul ac filiis ejus mortuis, dereliquerunt urbes suas, et huc illucque dispersi sunt: veneruntque Philisthiim, et habitaverunt in eis.

verses.text: And the next day the Philistines taking away the spoils of them that were slain, found Saul and his sons lying on mount Gelboe.
verses.textLatin: Die igitur altero detrahentes Philisthiim spolia cæsorum, invenerunt Saul et filios ejus jacentes in monte Gelboë.

verses.text: And when they had stripped him, and out off his head, and taken away his armour, they sent it into their land, to be carried about, and shewn in the temples of the idols and to the people.
verses.textLatin: Cumque spoliassent eum, et amputassent caput, armisque nudassent, miserunt in terram suam, ut circumferretur, et ostenderetur idolorum templis, et populis:

verses.text: And his armour they dedicated in the temple of their god, and his head they fastened up in the temple of Dagon.
verses.textLatin: arma autem ejus consecraverunt in fano dei sui, et caput affixerunt in templo Dagon.

verses.text: And when the men of Jabes Galaad had heard this, to wit, all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textLatin: Hoc cum audissent viri Jabes Galaad, omnia scilicet quæ Philisthiim fecerant super Saul,

verses.text: All the valiant men of them arose, and took the bodies of Saul and of his sons, and brought them to Jabes, and buried their bones under the oak that was in Jabes, and they fasted seven days.
verses.textLatin: consurrexerunt singuli virorum fortium, et tulerunt cadavera Saul et filiorum ejus: attuleruntque ea in Jabes, et sepelierunt ossa eorum subter quercum, quæ erat in Jabes, et jejunaverunt septem diebus.

verses.text: So Saul died for his iniquities, because he transgressed the commandment of the Lord, which he had commanded, and kept it not: and moreover consulted also a witch,
verses.textLatin: Mortuus est ergo Saul propter iniquitates suas, eo quod prævaricatus sit mandatum Domini quod præceperat, et non custodierit illud: sed insuper etiam pythonissam consuluerit,

verses.text: And trusted not in the Lord: therefore he slew him, and transferred his kingdom to David the son of Isai.
verses.textLatin: nec speraverit in Domino: propter quod interfecit eum, et transtulit regnum ejus ad David filium Isai.

verses.text: Then  all Israel gathered themselves to David in Hebron, saying: We are thy bone, and thy flesh.
verses.textLatin: Congregatus est igitur omnis Israël ad David in Hebron, dicens: Os tuum sumus, et caro tua.

verses.text: Yesterday also, and the day before when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: for the Lord thy God said to thee: Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over them.
verses.textLatin: Heri quoque et nudiustertius cum adhuc regnaret Saul, tu eras qui educebas et introducebas Israël: tibi enim dixit Dominus Deus tuus: Tu pasces populum meum Israël, et tu eris princeps super eum.

verses.text: So all the ancients of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and David made a covenant with them before the Lord: and they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke in the hand of Samuel.
verses.textLatin: Venerunt ergo omnes majores natu Israël ad regem in Hebron, et iniit David cum eis fœdus coram Domino: unxeruntque eum regem super Israël, juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est in manu Samuel.

verses.text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, where the Jebusites were the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textLatin: Abiit quoque David et omnis Israël in Jerusalem: hæc est Jebus, ubi erant Jebusæi habitatores terræ.

verses.text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David: Thou shalt not come in here. But David took the castle of Sion, which is the city of David.
verses.textLatin: Dixeruntque qui habitabant in Jebus ad David: Non ingredieris huc. Porro David cepit arcem Sion, quæ est civitas David,

verses.text: And he said: Whosoever shall first strike the Jebusites, shall be the head and chief captain. And Joab the son of Sarvia went up first, and was made the general.
verses.textLatin: dixitque: Omnis qui percusserit Jebusæum in primis, erit princeps et dux. Ascendit igitur primus Joab filius Sarviæ, et factus est princeps.

verses.text: And David dwelt in the castle, and therefore it was called the city of David.
verses.textLatin: Habitavit autem David in arce, et idcirco appellata est civitas David.

verses.text: And he built the city round about from Mello all round, and Joab built the rest of the city.
verses.textLatin: Ædificavitque urbem in circuitu a Mello usque ad gyrum; Joab autem reliqua urbis exstruxit.

verses.text: And David went on growing and increasing, and the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.textLatin: Proficiebatque David vadens et crescens, et Dominus exercituum erat cum eo.

verses.text: These are the chief of the valiant man of David, who helped him to be made king over all Israel, according to the word of the Lord, which he spoke to Israel.
verses.textLatin: Hi principes virorum fortium David, qui adjuverunt eum ut rex fieret super omnem Israël, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus est ad Israël.

verses.text: And this is the number of the heroes of David: Jesbaam the son of Hachamoni the chief among the thirty: he lifted up his spear against three hundred wounded by him at one time.
verses.textLatin: Et iste numerus robustorum David: Jesbaam filius Hachamoni princeps inter triginta: iste levavit hastam suam super trecentos vulneratos una vice.

verses.text: And after him was Eleazar his uncle’s son the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.textLatin: Et post eum Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites, qui erat inter tres potentes.

verses.text: He was with David in Phesdomim, when the Philistines were gathered to that place to battle: and the field of that country was full of barley, and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.textLatin: Iste fuit cum David in Phesdomim, quando Philisthiim congregati sunt ad locum illum in prælium: et erat ager regionis illius plenus hordeo, fugeratque populus a facie Philisthinorum.

verses.text: But these men stood in the midst of the field, and defended it: and they slew the Philistines, and the Lord gave a great deliverance to his people.
verses.textLatin: Hi steterunt in medio agri, et defenderunt eum: cumque percussissent Philisthæos, dedit Dominus salutem magnam populo suo.

verses.text: And three of the thirty captains went down to the rock, wherein David was, to the cave of Odollam, when the Philistines encamped in the valley of Raphaim.
verses.textLatin: Descenderunt autem tres de triginta principibus ad petram, in qua erat David, ad speluncam Odollam, quando Philisthiim fuerant castrametati in valle Raphaim.

verses.text: And David was in a hold, and the garrison of the Philistines in Bethlehem.
verses.textLatin: Porro David erat in præsidio, et statio Philisthinorum in Bethlehem.

verses.text: And David longed, and said: O that some man would give me water of the cistern of Bethlehem, which is in the gate.
verses.textLatin: Desideravit igitur David, et dixit: O si quis daret mihi aquam de cisterna Bethlehem, quæ est in porta!

verses.text: And these three broke through the midst of the camp of the Philistines, and drew water out of the cistern of Bethlehem, which was in the gate, and brought it to David to drink: and he would not drink of it, but rather offered it to the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Tres ergo isti per media castra Philisthinorum perrexerunt, et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem quæ erat in porta, et attulerunt ad David ut biberet. Qui noluit, sed magis libavit illam Domino,

verses.text: Saying: God forbid that I should do this in the sight of my God, and should drink the blood of these men: for with the danger of their lives they have brought me the water. And therefore he would not drink. These things did the three most valiant.
verses.textLatin: dicens: Absit ut in conspectu Dei mei hoc faciam, et sanguinem istorum virorum bibam: quia in periculo animarum suarum attulerunt mihi aquam. Et ob hanc causam noluit bibere: hæc fecerunt tres robustissimi.

verses.text: And Abisai the brother of Joab, he was chief of three, and he lifted up his spear against three hundred whom he slew, and he was renowned among the three,
verses.textLatin: Abisai quoque frater Joab ipse erat princeps trium, et ipse levavit hastam suam contra trecentos vulneratos, et ipse erat inter tres nominatissimus,

verses.text: And illustrious among the second three, and their captain: but yet he attained not to the first three.
verses.textLatin: et inter tres secundos inclytus, et princeps eorum: verumtamen usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.

verses.text: Banaias the son of Joiada, a most valiant man, of Cabseel, who had done many acts: he slew the two ariels of Moab: and he went down, and killed a lion in the midst of a pit in the time of snow.
verses.textLatin: Banaias filius Jojadæ viri robustissimi, qui multa opera perpetrarat, de Cabseel: ipse percussit duos ariel Moab, et ipse descendit et interfecit leonem in media cisterna tempore nivis.

verses.text: And he slew an Egyptian, whose stature was of five cubits, and who had a spear like a weaver’s beam: and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked away the spear, that he held in his hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.textLatin: Et ipse percussit virum ægyptium, cujus statura erat quinque cubitorum, et habebat lanceam ut liciatorium texentium: descendit igitur ad eum cum virga, et rapuit hastam quam tenebat manu, et interfecit eum hasta sua.

verses.text: These things did Banaias the son of Joiada, who was renowned among the three valiant ones,
verses.textLatin: Hæc fecit Banaias filius Jojadæ, qui erat inter tres robustos nominatissimus,

verses.text: And the first among the thirty, but yet to the three he attained not: and David made him of his council.
verses.textLatin: inter triginta primus, verumtamen ad tres usque non pervenerat: posuit autem eum David ad auriculam suam.

verses.text: Moreover the most valiant men of the army, were Asahel brother of Joab, and Elchanan the son of his uncle of Bethlehem,
verses.textLatin: Porro fortissimi viri in exercitu, Asahel frater Joab, et Elchanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,

verses.text: Sammoth an Arorite, Helles a Phalonite,
verses.textLatin: Sammoth Arorites, Helles Pharonites,

verses.text: Ira the son of Acces a Thecuite, Abiezer an Anathothite,
verses.textLatin: Ira filius Acces Thecuites, Abiezer Anathothites,

verses.text: Sobbochai a Husathite, Ilai an Ahohite,
verses.textLatin: Sobbochai Husathites, Ilai Ahohites,

verses.text: Maharai a Netophathite, Heled the son of Baana a Netophathite,
verses.textLatin: Maharai Netophathites, Heled filius Baana Netophathites,

verses.text: Ethai the son of Ribai of Gabaath of the sons of Benjamin, Banai a Pharathonite,
verses.textLatin: Ethai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin, Banaia Pharatonites,

verses.text: Hurai of the torrent Gaas, Abiel an Arbathite, Azmoth a Bauramite, Eliaba a Salabonite,
verses.textLatin: Hurai de torrente Gaas, Abiel Arbathites, Azmoth Bauramites, Eliaba Salabonites.

verses.text: The sons of Assem a Gezonite, Jonathan the son of Sage an Ararite,
verses.textLatin: Filii Assem Gezonites, Jonathan filius Sage Ararites,

verses.text: Ahiam the son of Sachar an Ararite,
verses.textLatin: Ahiam filius Sachar Ararites,

verses.text: Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.textLatin: Eliphal filius Ur,

verses.text: Hepher a Mecherathite, Ahia a Phelonite,
verses.textLatin: Hepher Mecherathites, Ahia Phelonites,

verses.text: Hesro a Carmelite, Naarai the son of Azbai,
verses.textLatin: Hesro Carmelites, Naarai filius Asbai,

verses.text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibahar the son of Agarai.
verses.textLatin: Joël frater Nathan, Mibahar filius Agarai,

verses.text: Selec an Ammonite, Naharai a Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Sarvia.
verses.textLatin: Selec Ammonites, Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,

verses.text: Ira a Jethrite, Gareb a Jethrite,
verses.textLatin: Ira Jethræus, Gareb Jethræus,

verses.text: Urias a Hethite, Zabad the son of Oholi,
verses.textLatin: Urias Hethæus, Zabad filius Oholi,

verses.text: Adina the son of Siza a Rubenite the prince of the Rubenites, and thirty with him:
verses.textLatin: Adina filius Siza Rubenites princeps Rubenitarum, et cum eo triginta:

verses.text: Hanan the son of Maacha, and Josaphat a Mathanite,
verses.textLatin: Hanan filius Maacha, et Josaphat Mathanites,

verses.text: Ozia an Astarothite, Samma, and Jehiel the sons of Hotham an Arorite,
verses.textLatin: Ozia Astarothites, Samma, et Jehiel filii Hotham Arorites,

verses.text: Jedihel the son of Zamri, and Joha his brother a Thosaite,
verses.textLatin: Jedihel filius Samri, et Joha frater ejus Thosaites,

verses.text: Eliel a Mahumite, and Jeribai, and Josaia the sons of Elnaim, and Jethma a Moabite, Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel of Masobia.
verses.textLatin: Eliel Mahumites, et Jeribai, et Josaia filii Elnaëm, et Jethma Moabites, Eliel, et Obed, et Jasiel de Masobia.

verses.text: Now  these are they that came to David to Siceleg, while he yet fled from Saul the son of Cis, and they were most valiant and excellent warriors,
verses.textLatin: Hi quoque venerunt ad David in Siceleg, cum adhuc fugeret Saul filium Cis, qui erant fortissimi et egregii pugnatores,

verses.text: Bending the bow, and using either hand in hurling stones with slings, and shooting arrows: of the brethren of Saul of Benjamin.
verses.textLatin: tendentes arcum, et utraque manu fundis saxa jacientes, et dirigentes sagittas, de fratribus Saul ex Benjamin.

verses.text: The chief was Ahiezer, and Joas, the sons of Samaa of Gabaath, and Jaziel, and Phallet the sons of Azmoth, and Beracha, and Jehu an Anathothite.
verses.textLatin: Princeps Ahiecer, et Joas filii Samaa Gabaathites, et Jaziel, et Phallet filii Azmoth, et Baracha, et Jehu Anathotites.

verses.text: And Samaias of Gabaon, the stoutest amongst the thirty and over the thirty; Jeremias, and Jeheziel, and Johanan, and Jezabad of Gaderoth;
verses.textLatin: Samaias quoque Gabaonites fortissimus inter triginta et super triginta. Jeremias, et Jeheziel, et Johanan, et Jezabad Gaderothites.

verses.text: And Eluzai, and Jerimuth, and Baalia, and Samaria, and Saphatia the Haruphite;
verses.textLatin: Et Eluzai, et Jerimuth, et Baalia, et Samaria, et Saphatia Haruphites.

verses.text: Elcana, and Jesia, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jesbaam of Carehim:
verses.textLatin: Elcana, et Jesia, et Azareel, et Joëzer, et Jesbaam de Carehim:

verses.text: And Joela, and Zabadia the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.textLatin: Joëla quoque, et Zabadia filii Jeroham de Gedor.

verses.text: From Gaddi also there went over to David, when he lay hid in the wilderness most valiant men, and excellent warriors, holding shield and spear: whose faces were like the faces of a lion, and they were swift like the roebucks on the mountains.
verses.textLatin: Sed et de Gaddi transfugerunt ad David cum lateret in deserto, viri robustissimi, et pugnatores optimi, tenentes clypeum et hastam: facies eorum quasi facies leonis, et veloces quasi capreæ in montibus:

verses.text: Ezer the chief, Obdias the second, Eliab the third,
verses.textLatin: Ezer princeps, Obdias secundus, Eliab tertius,

verses.text: Masmana the fourth, Jeremias the fifth,
verses.textLatin: Masmana quartus, Jeremias quintus,

verses.text: Ethi the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.textLatin: Ethi sextus, Eliel septimus,

verses.text: Johanan the eighth, Elzebad the ninth,
verses.textLatin: Johanan octavus, Elzebad nonus,

verses.text: Jerenias the tenth, Machbani the eleventh,
verses.textLatin: Jeremias decimus, Machbanai undecimus.

verses.text: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the army: the least of them was captain over a hundred soldiers, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.textLatin: Hi de filiis Gad principes exercitus: novissimus centum militibus præerat, et maximus mille.

verses.text: These are they who passed over the Jordan in the first month, when it is used to flow over its banks: and they put to flight all that dwelt in the valleys both toward the east and toward the west.
verses.textLatin: Isti sunt qui transierunt Jordanem mense primo, quando inundare consuevit super ripas suas: et omnes fugaverunt qui morabantur in vallibus ad orientalem plagam et occidentalem.

verses.text: And there came also of the men of Benjamin, and of Juda to the hold, in which David abode.
verses.textLatin: Venerunt autem et de Benjamin et de Juda ad præsidium in quo morabatur David.

verses.text: And David went out to meet them, and said: If you are come peaceably to me to help me, let my heart be joined to you: but if you plot against me for my enemies whereas I have no iniquity in my hands, let the God of our fathers see, and judge.
verses.textLatin: Egressusque est David obviam eis, et ait: Si pacifice venistis ad me ut auxiliemini mihi, cor meum jungatur vobis: si autem insidiamini mihi pro adversariis meis, cum ego iniquitatem in manibus non habeam, videat Deus patrum nostrorum, et judicet.

verses.text: But the spirit came upon Amasai the chief among thirty, and he said: We are thine, O David, and for thee, O son of Isai: peace, peace be to thee, and peace to thy helpers. For thy God helpeth thee. So David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.textLatin: Spiritus vero induit Amasai principem inter triginta, et ait: Tui sumus, o David, et tecum, fili Isai. Pax, pax tibi, et pax adjutoribus tuis: te enim adjuvat Deus tuus. Suscepit ergo eos David, et constituit principes turmæ.
