verses.text: And there were some of Manasses that went over to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to fight: but he did not fight with them: because the lords of the Philistines taking counsel sent him back, saying: With the danger of our heads he will return to his master Saul.
verses.textLatin: Porro de Manasse transfugerunt ad David, quando veniebat cum Philisthiim adversus Saul ut pugnaret: et non dimicavit cum eis, quia inito consilio remiserunt eum principes Philisthinorum, dicentes: Periculo capitis nostri revertetur ad dominum suum Saul.

verses.text: So when he went back to Siceleg, there fled to him of Manasses, Ednas and Jozabad, and Jedihel, and Michael, and Ednas, and Jozabad, and Eliu, and Salathi, captains of thousands in Manasses.
verses.textLatin: Quando igitur reversus est in Siceleg, transfugerunt ad eum de Manasse, Ednas, et Jozabad, et Jedihel, et Michaël, et Ednas, et Jozabad, et Eliu, et Salathi, principes millium in Manasse.

verses.text: These helped David against the rovers: for they were all most valiant men, and were made commanders in the army.
verses.textLatin: Hi præbuerunt auxilium David adversus latrunculos: omnes enim erant viri fortissimi, et facti sunt principes in exercitu.

verses.text: Moreover day by day there came some to David to help him till they became a great number, like the army of God.
verses.textLatin: Sed et per singulos dies veniebant ad David ad auxiliandum ei, usque dum fieret grandis numerus, quasi exercitus Dei.

verses.text: And this is the number of the chiefs of the army who came to David, when he was in Hebron, to transfer to him the kingdom of Saul, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Iste quoque est numerus principum exercitus qui venerunt ad David cum esset in Hebron, ut transferrent regnum Saul ad eum, juxta verbum Domini.

verses.text: The sons of Juda bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred well appointed to war.
verses.textLatin: Filii Juda portantes clypeum et hastam, sex millia octingenti expediti ad prælium.

verses.text: Of the sons of Simeon valiant men for war, seven thousand one hundred.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Simeon virorum fortissimorum ad pugnandum, septem millia centum.

verses.text: Of the sons of Levi, four thousand six hundred.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Levi, quatuor millia sexcenti.

verses.text: And Joiada prince of the race of Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred.
verses.textLatin: Jojoda quoque princeps de stirpe Aaron, et cum eo tria millia septingenti.

verses.text: Sadoc also a young man of excellent disposition, and the house of his father, twenty-two principal men.
verses.textLatin: Sadoc etiam puer egregiæ indolis, et domus patris ejus, principes viginti duo.

verses.text: And of the sons of Benjamin the brethren of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto a great part of them followed the house of Saul.
verses.textLatin: De filiis autem Benjamin fratribus Saul, tria millia: magna enim pars eorum adhuc sequebatur domum Saul.

verses.text: And of the sons of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, men of great valour renowned in their kindreds.
verses.textLatin: Porro de filiis Ephraim viginti millia octingenti, fortissimi robore, viri nominati in cognationibus suis.

verses.text: And of the half tribe of Manasses, eighteen thousand, every one by their names, came to make David king.
verses.textLatin: Et ex dimidia tribu Manasse, decem et octo millia, singuli per nomina sua, venerunt ut constituerent regem David.

verses.text: Also of the sons of Issachar men of understanding, that knew all times to order what Israel should do, two hundred principal men: and all the rest of the tribe followed their counsel.
verses.textLatin: De filiis quoque Issachar viri eruditi, qui noverant singula tempora ad præcipiendum quid facere deberet Israël, principes ducenti: omnis autem reliqua tribus eorum consilium sequebatur.

verses.text: And of Zabulon such as went forth to battle, and stood in array well appointed with armour for war, there came fifty thousand to his aid, with no double heart.
verses.textLatin: Porro de Zabulon qui egrediebantur ad prælium, et stabant in acie instructi armis bellicis, quinquaginta millia venerunt in auxilium, non in corde duplici.

verses.text: And of Nephtali, a thousand leaders: and with them seven and thirty thousand, furnished with shield and spear.
verses.textLatin: Et de Nephthali, principes mille, et cum eis instructi clypeo et hasta, triginta et septem millia.

verses.text: Of Dan also twenty-eight thousand six hundred prepared for battle.
verses.textLatin: De Dan etiam præparati ad prælium, viginti octo millia sexcenti.

verses.text: And of Aser forty thousand going forth to fight, and challenging in battle.
verses.textLatin: Et de Aser egredientes ad pugnam, et in acie provocantes, quadraginta millia.

verses.text: And on the other side of the Jordan of the sons of Ruben, and of Gad, and of the half of the tribe of Manasses a hundred and twenty thousand, furnished with arms for war.
verses.textLatin: Trans Jordanem autem de filiis Ruben, et de Gad, et dimidia parte tribus Manasse, instructi armis bellicis, centum viginti millia.

verses.text: All these men of war well appointed to fight, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel, were of one heart to make David king.
verses.textLatin: Omnes isti viri bellatores expediti ad pugnandum, corde perfecto venerunt in Hebron, ut constituerent regem David super universum Israël: sed et omnes reliqui ex Israël uno corde erant, ut rex fieret David.

verses.text: And they were there with David three days eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.textLatin: Fueruntque ibi apud David tribus diebus comedentes et bibentes: præparaverant enim eis fratres sui.

verses.text: Moreover they that were near them even as far as Issachar, and Zabulon, and Nephtali, brought loaves on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, to eat: meal, figs, raisins, wine, oil, and oxen, and sheep in abundance, for there was joy in Israel.
verses.textLatin: Sed et qui juxta eos erant, usque ad Issachar, et Zabulon, et Nephthali, afferebant panes in asinis, et camelis, et mulis, et bobus ad vescendum: farinam, palathas, uvam passam, vinum, oleum, boves, arietes ad omnem copiam: gaudium quippe erat in Israël.

verses.text: And  David consulted with the captains of thousands, and of hundreds, and with all the commanders.
verses.textLatin: Iniit autem consilium David cum tribunis, et centurionibus, et universis principibus,

verses.text: And he said to all the assembly of Israel: If it please you; and if the words which I speak come from the Lord our God, let us send to the rest of our brethren into all the countries of Israel, and to the priests, and the Levites, that dwell in the suburbs of the cities, to gather themselves to us,
verses.textLatin: et ait ad omnem cœtum Israël: Si placet vobis, et a Domino Deo nostro egreditur sermo quem loquor, mittamus ad fratres nostros reliquos in universas regiones Israël, et ad sacerdotes et Levitas qui habitant in suburbanis urbium, ut congregentur ad nos,

verses.text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we sought it not in the days of Saul.
verses.textLatin: et reducamus arcam Dei nostri ad nos: non enim requisivimus eam in diebus Saul.

verses.text: And all the multitude answered that it should be so: for the word pleased all the people.
verses.textLatin: Et respondit universa multitudo ut ita fieret: placuerat enim sermo omni populo.

verses.text: So David assembled all Israel from Sihor of Egypt, even to the entering into Emath, to bring the ark of God from Cariathiarim.
verses.textLatin: Congregavit ergo David cunctum Israël, a Sihor Ægypti usque dum ingrediaris Emath, ut adduceret arcam Dei de Cariathiarim.

verses.text: And David went up with all the men of Israel to the hill of Cariathiarim which is in Juda, to bring thence the ark of the Lord God sitting upon the cherubims, where his name is called upon.
verses.textLatin: Et ascendit David, et omnis vir Israël, ad collem Cariathiarim, qui est in Juda, ut afferret inde arcam Domini Dei sedentis super cherubim, ubi invocatum est nomen ejus.

verses.text: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart, out of the house of Abinadab. And Oza and his brother drove the cart.
verses.textLatin: Imposueruntque arcam Dei super plaustrum novum, de domo Abinadab: Oza autem, et frater ejus minabant plaustrum.

verses.text: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might with hymns, and with harps, and with psalteries, and timbrels, and cymbals, and trumpets,
verses.textLatin: Porro David, et universus Israël, ludebant coram Deo omni virtute in canticis, et in citharis, et psalteriis, et tympanis, et cymbalis, et tubis.

verses.text: And when they came to the floor of Chidon, Oza put forth his hand, to hold up the ark: for the ox being wanton had made it lean a little on one side.
verses.textLatin: Cum autem pervenisset ad aream Chidon, tetendit Oza manum suam, ut sustentaret arcam: bos quippe lasciviens paululum inclinaverat eam.

verses.text: And the Lord was angry with Oza, and struck him, because he had touched the ark; and he died there before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Iratus est itaque Dominus contra Ozam, et percussit eum, eo quod tetigisset arcam: et mortuus est ibi coram Domino.

verses.text: And David was troubled because the Lord had divided Oza: and he called that place the Breach of Oza to this day.
verses.textLatin: Contristatusque est David, eo quod divisisset Dominus Ozam: vocavitque locum illum Divisio Ozæ, usque in præsentem diem.

verses.text: And he feared God at that time, saying: How can I bring in the ark of God to me?
verses.textLatin: Et timuit Deum tunc temporis, dicens: Quomodo possum ad me introducere arcam Dei?

verses.text: And therefore he brought it not home to himself, that is, into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gethite.
verses.textLatin: et ob hanc causam non adduxit eam ad se, hoc est, in civitatem David, sed avertit in domum Obededom Gethæi.

verses.text: And the ark of God remained in the house of Obededom three months: and the Lord blessed his house, and all that he had.
verses.textLatin: Mansit ergo arca Dei in domo Obededom tribus mensibus: et benedixit Dominus domui ejus, et omnibus quæ habebat.

verses.text: And  Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.textLatin: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri nuntios ad David, et ligna cedrina, et artifices parietum, lignorumque, ut ædificarent ei domum.

verses.text: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, and that his kingdom was exalted over his people Israel.
verses.textLatin: Cognovitque David quod confirmasset eum Dominus in regem super Israël, et sublevatum esset regnum suum super populum ejus Israël.

verses.text: And David took other wives in Jerusalem: and he begot sons, and daughters.
verses.textLatin: Accepit quoque David alias uxores in Jerusalem, genuitque filios et filias.

verses.text: Now these are the names of them that were born to him in Jerusalem: Samua, and Sobad, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.textLatin: Et hæc nomina eorum, qui nati sunt ei in Jerusalem: Samua, et Sobab, Nathan, et Salomon,

verses.text: Jebahar, and Elisua, and Eliphalet,
verses.textLatin: Jebahar, et Elisua, et Eliphalet,

verses.text: And Noga, and Napheg, and Japhia,
verses.textLatin: Noga quoque, et Napheg, et Japhia,

verses.text: Elisama, and Baaliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.textLatin: Elisama, et Baaliada, et Eliphalet.

verses.text: And the Philistines hearing that David was anointed king over all Israel, went all up to seek him: and David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.textLatin: Audientes autem Philisthiim eo quod unctus esset David regem super universum Israël, ascenderunt omnes ut quærerent eum: quod cum audisset David, egressus est obviam eis.

verses.text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the vale of Raphaim.
verses.textLatin: Porro Philisthiim venientes, diffusi sunt in valle Raphaim.

verses.text: And David consulted the Lord, saying: Shall I go up against the Philistines, and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to him: Go up, and I will deliver them into thy hand.
verses.textLatin: Consuluitque David Dominum, dicens: Si ascendam ad Philisthæos, et si trades eos in manu mea? Et dixit ei Dominus: Ascende, et tradam eos in manu tua.

verses.text: And when they were come to Baalpharasim, David defeated them there, and he said: God hath divided my enemies by my hand, as waters are divided: and therefore the name of that place was called Baalpharasim.
verses.textLatin: Cumque illi ascendissent in Baalpharasim, percussit eos ibi David, et dixit: Divisit Deus inimicos meos per manum meam, sicut dividuntur aquæ: et idcirco vocatum est nomen illius loci Baalpharasim.

verses.text: And they left there their gods, and David commanded that they should be burnt.
verses.textLatin: Dereliqueruntque ibi deos suos, quos David jussit exuri.

verses.text: Another time also the Philistines made an irruption, and spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.textLatin: Alia etiam vice Philisthiim irruerunt, et diffusi sunt in valle.

verses.text: And David consulted God again, and God said to him: Go not up after them, turn away from them, and come upon them over against the pear trees.
verses.textLatin: Consuluitque rursum David Deum, et dixit ei Deus: Non ascendas post eos: recede ab eis, et venies contra illos ex adverso pyrorum.

verses.text: And when thou shalt hear the sound of one going in the tops of the pear trees, then shalt thou go out to battle. For God is gone out before thee to strike the army of the Philistines.
verses.textLatin: Cumque audieris sonitum gradientis in cacumine pyrorum, tunc egredieris ad bellum: egressus est enim Deus ante te, ut percutiat castra Philisthiim.

verses.text: And David did as God had commanded him, and defeated the army of the Philistines, slaying them from Gabaon to Gazera.
verses.textLatin: Fecit ergo David sicut præceperat ei Deus, et percussit castra Philisthinorum, de Gabaon usque Gazera.

verses.text: And the name of David became famous in all countries, and the Lord made all nations fear him.
verses.textLatin: Divulgatumque est nomen David in universis regionibus, et Dominus dedit pavorem ejus super omnes gentes.

verses.text: He  made also houses for himself in the city of David: and built a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tabernacle for it.
verses.textLatin: Fecit quoque sibi domos in civitate David: et ædificavit locum arcæ Dei, tetenditque ei tabernaculum.

verses.text: Then David said: No one ought to carry the ark of God, but the Levites, whom the Lord hath chosen to carry it, and to minister unto himself for ever.
verses.textLatin: Tunc dixit David: Illicitum est ut a quocumque portetur arca Dei nisi a Levitis, quos elegit Dominus ad portandum eam, et ad ministrandum sibi usque in æternum.

verses.text: And he gathered all Israel together into Jerusalem, that the ark of God might be brought into its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.textLatin: Congregavitque universum Israël in Jerusalem, ut afferretur arca Dei in locum suum, quem præparaverat ei:

verses.text: And the sons of Aaron also, and the Levites.
verses.textLatin: necnon et filios Aaron, et Levitas.

verses.text: Of the children of Caath, Uriel was the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Caath, Uriel princeps fuit, et fratres ejus centum viginti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Merari, Asaia the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Merari, Asaia princeps: et fratres ejus ducenti viginti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Gersom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Gersom, Joël princeps: et fratres ejus centum triginta.

verses.text: Of the sons of Elisaphan, Semeias the chief: and his brethren two hundred.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Elisaphan, Semeias princeps: et fratres ejus ducenti.

verses.text: Of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief: and his brethren eighty.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Hebron, Eliel princeps: et fratres ejus octoginta.

verses.text: Of the sons of Oziel, Aminadab the chief: and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Oziel, Aminadab princeps: et fratres ejus centum duodecim.

verses.text: And David called Sadoc, and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites, Uriel, Asaia, Joel, Semeia, Eliel, and Aminadab:
verses.textLatin: Vocavitque David Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotes, et Levitas, Uriel, Asaiam, Joël, Semeiam, Eliel, et Aminadab:

verses.text: And he said to them: You that are the heads of the Levitical families, be sanctified with your brethren, and bring the ark of the Lord the God of Israel to the place, which is prepared for it:
verses.textLatin: et dixit ad eos: Vos, qui estis principes familiarum Leviticarum, sanctificamini cum fratribus vestris, et afferte arcam Domini Dei Israël ad locum qui ei præparatus est:

verses.text: Lest as the Lord at first struck us, because you were not present, the same should now also come to pass, by our doing some thing against the law.
verses.textLatin: ne ut a principio, quia non eratis præsentes, percussit nos Dominus; sic et nunc fiat, illicitum quid nobis agentibus.

verses.text: So the priests and the Levites were sanctified, to carry the ark of the Lord the God of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Sanctificati sunt ergo sacerdotes et Levitæ ut portarent arcam Domini Dei Israël.

verses.text: And the sons of Levi took the ark of God as Moses had commanded, according to the word of the Lord, upon their shoulders, with the staves.
verses.textLatin: Et tulerunt filii Levi arcam Dei, sicut præceperat Moyses juxta verbum Domini, humeris suis in vectibus.

verses.text: And David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites, to appoint some of their brethren to be singers with musical instruments, to wit, on psalteries, and harps, and cymbals, that the joyful noise might resound on high.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David principibus Levitarum, ut constituerent de fratribus suis cantores in organis musicorum, nablis videlicet, et lyris, et cymbalis, ut resonaret in excelsis sonitus lætitiæ.

verses.text: And they appointed Levites, Hemam the son of Joel, and of his brethren Asaph the son of Barachias: and of the sons of Merari, their brethren: Ethan the son of Casaia.
verses.textLatin: Constitueruntque Levitas: Heman filium Joël, et de fratribus ejus Asaph filium Barachiæ: de filiis vero Merari, fratribus eorum: Ethan filium Casaiæ.

verses.text: And with them their brethren: in the second rank, Zacharias, and Ben, and Jaziel, and Semiramoth, and Jahiel, and Ani, and Eliab, and Banaias, and Maasias, and Mathathias, and Eliphalu, and Macenias, and Obededom, and Jehiel, the porters.
verses.textLatin: Et cum eis fratres eorum: in secundo ordine, Zachariam, et Ben, et Jaziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, Eliab, et Banaiam, et Maasiam, et Mathathiam, et Eliphalu, et Maceniam, et Obededom, et Jehiel, janitores.

verses.text: Now the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, sounded with cymbals of brass.
verses.textLatin: Porro cantores, Heman, Asaph, et Ethan, in cymbalis æneis concrepantes.

verses.text: And Zacharias, and Oziel, and Semiramoth, and Jehiel, and Ani, and Eliab, and Maasias, and Banaias, sung mysteries upon psalteries.
verses.textLatin: Zacharias autem, et Oziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, et Eliab, et Maasias, et Banaias in nablis arcana cantabant.

verses.text: And Mathathias, and Eliphalu, and Macenias and Obededom, and Jehiel and Ozaziu, sung a song of victory for the octave upon harps.
verses.textLatin: Porro Mathathias, et Eliphalu, et Macenias, et Obededom, et Jehiel, et Ozaziu, in citharis pro octava canebant epinicion.

verses.text: And Chonenias chief of the Levites, presided over the prophecy, to give out the tunes: for he was very skilful.
verses.textLatin: Chonenias autem princeps Levitarum, prophetiæ præerat, ad præcinendam melodiam: erat quippe valde sapiens.

verses.text: And Barachias, and Elcana, were doorkeepers of the ark.
verses.textLatin: Et Barachias, et Elcana, janitores arcæ.

verses.text: And Sebenias, and Josaphat, and Nathanael, and Amasai, and Zacharias, and Banaias, and Eliezer the priests, sounded with trumpets, before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehias were porters of the ark.
verses.textLatin: Porro Sebenias, et Josaphat, et Nathanaël, et Amasai, et Zacharias, et Banaias, et Eliezer sacerdotes, clangebant tubis coram arca Dei: et Obededom et Jehias erant janitores arcæ.

verses.text: So David and all the ancients of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.textLatin: Igitur David, et omnes majores natu Israël, et tribuni, ierunt ad deportandam arcam fœderis Domini de domo Obededom cum lætitia.

verses.text: And when God had helped the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, they offered in sacrifice seven oxen, and seven rams.
verses.textLatin: Cumque adjuvisset Deus Levitas qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, immolabantur septem tauri, et septem arietes.

verses.text: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that carried the ark, and the singing men, and Chonenias the ruler of the prophecy among the singers: and David also had on him an ephod of linen.
verses.textLatin: Porro David erat indutus stola byssina, et universi Levitæ qui portabant arcam, cantoresque, et Chonenias princeps prophetiæ inter cantores: David autem etiam indutus erat ephod lineo.

verses.text: And all Israel brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord with joyful shouting, and sounding with the sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and cymbals, and psalteries, and harps.
verses.textLatin: Universusque Israël deducebant arcam fœderis Domini in jubilo, et sonitu buccinæ, et tubis, et cymbalis, et nablis, et citharis concrepantes.

verses.text: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord was come to the city of David, Michol the daughter of Saul looking out at a window, saw king David dancing and playing, and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textLatin: Cumque pervenisset arca fœderis Domini usque ad civitatem David, Michol filia Saul prospiciens per fenestram vidit regem David saltantem atque ludentem, et despexit eum in corde suo.

verses.text: So  they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent, which David had pitched for it: and they offered holocausts, and peace offerings before God.
verses.textLatin: Attulerunt igitur arcam Dei, et constituerunt eam in medio tabernaculi quod tetenderat ei David: et obtulerunt holocausta et pacifica coram Deo.

verses.text: And when David had made an end of offering holocausts, and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Cumque complesset David offerens holocausta et pacifica, benedixit populo in nomine Domini.

verses.text: And he divided to all and every one, both men and women, a loaf of bread, and a piece of roasted beef, and flour fried with oil.
verses.textLatin: Et divisit universis per singulos, a viro usque ad mulierem, tortam panis, et partem assæ carnis bubalæ, et frixam oleo similam.

verses.text: And he appointed Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to remember his works, and to glorify, and praise the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Constituitque coram arca Domini de Levitis, qui ministrarent, et recordarentur operum ejus, et glorificarent atque laudarent Dominum Deum Israël:

verses.text: Asaph the chief, and next after him Zacharias: moreover Jahiel, and Semiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mathathias, and Eliab, and Banaias, and Obededom: and Jehiel over the instruments of psaltery, and harps: and Asaph sounded with cymbals:
verses.textLatin: Asaph principem, et secundum ejus Zachariam: porro Jahiel, et Semiramoth, et Jehiel, et Mathathiam, et Eliab, et Banaiam, et Obededom: Jehiel super organa psalterii et lyras: Asaph autem ut cymbalis personaret:

verses.text: But Banaias, and Jaziel the priests, to sound the trumpet continually before the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Banaiam vero et Jaziel sacerdotes canere tuba jugiter coram arca fœderis Domini.

verses.text: In that day David made Asaph the chief to give praise to the Lord with his brethren.
verses.textLatin: In illo die fecit David principem ad confitendum Domino Asaph et fratres ejus:

verses.text: Praise ye the Lord, and call upon his name: make known his doings among the nations.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Domino, et invocate nomen ejus: notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus.

verses.text: Sing to him, yea, sing praises to him: and relate all his wondrous works.
verses.textLatin: Cantate ei, et psallite ei, et narrate omnia mirabilia ejus.

verses.text: Praise ye his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice, that seek the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Laudate nomen sanctum ejus: lætetur cor quærentium Dominum.

verses.text: Seek ye the Lord, and his power: seek ye his face evermore.
verses.textLatin: Quærite Dominum, et virtutem ejus: quærite faciem ejus semper.

verses.text: Remember his wonderful works, which he hath done: his signs, and the judgments of his mouth.
verses.textLatin: Recordamini mirabilium ejus quæ fecit; signorum illius, et judiciorum oris ejus,

verses.text: O ye seed of Israel his servants, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.textLatin: semen Israël servi ejus, filii Jacob electi ejus.

verses.text: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textLatin: Ipse Dominus Deus noster: in universa terra judicia ejus.

verses.text: Remember for ever his covenant: the word, which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.textLatin: Recordamini in sempiternum pacti ejus: sermonis quem præcepit in mille generationes,

verses.text: The covenant which he made with Abraham: and his oath to Isaac.
verses.textLatin: quem pepigit cum Abraham, et juramenti illius cum Isaac.

verses.text: And he appointed the same to Jacob for a precept: and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.textLatin: Et constituit illud Jacob in præceptum, et Israël in pactum sempiternum,

verses.text: Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan: the lot of your inheritance.
verses.textLatin: dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chanaan, funiculum hæreditatis vestræ:

verses.text: When they were but a small number: very few and sojourners in it.
verses.textLatin: cum essent pauci numero, parvi et coloni ejus.

verses.text: And they passed from nation to nation: and from a kingdom to another people.
verses.textLatin: Et transierunt de gente in gentem, et de regno ad populum alterum.

verses.text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: and reproved kings for their sake.
verses.textLatin: Non dimisit quemquam calumniari eos, sed increpavit pro eis reges.

verses.text: Touch not my anointed: and do no evil to my prophets.
verses.textLatin: Nolite tangere christos meos, et in prophetis meis nolite malignari.

verses.text: Sing ye to the Lord, all the earth: shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.textLatin: Cantate Domino omnis terra; annuntiate ex die in diem salutare ejus:

verses.text: Declare his glory among the Gentiles: his wonders among all people.
verses.textLatin: narrate in gentibus gloriam ejus; in cunctis populis mirabilia ejus.

verses.text: For the Lord is great and exceedingly to be praised: and he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textLatin: Quia magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis, et horribilis super omnes deos.

verses.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textLatin: Omnes enim dii populorum idola: Dominus autem cælos fecit.

verses.text: Praise and magnificence are before him: strength and joy in his place.
verses.textLatin: Confessio et magnificentia coram eo: fortitudo et gaudium in loco ejus.

verses.text: Bring ye to the Lord, O ye families of the nations: bring ye to the Lord glory and empire.
verses.textLatin: Afferte Domino, familiæ populorum: afferte Domino gloriam et imperium.

verses.text: Give to the Lord glory to his name, bring up sacrifice, and come ye in his sight: and adore the Lord in holy becomingness.
verses.textLatin: Date Domino gloriam; nomini ejus levate sacrificium, et venite in conspectu ejus: et adorate Dominum in decore sancto.

verses.text: Let all the earth be moved at his presence: for he hath founded the world immoveable.
verses.textLatin: Commoveatur a facie ejus omnis terra: ipse enim fundavit orbem immobilem.

verses.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and the earth be glad: and let them say among the nations: The Lord hath reigned.
verses.textLatin: Lætentur cæli, et exultet terra, et dicant in nationibus: Dominus regnavit.

verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all things that are in them.
verses.textLatin: Tonet mare et plenitudo ejus; exultent agri, et omnia quæ in eis sunt.

verses.text: Then shall the trees of the wood give praise before the Lord: because he is come to judge the earth.
verses.textLatin: Tunc laudabunt ligna saltus coram Domino: quia venit judicare terram.

verses.text: Give ye glory to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus: quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: And say ye: Save us, O God our saviour: and gather us together, and deliver us from the nations, that we may give glory to thy holy name, and may rejoice in singing thy praises.
verses.textLatin: Et dicite: Salva nos, Deus salvator noster, et congrega nos, et erue de gentibus: ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, et exultemus in carminibus tuis.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel from eternity to eternity: and let all the people say Amen, and a hymn to God.
verses.textLatin: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, ab æterno usque in æternum. Et dicat omnis populo: Amen, et hymnum Domino.

verses.text: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, Asaph and his brethren to minister in the presence of the ark continually day by day, and in their courses.
verses.textLatin: Reliquit itaque ibi coram arca fœderis Domini Asaph et fratres ejus, ut ministrarent in conspectu arcæ jugiter per singulos dies, et vices suas.

verses.text: And Obededom, with his brethren sixty-eight: and Obededom the son of Idithun, and Hosa he appointed to be porters.
verses.textLatin: Porro Obededom, et fratres ejus sexaginta octo: et Obededom filium Idithun, et Hosa, constituit janitores;

verses.text: And Sadoc the priest, and his brethren priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place, which was in Gabaon.
verses.textLatin: Sadoc autem sacerdotem, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, coram tabernaculo Domini in excelso quod erat in Gabaon,

verses.text: That they should offer holocausts to the Lord upon the altar of holocausts continually, morning and evening, according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel.
verses.textLatin: ut offerrent holocausta Domino super altare holocautomatis jugiter, mane et vespere, juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Domini, quam præcepit Israëli.

verses.text: And after him Heman, and Idithun, and the rest that were chosen, every one by his name to give praise to the Lord: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Et post eum Heman, et Idithun, et reliquos electos, unumquemque vocabulo suo ad confitendum Domino, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: And Heman and Idithun sounded the trumpet, and played on the cymbals, and all kinds of musical instruments to sing praises to God: and the sons of Idithun he made porters.
verses.textLatin: Heman quoque et Idithun canentes tuba, et quatientes cymbala et omnia musicorum organa ad canendum Deo: filios autem Idithun fecit esse portarios.

verses.text: And all the people returned to their houses: and David to bless also his own house.
verses.textLatin: Reversusque est omnis populus in domum suam: et David, ut benediceret etiam domui suæ.

verses.text: Now  when David was dwelling in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet: Behold I dwell in a house of cedar: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under skins.
verses.textLatin: Cum autem habitaret David in domo sua, dixit ad Nathan prophetam: Ecce ego habito in domo cedrina: arca autem fœderis Domini sub pellibus est.

verses.text: And Nathan said to David: Do all that is in thy heart: for God is with thee.
verses.textLatin: Et ait Nathan ad David: Omnia quæ in corde tuo sunt, fac: Deus enim tecum est.

verses.text: Now that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:
verses.textLatin: Igitur nocte illa factus est sermo Dei ad Nathan, dicens:

verses.text: Go, and speak to David my servant: Thus saith the Lord: Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in.
verses.textLatin: Vade, et loquere David servo meo: Hæc dicit Dominus: Non ædificabis tu mihi domum ad habitandum.

verses.text: For I have not remained in a house from the time that I brought up Israel, to this day: but I have been always changing places in a tabernacle, and in a tent,
verses.textLatin: Neque enim mansi in domo ex eo tempore quo eduxi Israël usque ad diem hanc: sed fui semper mutans loca tabernaculi, et in tentorio

verses.text: Abiding with all Israel. Did I ever speak to any one, of all the judges of Israel, whom I charged to feed my people, saying: Why have you not built me a house of cedar?
verses.textLatin: manens cum omni Israël. Numquid locutus sum saltem uni judicum Israël, quibus præceperam ut pascerent populum meum, et dixi: Quare non ædificastis mihi domum cedrinam?

verses.text: Now therefore thus shalt thou say to my servant David: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: I took thee from the pastures, from following the flock, that thou shouldst be ruler of my people Israel.
verses.textLatin: Nunc itaque sic loqueris ad servum meum David: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum: Ego tuli te, cum in pascuis sequereris gregem, ut esses dux populi mei Israël:

verses.text: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast gone: and have slain all thy enemies before thee, and have made thee a name like that of one of the great ones that are renowned in the earth.
verses.textLatin: et fui tecum quocumque perrexisti, et interfeci omnes inimicos tuos coram te, fecique tibi nomen quasi unius magnorum qui celebrantur in terra.

verses.text: And I have given a place to my people Israel: they shall be planted, and shall dwell therein, and shall be moved no more, neither shall the children of iniquity waste them, as at the beginning,
verses.textLatin: Et dedi locum populo meo Israël: plantabitur, et habitabit in eo, et ultra non commovebitur: nec filii iniquitatis atterent eos, sicut a principio,

verses.text: Since the days that I gave judges to my people Israel, and have humbled all thy enemies. And I declare to thee, that the Lord will build thee a house.
verses.textLatin: ex diebus quibus dedi judices populo meo Israël, et humiliavi universos inimicos tuos. Annuntio ergo tibi, quod ædificaturus sit tibi Dominus domum.

verses.text: And when thou shalt have ended thy days to go to thy fathers, I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons: and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textLatin: Cumque impleveris dies tuos ut vadas ad patres tuos, suscitabo semen tuum post te, quod erit de filiis tuis: et stabiliam regnum ejus.

verses.text: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
verses.textLatin: Ipse ædificabit mihi domum, et firmabo solium ejus usque in æternum.

verses.text: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee.
verses.textLatin: Ego ero ei in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium: et misericordiam meam non auferam ab eo, sicut abstuli ab eo qui ante te fuit.

verses.text: But I will settle him in my house, and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be most firm for ever.
verses.textLatin: Et statuam eum in domo mea, et in regno meo usque in sempiternum: et thronus ejus erit firmissimus in perpetuum.

verses.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak to David.
verses.textLatin: Juxta omnia verba hæc, et juxta universam visionem istam, sic locutus est Nathan ad David.

verses.text: And king David came and sat before the Lord, and said: Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that thou shouldst give such things to me?
verses.textLatin: Cumque venisset rex David, et sedisset coram Domino, dixit: Quis ego sum, Domine Deus, et quæ domus mea, ut præstares mihi talia?

verses.text: But even this hath seemed little in thy sight, and therefore thou hast also spoken concerning the house of thy servant for the time to come: and hast made me remarkable above all men, O Lord God.
verses.textLatin: sed et hoc parum visum est in conspectu tuo, ideoque locutus es super domum servi tui etiam in futurum: et fecisti me spectabilem super omnes homines, Domine Deus.

verses.text: What can David add more, seeing thou hast thus glorified thy servant, and known him?
verses.textLatin: Quid ultra addere potest David, cum ita glorificaveris servum tuum, et cognoveris eum?

verses.text: O Lord, for thy servant’s sake, according to thy own heart, thou hast shewn all this magnificence, and wouldst have all the great things to be known.
verses.textLatin: Domine, propter famulum tuum juxta cor tuum fecisti omnem magnificentiam hanc, et nota esse voluisti universa magnalia.

verses.text: O Lord there is none like thee: and there is no other God beside thee, of all whom we have heard of with our ears.
verses.textLatin: Domine, non est similis tui, et non est alius deus absque te, ex omnibus quos audivimus auribus nostris.

verses.text: For what other nation is there upon earth like thy people Israel, whom God went to deliver, and make a people for himself, and by his greatness and terrors cast out nations before their face whom he had delivered out of Egypt?
verses.textLatin: Quis enim est alius, ut populus tuus Israël, gens una in terra, ad quam perrexit Deus ut liberaret et faceret populum sibi, et magnitudine sua atque terroribus ejiceret nationes a facie ejus, quem de Ægypto liberarat?

verses.text: And thou hast made thy people Israel to be thy own people for ever, and thou, O Lord, art become their God.
verses.textLatin: Et posuisti populum tuum Israël tibi in populum usque in æternum, et tu, Domine, factus es Deus ejus.

verses.text: Now therefore, O Lord, let the word which thou hast spoken to thy servant, and concerning his house, be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.textLatin: Nunc igitur Domine, sermo quem locutus es famulo tuo et super domum ejus confirmetur in perpetuum, et fac sicut locutus es.

verses.text: And let thy name remain and be magnified for ever: and let it be said: The Lord of hosts is God of Israel, and the house of David his servant remaineth before him.
verses.textLatin: Permaneatque et magnificetur nomen tuum usque in sempiternum, et dicatur: Dominus exercituum Deus Israël, et domus David servi ejus permanens coram eo.

verses.text: For thou, O Lord my God, hast revealed to the ear of thy servant, that thou wilt build him a house: and therefore thy servant hath found confidence to pray before thee.
verses.textLatin: Tu enim, Domine Deus meus, revelasti auriculam servi tui, ut ædificares ei domum: et idcirco invenit servus tuus fiduciam, ut oret coram te.

verses.text: And now O Lord, thou art God: and thou hast promised to thy servant such great benefits.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo Domine, tu es Deus, et locutus es ad servum tuum tanta beneficia.

verses.text: And thou hast begun to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be always before thee: for seeing thou blessest it, O Lord, it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.textLatin: Et cœpisti benedicere domui servi tui, ut sit semper coram te: te enim, Domine, benedicente, benedicta erit in perpetuum.

verses.text: And  it came to pass after this, that David defeated the Philistines, and humbled them, and took away Geth, and her daughters out of the hands of the Philistines,
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem post hæc, ut percuteret David Philisthiim, et humiliaret eos, et tolleret Geth et filias ejus de manu Philisthiim,

verses.text: And he defeated Moab, and the Moabites were made David’s servants, and brought him gifts.
verses.textLatin: percuteretque Moab, et fierent Moabitæ servi David, offerentes ei munera.

verses.text: At that time David defeated also Adarezer king of Soba of the land of Hemath, when he went to extend his dominions as far as the river Euphrates.
verses.textLatin: Eo tempore percussit David etiam Adarezer regem Soba regionis Hemath, quando perrexit ut dilataret imperium suum usque ad flumen Euphraten.

verses.text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen, and he houghed all the chariot horses, only a hundred chariots, which he reserved for himself.
verses.textLatin: Cepit ergo David mille quadrigas ejus, et septem millia equitum, ac viginti millia virorum peditum, subnervavitque omnes equos curruum, exceptis centum quadrigis, quas reservavit sibi.

verses.text: And the Syrians of Damascus came also to help Adarezer king of Soba: and David slew of them likewise two and twenty thousand men.
verses.textLatin: Supervenit autem et Syrus Damascenus, ut auxilium præberet Adarezer regi Soba: sed et hujus percussit David viginti duo millia virorum.

verses.text: And he put a garrison in Damascus, that Syria also should serve him, and bring gifts. And the Lord assisted him in all things to which he went.
verses.textLatin: Et posuit milites in Damasco, ut Syria quoque serviret sibi, et offerret munera. Adjuvitque eum Dominus in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.

verses.text: And David took the golden quivers which the servants of Adarezer had, and he brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Tulit quoque David pharetras aureas, quas habuerant servi Adarezer, et attulit eas in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Likewise out of Thebath and Chun, cities of Adarezer, he brought very much brass, of which Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.textLatin: Necnon de Thebath et Chun urbibus Adarezer æris plurimum, de quo fecit Salomon mare æneum, et columnas, et vasa ænea.

verses.text: Now when Thou king of Hemath heard that David had defeated all the army of Adarezer king of Soba,
verses.textLatin: Quod cum audisset Thou rex Hemath, percussisse videlicet David omnem exercitum Adarezer regis Soba,

verses.text: He sent Adoram his son to king David, to desire peace of him, and to congratulate him that he had defeated and overthrown Adarezer: for Thou was an enemy to Adarezer.
verses.textLatin: misit Adoram filium suum ad regem David, ut postularet ab eo pacem, et congratularetur ei quod percussisset et expugnasset Adarezer: adversarius quippe erat Thou Adarezer.

verses.text: And all the vessels of gold, and silver, and brass king David consecrated to the Lord, with the silver and gold which he had taken from all the nations, as well from Edom, and from Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, as from the Philistines, and from Amalec.
verses.textLatin: Sed et omnia vasa aurea, et argentea, et ænea consecravit David rex Domino, cum argento et auro quod tulerat ex universis gentibus, tam de Idumæa, et Moab, et filiis Ammon, quam de Philisthiim et Amalec.

verses.text: And Abisai the son of Sarvia slew of the Edomites in the vale of the saltpits, eighteen thousand:
verses.textLatin: Abisai vero filius Sarviæ percussit Edom in valle Salinarum, decem et octo millia:

verses.text: And he put a garrison in Edom, that Edom should serve David: and the Lord preserved David in all things to which he went.
verses.textLatin: et constituit in Edom præsidium, ut serviret Idumæa David: salvavitque Dominus David in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.

verses.text: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.textLatin: Regnavit ergo David super universum Israël, et faciebat judicium atque justitiam cuncto populo suo.

verses.text: And Joab the son of Sarvia was over the army, and Josaphat the son of Ahilud recorder.
verses.textLatin: Porro Joab filius Sarviæ erat super exercitum, et Josaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis:

verses.text: And Sadoc the son of Achitob, and Achimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests: and Susa, scribe.
verses.textLatin: Sadoc autem filius Achitob, et Ahimelech filius Abiathar, sacerdotes: et Susa, scriba:

verses.text: And Banaias the son of Joiada was over the bands of the Cerethi, and the Phelethi: and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.textLatin: Banaias quoque filius Jojadæ super legiones Cerethi et Phelethi: porro filii David, primi ad manum regis.

verses.text: Now  it came to pass that Naas the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Accidit autem ut moreretur Naas rex filiorum Ammon, et regnaret filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: And David said: I will shew kindness to Hanon the son of Naas: for his father did a favour to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him upon the death of his father. But when they were come into the land of the children of Ammon, to comfort Hanon,
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David: Faciam misericordiam cum Hanon filio Naas: præstitit enim mihi pater ejus gratiam. Misitque David nuntios ad consolandum eum super morte patris sui. Qui cum pervenissent in terram filiorum Ammon ut consolarentur Hanon,

verses.text: The princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanon: Thou thinkest perhaps that David to do honour to thy father hath sent comforters to thee: and thou dost not take notice, that his servants are come to thee to consider, and search, and spy out thy land.
verses.textLatin: dixerunt principes filiorum Ammon ad Hanon: Tu forsitan putas, quod David honoris causa in patrem tuum miserit qui consolentur te: nec animadvertis quod ut explorent, et investigent, et scrutentur terram tuam, venerint ad te servi ejus.

verses.text: Wherefore Hanon shaved the heads and beards of the servants of David, and cut away their garments from the buttocks to the feet, and sent them away.
verses.textLatin: Igitur Hanon pueros David decalvavit, et rasit, et præcidit tunicas eorum a natibus usque ad pedes, et dimisit eos.

verses.text: And when they were gone, they sent word to David, who sent to meet them (for they had suffered a great affront) and ordered them to stay at Jericho till their beards grew and then to return.
verses.textLatin: Qui cum abiissent, et hoc mandassent David, misit in occursum eorum (grandem enim contumeliam sustinuerant) et præcepit ut manerent in Jericho, donec cresceret barba eorum, et tunc reverterentur.

verses.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had done an injury to David, Hanon and the rest of the people sent a thousand talents of silver, to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria Maacha, and out of Soba.
verses.textLatin: Videntes autem filii Ammon quod injuriam fecissent David, tam Hanon quam reliquus populus, miserunt mille talenta argenti, ut conducerent sibi de Mesopotamia, et de Syria Maacha, et de Soba currus et equites.

verses.text: And they hired two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maacha, with his people. And they came and camped over against Medaba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together out of their cities, and came to battle.
verses.textLatin: Conduxeruntque triginta duo millia curruum, et regem Maacha cum populo ejus. Qui cum venissent, castrametati sunt e regione Medaba. Filii quoque Ammon congregati de urbibus suis venerunt ad bellum.

verses.text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the army of valiant men:
verses.textLatin: Quod cum audisset David, misit Joab, et omnem exercitum virorum fortium:

verses.text: And the children of Ammon came out and put their army in array before the gate of the city: and the kings, that were come to their aid, stood apart in the field.
verses.textLatin: egressique filii Ammon, direxerunt aciem juxta portam civitatis; reges autem, qui ad auxilium ejus venerant, separatim in agro steterunt.

verses.text: Wherefore Joab understanding that the battle was set against him before and behind, chose out the bravest men of all Israel, and marched against the Syrians,
verses.textLatin: Igitur Joab, intelligens bellum ex adverso et post tergum contra se fieri, elegit viros fortissimos de universo Israël, et perrexit contra Syrum.

verses.text: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abisai his brother, and they went against the children of Ammon.
verses.textLatin: Reliquam autem partem populi dedit sub manu Abisai fratris sui: et perrexerunt contra filios Ammon.

verses.text: And he said: If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, I will help thee.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque: Si vicerit me Syrus, auxilio eris mihi: si autem superaverint te filii Ammon, ero tibi in præsidium.

verses.text: Be of good courage and let us behave ourselves manfully for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the Lord will do that which is good in his sight.
verses.textLatin: Confortare, et agamus viriliter pro populo nostro, et pro urbibus Dei nostri: Dominus autem, quod in conspectu suo bonum est, faciet.

verses.text: So Joab and the people that were with him, went against the Syrians to the battle: and he put them to flight.
verses.textLatin: Perrexit ergo Joab et populus qui cum eo erat, contra Syrum ad prælium: et fugavit eos.

verses.text: And the children of Ammon seeing that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled from Abisai his brother, and went into the city: and Joab also returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Ammon videntes quod fugisset Syrus, ipsi quoque fugerunt Abisai fratrem ejus, et ingressi sunt civitatem: reversusque est etiam Joab in Jerusalem.

verses.text: But the Syrians seeing that they had fallen before Israel, sent messengers, and brought to them the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Sophach, general of the army of Adarezer, was their leader.
verses.textLatin: Videns autem Syrus quod cecidisset coram Israël, misit nuntios, et adduxit Syrum, qui erat trans fluvium: Sophach autem princeps militiæ Adarezer erat dux eorum.

verses.text: And it was told David, and he gathered together all Israel, and passed the Jordan, and came upon them, and put his army in array against them, and they fought with him.
verses.textLatin: Quod cum nuntiatum esset David, congregavit universum Israël, et transivit Jordanem, irruitque in eos et direxit ex adverso aciem, illis contra pugnantibus.

verses.text: But the Syrian fled before Israel: and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and Sophach the general of the army.
verses.textLatin: Fugit autem Syrus Israël, et interfecit David de Syris septem millia curruum, et quadraginta millia peditum, et Sophach exercitus principem.

verses.text: And when the servants of Adarezer saw themselves overcome by Israel, they went over to David, and served him: and Syria would not help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.textLatin: Videntes autem servi Adarezer se ab Israël esse superatos, transfugerunt ad David, et servierunt ei: noluitque ultra Syria auxilium præbere filiis Ammon.

verses.text: And  it came to pass after the course of a year, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab gathered together an army and the strength of the troops, and wasted the land of the children of Ammon: and went and besieged Rabba. But David stayed at Jerusalem, when Joab smote Rabba, and destroyed it.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem post anni circulum, eo tempore quo solent reges ad bella procedere, congregavit Joab exercitum, et robur militiæ, et vastavit terram filiorum Ammon: perrexitque et obsedit Rabba. Porro David manebat in Jerusalem, quando Joab percussit Rabba et destruxit eam.

verses.text: And David took the crown of Melchom from his head, and found in it a talent weight of gold, and most precious stones, and he made himself a diadem of it: he took also the spoils of the city which were very great.
verses.textLatin: Tulit autem David coronam Melchom de capite ejus, et invenit in ea auri pondo talentum, et pretiosissimas gemmas, fecitque sibi inde diadema: manubias quoque urbis plurimas tulit;

verses.text: And the people that were therein he brought out: and made harrows, and sleds, and chariots of iron to go over them, so that they were cut and bruised to pieces: in this manner David dealt with all the cities of the children of Ammon: and he returned with all his people to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: populum autem, qui erat in ea, eduxit, et fecit super eos tribulas, et trahas, et ferrata carpenta transire, ita ut dissecarentur et contererentur. Sic fecit David cunctis urbibus filiorum Ammon: et reversus est cum omni populo suo in Jerusalem.

verses.text: After this there arose a war at Gazer against the Philistines: in which Sabachai the Husathite slew Saphai of the race of Raphaim, and humbled them.
verses.textLatin: Post hæc initum est bellum in Gazer adversum Philisthæos, in quo percussit Sobochai Husathites, Saphai de genere Raphaim, et humiliavit eos.

verses.text: Another battle also was fought against the Philistines, in which Adeodatus the son of Saltus a Bethlehemite slew the brother of Goliath the Gethite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textLatin: Aliud quoque bellum gestum est adversus Philisthæos, in quo percussit Adeodatus filius Saltus Bethlehemites fratrem Goliath Gethæi, cujus hastæ lignum erat quasi liciatorium texentium.

verses.text: There was another battle also in Geth, in which there was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand and foot: who also was born of the stock of Rapha.
verses.textLatin: Sed et aliud bellum accidit in Geth, in quo fuit homo longissimus, senos habens digitos, id est, simul viginti quatuor: qui et ipse de Rapha fuerat stirpe generatus.

verses.text: He reviled Israel: but Jonathan the son of Samaa the brother of David slew him. These were the sons of Rapha in Geth, who fell by the hand of David and his servants.
verses.textLatin: Hic blasphemavit Israël: et percussit eum Jonathan filius Samaa fratris David. Hi sunt filii Rapha in Geth, qui ceciderunt in manu David et servorum ejus.

verses.text: And  Satan rose up against Israel: and moved David to number Israel.
verses.textLatin: Consurrexit autem Satan contra Israël, et concitavit David ut numeraret Israël.

verses.text: And David said to Joab, and to the rulers of the people: Go, and number Israel from Bersabee even to Dan, and bring me the number of them that I may know it.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David ad Joab et ad principes populi: Ite, et numerate Israël a Bersabee usque Dan: et afferte mihi numerum ut sciam.

verses.text: And Joab answered: The Lord make his people a hundred times more than they are: but, my lord the king, are they not all thy servants: why doth my lord seek this thing, which may be imputed as a sin to Israel?
verses.textLatin: Responditque Joab: Augeat Dominus populum suum centuplum quam sunt: nonne, domine mi rex, omnes servi tui sunt? quare hoc quærit dominus meus, quod in peccatum reputetur Israëli?

verses.text: But the king’s word rather prevailed: and Joab departed, and went through all Israel: and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Sed sermo regis magis prævaluit: egressusque est Joab, et circuivit universum Israël: et reversus est Jerusalem,

verses.text: And he gave David the number of them, whom he had surveyed: and all the number of Israel was found to be eleven hundred thousand men that drew the sword: and of Juda four hundred and seventy thousand fighting men.
verses.textLatin: deditque David numerum eorum quos circuierat: et inventus est omnis numerus Israël, mille millia et centum millia virorum educentium gladium: de Juda autem quadringenta septuaginta millia bellatorum.

verses.text: But Levi and Benjamin he did not number: for Joab unwillingly executed the king’s orders.
verses.textLatin: Nam Levi et Benjamin non numeravit: eo quod Joab invitus exsequeretur regis imperium.

verses.text: And God was displeased with this thing that was commanded: and he struck Israel.
verses.textLatin: Displicuit autem Deo quod jussum erat: et percussit Israël.

verses.text: And David said to God: I have sinned exceedingly in doing this: I beseech thee take away the iniquity of thy servant, for I have done foolishly.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David ad Deum: Peccavi nimis ut hoc facerem: obsecro, aufer iniquitatem servi tui, quia insipienter egi.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Gad the seer of David, saying:
verses.textLatin: Et locutus est Dominus ad Gad videntem Davidis, dicens:

verses.text: Go, and speak to David, and tell him: Thus saith the Lord: I give thee the choice of three things: choose one which thou wilt, and I will do it to thee.
verses.textLatin: Vade, et loquere ad David, et dic ei: Hæc dicit Dominus: Trium tibi optionem do: unum, quod volueris, elige, et faciam tibi.

verses.text: And when Gad was come to David, he said to him: Thus saith the Lord: choose which thou wilt:
verses.textLatin: Cumque venisset Gad ad David, dixit ei: Hæc dicit Dominus: Elige, quod volueris:

verses.text: Either three years’ famine: or three months to flee from thy enemies, and not to be able to escape their sword: or three days to have the sword of the Lord, and pestilence in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying in all the coasts of Israel: now therefore see what I shall answer him who sent me.
verses.textLatin: aut tribus annis famem; aut tribus mensibus te fugere hostes tuos, et gladium eorum non posse evadere; aut tribus diebus gladium Domini, et pestilentiam versari in terra, et angelum Domini interficere in universis finibus Israël: nunc igitur vide quid respondeam ei qui misit me.

verses.text: And David said to Gad: I am on every side in a great strait: but it is better for me to fall into the hands of the Lord, for his mercies are many, than into the hands of men.
verses.textLatin: Et dixit David ad Gad: Ex omni parte me angustiæ premunt: sed melius mihi est ut incidam in manus Domini, quia multæ sunt miserationes ejus, quam in manus hominum.

verses.text: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel. And there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.textLatin: Misit ergo Dominus pestilentiam in Israël: et ceciderunt de Israël septuaginta millia virorum.

verses.text: And he sent an angel to Jerusalem, to strike it: and as he was striking it, the Lord beheld, and took pity for the greatness of the evil: and said to the angel that destroyed: It is enough, now stop thy hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textLatin: Misit quoque angelum in Jerusalem ut percuteret eam: cumque percuteretur, vidit Dominus, et misertus est super magnitudine mali: et imperavit angelo qui percutiebat: Sufficit, jam cesset manus tua. Porro angelus Domini stabat juxta aream Ornan Jebusæi.

verses.text: And David lifting up his eyes, saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand, turned against Jerusalem: and both he and the ancients clothed in haircloth, fell down flat on the ground.
verses.textLatin: Levansque David oculos suos, vidit angelum Domini stantem inter cælum et terram, et evaginatum gladium in manu ejus, et versum contra Jerusalem: et ceciderunt tam ipse quam majores natu, vestiti ciliciis, proni in terram.

verses.text: And David said to God: Am not I he that commanded the people to be numbered? It is I that have sinned: it is I that have done the evil: but as for this flock, what hath it deserved? O Lord my God, let thy hand be turned, I beseech thee, upon me, and upon my father’s house: and let not thy people be destroyed.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David ad Deum: Nonne ego sum, qui jussi ut numeraretur populus? ego, qui peccavi? ego, qui malum feci? iste grex, quid commeruit? Domine Deus meus, vertatur, obsecro, manus tua in me, et in domum patris mei: populus autem tuus non percutiatur.

verses.text: And the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to tell David, to go up, and build an altar to the Lord God in the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textLatin: Angelus autem Domini præcepit Gad ut diceret Davidi ut ascenderet, exstrueretque altare Domino Deo in area Ornan Jebusæi.

verses.text: And David went up, according to the word of Gad, which he spoke to him in the name of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Ascendit ergo David juxta sermonem Gad, quem locutus ei fuerat ex nomine Domini.

verses.text: Now when Ornan looked up, and saw the angel, he and his four sons hid themselves: for at that time he was thrashing wheat in the floor.
verses.textLatin: Porro Ornan cum suspexisset et vidisset angelum, quatuorque filii ejus cum eo, absconderunt se: nam eo tempore terebat in area triticum.

verses.text: And as David was coming to Ornan, Ornan saw him, and went out of the thrashingfloor to meet him, and bowed down to him with his face to the ground.
verses.textLatin: Igitur cum veniret David ad Ornan, conspexit eum Ornan, et processit ei obviam de area, et adoravit eum pronus in terram.

verses.text: And David said to him: Give me this place of thy thrashingfloor, that I may build therein an altar to the Lord: but thou shalt take of me as much money as it is worth, that the plague may cease from the people.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque ei David: Da mihi locum areæ tuæ, ut ædificem in ea altare Domino: ita ut quantum valet argenti accipias, et cesset plaga a populo.

verses.text: And Ornan said to David: Take it, and let my lord the king do all that pleaseth him: and moreover the oxen also I give for a holocaust, and the drays for wood, and the wheat for the sacrifice: I will give it all willingly.
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Ornan ad David: Tolle, et faciat dominus meus rex quodcumque ei placet: sed et boves do in holocaustum, et tribulas in ligna, et triticum in sacrificium: omnia libens præbebo.

verses.text: And king David said to him: It shall not be so, but I will give thee money as much as it is worth: for I must not take it from thee, and so offer to the Lord holocausts free cost.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque ei rex David: Nequaquam ita fiet, sed argentum dabo quantum valet: neque enim tibi auferre debeo, et sic offerre Domino holocausta gratuita.

verses.text: So David gave to Ornan for the place, six hundred sicles of gold of just weight.
verses.textLatin: Dedit ergo David Ornan pro loco siclos auri justissimi ponderis sexcentos.

verses.text: And he built there an altar to the Lord: and he offered holocausts, and peace offerings, and he called upon the Lord, and he heard him by sending fire from heaven upon the altar of the holocaust.
verses.textLatin: Et ædificavit ibi altare Domino, obtulitque holocausta et pacifica, et invocavit Dominum; et exaudivit eum in igne de cælo super altare holocausti.

verses.text: And the Lord commanded the angel: and he put up his sword again into the sheath.
verses.textLatin: Præcepitque Dominus angelo, et convertit gladium suum in vaginam.

verses.text: And David seeing that the Lord had heard him in the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, forthwith offered victims there.
verses.textLatin: Protinus ergo David, videns quod exaudisset eum Dominus in area Ornan Jebusæi, immolavit ibi victimas.

verses.text: But the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the desert, and the altar of holocausts, was at that time in the high place of Gabaon.
verses.textLatin: Tabernaculum autem Domini, quod fecerat Moyses in deserto, et altare holocaustorum, ea tempestate erat in excelso Gabaon.

verses.text: And David could not go to the altar there to pray to God: for he was seized with an exceeding great fear, seeing the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et non prævaluit David ire ad altare ut ibi obsecraret Deum: nimio enim fuerat in timore perterritus, videns gladium angeli Domini.

verses.text: Then  David said: This is the house of God, and this is the altar for the holocaust of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David: Hæc est domus Dei, et hoc altare in holocaustum Israëli.

verses.text: And he commanded to gather together all the proselytes of the land of Israel, and out of them he appointed stonecutters to hew stones and polish them, to build the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Et præcepit ut congregarentur omnes proselyti de terra Israël, et constituit ex eis latomos ad cædendos lapides et poliendos, ut ædificaretur domus Dei.

verses.text: And David prepared in abundance iron for the nails of the gates, and for the closures and joinings: and of brass an immense weight.
verses.textLatin: Ferrum quoque plurimum ad clavos januarum, et ad commissuras atque juncturas, præparavit David: et æris pondus innumerabile.

verses.text: And the cedar trees were without number, which the Sidonians, and Tyrians brought to David.
verses.textLatin: Ligna quoque cedrina non poterant æstimari, quæ Sidonii et Tyrii deportaverant ad David.

verses.text: And David said: Solomon my son is very young and tender, and the house which I would have to be built to the Lord, must be such as to be renowned in all countries: therefore I will prepare him necessaries. And therefore before his death he prepared all the charges.
verses.textLatin: Et dixit David: Solomon filius meus puer parvulus est et delicatus: domus autem, quam ædificari volo Domino, talis esse debet ut in cunctis regionibus nominetur: præparabo ergo ei necessaria. Et ob hanc causam ante mortem suam omnes præparavit impensas.

verses.text: And he called for Solomon his son: and commanded him to build a house to the Lord the God of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Vocavitque Salomonem filium suum, et præcepit ei ut ædificaret domum Domino Deo Israël.

verses.text: And David said to Solomon: My son, it was my desire to have built a house to the name of the Lord my God.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque David ad Salomonem: Fili mi, voluntatis meæ fuit ut ædificarem domum nomini Domini Dei mei:

verses.text: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying: Thou hast shed much blood, and fought many battles, so thou canst not build a house to my name, after shedding so much blood before me:
verses.textLatin: sed factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens: Multum sanguinem effudisti, et plurima bella bellasti: non poteris ædificare domum nomini meo, tanto effuso sanguine coram me:

verses.text: The son, that shall be born to thee, shall be a most quiet man: for I will make him rest from all his enemies round about: and therefore he shall be called Peaceable: and I will give peace and quietness to Israel all his days.
verses.textLatin: filius qui nascetur tibi, erit vir quietissimus: faciam enim eum requiescere ab omnibus inimicis suis per circuitum: et ob hanc causam Pacificus vocabitur: et pacem et otium dabo in Israël cunctis diebus ejus.

verses.text: He shall build a house to my name, and he shall be a son to me, and I will be a father to him: and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.textLatin: Ipse ædificabit domum nomini meo, et ipse erit mihi in filium, et ego ero illi in patrem: firmaboque solium regni ejus super Israël in æternum.

verses.text: Now then, my son, the Lord be with thee, and do thou prosper, and build the house to the Lord thy God, as he hath spoken of thee.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo fili mi, sit Dominus tecum, et prosperare, et ædifica domum Domino Deo tuo sicut locutus est de te.

verses.text: The Lord also give thee wisdom and understanding, that thou mayest be able to rule Israel, and to keep the law of the Lord thy God.
verses.textLatin: Det quoque Dominus prudentiam et sensum ut regere possis Israël, et custodire legem Domini Dei tui.

verses.text: For then thou shalt be able to prosper, if thou keep the commandments, and judgments, which the Lord commanded Moses to teach Israel: take courage and act manfully, fear not, nor be dismayed.
verses.textLatin: Tunc enim proficere poteris, si custodieris mandata et judicia quæ præcepit Dominus Moysi ut doceret Israël. Confortare, et viriliter age: ne timeas, neque paveas.

verses.text: Behold I in my poverty have prepared the charges of the house of the Lord, of gold a hundred thousand talents, and of silver a million of talents: but of brass, and of iron there is no weight, for the abundance surpasseth all account: timber also and stones I have prepared for all the charges.
verses.textLatin: Ecce ego in paupertate mea præparavi impensas domus Domini, auri talenta centum millia, et argenti mille millia talentorum: æris vero et ferri non est pondus, vincitur enim numerus magnitudine; ligna et lapides præparavi ad universa impendia.

verses.text: Thou hast also workmen in abundance, hewers of stones, and masons, and carpenters, and of all trades the most skilful in their work,
verses.textLatin: Habes quoque plurimos artifices, latomos, et cæmentarios, artificesque lignorum, et omnium artium ad faciendum opus prudentissimos,

verses.text: In gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, whereof there is no number. Arise then, and be doing, and the Lord will be with thee.
verses.textLatin: in auro et argento et ære et ferro, cujus non est numerus. Surge igitur et fac, et erit Dominus tecum.

verses.text: David also charged all the princes of Israel, to help Solomon his son,
verses.textLatin: Præcepit quoque David cunctis principibus Israël ut adjuvarent Salomonem filium suum:

verses.text: Saying: You see, that the Lord your God is with you, and hath given you rest round about, and hath delivered all your enemies into your hands, and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
verses.textLatin: Cernitis, inquiens, quod Dominus Deus vester vobiscum sit, et dederit vobis requiem per circuitum, et tradiderit omnes inimicos vestros in manus vestras, et subjecta sit terra coram Domino, et coram populo ejus.

verses.text: Give therefore your hearts and your souls, to seek the Lord your God: and arise, and build a sanctuary to the Lord God, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the vessels consecrated to the Lord, may be brought into the house, which is built to the name of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Præbete igitur corda vestra et animas vestras, ut quæratis Dominum Deum vestrum: et consurgite, et ædificate sanctuarium Domino Deo, ut introducatur arca fœderis Domini, et vasa Domino consecrata, in domum quæ ædificatur nomini Domini.

verses.text: And  David being old and full of days, made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.textLatin: Igitur David, senex et plenus dierum, regem constituit Salomonem filium suum super Israël.

verses.text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, and the priests and Levites.
verses.textLatin: Et congregavit omnes principes Israël, et sacerdotes atque Levitas.

verses.text: And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years, and upwards: and there were found of them thirty-eight thousand men.
verses.textLatin: Numeratique sunt Levitæ a triginta annis et supra: et inventa sunt triginta octo millia virorum.

verses.text: Of these twenty-four thousand were chosen, and distributed unto the ministry of the house of the Lord: and six thousand were the overseers and judges.
verses.textLatin: Ex his electi sunt, et distributi in ministerium domus Domini, viginti quatuor millia: præpositorum autem et judicum, sex millia.

verses.text: Moreover four thousand were porters: and as many singers singing to the Lord with the instruments, which he had made to sing with.
verses.textLatin: Porro quatuor millia janitores, et totidem psaltæ, canentes Domino in organis quæ fecerat ad canendum.

verses.text: And David distributed them into courses by the families of the sons of Levi, to wit, of Gerson, and of Caath, and of Merari.
verses.textLatin: Et distribuit eos David per vices filiorum Levi, Gerson videlicet, et Caath, et Merari.

verses.text: The sons of Gerson were Leedan and Semei.
verses.textLatin: Filii Gerson: Leedan, et Semei.

verses.text: The sons of Leedan: the chief Jahiel, and Zethan, and Joel, three.
verses.textLatin: Filii Leedan: princeps Jahiel, et Zethan, et Joël, tres.

verses.text: The sons of Semei: Salomith, and Hosiel, and Aran, three: these were the heads of the families of Leedan.
verses.textLatin: Filii Semei: Salomith, et Hosiel, et Aran, tres: isti principes familiarum Leedan.

verses.text: And the sons of Semei were Leheth, and Ziza, and Jaus, and Baria: these were the sons of Semei, four.
verses.textLatin: Porro filii Semei: Leheth, et Ziza, et Jaus, et Baria: isti filii Semei, quatuor.

verses.text: And Leheth was the first, Ziza the second: but Jaus and Baria had not many children, and therefore they were counted in one family, and in one house.
verses.textLatin: Erat autem Leheth prior, Ziza secundus: porro Jaus et Baria non habuerunt plurimos filios, et idcirco in una familia, unaque domo computati sunt.

verses.text: The sons of Caath were Amram, and Isaar, Hebron, and Oziel, four.
verses.textLatin: Filii Caath: Amram, et Isaar, Hebron, et Oziel, quatuor.

verses.text: The sons of Amram, Aaron, and Moses. And Aaron was separated to minister in the holy of holies, he and his sons for ever, and to burn incense before the Lord, according to his ceremonies, and to bless his name for ever.
verses.textLatin: Filii Amram: Aaron et Moyses. Separatusque est Aaron ut ministraret in Sancto sanctorum, ipse et filii ejus in sempiternum, et adoleret incensum Domino secundum ritum suum, ac benediceret nomini ejus in perpetuum.

verses.text: The sons also of Moses, the man of God, were numbered in the tribe of Levi.
verses.textLatin: Moysi quoque hominis Dei filii annumerati sunt in tribu Levi.

verses.text: The sons of Moses were Gersom and Eliezer:
verses.textLatin: Filii Moysi: Gersom et Eliezer.

verses.text: The sons of Gersom: Subuel the first.
verses.textLatin: Filii Gersom: Subuel primus.

verses.text: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rohobia the first: and Eliezer had no more sons. But the sons of Rohobia were multiplied exceedingly.
verses.textLatin: Fuerunt autem filii Eliezer: Rohobia primus: et non erant Eliezer filii alii. Porro filii Rohobia multiplicati sunt nimis.

verses.text: The sons of Isaar: Salomith the first.
verses.textLatin: Filii Isaar: Salomith primus.

verses.text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriau the first, Amarias the second, Jahaziel the third, Jecmaam the fourth.
verses.textLatin: Filii Hebron: Jeriau primus, Amarias secundus, Jahaziel tertius, Jecmaam quartus.

verses.text: The sons of Oziel: Micha the first, Jesia the second.
verses.textLatin: Filii Oziel: Micha primus, Jesia secundus.

verses.text: The sons of Merari: Moholi, and Musi. The sons of Moholi: Eleazar and Cis.
verses.textLatin: Filii Merari: Moholi, et Musi. Filii Moholi: Eleazar et Cis.

verses.text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons but daughters: and the sons of Cis their brethren took them.
verses.textLatin: Mortuus est autem Eleazar, et non habuit filios, sed filias: acceperuntque eas filii Cis fratres earum.

verses.text: The sons of Musi: Moholi, and Eder, and Jerimoth, three.
verses.textLatin: Filii Musi: Moholi, et Eder, et Jerimoth, tres.

verses.text: These are the sons of Levi in their kindreds and families, princes by their courses, and the number of every head that did the works of the ministry of the house of the Lord from twenty years old and upward.
verses.textLatin: Hi filii Levi in cognationibus et familiis suis, principes per vices, et numerum capitum singulorum qui faciebant opera ministerii domus Domini, a viginti annis et supra.

verses.text: For David said: The Lord the God of Israel hath given rest to his people, and a habitation in Jerusalem for ever.
verses.textLatin: Dixit enim David: Requiem dedit Dominus Deus Israël populo suo, et habitationem Jerusalem usque in æternum.

verses.text: And it shall not be the office of the Levites to carry any more the tabernacle, and all the vessels for the service thereof.
verses.textLatin: Nec erit officii Levitarum ut ultra portent tabernaculum et omnia vasa ejus ad ministrandum.

verses.text: So according to the last precepts of David, the sons of Levi are to be numbered from twenty years old and upward.
verses.textLatin: Juxta præcepta quoque David novissima, supputabitur numerus filiorum Levi a viginti annis et supra.

verses.text: And they are to be under the hand of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the porches, and in the chambers, and in the place of purification, and in the sanctuary, and in all the works of the ministry of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et erunt sub manu filiorum Aaron in cultum domus Domini, in vestibulis, et in exedris, et in loco purificationis, et in sanctuario, et in universis operibus ministerii templi Domini.

verses.text: And the priests have the charge of the loaves of proposition, and of the sacrifice of fine flour, and of the unleavened cakes, and of the fryingpan, and of the roasting, and of every weight and measure.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdotes autem, super panes propositionis, et ad similæ sacrificium, et ad lagana azyma, et sartaginem, et ad torrendum, et super omne pondus atque mensuram.

verses.text: And the Levites are to stand in the morning to give thanks, and to sing praises to the Lord: and in like manner in the evening,
verses.textLatin: Levitæ vero ut stent mane ad confitendum et canendum Domino: similiterque ad vesperam,

verses.text: As well in the oblation of the holocausts of the Lord, as in the sabbaths and in the new moons, and the rest of the solemnities, according to the number and ceremonies prescribed for every thing, continually before the Lord.
verses.textLatin: tam in oblatione holocaustorum Domini, quam in sabbatis et calendis et solemnitatibus reliquis juxta numerum et cæremonias uniuscujusque rei, jugiter coram Domino.

verses.text: And let them keep the observances of the tabernacle of the covenant, and the ceremonies of the sanctuary, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, that they may minister in the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et custodiant observationes tabernaculi fœderis, et ritum sanctuarii, et observationem filiorum Aaron fratrum suorum, ut ministrent in domo Domini.

verses.text: Now  these were the divisions of the sons of Aaron: The sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abiu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textLatin: Porro filiis Aaron hæ partitiones erant. Filii Aaron: Nadab, et Abiu, et Eleazar, et Ithamar.

verses.text: But Nadab and Abiu died before their father, and had no children: so Eleazar, and Ithamar did the office of the priesthood.
verses.textLatin: Mortui sunt autem Nadab et Abiu ante patrem suum absque liberis: sacerdotioque functus est Eleazar, et Ithamar.

verses.text: And David distributed them, that is, Sadoc of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their courses and ministry.
verses.textLatin: Et divisit eos David, id est, Sadoc de filiis Eleazari, et Ahimelech de filiis Ithamar, secundum vices suas et ministerium.
