verses.text: And there were found many more of the sons of Eleazar among the principal men, than of the sons of Ithamar. And he divided them so, that there were of the sons of Eleazar, sixteen chief men by their families: and of the sons of Ithamar eight by their families and houses.
verses.textLatin: Inventique sunt multo plures filii Eleazar in principibus viris, quam filii Ithamar. Divisit autem eis, hoc est, filiis Eleazar, principes per familias sedecim: et filiis Ithamar per familias et domos suas octo.

verses.text: And he divided both the families one with the other by lot: for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.textLatin: Porro divisit utrasque inter se familias sortibus: erant enim principes sanctuarii, et principes Dei, tam de filiis Eleazar quam de filiis Ithamar.

verses.text: And Semeias the son of Nathanael the scribe a Levite, wrote them down before the king and the princes, and Sadoc the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the princes also of the priestly and Levitical families: one house, which was over the rest, of Eleazar: and another house, which had the rest under it, of Ithamar.
verses.textLatin: Descripsitque eos Semeias filius Nathanaël scriba Levites, coram rege et principibus, et Sadoc sacerdote, et Ahimelech filio Abiathar, principibus quoque familiarum sacerdotalium, et Leviticarum: unam domum, quæ ceteris præerat, Eleazar: et alteram domum, quæ sub se habebat ceteros, Ithamar.

verses.text: Now the first lot came forth to Joiarib, the second to Jedei,
verses.textLatin: Exivit autem sors prima Jojarib, secunda Jedei,

verses.text: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.textLatin: tertia Harim, quarta Seorim,

verses.text: The fifth to Melchia, the sixth to Maiman,
verses.textLatin: quinta Melchia, sexta Maiman,

verses.text: The seventh to Accos, the eighth to Abia,
verses.textLatin: septima Accos, octava Abia,

verses.text: The ninth to Jesua, the tenth to Sechenia,
verses.textLatin: nona Jesua, decima Sechenia,

verses.text: The eleventh to Eliasib, the twelfth to Jacim,
verses.textLatin: undecima Eliasib, duodecima Jacim,

verses.text: The thirteenth to Hoppha, the fourteenth to Isbaab,
verses.textLatin: tertiadecima Hoppha, decimaquarta Isbaab,

verses.text: The fifteenth to Belga, the sixteenth to Emmer,
verses.textLatin: decimaquinta Belga, decimasexta Emmer,

verses.text: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.textLatin: decimaseptima Hezir, decimaoctava Aphses,

verses.text: The nineteenth to Pheteia, the twentieth to Hezechiel,
verses.textLatin: decimanona Pheteia, vigesima Hezechiel,

verses.text: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.textLatin: vigesima prima Jachin, vigesima secunda Gamul,

verses.text: The three and twentieth to Dalaiau, the four and twentieth to Maaziau.
verses.textLatin: vigesima tertia Dalaiau, vigesima quarta Maaziau.

verses.text: These are their courses according to their ministries, to come into the house of the Lord, and according to their manner under the hand of Aaron their father: as the Lord the God of Israel had com-manded.
verses.textLatin: Hæ vices eorum secundum ministeria sua, ut ingrediantur domum Domini, et juxta ritum suum sub manu Aaron patris eorum, sicut præceperat Dominus Deus Israël.

verses.text: Now of the rest of the sons of Levi, there was of the sons of Amram, Subael: and of the sons of Subael, Jehedeia.
verses.textLatin: Porro filiorum Levi qui reliqui fuerant, de filiis Amram erat Subaël, et de filiis Subaël, Jehedeia.

verses.text: Also of the sons of Rohobia the chief Jesias.
verses.textLatin: De filiis quoque Rohobiæ, princeps Jesias.

verses.text: And the son of Isaar Salemoth, and the son of Salemoth Jahath:
verses.textLatin: Isaari vero filius Salemoth, filiusque Salemoth Jahath:

verses.text: And his son Jeriau the first, Amarias the second, Jahaziel the third, Jecmaan the fourth.
verses.textLatin: filiusque ejus Jeriau primus, Amarias secundus, Jahaziel tertius, Jecmaan quartus.

verses.text: The son of Oziel, Micha: the son of Micha, Samir.
verses.textLatin: Filius Oziel, Micha: filius Micha, Samir.

verses.text: The brother of Micha, Jesia: and the son of Jesia, Zacharias.
verses.textLatin: Frater Micha, Jesia: filiusque Jesiæ, Zacharias.

verses.text: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi: the son of Oziau: Benno.
verses.textLatin: Filii Merari: Moholi, et Musi. Filius Oziau: Benno.

verses.text: The son also of Merari: Oziau, and Soam, and Zacchur, and Hebri.
verses.textLatin: Filius quoque Merari: Oziau, et Soam, et Zachur, et Hebri.

verses.text: And the son of Moholi: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.textLatin: Porro Moholi filius, Eleazar, qui non habebat liberos.

verses.text: And the son of Cis, Jeramael.
verses.textLatin: Filius vero Cis, Jerameel.

verses.text: The sons of Musi: Moholi, Eder, and Jerimoth. These are the sons of Levi according to the houses of their families.
verses.textLatin: Filii Musi: Moholi, Eder et Jerimoth: isti filii Levi secundum domos familiarum suarum.

verses.text: And they also cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron before David the king, and Sadoc, and Ahimelech, and the princes of the priestly and Levitical families, both the elder and the younger. The lot divided all equally.
verses.textLatin: Miseruntque et ipsi sortes contra fratres suos filios Aaron coram David rege, et Sadoc, et Ahimelech, et principibus familiarum sacerdotalium et Leviticarum, tam majores quam minores: omnes sors æqualiter dividebat.

verses.text: Moreover  David and the chief officers of the army separated for the ministry the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Idithun: to prophesy with harps, and with psalteries, and with cymbals according to their number serving in their appointed office.
verses.textLatin: Igitur David et magistratus exercitus segregaverunt in ministerium filios Asaph, et Heman, et Idithun, qui prophetarent in citharis, et psalteriis, et cymbalis secundum numerum suum, dedicato sibi officio servientes.

verses.text: Of the sons of Asaph: Zacchur, and Joseph, and Nathania, and Asarela, sons of Asaph: under the hand of Asaph prophesying near the king.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Asaph: Zachur, et Joseph, et Nathania, et Asarela, filii Asaph: sub manu Asaph prophetantis juxta regem.

verses.text: And of Idithun: the sons of Idithun, Godolias, Sori, Jeseias, and Hasabias, and Mathathias, six, under the hand of their father Idithun, who prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Porro Idithun: filii Idithun, Godolias, Sori, Jeseias, et Hasabias, et Mathathias, sex, sub manu patris sui Idithun, qui in cithara prophetabat super confitentes et laudantes Dominum.

verses.text: Of Heman also: the sons of Heman, Bocciau, Mathaniau, Oziel, Subuel, and Jerimoth, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatha, Geddelthi, and Romemthiezer, and Jesbacassa, Mellothi, Othir, Mahazioth:
verses.textLatin: Heman quoque: filii Heman, Bocciau, Mathaniau, Oziel, Subuel, et Jerimoth, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatha, Geddelthi, et Romemthiezer, et Jesbacassa, Mellothi, Othir, Mahazioth:

verses.text: All these were the sons of Heman the seer of the king in the words of God, to lift up the horn: and God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.textLatin: omnes isti filii Heman videntis regis in sermonibus Dei, ut exaltaret cornu: deditque Deus Heman filios quatuordecim, et filias tres.

verses.text: All these under their father’s hand were distributed to sing in the temple of the Lord, with cymbals, and psalteries and harps, for the service of the house of the Lord near the king: to wit, Asaph, and Idithun, and Heman.
verses.textLatin: Universi sub manu patris sui ad cantandum in templo Domini distributi erant, in cymbalis, et psalteriis, et citharis, in ministeria domus Domini juxta regem: Asaph videlicet, et Idithun, et Heman.

verses.text: And the number of them with their brethren, that taught the song of the Lord, all the teachers, were two hundred and eighty-eight.
verses.textLatin: Fuit autem numerus eorum cum fratribus suis, qui erudiebant canticum Domini, cuncti doctores, ducenti octoginta octo.

verses.text: And they cast lots by their courses, the elder equally with the younger, the learned and the unlearned together.
verses.textLatin: Miseruntque sortes per vices suas, ex æquo tam major quam minor, doctus pariter et indoctus.

verses.text: And the first lot came forth to Joseph, who was of Asaph. The second to Godolias, to him and his sons, and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Egressaque est sors prima Joseph, qui erat de Asaph. Secunda Godoliæ, ipsi et filiis ejus, et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The third to Zachur, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Tertia Zachur, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The fourth to Isari, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Quarta Isari, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The fifth to Nathania, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Quinta Nathaniæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The sixth to Bocciau, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Sexta Bocciau, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The seventh to Isreela, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Septima Isreela, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The eighth to Jesaia, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Octava Jesaiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The ninth to Mathanaias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Nona Mathaniæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The tenth to Semeias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Decima Semeiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The eleventh to Azareel, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Undecima Azareel, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The twelfth to Hasabia, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Duodecima Hasabiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The thirteenth to Subael, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Tertiadecima Subaël, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The fourteenth to Mathathias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Quartadecima Mathathiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The fifteenth to Jerimoth, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Quintadecima Jerimoth, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The sixteenth to Hananias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Sextadecima Hananiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The seventeenth to Jesbacassa, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Septimadecima Jesbacassæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The eighteenth to Hanani, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Octavadecima Hanani, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The nineteenth to Mellothi, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Nonadecima Mellothi, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The twentieth to Eliatha, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Vigesima Eliatha, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The one and twentieth to Othir, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Vigesima prima Othir, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The two and twentieth to Geddelthi, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Vigesima secunda Geddelthi, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Vigesima tertia Mahazioth, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: The four and twentieth to Romemthiezer, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
verses.textLatin: Vigesima quarta Romemthiezer, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.

verses.text: And  the divisions of the porters: of the Corites Meselemia, the son of Core, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.textLatin: Divisiones autem janitorum: de Coritis Meselemia, filius Core, de filiis Asaph.

verses.text: The sons of Meselemia: Zacharias the firstborn, Jadihel the second, Zabadias the third, Jathanael the fourth,
verses.textLatin: Filii Meselemiæ: Zacharias primogenitus, Jadihel secundus, Zabadias tertius, Jathanaël quartus,

verses.text: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.textLatin: Ælam quintus, Johanan sextus, Elioënai septimus.

verses.text: And the sons of Obededom, Semeias the firstborn, Jozabad the second, Joaha the third, Sachar the fourth, Nathanael the fifth,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Obededom: Semeias primogenitus, Jozabad secundus, Joaha tertius, Sachar quartus, Nathanaël quintus,

verses.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Phollathi the eighth: for the Lord had blessed him.
verses.textLatin: Ammiel sextus, Issachar septimus, Phollathi octavus: quia benedixit illi Dominus.

verses.text: And to Semei his son were born sons, heads of their families: for they were men of great valour.
verses.textLatin: Semei autem filio ejus nati sunt filii, præfecti familiarum suarum: erant enim viri fortissimi.

verses.text: The sons then of Semeias were Othni, and Raphael, and Obed, Elizabad, and his brethren most valiant men: and Eliu, and Samachias.
verses.textLatin: Filii ergo Semeiæ: Othni, et Raphaël, et Obed, Elzabad, fratres ejus viri fortissimi: Eliu quoque et Samachias.

verses.text: All these of the sons of Obededom: they, and their sons, and their brethren most able men for service, sixty-two of Obededom.
verses.textLatin: Omnes hi, de filiis Obededom: ipsi, et filii et fratres eorum, fortissimi ad ministrandum, sexaginta duo de Obededom.

verses.text: And the sons of Meselemia, and their brethren strong men, were eighteen.
verses.textLatin: Porro Meselemiæ filii, et fratres eorum robustissimi, decem et octo.

verses.text: And of Hosa, that is, of the sons of Merari: Semri the chief, (for he had not a firstborn, and therefore his father made him chief.)
verses.textLatin: De Hosa autem, id est, de filiis Merari: Semri princeps (non enim habuerat primogenitum, et idcirco posuerat eum pater ejus in principem),

verses.text: Helcias the second, Tabelias the third, Zacharias the fourth: all these the sons, and the brethren of Hosa, were thirteen.
verses.textLatin: Helcias secundus, Tabelias tertius, Zacharias quartus: omnes hi filii et fratres Hosa, tredecim.

verses.text: Among these were the divisions of the porters, so that the chiefs of the wards, as well as their brethren, always ministered in the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Hi divisi sunt in janitores, ut semper principes custodiarum, sicut et fratres eorum ministrarent in domo Domini.

verses.text: And they cast lots equally, both little and great, by their families for every one of the gates.
verses.textLatin: Missæ sunt ergo sortes ex æquo, et parvis et magnis, per familias suas in unamquamque portarum.

verses.text: And the lot of the east fell to Selemias. But to his son Zacharias, a very wise and learned man, the north gate fell by lot.
verses.textLatin: Cecidit ergo sors orientalis, Selemiæ. Porro Zachariæ filio ejus, viro prudentissimo et erudito, sortito obtigit plaga septentrionalis.

verses.text: And to Obededom and his sons that towards the south: in which part of the house was the council of the ancients.
verses.textLatin: Obededom vero et filiis ejus ad austrum: in qua parte domus erat seniorum concilium.

verses.text: To Sephim, and Hosa towards the west, by the gate which leadeth to the way of the ascent: ward against ward.
verses.textLatin: Sephim et Hosa ad occidentem, juxta portam, quæ ducit ad viam ascensionis: custodia contra custodiam.

verses.text: Now towards the east were six Levites: and towards the north four a day: and towards the south likewise four a day: and where the council was, two and two.
verses.textLatin: Ad orientem vero Levitæ sex: et ad aquilonem, quatuor per diem: atque ad meridiem similiter in die quatuor: et ubi erat concilium bini et bini.

verses.text: In the cells also of the porters toward the west four in the way: and two at every cell.
verses.textLatin: In cellulis quoque janitorum ad occidentem quatuor in via, binique per cellulas.

verses.text: These are the divisions of the porters of the sons of Core, and of Merari.
verses.textLatin: Hæ sunt divisiones janitorum filiorum Core et Merari.

verses.text: Now Achias was over the treasures of the house of God, and the holy vessels.
verses.textLatin: Porro Achias erat super thesauros domus Dei, et vasa sanctorum.

verses.text: The sons of Ledan, the sons of Gersonni: of Ledan were heads of the families, of Ledan, and Gersonni, Jehieli.
verses.textLatin: Filii Ledan, filii Gersonni: de Ledan principes familiarum Ledan, et Gersonni, Jehieli.

verses.text: The sons of Jehieli: Zathan and Joel, his brethren over the treasures of the house of the Lord,
verses.textLatin: Filii Jehieli: Zathan, et Joël fratres ejus super thesauros domus Domini.

verses.text: With the Amramites, and Isaarites, and Hebronites, and Ozielites.
verses.textLatin: Amramitis, et Isaaritis, et Hebronitis, et Ozihelitis.

verses.text: And Subael the son of Gersom, the son of Moses, was chief over the treasures.
verses.textLatin: Subaël autem filius Gersom filii Moysi, præpositus thesauris.

verses.text: His brethren also, Eliezer, whose son Rohobia, and his son Isaias, and his son Joram, and his son Zechri, and his son Selemith.
verses.textLatin: Fratres quoque ejus Eliezer, cujus filius Rahabia, et hujus filius Isaias, et hujus filius Joram, hujus quoque filius Zechri, et hujus filius Selemith.

verses.text: Which Selemith and his brethren were over the treasures of the holy things, which king David, and the heads of families, and the captains over thousands and over hundreds, and the captains of the host had dedicated,
verses.textLatin: Ipse Selemith, et fratres ejus, super thesauros sanctorum quæ sanctificavit David rex, et principes familiarum, et tribuni, et centuriones, et duces exercitus,

verses.text: Out of the wars, and the spoils won in battles, which they had consecrated to the building and furniture of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: de bellis et manubiis præliorum, quæ consecraverant ad instaurationem et supellectilem templi Domini.

verses.text: And all these things that Samuel the seer and Saul the son of Cis, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Sarvia had sanctified: and whosoever had sanctified those things, they were under the hand of Selemith and his brethren.
verses.textLatin: Hæc autem universa sanctificavit Samuel videns, et Saul filius Cis, et Abner filius Ner, et Joab filius Sarviæ: omnes qui sanctificaverant ea per manum Selemith et fratrum ejus.

verses.text: But Chonenias and his sons were over the Isaarites, for the business abroad over Israel to teach them and judge them.
verses.textLatin: Isaaritis vero præerat Chonenias, et filii ejus ad opera forinsecus super Israël ad docendum et judicandum eos.

verses.text: And of the Hebronites Hasabias, and his brethren most able men, a thousand seven hundred had the charge over Israel beyond the Jordan westward, in all the works of the Lord, and for the service of the king.
verses.textLatin: Porro de Hebronitis Hasabias, et fratres ejus viri fortissimi, mille septingenti præerant Israëli trans Jordanem contra occidentem, in cunctis operibus Domini, et in ministerium regis.

verses.text: And the chief of the Hebronites was Jeria according to their families and kindreds. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were numbered, and there were found most valiant men in Jazer Galaad,
verses.textLatin: Hebronitarum autem princeps fuit Jeria secundum familias et cognationes eorum. Quadragesimo anno regni David recensiti sunt, et inventi sunt viri fortissimi in Jazer Galaad,

verses.text: And his brethren of stronger age, two thousand seven hundred chiefs of families. And king David made them rulers over the Rubenites and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasses, for all the service of God, and the king.
verses.textLatin: fratresque ejus robustioris ætatis, duo millia septingenti principes familiarum. Præposuit autem eos David rex Rubenitis, et Gadditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, in omne ministerium Dei et regis.

verses.text: Now  the children of Israel according to their number, the heads of families, captains of thousands and of hundreds, and officers, that served the king according to their companies, who came in and went out every month in the year, under every chief were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Israël secundum numerum suum, principes familiarum, tribuni, et centuriones, et præfecti, qui ministrabant regi juxta turmas suas, ingredientes et egredientes per singulos menses in anno, viginti quatuor millibus singuli præerant.

verses.text: Over the first company the first month Jesboam, the son of Zabdiel was chief, and under him were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Primæ turmæ in primo mense Jesboam præerat filius Zabdiel, et sub eo viginti quatuor millia;

verses.text: Of the sons of Phares, the chief of all the captains in the host in the first month.
verses.textLatin: de filiis Phares, princeps cunctorum principum in exercitu mense primo.

verses.text: The company of the second month was under Dudia, an Ahohite, and after him was another named Macelloth, who commanded a part of the army of four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Secundi mensis habebat turmam Dudia Ahohites, et post se alter nomine Macelloth, qui regebat partem exercitus viginti quatuor millium.

verses.text: And the captain of the third company for the third month, was Banaias the son of Joiada the priest: and in his division were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Dux quoque turmæ tertiæ in mense tertio erat Banaias filius Jojadæ sacerdos: et in divisione sua viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: This is that Banaias the most valiant among the thirty, and above the thirty. And Amizabad his son commanded his company.
verses.textLatin: Ipse est Banaias fortissimus inter triginta, et super triginta: præerat autem turmæ ipsius Amizabad filius ejus.

verses.text: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zabadias his son after him: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Quartus, mense quarto, Asahel frater Joab, et Zabadias filius ejus post eum: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The fifth captain for the fifth month, was Samaoth a Jezerite: and his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Quintus, mense quinto, princeps Samaoth Jezerites: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Hira the son of Acces a Thecuite: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Sextus, mense sexto, Hira filius Acces Thecuites: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helles a Phallonite of the sons of Ephraim: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Septimus, mense septimo, Helles Phallonites de filiis Ephraim: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sobochai a Husathite of the race of Zarahi: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Octavus, mense octavo, Sobochai Husathites de stirpe Zarahi: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer an Anathothite of the sons of Jemini, and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Nonus, mense nono, Abiezer Anathothites de filiis Jemini: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Marai, who was a Netophathite of the race of Zarai: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Decimus, mense decimo, Marai, et ipse Netophathites de stirpe Zarai: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Banaias, a Pharathonite of the sons of Ephraim: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Undecimus, mense undecimo, Banaias Pharathonites de filiis Ephraim: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Holdai a Netophathite, of the race of Gothoniel: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
verses.textLatin: Duodecimus, mense duodecimo, Holdai Netophathites, de stirpe Gothoniel: et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.

verses.text: Now the chiefs over the tribes of Israel were these: over the Rubenites, Eliezer the son of Zechri was ruler: over the Simeonites, Saphatias the son of Maacha:
verses.textLatin: Porro tribubus præerant Israël, Rubenitis, dux Eliezer filius Zechri: Simeonitis, dux Saphatias filius Maacha:

verses.text: Over the Levites, Hasabias the son of Camuel: over the Aaronites, Sadoc:
verses.textLatin: Levitis, Hasabias filius Camuel: Aaronitis, Sadoc:

verses.text: Over Juda, Eliu the brother of David: over Issachar, Amri the son of Michael:
verses.textLatin: Juda, Eliu frater David: Issachar, Amri filius Michaël.

verses.text: Over the Zabulonites, Jesmaias the son of Adias: over the Nephtalites, Jerimoth the son of Ozriel:
verses.textLatin: Zabulonitis, Jesmaias filius Abdiæ: Nephthalitibus, Jerimoth filius Ozriel:

verses.text: Over the sons of Ephraim, Osee the son of Ozaziu: over the half tribe of Manasses, Joel the son of Phadaia:
verses.textLatin: filiis Ephraim, Osee filius Ozaziu: dimidiæ tribui Manasse, Joël filius Phadaiæ:

verses.text: And over the half tribe of Manasses in Galaad, Jaddo the son of Zacharias: and over Benjamin, Jasiel the son of Abner.
verses.textLatin: et dimidiæ tribui Manasse in Galaad, Jaddo filius Zachariæ: Benjamin autem, Jasiel filius Abner:

verses.text: And over Dan, Ezrihel the son of Jeroham: these were the princes of the children of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Dan vero, Ezrihel filius Jeroham: hi principes filiorum Israël.

verses.text: But David would not number them from twenty years old and under: because the lord had said that he would multiply Israel like the stars of heaven.
verses.textLatin: Noluit autem David numerare eos a viginti annis inferius: quia dixerat Dominus ut multiplicaret Israël quasi stellas cæli.

verses.text: Joab the son of Sarvia began to number, but he finished not: because upon this there fell wrath upon Israel: and therefore the number of them that were numbered, was not registered in the chronicles of king David.
verses.textLatin: Joab filius Sarviæ cœperat numerare, nec complevit: quia super hoc ira irruerat in Israël, et idcirco numerus eorum qui fuerant recensiti, non est relatus in fastos regis David.

verses.text: And over the king’s treasures was Azmoth the son of Adiel: and over those stores which were in the cities, and in the villages, and, in the castles, was Jonathan the son of Ozias.
verses.textLatin: Super thesauros autem regis fuit Azmoth filius Adiel: his autem thesauris, qui erant in urbibus, et in vicis, et in turribus, præsidebat Jonathan filius Oziæ.

verses.text: And over the tillage, and the husbandmen, who tilled the ground, was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.textLatin: Operi autem rustico, et agricolis qui exercebant terram, præerat Ezri filius Chelub:

verses.text: And over the dressers of the vineyards, was Semeias a Romathite: and over the wine cellars, Zabdias an Aphonite.
verses.textLatin: vinearumque cultoribus, Semeias Romathites: cellis autem vinariis, Zabdias Aphonites.

verses.text: And over the oliveyards and the fig groves, which were in the plains, was Balanam a Gederite: and over the oil cellars, Joas.
verses.textLatin: Nam super oliveta et ficeta quæ erant in campestribus, Balanam Gederites: super apothecas autem olei, Joas.

verses.text: And over the herds that fed in Saron, was Setrai a Saronite: and over the oxen in the valleys, Saphat the son of Adli:
verses.textLatin: Porro armentis quæ pascebantur in Saron, præpositus fuit Setrai Saronites: et super boves in vallibus, Saphat filius Adli:

verses.text: And over the camels, Ubil an Ishmahelite: and over the asses, Jadias a Meronathite:
verses.textLatin: super camelos vero, Ubil Ismahelites: et super asinos, Jadias Meronathites:

verses.text: And over the sheep Jaziz an Agarene. All these were the rulers of the substance of king David.
verses.textLatin: super oves quoque, Jaziz Agareus: omnes hi, principes substantiæ regis David.

verses.text: And Jonathan David’s uncle, a counsellor, a wise and learned man: he and Jahiel the son of Hachamoni were with the king’s sons.
verses.textLatin: Jonathan autem patruus David, consiliarius, vir prudens et litteratus: ipse et Jahiel filius Hachamoni erant cum filiis regis.

verses.text: And Achitophel was the king’s counsellor, and Chusai the Arachite, the king’s friend.
verses.textLatin: Achitophel etiam consiliarius regis, et Chusai Arachites amicus regis.

verses.text: And after Achitophel was Joiada the son of Banaias, and Abiathar. And the general of the king’s army was Joab.
verses.textLatin: Post Achitophel fuit Jojada filius Banaiæ, et Abiathar. Princeps autem exercitus regis erat Joab.

verses.text: And  David assembled all the chief men of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies, who waited on the king: and the captains over thousands, and over hundreds, and them who had the charge over the substance and possessions of the king, and his sons with the officers of the court, and the men of power, and all the bravest of the army at Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Convocavit igitur David omnes principes Israël, duces tribuum, et præpositos turmarum, qui ministrabant regi: tribunos quoque et centuriones, et qui præerant substantiæ et possessionibus regis, filiosque suos cum eunuchis, et potentes et robustissimos quosque in exercitu Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the king rising up, and standing said: Hear me, my brethren and my people: I had a thought to have built a house, in which the ark of the Lord, and the footstool of our God might rest: and I prepared all things for the building.
verses.textLatin: Cumque surrexisset rex, et stetisset, ait: Audite me, fratres mei et populus meus: cogitavi ut ædificarem domum, in qua requiesceret arca fœderis Domini, et scabellum pedum Dei nostri: et ad ædificandum, omnia præparavi.

verses.text: And God said to me: Thou shalt not build a house to my name: because thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.textLatin: Deus autem dixit mihi: Non ædificabis domum nomini meo, eo quod sis vir bellator, et sanguinem fuderis.

verses.text: But the Lord God of Israel chose me of all the house of my father, to be king over Israel for ever: for of Juda he chose the princes: and of the house of Juda, my father’s house: and among the sons of my father, it pleased him to choose me king over all Israel.
verses.textLatin: Sed elegit Dominus Deus Israël me de universa domo patris mei, ut essem rex super Israël in sempiternum: de Juda enim elegit principes: porro de domo Juda, domum patris mei, et de filiis patris mei placuit ei ut me eligeret regem super cunctum Israël.

verses.text: And among my sons (for the Lord hath given me many sons) he hath chosen Solomon my son, to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.textLatin: Sed et de filiis meis (filios enim mihi multos dedit Dominus) elegit Salomonem filium meum ut sederet in throno regni Domini super Israël,

verses.text: And he said to me: Solomon thy son shall build my house, and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be a father to him.
verses.textLatin: dixitque mihi: Salomon filius tuus ædificabit domum meam, et atria mea: ipsum enim elegi mihi in filium, et ego ero ei in patrem.

verses.text: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he continue to keep my commandments, and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.textLatin: Et firmabo regnum ejus usque in æternum, si perseveraverit facere præcepta mea et judicia, sicut et hodie.

verses.text: Now then before all the assembly of Israel, in the hearing of our God, keep ye, and seek all the commandments of the Lord our God: that you may possess the good land, and may leave it to your children after you for ever.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo coram universo cœtu Israël audiente Deo nostro, custodite, et perquirite cuncta mandata Domini Dei nostri: ut possideatis terram bonam, et relinquatis eam filiis vestris post vos usque in sempiternum.

verses.text: And thou my son Solomon, know the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart, and a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the thoughts of minds. If thou seek him, thou shalt find him: but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.textLatin: Tu autem, Salomon fili mi, scito Deum patris tui, et servito ei corde perfecto, animo voluntario: omnia enim corda scrutatur Dominus, et universas mentium cogitationes intelligit. Si quæsieris eum, invenies: si autem dereliqueris eum, projiciet te in æternum.

verses.text: Now therefore seeing the Lord hath chosen thee to build the house of the sanctuary, take courage, and do it.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo quia elegit te Dominus ut ædificares domum sanctuarii, confortare, et perfice.

verses.text: And David gave to Solomon his son a description of the porch, and of the temple, and of the treasures, and of the upper floor, and of the inner chambers, and of the house for the mercy seat,
verses.textLatin: Dedit autem David Salomoni filio suo descriptionem porticus, et templi, et cellariorum, et cœnaculi, et cubiculorum in adytis, et domus propitiationis,

verses.text: As also of all the courts, which he had in his thought, and of the chambers round about, for the treasures of the house of the Lord, and for the treasures of the consecrated things,
verses.textLatin: necnon et omnium quæ cogitaverat atriorum et exedrarum per circuitum in thesauros domus Domini, et in thesauros sanctorum,

verses.text: And of the divisions of the priests and of the Levites, for all the works of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of the service of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: divisionumque sacerdotalium et Leviticarum, in omnia opera domus Domini, et in universa vasa ministerii templi Domini.

verses.text: Gold by weight for every vessel for the ministry. And silver by weight according to the diversity of the vessels and uses.
verses.textLatin: Aurum in pondere per singula vasa ministerii. Argenti quoque pondus pro vasorum et operum diversitate.

verses.text: He gave also gold for the golden candlesticks, and their lamps, according to the dimensions of every candlestick, and the lamps thereof. In like manner also he gave silver by weight for the silver candlesticks, and for their lamps according to the diversity of the dimensions of them.
verses.textLatin: Sed et in candelabra aurea, et ad lucernas eorum, aurum pro mensura uniuscujusque candelabri et lucernarum. Similiter et in candelabra argentea, et in lucernas eorum, pro diversitate mensuræ, pondus argenti tradidit.

verses.text: He gave also gold for the tables of proposition, according to the diversity of the tables: in like manner also silver for other tables of silver.
verses.textLatin: Aurum quoque dedit in mensas propositionis pro diversitate mensarum: similiter et argentum in alias mensas argenteas.

verses.text: For fleshhooks also, and bowls, and censers of fine gold, and for little lions of gold, according to the measure he gave by weight, for every lion. In like manner also for lions of silver he set aside a different weight of silver.
verses.textLatin: Ad fuscinulas quoque, et phialas, et thuribula ex auro purissimo, et leunculos aureos pro qualitate mensuræ pondus distribuit in leunculum et leunculum. Similiter et in leones argenteos diversum argenti pondus separavit.

verses.text: And for the altar of incense, he gave the purest gold: and to make the likeness of the chariot of the cherubims spreading their wings, and covering the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Altari autem, in quo adoletur incensum, aurum purissimum dedit: ut ex ipso fieret similitudo quadrigæ cherubim extendentium alas, et velantium arcam fœderis Domini.

verses.text: All these things, said he, came to me written by the hand of the Lord that I might understand all the works of the pattern.
verses.textLatin: Omnia, inquit, venerunt scripta manu Domini ad me, ut intelligerem universa opera exemplaris.

verses.text: And David said to Solomon his son: Act like a man, and take courage, and do: fear not, and be not dismayed: for the Lord my God will be with thee, and will not leave thee, nor forsake thee, till thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Dixit quoque David Salomoni filio suo: Viriliter age, et confortare, et fac: ne timeas, et ne paveas: Dominus enim Deus meus tecum erit, et non dimittet te nec derelinquet, donec perficias omne opus ministerii domus Domini.

verses.text: Behold the courses of the priests and the Levites, for every ministry of the house of the Lord, stand by thee, and are ready, and both the princes, and the people know how to execute all thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Ecce divisiones sacerdotum et Levitarum: in omne ministerium domus Domini assistunt tibi, et parati sunt, et noverunt tam principes quam populus facere omnia præcepta tua.

verses.text: And  king David said to all the assembly: Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is as yet young and tender: and the work is great, for a house is prepared not for man, but for God.
verses.textLatin: Locutusque est David rex ad omnem ecclesiam: Salomonem filium meum unum elegit Deus, adhuc puerum et tenellum: opus namque grande est, neque enim homini præparatur habitatio, sed Deo.

verses.text: And I with all my ability have prepared the expenses for the house of my God. Gold for vessels of gold, and silver for vessels of silver, brass for things of brass, iron for things of iron, wood for things of wood: and onyx stones, and stones like alabaster, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble of Paros in great abundance.
verses.textLatin: Ego autem totis viribus meis præparavi impensas domus Dei mei. Aurum ad vasa aurea, et argentum in argentea, æs in ænea, ferrum in ferrea, ligna ad lignea: et lapides onychinos, et quasi stibinos, et diversorum colorum, omnemque pretiosum lapidem, et marmor Parium abundantissime:

verses.text: Now over and above the things which I have offered into the house of my God I give of my own proper goods, gold and silver for the temple of my God, beside what things I have prepared for the holy house.
verses.textLatin: et super hæc quæ obtuli in domum Dei mei de peculio meo aurum et argentum, do in templum Dei mei, exceptis his quæ præparavi in ædem sanctam.

verses.text: Three thousand talents of gold of the gold of Ophir: and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the temple.
verses.textLatin: Tria millia talenta auri de auro Ophir, et septem millia talentorum argenti probatissimi ad deaurandos parietes templi.

verses.text: And gold for wheresoever there is need of gold: and silver for wheresoever there is need of silver, for the works to be made by the hands of the artificers: now if any man is willing to offer, let him fill his hand to day, and offer what he pleaseth to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et ubicumque opus est aurum de auro, et ubicumque opus est argentum de argento, opera fiant per manus artificum: et si quis sponte offert, impleat manum suam hodie, et offerat quod voluerit Domino.

verses.text: Then the heads of the families, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands, and of hundreds, and the overseers of the king’s possessions promised,
verses.textLatin: Polliciti sunt itaque principes familiarum, et proceres tribuum Israël, tribuni quoque, et centuriones, et principes possessionum regis.

verses.text: And they gave for the works of the house of the Lord, of gold, five thousand talents, and ten thousand solids: of silver ten thousand talents: and of brass eighteen thousand talents: and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
verses.textLatin: Dederuntque in opera domus Dei auri talenta quinque millia, et solidos decem millia: argenti talenta decem millia, et æris talenta decem et octo millia: ferri quoque centum millia talentorum.

verses.text: And all they that had stones, gave them to the treasures of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jahiel the Gersonite.
verses.textLatin: Et apud quemcumque inventi sunt lapides, dederunt in thesauros domus Domini per manum Jahiel Gersonitis.

verses.text: And the people rejoiced, when they promised their offerings willingly: because they offered them to the Lord with all their heart: and David the king rejoiced also with a great joy.
verses.textLatin: Lætatusque est populus cum vota sponte promitterent, quia corde toto offerebant ea Domino: sed et David rex lætatus est gaudio magno.

verses.text: And he blessed the Lord before all the multitude, and he said: Blessed art thou, O Lord the God of Israel, our father from eternity to eternity.
verses.textLatin: Et benedixit Domino coram universa multitudine, et ait: Benedictus es, Domine Deus Israël patris nostri, ab æterno in æternum.

verses.text: Thine, O Lord, is magnificence, and power, and glory, and victory: and to thee is praise: for all that is in heaven, and in earth, is thine: thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art above all princes.
verses.textLatin: Tua est, Domine, magnificentia, et potentia, et gloria, atque victoria: et tibi laus: cuncta enim quæ in cælo sunt et in terra, tua sunt: tuum, Domine, regnum, et tu es super omnes principes.

verses.text: Thine are riches, and thine is glory, thou hast dominion over all, in thy hand is power and might: in thy hand greatness, and the empire of all things.
verses.textLatin: Tuæ divitiæ, et tua est gloria: tu dominaris omnium. In manu tua virtus et potentia: in manu tua magnitudo, et imperium omnium.

verses.text: Now therefore our God we give thanks to thee, and we praise thy glorious name.
verses.textLatin: Nunc igitur Deus noster, confitemur tibi, et laudamus nomen tuum inclytum.

verses.text: Who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to promise thee all these things? all things are thine: and we have given thee what we received of thy hand.
verses.textLatin: Quis ego, et quis populus meus, ut possimus hæc tibi universa promittere? Tua sunt omnia: et quæ de manu tua accepimus, dedimus tibi.

verses.text: For we are sojourners before thee, and strangers, as were all our fathers. Our days upon earth are as a shadow, and there is no stay.
verses.textLatin: Peregrini enim sumus coram te, et advenæ, sicut omnes patres nostri. Dies nostri quasi umbra super terram, et nulla est mora.

verses.text: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name, is from thy hand, and all things are thine.
verses.textLatin: Domine Deus noster, omnis hæc copia quam paravimus ut ædificaretur domus nomini sancto tuo, de manu tua est, et tua sunt omnia.

verses.text: I know my God that thou provest hearts, and lovest simplicity, wherefore I also in the simplicity of my heart, have joyfully offered all these things: and I have seen with great joy thy people, which are here present, offer thee their offerings.
verses.textLatin: Scio, Deus meus, quod probes corda, et simplicitatem diligas, unde et ego in simplicitate cordis mei lætus obtuli universa hæc: et populum tuum qui hic repertus est, vidi cum ingenti gaudio tibi offerre donaria.

verses.text: O Lord God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Israel our fathers, keep for ever this will of their heart, and let this mind remain always for the worship of thee.
verses.textLatin: Domine Deus Abraham, et Isaac, et Israël patrum nostrorum, custodi in æternum hanc voluntatem cordis eorum, et semper in venerationem tui mens ista permaneat.

verses.text: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, that he may keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy ceremonies, and do all things: and build the house, for which I have provided the charges.
verses.textLatin: Salomoni quoque filio meo da cor perfectum, ut custodiat mandata tua, testimonia tua, et cæremonias tuas, et faciat universa: et ædificet ædem, cujus impensas paravi.

verses.text: And David commanded all the assembly: Bless ye the Lord our God. And all the assembly blessed the Lord the God of their fathers: and they bowed themselves and worshipped God, and then the king.
verses.textLatin: Præcepit autem David universæ ecclesiæ: Benedicite Domino Deo nostro. Et benedixit omnis ecclesia Domino Deo patrum suorum: et inclinaverunt se, et adoraverunt Deum, et deinde regem.

verses.text: And they sacrificed victims to the Lord: and they offered holocausts the next day, a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their libations, and with every thing prescribed most abundantly for all Israel.
verses.textLatin: Immolaveruntque victimas Domino: et obtulerunt holocausta die sequenti, tauros mille, arietes mille, agnos mille cum libaminibus suis, et universo ritu abundantissime in omnem Israël.

verses.text: And they ate, and drank before the Lord that day with great joy. And they anointed the second time Solomon the son of David. And they anointed him to the Lord to be prince, and Sadoc to be high priest.
verses.textLatin: Et comederunt, et biberunt coram Domino in die illo cum grandi lætitia. Et unxerunt secundo Salomonem filium David. Unxerunt autem eum Domino in principem, et Sadoc in pontificem.

verses.text: And Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and he pleased all: and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.textLatin: Seditque Salomon super solium Domini in regem pro David patre suo, et cunctis placuit: et paruit illi omnis Israël.

verses.text: And all the princes, and men of power, and all the sons of king David gave their hand, and were subject to Solomon the king.
verses.textLatin: Sed et universi principes, et potentes, et cuncti filii regis David dederunt manum, et subjecti fuerunt Salomoni regi.

verses.text: And the Lord magnified Solomon over all Israel: and gave him the glory of a reign, such as no king of Israel had before him.
verses.textLatin: Magnificavit ergo Dominus Salomonem super omnem Israël: et dedit illi gloriam regni, qualem nullus habuit ante eum rex Israël.

verses.text: So David the son of Isai reigned over all Israel.
verses.textLatin: Igitur David filius Isai regnavit super universum Israël.

verses.text: And the days that he reigned over Israel, were forty years: in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem three and thirty years.
verses.textLatin: Et dies quibus regnavit super Israël, fuerunt quadraginta anni: in Hebron regnavit septem annis, et in Jerusalem annis triginta tribus.

verses.text: And he died in a good age, full of days, and riches, and glory. And Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Et mortuus est in senectute bona, plenus dierum, et divitiis, et gloria: et regnavit Salomon filius ejus pro eo.

verses.text: Now the acts of king David first and last are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer:
verses.textLatin: Gesta autem David regis priora et novissima scripta sunt in libro Samuelis videntis, et in libro Nathan prophetæ, atque in volumine Gad videntis:

verses.text: And of all his reign, and his valour, and of the times that passed under him, either in Israel, or in all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.textLatin: universique regni ejus, et fortitudinis, et temporum quæ transierunt sub eo, sive in Israël, sive in cunctis regnis terrarum.

verses.text: And  Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him to a high degree.
verses.textLatin: Confortatus est ergo Salomon filius David in regno suo, et Dominus Deus ejus erat cum eo, et magnificavit eum in excelsum.

verses.text: And Solomon gave orders to all Israel, to the captains of thousands, and of hundreds, and to the rulers, and to the judges of all Israel, and the heads of the families:
verses.textLatin: Præcepitque Salomon universo Israëli, tribunis, et centurionibus, et ducibus, et judicibus omnis Israël, et principibus familiarum:

verses.text: And he went with all the multitude to the high place of Gabaon, where was the tabernacle of the covenant of the Lord, which Moses the servant of God made, in the wilderness.
verses.textLatin: et abiit cum universa multitudine in excelsum Gabaon, ubi erat tabernaculum fœderis Dei, quod fecit Moyses famulus Dei in solitudine.

verses.text: For David had brought the ark of God from Cariathiarim to the place, which he had prepared for it, and where he had pitched a tabernacle for it, that is, in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Arcam autem Dei adduxerat David de Cariathiarim in locum quem præparaverat ei, et ubi fixerat illi tabernaculum, hoc est, in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the altar of brass, which Beseleel the son of Uri the son of Hur had made, was there before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and all the assembly sought it:
verses.textLatin: Altare quoque æneum quod fabricatus fuerat Beseleel filius Uri filii Hur, ibi erat coram tabernaculo Domini: quod et requisivit Salomon, et omnis ecclesia.

verses.text: And Solomon went up thither to the brazen altar, before the tabernacle of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up on it a thousand victims.
verses.textLatin: Ascenditque Salomon ad altare æneum, coram tabernaculo fœderis Domini, et obtulit in eo mille hostias.

verses.text: And behold that night God appeared to him, saying: Ask what thou wilt that I should give thee.
verses.textLatin: Ecce autem in ipsa nocte apparuit ei Deus, dicens: Postula quod vis, ut dem tibi.

verses.text: And Solomon said to God: Thou hast shewn great kindness to my father David: and hast made me king in his stead.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Salomon Deo: Tu fecisti cum David patre meo misericordiam magnam, et constituisti me regem pro eo.

verses.text: Now therefore, O Lord God, let thy word be fulfilled, which thou hast promised to David my father: for thou hast made me king over thy great people, which is as innumerable as the dust of the earth.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo Domine Deus, impleatur sermo tuus quem pollicitus es David patri meo: tu enim me fecisti regem super populum tuum multum, qui tam innumerabilis est quam pulvis terræ.

verses.text: Give me wisdom and knowledge that I may come in and go out before thy people: for who can worthily judge this thy people, which is so great?
verses.textLatin: Da mihi sapientiam et intelligentiam, ut ingrediar et egrediar coram populo tuo: quis enim potest hunc populum tuum digne, qui tam grandis est, judicare?

verses.text: And God said to Solomon: Because this choice hath pleased thy heart, and thou hast not asked riches, and wealth, and glory, nor the lives of them that hate thee, nor many days of life: but hast asked wisdom and knowledge, to be able to judge my people, over which I have made thee king,
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Deus ad Salomonem: Quia hoc magis placuit cordi tuo, et non postulasti divitias, et substantiam, et gloriam, neque animas eorum qui te oderant, sed nec dies vitæ plurimos: petisti autem sapientiam et scientiam, ut judicare possis populum meum super quem constitui te regem:

verses.text: Wisdom and knowledge are granted to thee: and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and glory, so that none of the kings before thee, nor after thee, shall be like thee.
verses.textLatin: sapientia et scientia data sunt tibi: divitias autem et substantiam et gloriam dabo tibi, ita ut nullus in regibus nec ante te nec post te fuerit similis tui.

verses.text: Then Solomon came from the high place of Gabaon to Jerusalem before the tabernacle of the covenant, and reigned over Israel.
verses.textLatin: Venit ergo Salomon ab excelso Gabaon in Jerusalem coram tabernaculo fœderis, et regnavit super Israël.

verses.text: And he gathered to himself chariots and horsemen, and he had a thousand four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen: and he placed them in the cities of the chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Congregavitque sibi currus et equites, et facti sunt ei mille quadringenti currus, et duodecim millia equitum: et fecit eos esse in urbibus quadrigarum, et cum rege in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the king made silver and gold to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees as sycamores, which grow in the plains in great multitude.
verses.textLatin: Præbuitque rex argentum et aurum in Jerusalem quasi lapides, et cedros quasi sycomoros quæ nascuntur in campestribus multitudine magna.

verses.text: And there were horses brought him from Egypt, and from Coa by the king’s merchants, who went, and bought at a price,
verses.textLatin: Adducebantur autem ei equi de Ægypto et de Coa a negotiatoribus regis, qui ibant et emebant pretio,

verses.text: A chariot of four horses for six hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty: in like manner market was made in all the kingdoms of the Hethites, and of the kings of Syria.
verses.textLatin: quadrigam equorum sexcentis argenteis, et equum centum quinquaginta: similiter de universis regnis Hethæorum, et a regibus Syriæ emptio celebrabatur.

verses.text: And  Solomon determined to build a house to the name of the Lord, and a palace for himself.
verses.textLatin: Decrevit autem Salomon ædificare domum nomini Domini, et palatium sibi.

verses.text: And he numbered out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand to hew stones in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
verses.textLatin: Et numeravit septuaginta millia virorum portantium humeris, et octoginta millia qui cæderent lapides in montibus, præpositosque eorum tria millia sexcentos.

verses.text: He sent also to Hiram king of Tyre, saying: As thou didst with David my father, and didst send him cedars, to build him a house, in which he dwelt:
verses.textLatin: Misit quoque ad Hiram regem Tyri, dicens: Sicut egisti cum David patre meo, et misisti ei ligna cedrina ut ædificaret sibi domum, in qua et habitavit:

verses.text: So do with me that I may build a house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to burn incense before him, and to perfume with aromatical spices, and for the continual setting forth of bread, and for the holocausts, morning and evening, and on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and the solemnities of the Lord our God for ever, which are commanded for Israel.
verses.textLatin: sic fac mecum ut ædificem domum nomini Domini Dei mei, ut consecrem eam ad adolendum incensum coram illo, et fumiganda aromata, et ad propositionem panum sempiternam, et ad holocautomata mane, et vespere, sabbatis quoque, et neomeniis, et solemnitatibus Domini Dei nostri in sempiternum, quæ mandata sunt Israëli.

verses.text: For the house which I desire to build, is great: for our God is great above all gods.
verses.textLatin: Domus enim quam ædificare cupio, magna est: magnus est enim Deus noster super omnes deos.

verses.text: Who then can be able to build him a worthy house? if heaven, and the heavens of heavens cannot contain him: who am I that I should be able to build him a house? but to this end only, that incense may be burnt before him.
verses.textLatin: Quis ergo poterit prævalere, ut ædificet ei dignam domum? si cælum, et cæli cælorum, capere eum nequeunt, quantus ego sum, ut possim ædificare ei domum? sed ad hoc tantum, ut adoleatur incensum coram illo.

verses.text: Send me therefore a skilful man, that knoweth how to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, and in iron, in purple, in scarlet and in blue, and that hath skill in engraving, with the artificers, which I have with me in Judea and Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
verses.textLatin: Mitte ergo mihi virum eruditum, qui noverit operari in auro, et argento, ære, et ferro, purpura, coccino, et hyacintho: et qui sciat sculpere cælaturas cum his artificibus quos mecum habeo in Judæa, et Jerusalem, quos præparavit David pater meus.

verses.text: Send me also cedars, and fir trees, and pine trees from Libanus: for I know that thy servants are skilful in cutting timber in Libanus, and my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.textLatin: Sed et ligna cedrina mitte mihi, et arceuthina, et pinea de Libano: scio enim quod servi tui noverint cædere ligna de Libano: et erunt servi mei cum servis tuis,

verses.text: To provide me timber in abundance. For the house which I desire to build, is to be exceeding great, and glorious.
verses.textLatin: ut parentur mihi ligna plurima. Domus enim quam cupio ædificare, magna est nimis, et inclyta.

verses.text: And I will give thy servants the workmen that are to cut down the trees, for their food twenty thousand cores of wheat, and as many cores of barley, and twenty thousand measures of wine, and twenty thousand measures of oil.
verses.textLatin: Præterea operariis qui cæsuri sunt ligna, servis tuis, dabo in cibaria tritici coros viginti millia, et hordei coros totidem, et vini viginti millia metretas, olei quoque sata viginti millia.

verses.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent a letter to Solomon, saying: Because the Lord hath loved his people, therefore he hath made thee king over them.
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Hiram rex Tyri per litteras quas miserat Salomoni: Quia dilexit Dominus populum suum, idcirco te regnare fecit super eum.

verses.text: And he added, saying: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who hath given to king David a wise and knowing son, endued with understanding and prudence, to build a house to the Lord, and a palace for himself.
verses.textLatin: Et addidit, dicens: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, qui fecit cælum et terram: qui dedit David regi filium sapientem et eruditum et sensatum atque prudentem, ut ædificaret domum Domino, et palatium sibi.

verses.text: I therefore have sent thee my father Hiram, a wise and most skilful man,
verses.textLatin: Misi ergo tibi virum prudentem et scientissimum Hiram patrem meum,

verses.text: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, whose father was a Tyrian, who knoweth how to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, and in iron, and in marble, and in timber, in purple also, and violet, and silk and scarlet: and who knoweth to grave all sort of graving, and to devise ingeniously all that there may be need of in the work with thy artificers, and with the artificers of my lord David thy father.
verses.textLatin: filium mulieris de filiabus Dan, cujus pater fuit Tyrius, qui novit operari in auro, et argento, ære, et ferro, et marmore, et lignis, in purpura quoque, et hyacintho, et bysso, et coccino: et qui scit cælare omnem sculpturam, et adinvenire prudenter quodcumque in opere necessarium est cum artificibus tuis, et cum artificibus domini mei David patris tui.

verses.text: The wheat therefore, and the barley and the oil, and the wine, which thou, my lord, hast promised, send to thy servants.
verses.textLatin: Triticum ergo, et hordeum, et oleum, et vinum, quæ pollicitus es, domine mi, mitte servis tuis.

verses.text: And we will cut down as many trees out of Libanus, as thou shalt want, and will convey them in floats by sea to Joppe: and it will be thy part to bring them thence to Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Nos autem cædemus ligna de Libano, quot necessaria habueris, et applicabimus ea ratibus per mare in Joppe: tuum autem erit transferre ea in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And Solomon numbered all the proselytes in the land of Israel, after the numbering which David his father had made, and they were found a hundred and fifty-three thousand and six hundred.
verses.textLatin: Numeravit igitur Salomon omnes viros proselytos qui erant in terra Israël, post dinumerationem quam dinumeravit David pater ejus, et inventi sunt centum quinquaginta millia, et tria millia sexcenti.

verses.text: And he set seventy thousand of them to carry burdens on their shoulders, and eighty thousand to hew stones in the mountains: and three thousand and six hundred to be overseers of the work of the people.
verses.textLatin: Fecitque ex eis septuaginta millia qui humeris onera portarent, et octoginta millia qui lapides in montibus cæderent: tria autem millia et sexcentos præpositos operum populi.

verses.text: And  Solomon began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, in mount Moria, which had been shewn to David his father, in the place which David had prepared in the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textLatin: Et cœpit Salomon ædificare domum Domini in Jerusalem in monte Moria, qui demonstratus fuerat David patri ejus, in loco quem paraverat David in area Ornan Jebusæi.

verses.text: And he began to build in the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textLatin: Cœpit autem ædificare mense secundo, anno quarto regni sui.

verses.text: Now these are the foundations, which Solomon laid, to build the house of God, the length by the first measure sixty cubits, the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.textLatin: Et hæc sunt fundamenta quæ jecit Salomon, ut ædificaret domum Dei: longitudinis cubitos in mensura prima sexaginta, latitudinis cubitos viginti.

verses.text: And the porch in the front, which was extended in length according to the measure of the breadth of the house, twenty cubits: and the height was a hundred and twenty cubits: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.textLatin: Porticum vero ante frontem, quæ tendebatur in longum juxta mensuram latitudinis domus, cubitorum viginti: porro altitudo centum viginti cubitorum erat: et deauravit eam intrinsecus auro mundissimo.

verses.text: And the greater house he ceiled with deal boards, and overlaid them with plates of fine gold throughout: and he graved in them palm trees, and like little chains interlaced with one another.
verses.textLatin: Domum quoque majorem texit tabulis ligneis abiegnis, et laminas auri obrizi affixit per totum: sculpsitque in ea palmas, et quasi catenulas se invicem complectentes.

verses.text: He paved also the floor of the temple with most precious marble, of great beauty.
verses.textLatin: Stravit quoque pavimentum templi pretiosissimo marmore, decore multo.

verses.text: And the gold of the plates with which he overlaid the house, and the beams thereof, and the posts, and the walls, and the doors was of the finest: and he graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.textLatin: Porro aurum erat probatissimum, de cujus laminis texit domum, et trabes ejus, et postes, et parietes, et ostia: et cælavit cherubim in parietibus.

verses.text: He made also the house of the holy of holies: the length of it according to the breadth of the temple, twenty cubits, and the breadth of it in like manner twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with plates of gold, amounting to about six hundred talents.
verses.textLatin: Fecit quoque domum Sancti sanctorum: longitudinem juxta latitudinem domus cubitorum viginti: et latitudinem similiter viginti cubitorum: et laminis aureis texit eam, quasi talentis sexcentis.

verses.text: He made also nails of gold, and the weight of every nail was fifty sicles: the upper chambers also he overlaid with gold.
verses.textLatin: Sed et clavos fecit aureos, ita ut singuli clavi siclos quinquagenos appenderent: cœnacula quoque texit auro.

verses.text: He made also in the house of the holy of holies two cherubims of image work: and he overlaid them with gold.
verses.textLatin: Fecit etiam in domo Sancti sanctorum cherubim duos, opere statuario: et texit eos auro.

verses.text: The wings of the cherubims were extended twenty cubits, so that one wing was five cubits long, and reached to the wall of the house: and the other was also five cubits long, and reached to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.textLatin: Alæ cherubim viginti cubitis extendebantur, ita ut una ala haberet cubitos quinque et tangeret parietem domus: et altera quinque cubitos habens, alam tangeret alterius cherub.

verses.text: In like manner the wing of the other cherub, was five cubits long, and reached to the wall: and his other wing was five cubits long, and touched the wing of the other cherub.
verses.textLatin: Similiter cherub alterius ala, quinque habebat cubitos, et tangebat parietem: et ala ejus altera quinque cubitorum, alam cherub alterius contingebat.

verses.text: So the wings of the two cherubims were spread forth, and were extended twenty cubits: and they stood upright on their feet, and their faces were turned toward the house without.
verses.textLatin: Igitur alæ utriusque cherubim expansæ erant et extendebantur per cubitos viginti: ipsi autem stabant erectis pedibus, et facies eorum erant versæ ad exteriorem domum.

verses.text: He made also a veil of violet, purple, scarlet, and silk: and wrought in it cherubims.
verses.textLatin: Fecit quoque velum ex hyacintho, purpura, cocco, et bysso: et intexuit ei cherubim.

verses.text: He made also before the doors of the temple two pillars, which were five and thirty cubits high: and their chapiters were five cubits.
verses.textLatin: Ante fores etiam templi duas columnas, quæ triginta et quinque cubitos habebant altitudinis: porro capita earum, quinque cubitorum.

verses.text: He made also as it were little chains in the oracle, and he put them on the heads of the pillars: and a hundred pomegranates, which he put between the little chains.
verses.textLatin: Necnon et quasi catenulas in oraculo, et superposuit eas capitibus columnarum: malogranata etiam centum, quæ catenulis interposuit.

verses.text: These pillars he put at the entrance of the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left: that which was on the right hand, he called Jachin: and that on the left hand, Booz.
verses.textLatin: Ipsas quoque columnas posuit in vestibulo templi, unam a dextris, et alteram a sinistris: eam quæ a dextris erat, vocavit Jachin: et quæ ad lævam, Booz.

verses.text: He  made also an altar of brass twenty cubits long, and twenty cubits broad, and ten cubits high.
verses.textLatin: Fecit quoque altare æneum viginti cubitorum longitudinis, et viginti cubitorum latitudinis, et decem cubitorum altitudinis.

verses.text: Also a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass: it was five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.
verses.textLatin: Mare etiam fusile decem cubitis a labio usque ad labium, rotundum per circuitum: quinque cubitos habebat altitudinis, et funiculus triginta cubitorum ambiebat gyrum ejus.

verses.text: And under it there was the likeness of oxen, and certain engravings on the outside of ten cubits compassed the belly of the sea, as it were with two rows.
verses.textLatin: Similitudo quoque boum erat subter illud, et decem cubitis quædam extrinsecus cælaturæ, quasi duobus versibus alvum maris circuibant. Boves autem erant fusiles:

verses.text: And the oxen were cast: and the sea itself was set upon the twelve oxen, three of which looked toward the north, and other three toward the west: and other three toward the south, and the other three that remained toward the east, and the sea stood upon them: and the hinder parts of the oxen were inward under the sea.
verses.textLatin: et ipsum mare super duodecim boves impositum erat, quorum tres respiciebant ad aquilonem, et alii tres ad occidentem: porro tres alii meridiem, et tres qui reliqui erant, orientem, habentes mare superpositum: posteriora autem boum erant intrinsecus sub mari.

verses.text: Now the thickness of it was a handbreadth, and the brim of it was like the brim of a cup, or of a crisped lily: and it held three thousand measures.
verses.textLatin: Porro vastitas ejus habebat mensuram palmi, et labium illius erat quasi labium calicis, vel repandi lilii: capiebatque tria millia metretas.

verses.text: He made also ten lavers: and he set five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them all such things as they were to offer for holocausts: but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.textLatin: Fecit quoque conchas decem: et posuit quinque a dextris, et quinque a sinistris, ut lavarent in eis omnia quæ in holocaustum oblaturi erant: porro in mari sacerdotes lavabantur.

verses.text: And he made ten golden candlesticks, according to the form which they were commanded to be made by: and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.textLatin: Fecit autem et candelabra aurea decem secundum speciem qua jussa erant fieri: et posuit ea in templo, quinque a dextris, et quinque a sinistris.

verses.text: Moreover also ten tables: and he set them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. Also a hundred bowls of gold.
verses.textLatin: Necnon et mensas decem: et posuit eas in templo, quinque a dextris, et quinque a sinistris: phialas quoque aureas centum.

verses.text: He made also the court of the priests, and a great hall, and doors in the hall, which he covered with brass.
verses.textLatin: Fecit etiam atrium sacerdotum, et basilicam grandem: et ostia in basilica, quæ texit ære.

verses.text: And he set the sea on the right side over against the east toward the south.
verses.textLatin: Porro mare posuit in latere dextro contra orientem ad meridiem.

verses.text: And Hiram made caldrons, and fleshhooks, and bowls: and finished all the king’s work in the house of God:
verses.textLatin: Fecit autem Hiram lebetes, et creagras, et phialas: et complevit omne opus regis in domo Dei:

verses.text: That is to say, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters, and the network, to cover the chapiters over the pommels.
verses.textLatin: hoc est, columnas duas, et epistylia, et capita, et quasi quædam retiacula, quæ capita tegerent super epistylia.

verses.text: And four hundred pomegranates, and two wreaths of network, so that two rows of pomegranates were joined to each wreath, to cover the pommels, and the chapiters of the pillars.
verses.textLatin: Malogranata quoque quadringenta, et retiacula duo ita ut bini ordines malogranatorum singulis retiaculis jungerentur, quæ protegerent epistylia, et capita columnarum.

verses.text: He made also bases, and lavers, which he set upon the bases:
verses.textLatin: Bases etiam fecit, et conchas, quas superposuit basibus:

verses.text: One sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.textLatin: mare unum, boves quoque duodecim sub mari,

verses.text: And the caldrons, and fleshhooks, and bowls. All the vessels did Hiram his father make for Solomon in the house of the Lord of the finest brass.
verses.textLatin: et lebetes, et creagras, et phialas. Omnia vasa fecit Salomoni Hiram pater ejus in domo Domini ex ære mundissimo.

verses.text: In the country near the Jordan did the king cast them, in a clay ground between Sochot and Saredatha.
verses.textLatin: In regione Jordanis, fudit ea rex in argillosa terra inter Sochot et Saredatha.

verses.text: And the multitude of vessels was innumerable, so that the weight of the brass was not known.
verses.textLatin: Erat autem multitudo vasorum innumerabilis, ita ut ignoraretur pondus æris.

verses.text: And Solomon made all the vessels for the house of God, and the golden altar, and the tables, upon which were the loaves of proposition,
verses.textLatin: Fecitque Salomon omnia vasa domus Dei, et altare aureum, et mensas, et super eas panes propositionis:

verses.text: The candlesticks also of most pure gold with their lamps to give light before the oracle, according to the manner.
verses.textLatin: candelabra quoque cum lucernis suis ut lucerent ante oraculum juxta ritum ex auro purissimo:

verses.text: And certain flowers, and lamps, and golden tongs: all were made of the finest gold.
verses.textLatin: et florentia quædam, et lucernas, et forcipes aureos: omnia de auro mundissimo facta sunt.

verses.text: The vessels also for the perfumes, and the censers, and the bowls, and the mortars, of pure gold. And he graved the doors of the inner temple, that is, for the holy of holies: and the doors of the temple without were of gold. And thus all the work was finished which Solomon made in the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Thymiateria quoque, et thuribula, et phialas, et mortariola ex auro purissimo. Et ostia cælavit templi interioris, id est, in Sancta sanctorum: et ostia templi forinsecus aurea. Sicque completum est omne opus quod fecit Salomon in domo Domini.

verses.text: Then  Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had vowed, the silver, and the gold, and all the vessels he put among the treasures of the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Intulit igitur Salomon omnia quæ voverat David pater suus: argentum, et aurum, et universa vasa posuit in thesauris domus Dei.

verses.text: And after this he gathered together the ancients of Israel, and all the princes of the tribes, and the heads of the families, of the children of Israel to Jerusalem, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Sion.
verses.textLatin: Post quæ congregavit majores natu Israël, et cunctos principes tribuum, et capita familiarum de filiis Israël in Jerusalem, ut adducerent arcam fœderis Domini de civitate David, quæ est Sion.

verses.text: And all the men of Israel came to the king in the solemn day of the seventh month.
verses.textLatin: Venerunt itaque ad regem omnes viri Israël in die solemni mensis septimi.

verses.text: And when all the ancients of Israel were come, the Levites took up the ark,
verses.textLatin: Cumque venissent cuncti seniorum Israël, portaverunt Levitæ arcam,

verses.text: And brought it in, together with all the furniture of the tabernacle. And the priests with the Levites carried the vessels of the sanctuary, which were in the tabernacle.
verses.textLatin: et intulerunt eam, et omnem paraturam tabernaculi. Porro vasa sanctuarii, quæ erant in tabernaculo, portaverunt sacerdotes cum Levitis.

verses.text: And king Solomon and all the assembly of Israel, and all that were gathered together before the ark, sacrificed rams, and oxen without number: so great was the multitude of the victims.
verses.textLatin: Rex autem Salomon, et universus cœtus Israël, et omnes qui fuerunt congregati ante arcam, immolabant arietes et boves absque ullo numero: tanta enim erat multitudo victimarum.

verses.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, that is, to the oracle of the temple, into the holy of holies under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.textLatin: Et intulerunt sacerdotes arcam fœderis Domini in locum suum, id est, ad oraculum templi, in Sancta sanctorum subter alas cherubim:

verses.text: So that the cherubims spread their wings over the place, in which the ark was set, and covered the ark itself and its staves.
verses.textLatin: ita ut cherubim expanderent alas suas super locum in quo posita erat arca, et ipsam arcam tegerent cum vectibus suis.

verses.text: Now the ends of the staves wherewith the ark was carried, because they were some thing longer, were seen before the oracle: but if a man were a little outward, he could not see them. So the ark has been there unto this day.
verses.textLatin: Vectium autem quibus portabatur arca, quia paululum longiores erant, capita parebant ante oraculum: si vero quis paululum fuisset extrinsecus, eos videre non poterat. Fuit itaque arca ibi usque in præsentem diem.

verses.text: And there was nothing else in the ark but the two tables which Moses put there at Horeb when the Lord gave the law to the children of Israel, at their coming out of Egypt.
verses.textLatin: Nihilque erat aliud in arca, nisi duæ tabulæ quas posuerat Moyses in Horeb, quando legem dedit Dominus filiis Israël egredientibus ex Ægypto.

verses.text: Now when the priests were come out of the sanctuary, (for all the priests that could be found there, were sanctified: and as yet at that time the courses and orders of the ministries were not divided among them,)
verses.textLatin: Egressis autem sacerdotibus de sanctuario (omnes enim sacerdotes qui ibi potuerant inveniri, sanctificati sunt: nec adhuc in illo tempore vices et ministeriorum ordo inter eos divisus erat),

verses.text: Both the Levites and the singing men, that is, both they that were under Asaph, and they that were under Heman, and they that were under Idithun, with their sons, and their brethren, clothed with fine linen, sounded with cymbals, and psalteries, and harps, standing on the east side of the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests, sounding with trumpets.
verses.textLatin: tam Levitæ quam cantores, id est, et qui sub Asaph erant, et qui sub Eman, et qui sub Idithun, filii et fratres eorum vestiti byssinis, cymbalis, et psalteriis, et citharis concrepabant, stantes ad orientalem plagam altaris: et cum eis sacerdotes centum viginti canentes tubis.

verses.text: So when they all sounded together, both with trumpets, and voice, and cymbals, and organs, and with divers kind of musical instruments, and lifted up their voice on high: the sound was heard afar off, so that when they began to praise the Lord, and to say: Give glory to the Lord for he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever: the house of God was filled with a cloud.
verses.textLatin: Igitur cunctis pariter, et tubis, et voce, et cymbalis, et organis, et diversi generis musicorum concinentibus, et vocem in sublime tollentibus, longe sonitus audiebatur, ita ut cum Dominum laudare cœpissent et dicere: Confitemini Domino quoniam bonus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus: impleretur domus Dei nube,

verses.text: Nor could the priests stand and minister by reason of the cloud. For the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.
verses.textLatin: nec possent sacerdotes stare et ministrare propter caliginem. Compleverat enim gloria Domini domum Dei.

verses.text: Then  Solomon said: The Lord promised that he would dwell in a cloud.
verses.textLatin: Tunc Salomon ait: Dominus pollicitus est ut habitaret in caligine:

verses.text: But I have built a house to his name, that he might dwell there for ever.
verses.textLatin: ego autem ædificavi domum nomini ejus, ut habitaret ibi in perpetuum.

verses.text: And the king turned his face, and blessed all the multitude of Israel (for all the multitude stood attentive) and he said:
verses.textLatin: Et convertit rex faciem suam, et benedixit universæ multitudini Israël (nam omnis turba stabat intenta), et ait:

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, who hath accomplished in deed that which he spoke to David my father, saying:
verses.textLatin: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, qui quod locutus est David patri meo, opere complevit, dicens:

verses.text: From the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel, for a house to be built in it to my name: neither chose I any other man, to be the ruler of my people Israel.
verses.textLatin: A die qua eduxi populum meum de terra Ægypti, non elegi civitatem de cunctis tribubus Israël ut ædificaretur in ea domus nomini meo, neque elegi quemquam alium virum ut esset dux in populo Israël:

verses.text: But I chose Jerusalem, that my name might be there: and I chose David to set him over my people Israel.
