verses.text: From the days of our fathers: and we ourselves also have sinned grievously unto this day, and for our iniquities we and our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the lands, and to the sword, and to captivity, and to spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is at this day.
verses.textLatin: a diebus patrum nostrorum: sed et nos ipsi peccavimus graviter usque ad diem hanc, et in iniquitatibus nostris traditi sumus ipsi, et reges nostri, et sacerdotes nostri, in manum regum terrarum, et in gladium, et in captivitatem, et in rapinam, et in confusionem vultus, sicut et die hac.

verses.text: And now as a little, and for a moment has our prayer been made before the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant, and give us a pin in his holy place, and that our God would enlighten our eyes, and would give us a little life in our bondage.
verses.textLatin: Et nunc quasi parum et ad momentum facta est deprecatio nostra apud Dominum Deum nostrum, ut dimitterentur nobis reliquiæ, et daretur nobis paxillus in loco sancto ejus, et illuminaret oculos nostros Deus noster, et daret nobis vitam modicam in servitute nostra:

verses.text: For we are bondmen, and in our bondage our God hath not forsaken us, but hath extended mercy upon us before the king of the Persians, to give us life, and to set up the house of our God, and to rebuild the desolations thereof, and to give us a fence in Juda and Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: quia servi sumus, et in servitute nostra non dereliquit nos Deus noster, sed inclinavit super nos misericordiam coram rege Persarum, ut daret nobis vitam, et sublimaret domum Dei nostri, et exstrueret solitudines ejus, et daret nobis sepem in Juda et Jerusalem.

verses.text: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
verses.textLatin: Et nunc quid dicemus, Deus noster, post hæc? Quia dereliquimus mandata tua,

verses.text: Which thou hast commanded by the hand of thy servants the prophets, saying: The land which you go to possess, is an unclean land, according to the uncleanness of the people, and of other lands, with their abominations, who have filled it from mouth to mouth with their filth.
verses.textLatin: quæ præcepisti in manu servorum tuorum prophetarum, dicens: Terra, ad quam vos ingredimini ut possideatis eam, terra immunda est juxta immunditiam populorum, ceterarumque terrarum, abominationibus eorum qui repleverunt eam ab ore usque ad os in coinquinatione sua.

verses.text: Now therefore give not your daughters to their sons, and take not their daughters for your sons, and seek not their peace, nor their prosperity for ever: that you may be strengthened, and may eat the good things of the land, and may have your children your heirs for ever.
verses.textLatin: Nunc ergo filias vestras ne detis filiis eorum, et filias eorum ne accipiatis filiis vestris, et non quæratis pacem eorum et prosperitatem eorum usque in æternum: ut confortemini, et comedatis quæ bona sunt terræ, et hæredes habeatis filios vestros usque in sæculum.

verses.text: And after all that is come upon us, for our most wicked deeds, and our great sin, seeing that thou our God hast saved us from our iniquity, and hast given us a deliverance as at this day,
verses.textLatin: Et post omnia quæ venerunt super nos in operibus nostris pessimis, et in delicto nostro magno, quia tu, Deus noster, liberasti nos de iniquitate nostra, et dedisti nobis salutem sicut est hodie,

verses.text: That we should not turn away, nor break thy commandments, nor join in marriage with the people of these abominations. Art thou angry with us unto utter destruction, not to leave us a remnant to be saved?
verses.textLatin: ut non converteremur, et irrita faceremus mandata tua, neque matrimonia jungeremus cum populis abominationum istarum. Numquid iratus es nobis usque ad consummationem, ne dimitteres nobis reliquias ad salutem?

verses.text: O Lord God of Israel, thou art just: for we remain yet to be saved as at this day. Behold we are before thee in our sin, for there can be no standing before thee in this matter.
verses.textLatin: Domine Deus Israël, justus es tu: quoniam derelicti sumus, qui salvaremur sicut die hac. Ecce coram te sumus in delicto nostro: non enim stari potest coram te super hoc.

verses.text: Now  when Esdras was thus praying, and beseeching, and weeping, and lying before the temple of God, there was gathered to him of Israel an exceeding great assembly of men and women and children, and the people wept with much lamentation.
verses.textLatin: Sic ergo orante Esdra, et implorante eo et flente, et jacente ante templum Dei, collectus est ad eum de Israël cœtus grandis nimis virorum et mulierum et puerorum, et flevit populus fletu multo.

verses.text: And Sechenias the son of Jehiel of the sons of Elam answered, and said to Esdras: We have sinned against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: and now if there be repentance in Israel concerning this,
verses.textLatin: Et respondit Sechenias filius Jehiel de filiis Ælam, et dixit Esdræ: Nos prævaricati sumus in Deum nostrum, et duximus uxores alienigenas de populis terræ: et nunc, si est pœnitentia in Israël super hoc,

verses.text: Let us make a covenant with the Lord our God, to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the will of the Lord, and of them that fear the commandment of the Lord our God: let it be done according to the law.
verses.textLatin: percutiamus fœdus cum Domino Deo nostro, ut projiciamus universas uxores, et eos qui de his nati sunt, juxta voluntatem Domini, et eorum qui timent præceptum Domini Dei nostri: secundum legem fiat.

verses.text: Arise, it is thy part to give orders, and we will be with thee: take courage, and do it.
verses.textLatin: Surge, tuum est decernere, nosque erimus tecum: confortare, et fac.

verses.text: So Esdras arose, and made the chiefs of the priests and of the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word, and they swore.
verses.textLatin: Surrexit ergo Esdras, et adjuravit principes sacerdotum et Levitarum, et omnem Israël, ut facerent secundum verbum hoc: et juraverunt.

verses.text: And Esdras rose up from before the house of God, and went to the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliasib, and entered in thither: he ate no bread, and drank no water: for he mourned for the transgression of them that were come out of the captivity.
verses.textLatin: Et surrexit Esdras ante domum Dei, et abiit ad cubiculum Johanan filii Eliasib, et ingressus est illuc: panem non comedit, et aquam non bibit: lugebat enim transgressionem eorum, qui venerant de captivitate.

verses.text: And proclamation was made in Juda and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should assemble together into Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et missa est vox in Juda et in Jerusalem omnibus filiis transmigrationis, ut congregarentur in Jerusalem:

verses.text: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the ancients, all his substance should be taken away, and he should be cast out of the company of them that were returned from captivity.
verses.textLatin: et omnis qui non venerit in tribus diebus juxta consilium principum et seniorum, auferetur universa substantia ejus, et ipse abjicietur de cœtu transmigrationis.

verses.text: Then all the men of Juda, and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within three days, in the ninth month, the twentieth day of the month: and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of the sin, and the rain.
verses.textLatin: Convenerunt igitur omnes viri Juda et Benjamin in Jerusalem tribus diebus: ipse est mensis nonus, vigesimo die mensis: et sedit omnis populus in platea domus Dei, trementes pro peccato, et pluviis.

verses.text: And Esdras the priest stood up, and said to them: You have transgressed, and taken strange wives, to add to the sins of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et surrexit Esdras sacerdos, et dixit ad eos: Vos transgressi estis, et duxistis uxores alienigenas, ut adderetis super delictum Israël.

verses.text: And now make confession to the Lord the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure, and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from your strange wives.
verses.textLatin: Et nunc date confessionem Domino Deo patrum vestrorum, et facite placitum ejus, et separamini a populis terræ, et ab uxoribus alienigenis.

verses.text: And all the multitude answered and said with a loud voice: According to thy word unto us, so be it done.
verses.textLatin: Et respondit universa multitudo, dixitque voce magna: Juxta verbum tuum ad nos, sic fiat.

verses.text: But as the people are many, and it is time of rain, and we are not able to stand without, and it is not a work of one day or two, (for we have exceedingly sinned in this matter,)
verses.textLatin: Verumtamen quia populus multus est, et tempus pluviæ, et non sustinemus stare foris, et opus non est diei unius vel duorum (vehementer quippe peccavimus in sermone isto),

verses.text: Let rulers be appointed in all the multitude: and in all our cities, let them that have taken strange wives come at the times appointed, and with them the ancients and the judges of every city, until the wrath of our God be turned away from us for this sin.
verses.textLatin: constituantur principes in universa multitudine: et omnes in civitatibus nostris qui duxerunt uxores alienigenas veniant in temporibus statutis, et cum his seniores per civitatem et civitatem, et judices ejus, donec avertatur ira Dei nostri a nobis super peccato hoc.

verses.text: Then Jonathan the son of Azahel, and Jaasia the son of Thecua were appointed over this, and Mesollam and Sebethai, Levites, helped them:
verses.textLatin: Igitur Jonathan filius Azahel, et Jaasia filius Thecue, steterunt super hoc, et Messollam et Sebethai Levites adjuverunt eos:

verses.text: And the children of the captivity did so. And Esdras the priest, and the men heads of the families in the houses of their fathers, and all by their names, went and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.textLatin: feceruntque sic filii transmigrationis. Et abierunt Esdras sacerdos, et viri principes familiarum, in domos patrum suorum, et omnes per nomina sua, et sederunt in die primo mensis decimi ut quærerent rem.

verses.text: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.textLatin: Et consummati sunt omnes viri, qui duxerant uxores alienigenas, usque ad diem primam mensis primi.

verses.text: And there were found among the sons of the priests that had taken strange wives: Of the sons of Josue the son of Josedec, and his brethren, Maasia, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Godolia.
verses.textLatin: Et inventi sunt de filiis sacerdotum qui duxerant uxores alienigenas. De filiis Josue filii Josedec, et fratres ejus, Maasia, et Eliezer, et Jarib, et Godolia.

verses.text: And they gave their hands to put away their wives, and to offer for their offence a ram of the flock.
verses.textLatin: Et dederunt manus suas ut ejicerent uxores suas, et pro delicto suo arietem de ovibus offerrent.

verses.text: And of the sons of Emmer, Hanani, and Zebedia.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Emmer, Hanani, et Zebedia.

verses.text: And of the sons of Harim, Maasia, and Elia, and Semeia, and Jehiel, and Ozias.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Harim, Maasia, et Elia, et Semeia, et Jehiel, et Ozias.

verses.text: And of the sons of Pheshur, Elioenai, Maasia, Ismael, Nathanael, Jozabed, and Elasa.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Pheshur, Elioënai, Maasia, Ismaël, Nathanaël, Jozabed, et Elasa.

verses.text: And of the sons of the Levites, Jozabed, and Semei, and Celaia, the same is Calita, Phataia, Juda, and Eliezer.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Levitarum, Jozabed, et Semei, et Celaia, ipse est Calita, Phataia, Juda, et Eliezer.

verses.text: And of the singing men, Elisiab: and of the porters, Sellum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.textLatin: Et de cantoribus, Eliasib. Et de janitoribus, Sellum, et Telem, et Uri.

verses.text: And of Israel, of the sons of Pharos, Remeia, and Jezia, and Melchia, and Miamin, and Eliezer, and Melchia, and Banea.
verses.textLatin: Et ex Israël, de filiis Pharos, Remeia, et Jesia, et Melchia, et Miamin, et Eliezer, et Melchia, et Banea.

verses.text: And of the sons of Elam, Mathania, Zacharias, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jerimoth, and Elia.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Ælam, Mathania, Zacharias, et Jehiel, et Abdi, et Jerimoth, et Elia.

verses.text: And of the sons of Zethua, Elioenai, Eliasib, Mathania, Jerimuth, and Zabad, and Aziaza.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Zethua, Elioënai, Eliasib, Mathania, et Jerimuth, et Zabad, et Aziza.

verses.text: And of the sons of Babai, Johanan, Hanania, Zabbai, Athalai:
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Bebai, Johanan, Hanania, Zabbai, Athalai.

verses.text: And of the sons of Bani, Mosollam, and Melluch, and Adaia, Jasub, and Saal, and Ramoth.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Bani, Mosollam, et Melluch, et Adaia, Jasub, et Saal, et Ramoth.

verses.text: And of the sons of Phahath, Moab, Edna, and Chalal, Banaias, and Maasias, Mathanias, Beseleel, Bennui, and Manasse.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Phahath Moab, Edna, et Chalal, Banaias, et Maasias, Mathanias, Beseleel, Bennui, et Manasse.

verses.text: And of the sons of Herem, Eliezer, Josue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Herem, Eliezer, Josue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,

verses.text: Benjamin, Maloch, Samarias.
verses.textLatin: Benjamin, Maloch, Samarias.

verses.text: And of the sons of Hasom, Mathanai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jermai, Manasse, Semei.
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis Hasom, Mathanai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jermai, Manasse, Semei.

verses.text: Of the sons of Bani, Maaddi, Amram, and Uel,
verses.textLatin: De filiis Bani, Maadi, Amram, et Vel,

verses.text: Baneas, and Badaias, Cheliau,
verses.textLatin: Baneas, et Badaias, Cheliau,

verses.text: Vania, Marimuth, and Eliasib,
verses.textLatin: Vania, Marimuth, et Eliasib,

verses.text: Mathanias, Mathania, and Jasi,
verses.textLatin: Mathanias, Mathanai, et Jasi,

verses.text: And Bani, and Bennui, Semei,
verses.textLatin: et Bani, et Bennui, Semei,

verses.text: And Salmias, and Nathan, and Adaias,
verses.textLatin: et Salmias, et Nathan, et Adaias,

verses.text: And Mechnedebai, Sisai, Sarai,
verses.textLatin: et Mechnedebai, Sisai, Sarai,

verses.text: Ezrel, and Selemiau, Semeria,
verses.textLatin: Ezrel, et Selemiau, Semeria,

verses.text: Sellum, Amaria, Joseph.
verses.textLatin: Sellum, Amaria, Joseph.

verses.text: Of the sons of Nebo, Jehiel, Mathathias, Zabad, Zabina, Jeddu, and Joel, and Banaia.
verses.textLatin: De filiis Nebo, Jehiel, Mathathias, Zabad, Zabina, Jeddu, et Joël, et Banaia.

verses.text: All these had taken strange wives, and there were among them women that had borne children.
verses.textLatin: Omnes hi acceperant uxores alienigenas, et fuerunt ex eis mulieres, quæ pepererant filios.

verses.text: The  words of Nehemias the son of Helchias. And it came to pass in the month of Casleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in the castle of Susa,
verses.textLatin: Verba Nehemiæ filii Helchiæ. Et factum est in mense Casleu, anno vigesimo, et ego eram in Susis castro.

verses.text: That Hanani one of my brethren came, he and some men of Juda; and I asked them concerning the Jews, that remained and were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et venit Hanani, unus de fratribus meis, ipse et viri ex Juda: et interrogavi eos de Judæis qui remanserant, et supererant de captivitate, et Jerusalem.

verses.text: And they said to me: They that have remained, and are left of the captivity there in the province, are in great affliction, and reproach: and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and the gates thereof are burnt with fire.
verses.textLatin: Et dixerunt mihi: Qui remanserunt, et relicti sunt de captivitate ibi in provincia, in afflictione magna sunt, et in opprobrio: et murus Jerusalem dissipatus est, et portæ ejus combustæ sunt igni.

verses.text: And when I had heard these words, I sat down, and wept, and mourned for many days: and I fasted, and prayed before the face of the God of heaven.
verses.textLatin: Cumque audissem verba hujuscemodi, sedi, et flevi, et luxi diebus multis: jejunabam, et orabam ante faciem Dei cæli:

verses.text: And I said: I beseech thee, O Lord God of heaven, strong, great, and terrible, who keepest covenant and mercy with those that love thee, and keep thy commandments:
verses.textLatin: et dixi: Quæso, Domine Deus cæli fortis, magne atque terribilis, qui custodis pactum et misericordiam cum his qui te diligunt, et custodiunt mandata tua:

verses.text: Let thy ears be attentive, and thy eyes open, to hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, night and day, for the children of Israel thy servants: and I confess the sins of the children of Israel, by which they have sinned against thee: I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.textLatin: fiant aures tuæ auscultantes, et oculi tui aperti, ut audias orationem servi tui, quam ego oro coram te hodie nocte et die pro filiis Israël servis tuis: et confiteor pro peccatis filiorum Israël, quibus peccaverunt tibi: ego et domus patris mei peccavimus,

verses.text: We have been seduced by vanity, and have not kept thy commandments, and ceremonies and judgments, which thou hast commanded thy servant Moses.
verses.textLatin: vanitate seducti sumus, et non custodivimus mandatum tuum, et cæremonias, et judicia quæ præcepisti Moysi famulo tuo.

verses.text: Remember the word that thou commandedst to Moses thy servant, saying: If you shall transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
verses.textLatin: Memento verbi quod mandasti Moysi servo tuo, dicens: Cum transgressi fueritis, ego dispergam vos in populos:

verses.text: But if you return to me, and keep my commandments, and do them, though you should be led away to the uttermost parts of the world, I will gather you from thence, and bring you back to the place which I have chosen for my name to dwell there.
verses.textLatin: et si revertamini ad me, et custodiatis præcepta mea, et faciatis ea: etiamsi abducti fueritis ad extrema cæli, inde congregabo vos, et reducam in locum quem elegi ut habitaret nomen meum ibi.

verses.text: And these are thy servants, and thy people: whom thou hast redeemed by thy great strength, and by thy mighty hand.
verses.textLatin: Et ipsi servi tui, et populus tuus, quos redemisti in fortitudine tua magna, et in manu tua valida.

verses.text: I beseech thee, O Lord, let thy ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants who desire to fear thy name: and direct thy servant this day, and give him mercy before this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.
verses.textLatin: Obsecro, Domine, sit auris tua attendens ad orationem servi tui, et ad orationem servorum tuorum, qui volunt timere nomen tuum: et dirige servum tuum hodie, et da ei misericordiam ante virum hunc. Ego enim eram pincerna regis.

verses.text: And  it came to pass in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king: that wine was before him, and I took up the wine, and gave it to the king: and I was as one languishing away before his face.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem in mense Nisan, anno vigesimo Artaxerxis regis: et vinum erat ante eum, et levavi vinum, et dedi regi: et eram quasi languidus ante faciem ejus.

verses.text: And the king said to me: Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou dost not appear to be sick? this is not without cause, but some evil, I know not what, is in thy heart. And I was seized with an exceeding great fear:
verses.textLatin: Dixitque mihi rex: Quare vultus tuus tristis est, cum te ægrotum non videam? non est hoc frustra, sed malum nescio quod in corde tuo est. Et timui valde, ac nimis:

verses.text: And I said to the king: O king, live for ever: why should not my countenance be sorrowful, seeing the city of the place of the sepulchres of my fathers is desolate, and the gates thereof are burnt with fire?
verses.textLatin: et dixi regi: Rex, in æternum vive: quare non mœreat vultus meus, quia civitas domus sepulchrorum patris mei deserta est, et portæ ejus combustæ sunt igni?

verses.text: Then the king said to me: For what dost thou make request? And I prayed to the God of heaven,
verses.textLatin: Et ait mihi rex: Pro qua re postulas? Et oravi Deum cæli,

verses.text: And I said to the king: If it seem good to the king, and if thy servant hath found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldst send me into Judea to the city of the sepulchre of my father, and I will build it.
verses.textLatin: et dixi ad regem: Si videtur regi bonum, et si placet servus tuus ante faciem tuam, ut mittas me in Judæam ad civitatem sepulchri patris mei, et ædificabo eam.

verses.text: And the king said to me, and the queen that sat by him: For how long shall thy journey be, and when wilt thou return? And it pleased the king, and he sent me: and I fixed him a time.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque mihi rex, et regina quæ sedebat juxta eum: Usque ad quod tempus erit iter tuum, et quando reverteris? Et placuit ante vultum regis, et misit me: et constitui ei tempus.

verses.text: And I said to the king: If it seem good to the king, let him give me letters to the governors of the country beyond the river, that they convey me over, till I come into Judea:
verses.textLatin: Et dixi regi: Si regi videtur bonum, epistolas det mihi ad duces regionis trans flumen, ut traducant me, donec veniam in Judæam:

verses.text: And a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, to give me timber that I may cover the gates of the tower of the house, and the walls of the city, and the house that I shall enter into. And the king gave me according to the good hand of my God with me.
verses.textLatin: et epistolam ad Asaph custodem saltus regis, ut det mihi ligna, ut tegere possim portas turris domus, et muros civitatis, et domum quam ingressus fuero. Et dedit mihi rex juxta manum Dei mei bonam mecum.

verses.text: And I came to the governors of the country beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. And the king had sent with me captains of soldiers, and horsemen.
verses.textLatin: Et veni ad duces regionis trans flumen, dedique eis epistolas regis. Miserat autem rex mecum principes militum, et equites.

verses.text: And Sanaballat the Horonite, and Tobias the servant, the Ammonite, heard it, and it grieved them exceedingly, that a man was come, who sought the prosperity of the children of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et audierunt Sanaballat Horonites, et Tobias servus Ammanites: et contristati sunt afflictione magna, quod venisset homo qui quæreret prosperitatem filiorum Israël.

verses.text: And I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.textLatin: Et veni Jerusalem, et eram ibi tribus diebus.

verses.text: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me, and I told not any man what God had put in my heart to do in Jerusalem, and there was no beast with me, but the beast that I rode upon.
verses.textLatin: Et surrexi nocte ego, et viri pauci mecum, et non indicavi cuiquam quid Deus dedisset in corde meo ut facerem in Jerusalem: et jumentum non erat mecum, nisi animal cui sedebam.

verses.text: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, and before the dragon fountain, and to the dung gate, and I viewed the wall of Jerusalem which was broken down, and the gates thereof which were consumed with fire.
verses.textLatin: Et egressus sum per portam vallis nocte, et ante fontem draconis, et ad portam stercoris, et considerabam murum Jerusalem dissipatum, et portas ejus consumptas igni.

verses.text: And I passed to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s aqueduct, and there was no place for the beast on which I rode to pass.
verses.textLatin: Et transivi ad portam fontis, et ad aquæductum regis, et non erat locus jumento cui sedebam ut transiret.

verses.text: And I went up in the night by the torrent, and viewed the wall, and going back I came to the gate of the valley, and returned.
verses.textLatin: Et ascendi per torrentem nocte, et considerabam murum, et reversus veni ad portam vallis, et redii.

verses.text: But the magistrates knew not whither I went, or what I did: neither had I as yet told any thing to the Jews, or to the priests, or to the nobles, or to the magistrates, or to the rest that did the work.
verses.textLatin: Magistratus autem nesciebant quo abiissem, aut quid ego facerem: sed et Judæis, et sacerdotibus, et optimatibus, et magistratibus, et reliquis qui faciebant opus, usque ad id loci nihil indicaveram.

verses.text: Then I said to them: You know the affliction wherein we are, because Jerusalem is desolate, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire: come, and let us build up the walls of Jerusalem, and let us be no longer a reproach.
verses.textLatin: Et dixi eis: Vos nostis afflictionem in qua sumus: quia Jerusalem deserta est, et portæ ejus consumptæ sunt igni: venite, et ædificemus muros Jerusalem, et non simus ultra opprobrium.

verses.text: And I shewed them how the hand of my God was good with me, and the king’s words, which he had spoken to me, and I said: Let us rise up, and build. And their hands were strengthened in good.
verses.textLatin: Et indicavi eis manum Dei mei, quod esset bona mecum, et verba regis quæ locutus esset mihi, et aio: Surgamus, et ædificemus. Et confortatæ sunt manus eorum in bono.

verses.text: But Sanaballat the Horonite, and Tobias the servant, the Ammonite, and Gossem the Arabian heard of it, and they scoffed at us, and despised us, and said: What is this thing that you do? are you going to rebel against the king?
verses.textLatin: Audierunt autem Sanaballat Horonites, et Tobias servus Ammanites, et Gosem Arabs, et subsannaverunt nos, et despexerunt, dixeruntque: Quæ est hæc res quam facitis? numquid contra regem vos rebellatis?

verses.text: And I answered them, and said to them: The God of heaven he helpeth us, and we are his servants: let us rise up and build: but you have no part, nor justice, nor remembrance in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et reddidi eis sermonem, dixique ad eos: Deus cæli ipse nos juvat, et nos servi ejus sumus: surgamus et ædificemus: vobis autem non est pars, et justitia, et memoria in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Then  Eliasib the high priest arose, and his brethren the priests, and they built the flock gate: they sanctified it, and set up the doors thereof, even unto the tower of a hundred cubits they sanctified it unto the tower of Hananeel.
verses.textLatin: Et surrexit Eliasib sacerdos magnus, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, et ædificaverunt portam gregis: ipsi sanctificaverunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et usque ad turrim centum cubitorum sanctificaverunt eam, usque ad turrim Hananeel.

verses.text: And next to him the men of Jericho built: and next to them built Zachur the son of Amri.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificaverunt viri Jericho: et juxta eum ædificavit Zachur filius Amri.

verses.text: But the fish gate the sons of Asnaa built: they covered it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars. And next to them built Marimuth the son of Urias the son of Accus.
verses.textLatin: Portam autem piscium ædificaverunt filii Asnaa: ipsi texerunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes. Et juxta eos ædificavit Marimuth filius Uriæ, filii Accus.

verses.text: And next to him built Mosollam the son of Barachias, the son of Merezebel, and next to them built Sadoc the son of Baana.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ, filii Mesezebel: et juxta eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Baana.

verses.text: And next to them the Thecuites built: but their great men did not put their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Thecueni: optimates autem eorum non supposuerunt colla sua in opere Domini sui.

verses.text: And Joiada the son of Phasea, and Mosollam the son of Besodia built the old gate: they covered it and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars.
verses.textLatin: Et portam veterem ædificaverunt Jojada filius Phasea, et Mosollam filius Besodia: ipsi texerunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.

verses.text: And next to them built Meltias the Gabaonite, and Jadon the Meronathite, the men of Gabaon and Maspha, for the governor that was in the country beyond the river.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Meltias Gabaonites, et Jadon Meronathites, viri de Gabaon et Maspha, pro duce qui erat in regione trans flumen.

verses.text: And next to him built Eziel the son of Araia the goldsmith: and next to him built Ananias the son of the perfumer: and they left Jerusalem unto the wall of the broad street.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificavit Eziel filius Araia aurifex: et juxta eum ædificavit Ananias filius pigmentarii: et dimiserunt Jerusalem usque ad murum plateæ latioris.

verses.text: And next to him built Raphaia the son of Hur, lord of the street of Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificavit Raphaia filius Hur, princeps vici Jerusalem.

verses.text: And next to him Jedaia the son of Haromaph over against his own house: and next to him built Hattus the son of Hasebonia.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificavit Jedaia filius Haromaph contra domum suam: et juxta eum ædificavit Hattus filius Haseboniæ.

verses.text: Melchias the son of Herem, and Hasub the son of Phahath Moab, built half the street, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.textLatin: Mediam partem vici ædificavit Melchias filius Herem, et Hasub filius Phahath Moab, et turrim furnorum.

verses.text: And next to him built Sellum the son of Alohes, lord of half the street of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.textLatin: Et juxta eum ædificavit Sellum filius Alohes, princeps mediæ partis vici Jerusalem, ipse et filiæ ejus.

verses.text: And the gate of the valley Hanun built, and the inhabitants of Zanoe: they built it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars, and a thousand cubits in the wall unto the gate of the dunghill.
verses.textLatin: Et portam vallis ædificavit Hanun, et habitatores Zanoë: ipsi ædificaverunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes, et mille cubitos in muro usque ad portam sterquilinii.

verses.text: And the gate of the dunghill Melchias the son of Rechab built, lord of the street of Bethacharam: he built it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars.
verses.textLatin: Et portam sterquilinii ædificavit Melchias filius Rechab, princeps vici Bethacharam: ipse ædificavit eam, et statuit valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.

verses.text: And the gate of the fountain Sellum the son of Cholhoza built, lord of the street of Maspha: he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars, and the walls of the pool of Siloe unto the king’s guard, and unto the steps that go down from the city of David.
verses.textLatin: Et portam fontis ædificavit Sellum filius Cholhoza, princeps pagi Maspha: ipse ædificavit eam, et texit, et statuit valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes, et muros piscinæ Siloë in hortum regis, et usque ad gradus qui descendunt de civitate David.

verses.text: After him built Nehemias the son of Azboc, lord of half the street of Bethsur, as far as over against the sepulchre of David, and to the pool, that was built with great labour, and to the house of the mighty.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificavit Nehemias filius Azboc, princeps dimidiæ partis vici Bethsur, usque contra sepulchrum David, et usque ad piscinam quæ grandi opere constructa est, et usque ad domum fortium.

verses.text: After him built the Levites, Rehum the son of Benni. After him built Hasebias, lord of half the street of Ceila in his own street.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificaverunt Levitæ, Rehum filius Benni: post eum ædificavit Hasebias princeps dimidiæ partis vici Ceilæ in vico suo.

verses.text: After him built their brethren Bavai the son of Enadad, lord of half Ceila.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificaverunt fratres eorum: Bavai filius Enadad, princeps dimidiæ partis Ceilæ:

verses.text: And next to him Aser the son of Josue, lord of Maspha, built another measure, over against the going up of the strong corner.
verses.textLatin: et ædificavit juxta eum Azer filius Josue, princeps Maspha, mensuram secundam, contra ascensum firmissimi anguli.

verses.text: After him in the mount Baruch the son of Zachai built another measure, from the corner to the door of the house of Eliasib the high priest.
verses.textLatin: Post eum in monte ædificavit Baruch filius Zachai mensuram secundam, ab angulo usque ad portam domus Eliasib sacerdotis magni.

verses.text: After him Merimuth the son of Urias the son of Haccus, built another measure, from the door of the house of Eliasib, to the end of the house of Eliasib.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificavit Merimuth filius Uriæ filii Haccus, mensuram secundam, a porta domus Eliasib, donec extenderetur domus Eliasib.

verses.text: And after him built the priests, the men of the plains of the Jordan.
verses.textLatin: Et post eum ædificaverunt sacerdotes, viri de campestribus Jordanis.

verses.text: After him built Benjamin and Hasub, over against their own house: and after him built Azarias the son of Maasias the son of Ananias over against his house.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificavit Benjamin et Hasub contra domum suam: et post eum ædificavit Azarias filius Maasiæ filii Ananiæ contra domum suam.

verses.text: After him built Bennui the son of Hanadad another measure, from the house of Azarias unto the bending, and unto the corner.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificavit Bennui filius Henadad mensuram secundam, a domo Azariæ usque ad flexuram, et usque ad angulum.

verses.text: Phalel, the son of Ozi, over against the bending and the tower, which lieth out from the king’s high house, that is, in the court of the prison: after him Phadaia the son of Pharos.
verses.textLatin: Phalel filius Ozi contra flexuram, et turrim quæ eminet de domo regis excelsa, id est, in atrio carceris: post eum Phadaia filius Pharos.

verses.text: And the Nathinites dwelt in Ophel, as far as over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stood out.
verses.textLatin: Nathinæi autem habitabant in Ophel usque contra portam aquarum ad orientem, et turrim quæ prominebat.

verses.text: After him the Thecuites built another measure over against, from the great tower that standeth out unto the wall of the temple.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificaverunt Thecueni mensuram secundam e regione, a turre magna et eminente usque ad murum templi.

verses.text: And upward from the horse gate the priests built, every man over against his house.
verses.textLatin: Sursum autem a porta equorum ædificaverunt sacerdotes, unusquisque contra domum suam.

verses.text: After them built Sadoc the son of Emmer over against his house. And after him built Semaia the son of Sechenias, keeper of the east gate.
verses.textLatin: Post eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Emmer contra domum suam. Et post eum ædificavit Semaia filius Secheniæ, custos portæ orientalis.

verses.text: After him built Hanania the son of Selemia, and Hanun the sixth son of Seleph, another measure: after him built Mosollam the son of Barachias over against his treasury. After him Melcias the goldsmith’s son built unto the house of the Nathinites, and of the sellers of small wares, over against the judgment gate, and unto the chamber of the corner.
verses.textLatin: Post eum ædificavit Hanania filius Selemiæ, et Hanun filius Seleph sextus, mensuram secundam: post eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ, contra gazophylacium suum. Post eum ædificavit Melchias filius aurificis usque ad domum Nathinæorum, et scruta vendentium contra portam judicialem, et usque ad cœnaculum anguli.

verses.text: And within the chamber of the corner of the flock gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants built.
verses.textLatin: Et inter cœnaculum anguli in porta gregis, ædificaverunt aurifices et negotiatores.

verses.text: And  it came to pass, that when Sanaballat heard that we were building the wall he was angry: and being moved exceedingly he scoffed at the Jews.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat quod ædificaremus murum, iratus est valde: et motus nimis subsannavit Judæos,

verses.text: And said before his brethren, and the multitude of the Samaritans: What are the silly Jews doing? Will the Gentiles let them alone? will they sacrifice and make an end in a day? are they able to raise stones out of the heaps of the rubbish, which are burnt?
verses.textLatin: et dixit coram fratribus suis, et frequentia Samaritanorum: Quid Judæi faciunt imbecilles? num dimittent eos gentes? num sacrificabunt, et complebunt in una die? numquid ædificare poterunt lapides de acervis pulveris, qui combusti sunt?

verses.text: Tobias also the Ammonite who was by him said: Let them build: if a fox go up, he will leap over their stone wall.
verses.textLatin: Sed et Tobias Ammanites, proximus ejus, ait: Ædificent: si ascenderit vulpes, transiliet murum eorum lapideum.

verses.text: Hear thou our God, for we are despised: turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them to be despised in a land of captivity.
verses.textLatin: Audi, Deus noster, quia facti sumus despectui: converte opprobrium super caput eorum, et da eos in despectionem in terra captivitatis.

verses.text: Cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thy face, because they have mocked thy builders.
verses.textLatin: Ne operias iniquitatem eorum, et peccatum eorum coram facie tua non deleatur, quia irriserunt ædificantes.

verses.text: So we built the wall, and joined it all together unto the half thereof: and the heart of the people was excited to work.
verses.textLatin: Itaque ædificavimus murum, et conjunximus totum usque ad partem dimidiam: et provocatum est cor populi ad operandum.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when Sanaballat, and Tobias, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Azotians heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and the breaches began to be closed, that they were exceedingly angry.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat, et Tobias, et Arabes, et Ammanitæ, et Azotii, quod obducta esset cicatrix muri Jerusalem, et quod cœpissent interrupta concludi, irati sunt nimis.

verses.text: And they all assembled themselves together, to come, and to fight against Jerusalem, and to prepare ambushes.
verses.textLatin: Et congregati sunt omnes pariter ut venirent, et pugnarent contra Jerusalem, et molirentur insidias.

verses.text: And we prayed to our God, and set watchmen upon the wall day and night against them.
verses.textLatin: Et oravimus Deum nostrum, et posuimus custodes super murum die ac nocte contra eos.

verses.text: And Juda said: The strength of the bearer of burdens is decayed, and the rubbish is very much, and we shall not be able to build the wall.
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Judas: Debilitata est fortitudo portantis, et humus nimia est, et nos non poterimus ædificare murum.

verses.text: And our enemies said: Let them not know, nor understand, till we come in the midst of them, and kill them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.textLatin: Et dixerunt hostes nostri: Nesciant, et ignorent donec veniamus in medium eorum, et interficiamus eos, et cessare faciamus opus.

verses.text: And it came to pass, that when the Jews that dwelt by them came and told us ten times, out of all the places from whence they came to us,
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem venientibus Judæis qui habitabant juxta eos, et dicentibus nobis per decem vices, ex omnibus locis quibus venerant ad nos,

verses.text: I set the people in the place behind the wall round about in order, with their swords, and spears, and bows.
verses.textLatin: statui in loco post murum per circuitum populum in ordinem cum gladiis suis, et lanceis, et arcubus.

verses.text: And I looked and rose up: and I said to the chief men and the magistrates, and to the rest of the common people: be not afraid of them. Remember the Lord who is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, and your wives, and your houses.
verses.textLatin: Et perspexi atque surrexi: et aio ad optimates et magistratus, et ad reliquam partem vulgi: Nolite timere a facie eorum: Domini magni et terribilis mementote, et pugnate pro fratribus vestris, filiis vestris, et filiabus vestris, et uxoribus vestris, et domibus vestris.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that the thing had been told us, that God defeated their counsel. And we returned all of us to the walls, every man to his work.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum audissent inimici nostri nuntiatum esse nobis, dissipavit Deus consilium eorum. Et reversi sumus omnes ad muros, unusquisque ad opus suum.

verses.text: And it came to pass from that day forward, that half of their young men did the work, and half were ready for to fight, with spears, and shields, and bows, and coats of mail, and the rulers were behind them in all the house of Juda.
verses.textLatin: Et factum est a die illa, media pars juvenum eorum faciebat opus, et media parata erat ad bellum: et lanceæ, et scuta, et arcus, et loricæ, et principes post eos in omni domo Juda.

verses.text: Of them that built on the wall and that carried burdens, and that laded: with one of his hands he did the work, and with the other he held a sword.
verses.textLatin: Ædificantium in muro, et portantium onera, et imponentium: una manu sua faciebat opus, et altera tenebat gladium:

verses.text: For every one of the builders was girded with a sword about his reins. And they built, and sounded with a trumpet by me.
verses.textLatin: ædificentium enim unusquisque gladio erat accinctus renes. Et ædificabant, et clangebant buccina juxta me.

verses.text: And I said to the nobles, and to the magistrates, and to the rest of the common people: The work is great and wide, and we are separated on the wall one far from another:
verses.textLatin: Et dixi ad optimates, et ad magistratus, et ad reliquam partem vulgi: Opus grande est et latum, et nos separati sumus in muro procul alter ab altero:

verses.text: In what place soever you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, run all thither unto us: our God will fight for us.
verses.textLatin: in loco quocumque audieritis clangorem tubæ, illuc concurrite ad nos: Deus noster pugnabit pro nobis.

verses.text: And let us do the work: and let one half of us hold our spears from the rising of the morning, till the stars appear.
verses.textLatin: Et nos ipsi faciamus opus, et media pars nostrum teneat lanceas ab ascensu auroræ donec egrediantur astra.

verses.text: At that time also I said to the people: Let every one with his servant stay in the midst of Jerusalem, and let us take our turns in the night, and by day, to work.
verses.textLatin: In tempore quoque illo dixi populo: Unusquisque cum puero suo maneat in medio Jerusalem, et sint nobis vices per noctem et diem ad operandum.

verses.text: Now I and my brethren, and my servants, and the watchmen that followed me, did not put off our clothes: only every man stripped himself when he was to be washed.
verses.textLatin: Ego autem et fratres mei, et pueri mei, et custodes, qui erant post me, non deponebamus vestimenta nostra: unusquisque tantum nudabatur ad baptismum.

verses.text: Now  there was a great cry of the people, and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.textLatin: Et factus est clamor populi et uxorum ejus magnus adversus fratres suos Judæos.

verses.text: And there were some that said: Our sons and our daughters are very many: let us take up corn for the price of them, and let us eat and live.
verses.textLatin: Et erant qui dicerent: Filii nostri et filiæ nostræ multæ sunt nimis: accipiamus pro pretio eorum frumentum, et comedamus, et vivamus.

verses.text: And there were some that said: Let us mortgage our lands, and our vineyards, and our houses, and let us take corn because of the famine.
verses.textLatin: Et erant qui dicerent: Agros nostros, et vineas, et domus nostras opponamus, et accipiamus frumentum in fame.

verses.text: And others said: Let us borrow money for the king’s tribute, and let us give up our fields and vineyards:
verses.textLatin: Et alii dicebant: Mutuo sumamus pecunias in tributa regis, demusque agros nostros et vineas:

verses.text: And now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren: and our children as their children. Behold we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters, and some of our daughters are bondwomen already, neither have we wherewith to redeem them, and our fields and our vineyards other men possess.
verses.textLatin: et nunc sicut carnes fratrum nostrorum, sic carnes nostræ sunt: et sicut filii eorum, ita et filii nostri: ecce nos subjugamus filios nostros et filias nostras in servitutem, et de filiabus nostris sunt famulæ, nec habemus unde possint redimi: et agros nostros et vineas nostras alii possident.

verses.text: And I was exceedingly angry when I heard their cry according to these words.
verses.textLatin: Et iratus sum nimis cum audissem clamorem eorum secundum verba hæc:

verses.text: And my heart thought with myself: and I rebuked the nobles and magistrates, and said to them: Do you every one exact usury of your brethren? And I gathered together a great assembly against them,
verses.textLatin: cogitavitque cor meum mecum, et increpavi optimates et magistratus, et dixi eis: Usurasne singuli a fratribus vestris exigitis? Et congregavi adversum eos concionem magnam,

verses.text: And I said to them: We, as you know, have redeemed according to our ability our brethren the Jews, that were sold to the Gentiles: and will you then sell your brethren, for us to redeem them? And they held their peace, and found not what to answer.
verses.textLatin: et dixi eis: Nos, ut scitis, redemimus fratres nostros Judæos, qui venditi fuerant gentibus secundum possibilitatem nostram: et vos igitur vendetis fratres vestros, et redimemus eos? Et siluerunt, nec invenerunt quid responderent.

verses.text: And I said to them: The thing you do is not good: why walk you not in the fear of our God, that we be not exposed to the reproaches of the Gentiles our enemies?
verses.textLatin: Dixique ad eos: Non est bona res quam facitis: quare non in timore Dei nostri ambulastis, ne exprobretur nobis a gentibus inimicis nostris?

verses.text: Both I and my brethren, and my servants, have lent money and corn to many: let us all agree not to call for it again; let us forgive the debt that is owing to us.
verses.textLatin: Et ego, et fratres mei, et pueri mei commodavimus plurimis pecuniam et frumentum. Non repetamus in commune istud: æs alienum concedamus quod debetur nobis.

verses.text: Restore ye to them this day their fields, and their vineyards, and their oliveyards, and their houses: and the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, which you were wont to exact of them, give it rather for them.
verses.textLatin: Reddite eis hodie agros suos, et vineas suas, et oliveta sua, et domos suas: quin potius et centesimum pecuniæ, frumenti, vini et olei, quam exigere soletis ab eis, date pro illis.

verses.text: And they said: We will restore, and we will require nothing of them: and we will do as thou sayest. And I called the priests and took an oath of them, to do according to what I had said.
verses.textLatin: Et dixerunt: Reddemus, et ab eis nihil quæremus: sicque faciemus ut loqueris. Et vocavi sacerdotes, et adjuravi eos ut facerent juxta quod dixeram.

verses.text: Moreover I shook my lap, and said: So may God shake every man that shall not accomplish this word, out of his house, and out of his labours, thus may he be shaken out, and become empty. And all the multitude said: Amen. And they praised God. And the people did according to what was said.
verses.textLatin: Insuper excussi sinum meum, et dixi: Sic excutiat Deus omnem virum qui non compleverit verbum istud, de domo sua, et de laboribus suis: sic excutiatur, et vacuus fiat. Et dixit universa multitudo: Amen: et laudaverunt Deum. Fecit ergo populus sicut erat dictum.

verses.text: And from the day, in which the king commanded me to be governor in the land of Juda, from the twentieth year even to the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, for twelve years, I and my brethren did not eat the yearly allowance that was due to the governors.
verses.textLatin: A die autem illa, qua præceperat rex mihi ut essem dux in terra Juda, ab anno vigesimo usque ad annum trigesimum secundum Artaxerxis regis per annos duodecim, ego et fratres mei annonas quæ ducibus debebantur non comedimus.

verses.text: But the former governors that had been before me, were chargeable to the people, and took of them in bread, and wine, and in money every day forty sicles: and their officers also oppressed the people. But I did not so for the fear of God.
verses.textLatin: Duces autem primi, qui fuerant ante me, gravaverunt populum, et acceperunt ab eis in pane, et vino, et pecunia, quotidie siclos quadraginta: sed et ministri eorum depresserunt populum. Ego autem non feci ita propter timorem Dei:

verses.text: Moreover I built in the work of the wall, and I bought no land, and all my servants were gathered together to the work.
verses.textLatin: quin potius in opere muri ædificavi, et agrum non emi, et omnes pueri mei congregati ad opus erant.

verses.text: The Jews also and the magistrates to the number of one hundred and fifty men, were at my table, besides them that came to us from among the nations that were round about us.
verses.textLatin: Judæi quoque et magistratus centum quinquaginta viri, et qui veniebant ad nos de gentibus quæ in circuitu nostro sunt, in mensa mea erant.

verses.text: And there was prepared for me day by day one ox, and six choice rams, besides fowls, and once in ten days I gave store of divers wines, and many other things: yet I did not require my yearly allowance as governor: for the people were very much impoverished.
verses.textLatin: Parabatur autem mihi per dies singulos bos unus, arietes sex electi, exceptis volatilibus, et inter dies decem vina diversa, et alia multa tribuebam: insuper et annonas ducatus mei non quæsivi: valde enim attenuatus erat populus.

verses.text: Remember me, O my God, for good according to all that I have done for this people.
verses.textLatin: Memento mei, Deus meus, in bonum, secundum omnia quæ feci populo huic.

verses.text: And  it came to pass, when Sanaballat, and Tobias, and Gossem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it, (though at that time I had not set up the doors in the gates,)
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat, et Tobias, et Gossem Arabs, et ceteri inimici nostri, quod ædificassem ego murum, et non esset in ipso residua interruptio (usque ad tempus autem illud valvas non posueram in portis),

verses.text: Sanaballat and Gossem sent to me, saying: Come, and let us make a league together in the villages, in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.textLatin: miserunt Sanaballat et Gossem ad me, dicentes: Veni, et percutiamus fœdus pariter in viculis in campo Ono. Ipsi autem cogitabant ut facerent mihi malum.

verses.text: And I sent messengers to them, saying: I am doing a great work, and I cannot come down, lest it be neglected whilst I come, and go down to you.
verses.textLatin: Misi ergo ad eos nuntios, dicens: Opus grande ego facio, et non possum descendere, ne forte negligatur cum venero, et descendero ad vos.

verses.text: And they sent to me according to this word, four times: and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.textLatin: Miserunt autem ad me secundum verbum hoc per quatuor vices: et respondi eis juxta sermonem priorem.

verses.text: And Sanaballat sent his servant to me the fifth time according to the former word, and he had a letter in his hand written in this manner:
verses.textLatin: Et misit ad me Sanaballat juxta verbum prius quinta vice puerum suum, et epistolam habebat in manu sua scriptam hoc modo:

verses.text: It is reported amongst the Gentiles, and Gossem hath said it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel, and therefore thou buildest the wall, and hast a mind to set thyself king over them: for which end
verses.textLatin: In gentibus auditum est, et Gossem dixit, quod tu et Judæi cogitetis rebellare, et propterea ædifices murum, et levare te velis super eos regem: propter quam causam

verses.text: Thou hast also set up prophets, to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying: There is a king in Judea. The king will hear of these things: therefore come now, that we may take counsel together.
verses.textLatin: et prophetas posueris, qui prædicent de te in Jerusalem, dicentes: Rex in Judæa est. Auditurus est rex verba hæc: idcirco nunc veni, ut ineamus consilium pariter.

verses.text: And I sent to them, saying: There is no such thing done as thou sayest: but thou feignest these things out of thy own heart.
verses.textLatin: Et misi ad eos, dicens: Non est factum secundum verba hæc, quæ tu loqueris: de corde enim tuo tu componis hæc.

verses.text: For all these men thought to frighten us, thinking that our hands would cease from the work, and that we would leave off. Wherefore I strengthened my hands the more:
verses.textLatin: Omnes enim hi terrebant nos, cogitantes quod cessarent manus nostræ ab opere, et quiesceremus: quam ob causam magis confortavi manus meas.

verses.text: And I went into the house of Samaia the son of Delaia, the son of Metabeel privately. And he said: Let us consult together in the house of God in the midst of the temple: and let us shut the doors of the temple, for they will come to kill thee, and in the night they will come to slay thee.
verses.textLatin: Et ingressus sum domum Semaiæ filii Dalaiæ filii Metabeel secreto. Qui ait: Tractemus nobiscum in domo Dei in medio templi, et claudamus portas ædis: quia venturi sunt ut interficiant te, et nocte venturi sunt ad occidendum te.

verses.text: And I said: Should such a man as I flee? and who is there that being as I am, would go into the temple, to save his life? I will not go in.
verses.textLatin: Et dixi: Num quisquam similis mei fugit? et quis ut ego ingredietur templum, et vivet? non ingrediar.

verses.text: And I understood that God had not sent him, but that he had spoken to me as if he had been prophesying, and Tobias, and Sanaballat had hired him.
verses.textLatin: Et intellexi quod Deus non misisset eum, sed quasi vaticinans locutus esset ad me, et Tobias et Sanaballat conduxissent eum.

verses.text: For he had taken money, that I being afraid should do this thing, and sin, and they might have some evil to upbraid me withal.
verses.textLatin: Acceperat enim pretium, ut territus facerem, et peccarem, et haberent malum quod exprobrarent mihi.

verses.text: Remember me, O Lord, for Tobias and Sanaballat, according to their works of this kind: and Noadias the prophet, and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.
verses.textLatin: Memento mei, Domine, pro Tobia et Sanaballat, juxta opera eorum talia: sed et Noadiæ prophetæ, et ceterorum prophetarum, qui terrebant me.

verses.text: But the wall was finished the five and twentieth day of the month of Elul, in two and fifty days.
verses.textLatin: Completus est autem murus vigesimo quinto die mensis Elul, quinquaginta duobus diebus.

verses.text: And it came to pass when all our enemies heard of it, that all nations which were round about us, were afraid, and were cast down within themselves, for they perceived that this work was the work of God.
verses.textLatin: Factum est ergo cum audissent omnes inimici nostri, ut timerent universæ gentes quæ erant in circuitu nostro, et conciderent intra semetipsos, et scirent quod a Deo factum esset opus hoc.

verses.text: Moreover in those days many letters were sent by the principal men of the Jews to Tobias, and from Tobias there came letters to them.
verses.textLatin: Sed et in diebus illis multæ optimatum Judæorum epistolæ mittebantur ad Tobiam, et a Tobia veniebant ad eos.

verses.text: For there were many in Judea sworn to him, because he was the son in law of Sechenias the son of Area, and Johanan his son had taken to wife the daughter of Mosollam the son of Barachias.
verses.textLatin: Multi enim erant in Judæa habentes juramentum ejus, quia gener erat Secheniæ filii Area, et Johanan filius ejus acceperat filiam Mosollam filii Barachiæ:

verses.text: And they praised him also before me, and they related my words to him: And Tobias sent letters to put me in fear.
verses.textLatin: sed et laudabant eum coram me, et verba mea nuntiabant ei: et Tobias mittebat epistolas ut terreret me.

verses.text: Now  after the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and numbered the porters and singing men, and Levites:
verses.textLatin: Postquam autem ædificatus est murus, et posui valvas, et recensui janitores, et cantores, et Levitas,

verses.text: I commanded Hanani my brother, and Hananias ruler of the house of Jerusalem, (for he seemed as a sincere man, and one that feared God above the rest,)
verses.textLatin: præcepi Hanani fratri meo, et Hananiæ principi domus de Jerusalem (ipse enim quasi vir verax et timens Deum plus ceteris videbatur),

verses.text: And I said to them: Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened till the sun be hot. And while they were yet standing by, the gates were shut, and barred: and I set watchmen of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one by their courses, and every man over against his house.
verses.textLatin: et dixi eis: Non aperiantur portæ Jerusalem usque ad calorem solis. Cumque adhuc assisterent, clausæ portæ sunt, et oppilatæ: et posui custodes de habitatoribus Jerusalem, singulos per vices suas, et unumquemque contra domum suam.

verses.text: And the city was very wide and great, and the people few in the midst thereof, and the houses were not built.
verses.textLatin: Civitas autem erat lata nimis et grandis, et populus parvus in medio ejus, et non erant domus ædificatæ.

verses.text: But God had put in my heart, and I assembled the princes and magistrates, and common people, to number them: and I found a book of the number of them who came up at first, and therein it was found written:
verses.textLatin: Deus autem dedit in corde meo, et congregavi optimates, et magistratus, et vulgus, ut recenserem eos: et inveni librum census eorum qui ascenderant primum, et inventum est scriptum in eo.

verses.text: These are the children of the province, who came up from the captivity of them that had been carried away, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned into Judea, every one into his own city.
verses.textLatin: Isti filii provinciæ, qui ascenderunt de captivitate migrantium, quos transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et reversi sunt in Jerusalem et in Judæam, unusquisque in civitatem suam.

verses.text: Who came with Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardochai, Belsam, Mespharath, Begoia, Nahum, Baana. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.textLatin: Qui venerunt cum Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardochæus, Belsam, Mespharath, Begoai, Nahum, Baana. Numerus virorum populi Israël:

verses.text: The children of Pharos, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
verses.textLatin: filii Pharos, duo millia centum septuaginta duo:

verses.text: The children of Sephatia, three hundred seventy-two.
verses.textLatin: filii Saphatia, trecenti septuaginta duo:

verses.text: The children of Area, six hundred fifty-two.
verses.textLatin: filii Area, sexcenti quinquaginta duo:

verses.text: The children of Phahath Moab of the children of Josue and Joab, two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
verses.textLatin: filii Phahathmoab filiorum Josue et Joab, duo millia octingenti decem et octo:

verses.text: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
verses.textLatin: filii Ælam, mille ducenti quinquaginta quatuor:

verses.text: The children of Zethua, eight hundred forty-five.
verses.textLatin: filii Zethua, octingenti quadraginta quinque:

verses.text: The children of Zachai, seven hundred sixty.
verses.textLatin: filii Zachai, septingenti sexaginta:

verses.text: The children of Bannui, six hundred forty-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Bannui, sexcenti quadraginta octo:

verses.text: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Bebai, sexcenti viginti octo:

verses.text: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
verses.textLatin: filii Azgad, duo millia trecenti viginti duo:

verses.text: The children of Adonicam, six hundred sixty-seven.
verses.textLatin: filii Adonicam, sexcenti sexaginta septem:

verses.text: The children of Beguai, two thousand sixty-seven.
verses.textLatin: filii Beguai, duo millia sexaginta septem:

verses.text: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty-five.
verses.textLatin: filii Adin, sexcenti quinquaginta quinque:

verses.text: The children of Ater, children of Hezechias, ninety-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Ater, filii Hezeciæ, nonaginta octo:

verses.text: The children of Hasem, three hundred twenty-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Hasem, trecenti viginti octo:

verses.text: The children of Besai, three hundred twenty-four.
verses.textLatin: filii Besai, trecenti viginti quatuor:

verses.text: The children of Hareph, a hundred and twelve.
verses.textLatin: filii Hareph, centum duodecim:

verses.text: The children of Gabaon, ninety-five.
verses.textLatin: filii Gabaon, nonaginta quinque:

verses.text: The children of Bethlehem, and Netupha, a hundred eighty-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Bethlehem et Netupha, centum octoginta octo.

verses.text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred twenty-eight.
verses.textLatin: Viri Anathoth, centum viginti octo.

verses.text: The men of Bethazmoth, forty-two.
verses.textLatin: Viri Bethazmoth, quadraginta duo.

verses.text: The men of Cariathiarim, Cephira, and Beroth, seven hundred forty-three.
verses.textLatin: Viri Cariathiarim, Cephira, et Beroth, septingenti quadraginta tres.

verses.text: The men of Rama and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.
verses.textLatin: Viri Rama et Geba, sexcenti viginti unus.

verses.text: The men of Machmas, a hundred twenty-two.
verses.textLatin: Viri Machmas, centum viginti duo.

verses.text: The men of Bethel and Hai, a hundred twenty-three.
verses.textLatin: Viri Bethel et Hai, centum viginti tres.

verses.text: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.
verses.textLatin: Viri Nebo alterius, quinquaginta duo.

verses.text: The men of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
verses.textLatin: Viri Ælam alterius, mille ducenti quinquaginta quatuor.

verses.text: The children of Harem, three hundred and twenty.
verses.textLatin: Filii Harem, trecenti viginti.

verses.text: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.
verses.textLatin: Filii Jericho, trecenti quadraginta quinque.

verses.text: The children of Lod, of Hadid and Ono, seven hundred twenty-one.
verses.textLatin: Filii Lod Hadid et Ono, septingenti viginti unus.

verses.text: The children of Senaa, three thousand nine hundred thirty.
verses.textLatin: Filii Senaa, tria millia nongenti triginta.

verses.text: The priests: the children of Idaia in the house of Josue, nine hundred and seventy-three.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdotes: filii Idaia in domo Josue, nongenti septuaginta tres.

verses.text: The children of Emmer, one thousand fifty-two.
verses.textLatin: Filii Emmer, mille quinquaginta duo.

verses.text: The children of Phashur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
verses.textLatin: Filii Phashur, mille ducenti quadraginta septem.

verses.text: The children of Arem, one thousand and seventeen. The Levites:
verses.textLatin: Filii Arem, mille decem et septem. Levitæ:

verses.text: The children of Josue and Cedmihel, the sons
verses.textLatin: filii Josue et Cedmihel filiorum

verses.text: Of Oduia, seventy-four. The singing men:
verses.textLatin: Oduiæ, septuaginta quatuor. Cantores:

verses.text: The children of Asaph, a hundred forty-eight.
verses.textLatin: filii Asaph, centum quadraginta octo.

verses.text: The porters: the children of Sellum, the children of Ater, the children of Telmon, the children of Accub, the children of Hatita, the children of Sobai: a hundred thirty-eight.
verses.textLatin: Janitores: filii Sellum, filii Ater, filii Telmon, filii Accub, filii Hatita, filii Sobai: centum triginta octo.

verses.text: The Nathinites: the children of Soha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tebbaoth,
verses.textLatin: Nathinæi: filii Soha, filii Hasupha, filii Tebbaoth,

verses.text: The children of Ceros, the children of Siaa, the children of Phadon, the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Selmai,
verses.textLatin: filii Ceros, filii Siaa, filii Phadon, filii Lebana, filii Hagaba, filii Selmai,

verses.text: The children of Hanan, the children of Geddel, the children of Gaher,
verses.textLatin: filii Hanan, filii Geddel, filii Gaher,

verses.text: The children of Raaia, the children of Rasin, the children of Necoda,
verses.textLatin: filii Raaia, filii Rasin, filii Necoda,

verses.text: The children of Gezem, the children of Asa, the children of Phasea,
verses.textLatin: filii Gezem, filii Aza, filii Phasea,

verses.text: The children of Besai, the children of Munim, the children of Nephussim,
verses.textLatin: filii Besai, filii Munim, filii Nephussim,

verses.text: The children of Bacbuc, the children of Hacupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.textLatin: filii Bacbuc, filii Hacupha, filii Harhur,

verses.text: The children of Besloth, the children of Mahida, the children of Harsa,
verses.textLatin: filii Besloth, filii Mahida, filii Harsa,

verses.text: The children of Bercos, the children of Sisara, the children of Thema,
verses.textLatin: filii Bercos, filii Sisara, filii Thema,

verses.text: The children of Nasia, the children of Hatipha,
verses.textLatin: filii Nasia, filii Hatipha,

verses.text: The children of the servants of Solomon, the children of Sothai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Pharida,
verses.textLatin: filii servorum Salomonis, filii Sothai, filii Sophereth, filii Pharida,

verses.text: The children of Jahala, the children of Darcon, the children of Jeddel,
verses.textLatin: filii Jahala, filii Darcon, filii Jeddel,

verses.text: The children of Saphatia, the children of Hatil, the children of Phochereth, who was born of Sabaim, the son of Amon.
verses.textLatin: filii Saphatia, filii Hatil, filii Phochereth, qui erat ortus ex Sabaim filio Amon.

verses.text: All the Nathinites, and the children of the servants of Solomon, three hundred ninety-two.
verses.textLatin: Omnes Nathinæi, et filii servorum Salomonis, trecenti nonaginta duo.

verses.text: And these are they that came up from Telmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, Addon, and Emmer: and could not shew the house of their fathers, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt autem qui ascenderunt de Thelmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, Addon, et Emmer: et non potuerunt indicare domum patrum suorum, et semen suum, utrum ex Israël essent,

verses.text: The children of Dalaia, the children of Tobia, the children of Necoda, six hundred forty-two.
verses.textLatin: filii Dalaia, filii Tobia, filii Necoda, sexcenti quadraginta duo.

verses.text: And of the priests, the children of Habia, the children of Accos, the children of Berzellai, who took a wife of the daughters of Berzellai the Galaadite, and he was called by their name.
verses.textLatin: Et de sacerdotibus, filii Habia, filii Accos, filii Berzellai, qui accepit de filiabus Berzellai Galaaditis uxorem, et vocatus est nomine eorum.

verses.text: These sought their writing in the record, and found it not: and they were cast out of the priesthood.
verses.textLatin: Hi quæsierunt scripturam suam in censu, et non invenerunt: et ejecti sunt de sacerdotio.

verses.text: And Athersatha said to them, that they should not eat of the holies of holies, until there stood up a priest learned and skilful.
verses.textLatin: Dixitque Athersatha eis ut non manducarent de Sanctis sanctorum, donec staret sacerdos doctus et eruditus.

verses.text: All the multitude as it were one man, forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
verses.textLatin: Omnis multitudo quasi vir unus quadraginta duo millia trecenti sexaginta,

verses.text: Beside their menservants and womenservants, who were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and among them singing men, and singing women, two hundred forty-five.
verses.textLatin: absque servis et ancillis eorum, qui erant septem millia trecenti triginta septem, et inter eos cantores et cantatrices, ducenti quadraginta quinque.

verses.text: Their horses, seven hundred thirty-six: their mules two hundred forty-five:
verses.textLatin: Equi eorum, septingenti triginta sex: muli eorum, ducenti quadraginta quinque:

verses.text: Their camels, four hundred thirty-five, their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.textLatin: cameli eorum, quadringenti triginta quinque: asini, sex millia septingenti viginti.

verses.text: And some of the heads of the families gave unto the work. Athersatha gave into the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty bowls, and five hundred and thirty garments for priests.
verses.textLatin: Nonnulli autem de principibus familiarum dederunt in opus. Athersatha dedit in thesaurum auri drachmas mille, phialas quinquaginta, tunicas sacerdotales quingentas triginta.

verses.text: And some of the heads of families gave to the treasure of the work, twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand two hundred pounds of silver.
verses.textLatin: Et de principibus familiarum dederunt in thesaurum operis, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia ducentas.

verses.text: And that which the rest of the people gave, was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven garments for priests.
verses.textLatin: Et quod dedit reliquus populus, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia, et tunicas sacerdotales sexaginta septem.

verses.text: And the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singing men, and the rest of the common people, and the Nathinites, and all Israel dwelt in their cities.
verses.textLatin: Habitaverunt autem sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et janitores, et cantores, et reliquum vulgus, et Nathinæi, et omnis Israël, in civitatibus suis.

verses.text: And  the seventh month came: and the children of Israel were in their cities. And all the people were gathered together as one man to the street which is before the water gate, and they spoke to Esdras the scribe, to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et venerat mensis septimus: filii autem Israël erant in civitatibus suis. Congregatusque est omnis populus quasi vir unus ad plateam quæ est ante portam aquarum: et dixerunt Esdræ scribæ ut afferret librum legis Moysi, quam præceperat Dominus Israëli.

verses.text: Then Esdras the priest brought the law before the multitude of men and women, and all those that could understand, in the first day of the seventh month.
verses.textLatin: Attulit ergo Esdras sacerdos legem coram multitudine virorum et mulierum, cunctisque qui poterant intelligere, in die prima mensis septimi.

verses.text: And he read it plainly in the street that was before the water gate, from the morning until midday, before the men, and the women, and all those that could understand: and the ears of all the people were attentive to the book.
verses.textLatin: Et legit in eo aperte in platea quæ erat ante portam aquarum, de mane usque ad mediam diem, in conspectu virorum et mulierum, et sapientium: et aures omnis populi erant erectæ ad librum.

verses.text: And Esdras the scribe stood upon a step of wood, which he had made to speak upon, and there stood by him Mathathias, and Semeia, and Ania, and Uria, and Helcia, and Maasia, on his right hand: and on the left, Phadaia, Misael, and Melchia, and Hasum, and Hasbadana, Zacharia and Mosollam.
verses.textLatin: Stetit autem Esdras scriba super gradum ligneum, quem fecerat ad loquendum: et steterunt juxta eum Mathathias, et Semeia, et Ania, et Uria, et Helcia, et Maasia, ad dexteram ejus: et ad sinistram, Phadaia, Misaël, et Melchia, et Hasum, et Hasbadana, Zacharia, et Mosollam.

verses.text: And Esdras opened the book before all the people: for he was above all the people: and when he had opened it, all the people stood.
verses.textLatin: Et aperuit Esdras librum coram omni populo: super universum quippe populum eminebat: et cum aperuisset eum, stetit omnis populus.

verses.text: And Esdras blessed the Lord the great God: and all the people answered, Amen, amen: lifting up their hands: and they bowed down, and adored God with their faces to the ground.
verses.textLatin: Et benedixit Esdras Domino Deo magno: et respondit omnis populus: Amen, amen, elevans manus suas: et incurvati sunt, et adoraverunt Deum proni in terram.

verses.text: Now Josue, and Bani, and Serebia, Jamin, Accub, Sephtai, Odia, Maasia, Celtia, Azarias, Jozabed, Hanan, Phalaia, the Levites, made silence among the people to hear the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.textLatin: Porro Josue, et Bani, et Serebia, Jamin, Accub, Septhai, Odia, Maasia, Celita, Azarias, Jozabed, Hanan, Phalaia, Levitæ, silentium faciebant in populo ad audiendam legem: populus autem stabat in gradu suo.

verses.text: And they read in the book of the law of God distinctly and plainly to be understood: and they understood when it was read.
verses.textLatin: Et legerunt in libro legis Dei distincte, et aperte ad intelligendum: et intellexerunt cum legeretur.

verses.text: And Nehemias (he is Athersatha) and Esdras the priest and scribe, and the Levites who interpreted to all the people, said: This is a holy day to the Lord our God: do not mourn, nor weep: for all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.textLatin: Dixit autem Nehemias (ipse est Athersatha) et Esdras sacerdos et scriba, et Levitæ interpretantes universo populo: Dies sanctificatus est Domino Deo nostro: nolite lugere, et nolite flere. Flebat enim omnis populus cum audiret verba legis.

verses.text: And he said to them: Go, eat fat meats, and drink sweet wine, and send portions to them that have not prepared for themselves: because it is the holy day of the Lord, and be not sad: for the joy of the Lord is our strength.
verses.textLatin: Et dixit eis: Ite, comedite pinguia, et bibite mulsum, et mittite partes his qui non præparaverunt sibi, quia sanctus dies Domini est: et nolite contristari: gaudium etenim Domini est fortitudo nostra.

verses.text: And the Levites stilled all the people, saying: Hold your peace, for the day is holy, and be not sorrowful.
verses.textLatin: Levitæ autem silentium faciebant in omni populo, dicentes: Tacete, quia dies sanctus est, et nolite dolere.

verses.text: So all the people went to eat and drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth: because they understood the words that he had taught them.
verses.textLatin: Abiit itaque omnis populus ut comederet, et biberet, et mitteret partes, et faceret lætitiam magnam: quia intellexerant verba quæ docuerat eos.

verses.text: And on the second day the chiefs of the families of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Esdras the scribe, that he should interpret to them the words of the law.
verses.textLatin: Et in die secundo congregati sunt principes familiarum universi populi, sacerdotes et Levitæ, ad Esdram scribam, ut interpretaretur eis verba legis.

verses.text: And they found written in the law, that the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in tabernacles, on the feast, in the seventh month:
verses.textLatin: Et invenerunt scriptum in lege præcepisse Dominum in manu Moysi ut habitent filii Israël in tabernaculis in die solemni, mense septimo:

verses.text: And that they should proclaim and publish the word in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying: Go forth to the mount, and fetch branches of olive, and branches of beautiful wood, branches of myrtle, and branches of palm, and branches of thick trees, to make tabernacles, as it is written.
verses.textLatin: et ut prædicent, et divulgent vocem in universis urbibus suis, et in Jerusalem, dicentes: Egredimini in montem, et afferte frondes olivæ, et frondes ligni pulcherrimi, frondes myrti, et ramos palmarum, et frondes ligni nemorosi, ut fiant tabernacula, sicut scriptum est.

verses.text: And the people went forth, and brought. And they made themselves tabernacles every man on the top of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.textLatin: Et egressus est populus, et attulerunt. Feceruntque sibi tabernacula unusquisque in domate suo: et in atriis suis, et in atriis domus Dei, et in platea portæ aquarum, et in platea portæ Ephraim.

verses.text: And all the assembly of them that were returned from the captivity, made tabernacles, and dwelt in tabernacles: for since the days of Josue the son of Nun the children of Israel had not done so, until that day: and there was exceeding great joy.
verses.textLatin: Fecit ergo universa ecclesia eorum qui redierant de captivitate, tabernacula, et habitaverunt in tabernaculis: non enim fecerant a diebus Josue filii Nun taliter filii Israël usque ad diem illum. Et fuit lætitia magna nimis.

verses.text: And he read in the book of the law of God day by day, from the first day till the last, and they kept the solemnity seven days, and in the eighth day a solemn assembly according to the manner.
verses.textLatin: Legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos, a die primo usque ad diem novissimum. Et fecerunt solemnitatem septem diebus, et in die octavo collectam juxta ritum.

verses.text: And  in the four and twentieth day of the month the children of Israel came together with fasting and with sackcloth, and earth upon them.
verses.textLatin: In die autem vigesimo quarto mensis hujus, convenerunt filii Israël in jejunio et in saccis, et humus super eos.

verses.text: And the seed of the children of Israel separated themselves from every stranger: and they stood, and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.textLatin: Et separatum est semen filiorum Israël ab omni filio alienigena: et steterunt, et confitebantur peccata sua, et iniquitates patrum suorum.

verses.text: And they rose up to stand: and they read in the book of the law of the Lord their God, four times in the day, and four times they confessed, and adored the Lord their God.
verses.textLatin: Et consurrexerunt ad standum: et legerunt in volumine legis Domini Dei sui, quater in die, et quater confitebantur, et adorabant Dominum Deum suum.

verses.text: And there stood up upon the step of the Levites, Josue, and Bani, and Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, and Chanani: and they cried with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
