verses.textLatin: Surrexerunt autem super gradum Levitarum Josue, et Bani, et Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, et Chanani: et clamaverunt voce magna ad Dominum Deum suum.

verses.text: And the Levites Josue and Cedmihel, Bonni, Hasebnia, Serebia, Oduia, Sebnia, and Phathahia, said: Arise, bless the Lord your God from eternity to eternity: and blessed be the high name of thy glory with all blessing and praise.
verses.textLatin: Et dixerunt Levitæ Josue, et Cedmihel, Bonni, Hasebnia, Serebia, Odaia, Sebnia, Phathathia: Surgite, benedicite Domino Deo vestro ab æterno usque in æternum: et benedicant nomini gloriæ tuæ excelso in omni benedictione et laude.

verses.text: Thou thyself, O Lord alone, thou hast made heaven, and the heaven of heavens, and all the host thereof: the earth and all things that are in it: the seas and all that are therein: and thou givest life to all these things, and the host of heaven adoreth thee.
verses.textLatin: Tu ipse, Domine, solus, tu fecisti cælum, et cælum cælorum, et omnem exercitum eorum: terram, et universa quæ in ea sunt: maria, et omnia quæ in eis sunt: et tu vivificas omnia hæc, et exercitus cæli te adorat.

verses.text: Thou, O Lord God, art he who chosest Abram, and broughtest him forth out of the fire of the Chaldeans, and gavest him the name of Abraham.
verses.textLatin: Tu ipse, Domine Deus, qui elegisti Abram, et eduxisti eum de igne Chaldæorum, et posuisti nomen ejus Abraham:

verses.text: And thou didst find his heart faithful before thee: and thou madest a covenant with him, to give him the land of the Chanaanite, of the Hethite, and of the Amorrhite, and of the Pherezite, and of the Jebusite, and of the Gergezite, to give it to his seed: and thou hast fulfilled thy words, because thou art just.
verses.textLatin: et invenisti cor ejus fidele coram te, et percussisti cum eo fœdus ut dares ei terram Chananæi, Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Jebusæi, et Gergesæi, ut dares semini ejus: et implesti verba tua, quoniam justus es.

verses.text: And thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt: and thou didst hear their cry by the Red Sea.
verses.textLatin: Et vidisti afflictionem patrum nostrorum in Ægypto, clamoremque eorum audisti super mare Rubrum.

verses.text: And thou shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharao, and upon all his servants, and upon the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them: and thou madest thyself a name, as it is at this day.
verses.textLatin: Et dedisti signa atque portenta in Pharaone, et in universis servis ejus, et in omni populo terræ illius: cognovisti enim quia superbe egerant contra eos: et fecisti tibi nomen, sicut et in hac die.

verses.text: And thou didst divide the sea before them, and they passed through the midst of the sea on dry land: but their persecutors thou threwest into the depth, as a stone into mighty waters.
verses.textLatin: Et mare divisisti ante eos, et transierunt per medium maris in sicco: persecutores autem eorum projecisti in profundum, quasi lapidem in aquas validas.

verses.text: And in a pillar of a cloud thou wast their leader by day, and in a pillar of fire by night, that they might see the way by which they went.
verses.textLatin: Et in columna nubis ductor eorum fuisti per diem, et in columna ignis per noctem, ut appareret eis via per quam ingrediebantur.

verses.text: Thou camest down also to mount Sinai, and didst speak with them from heaven, and thou gavest them right judgments, and the law of truth, ceremonies, and good precepts.
verses.textLatin: Ad montem quoque Sinai descendisti, et locutus es cum eis de cælo, et dedisti eis judicia recta, et legem veritatis, cæremonias, et præcepta bona:

verses.text: Thou madest known to them thy holy sabbath, and didst prescribe to them commandments, and ceremonies, and the law by the hand of Moses thy servant.
verses.textLatin: et sabbatum sanctificatum tuum ostendisti eis: et mandata, et cæremonias, et legem præcepisti eis in manu Moysi servi tui.

verses.text: And thou gavest them bread from heaven in their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock in their thirst, and thou saidst to them that they should go in, and possess the land, upon which thou hadst lifted up thy hand to give it them.
verses.textLatin: Panem quoque de cælo dedisti eis in fame eorum, et aquam de petra eduxisti eis sitientibus, et dixisti eis ut ingrederentur et possiderent terram, super quam levasti manum tuam ut traderes eis.

verses.text: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks and hearkened not to thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Ipsi vero et patres nostri superbe egerunt, et induraverunt cervices suas, et non audierunt mandata tua.

verses.text: And they would not hear, and they remembered not thy wonders which thou hadst done for them. And they hardened their necks, and gave the head to return to their bondage, as it were by contention. But thou, a forgiving God, gracious, and merciful, longsuffering, and full of compassion, didst not forsake them.
verses.textLatin: Et noluerunt audire, et non sunt recordati mirabilium tuorum quæ feceras eis. Et induraverunt cervices suas, et dederunt caput ut converterentur ad servitutem suam, quasi per contentionem. Tu autem, Deus propitius, clemens, et misericors, longanimis, et multæ miserationis, non dereliquisti eos,

verses.text: Yea when they had made also to themselves a molten calf, and had said: This is thy God, that brought thee out of Egypt: and had committed great blasphemies:
verses.textLatin: et quidem cum fecissent sibi vitulum conflatilem, et dixissent: Iste est deus tuus, qui eduxit te de Ægypto: feceruntque blasphemias magnas:

verses.text: Yet thou, in thy many mercies, didst not leave them in the desert: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day to lead them in the way, and the pillar of fire by night to shew them the way by which they should go.
verses.textLatin: tu autem in misericordiis tuis multis non dimisisti eos in deserto: columna nubis non recessit ab eis per diem ut duceret eos in viam, et columna ignis per noctem ut ostenderet eis iter per quod ingrederentur.

verses.text: And thou gavest them thy good Spirit to teach them, and thy manna thou didst not withhold from their mouth, and thou gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.textLatin: Et spiritum tuum bonum dedisti, qui doceret eos: et manna tuum non prohibuisti ab ore eorum, et aquam dedisti eis in siti.

verses.text: Forty years didst thou feed them in the desert, and nothing was wanting to them: their garments did not grow old, and their feet were not worn.
verses.textLatin: Quadraginta annis pavisti eos in deserto, nihilque eis defuit: vestimenta eorum non inveteraverunt, et pedes eorum non sunt attriti.

verses.text: And thou gavest them kingdoms, and nations, and didst divide lots for them: and they possessed the land of Sehon, and the land of the king of Hesebon, and the land of Og king of Basan.
verses.textLatin: Et dedisti eis regna, et populos, et partitus es eis sortes: et possederunt terram Sehon, et terram regis Hesebon, et terram Og regis Basan.

verses.text: And thou didst multiply their children as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them to the land concerning which thou hadst said to their fathers, that they should go in and possess it.
verses.textLatin: Et multiplicasti filios eorum sicut stellas cæli, et adduxisti eos ad terram de qua dixeras patribus eorum ut ingrederentur et possiderent.

verses.text: And the children came and possessed the land, and thou didst humble before them the inhabitants of the land, the Chanaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as it pleased them.
verses.textLatin: Et venerunt filii, et possederunt terram, et humiliasti coram eis habitatores terræ Chananæos, et dedisti eos in manu eorum, et reges eorum, et populos terræ, ut facerent eis sicut placebant illis.

verses.text: And they took strong cities and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods: cisterns made by others, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: and they ate, and were filled, and became fat, and abounded with delight in thy great goodness.
verses.textLatin: Ceperunt itaque urbes munitas et humum pinguem, et possederunt domos plenas cunctis bonis: cisternas ab aliis fabricatas, vineas, et oliveta, et ligna pomifera multa: et comederunt, et saturati sunt, et impinguati sunt, et abundaverunt deliciis in bonitate tua magna.

verses.text: But they provoked thee to wrath, and departed from thee, and threw thy law behind their backs: and they killed thy prophets, who admonished them earnestly to return to thee: and they were guilty of great blasphemies.
verses.textLatin: Provocaverunt autem te ad iracundiam, et recesserunt a te, et projecerunt legem tuam post terga sua: et prophetas tuos occiderunt, qui contestabantur eos ut reverterentur ad te: feceruntque blasphemias grandes.

verses.text: And thou gavest them into the hands of their enemies, and they afflicted them. And in the time of their tribulation they cried to thee, and thou heardest from heaven, and according to the multitude of thy tender mercies thou gavest them saviours, to save them from the hands of their enemies.
verses.textLatin: Et dedisti eos in manu hostium suorum, et afflixerunt eos. Et in tempore tribulationis suæ clamaverunt ad te, et tu de cælo audisti, et secundum miserationes tuas multas dedisti eis salvatores, qui salvarent eos de manu hostium suorum.

verses.text: But after they had rest, they returned to do evil in thy sight: and thou leftest them in the hand of their enemies, and they had dominion over them. Then they returned, and cried to thee: and thou heardest from heaven, and deliveredst them many times in thy mercies.
verses.textLatin: Cumque requievissent, reversi sunt ut facerent malum in conspectu tuo, et dereliquisti eos in manu inimicorum suorum, et possederunt eos. Conversique sunt, et clamaverunt ad te: tu autem de cælo exaudisti, et liberasti eos in misericordiis tuis, multis temporibus.

verses.text: And thou didst admonish them to return to thy law. But they dealt proudly, and hearkened not to thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, which if a man do, he shall live in them: and they withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.textLatin: Et contestatus es eos ut reverterentur ad legem tuam. Ipsi vero superbe egerunt, et non audierunt mandata tua, et in judiciis tuis peccaverunt, quæ faciet homo, et vivet in eis: et dederunt humerum recedentem, et cervicem suam induraverunt, nec audierunt.

verses.text: And thou didst forbear with them for many years, and didst testify against them by thy spirit by the hand of thy prophets: and they heard not, and thou didst deliver them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.textLatin: Et protraxisti super eos annos multos, et contestatus es eos in spiritu tuo per manum prophetarum tuorum: et non audierunt, et tradidisti eos in manu populorum terrarum.

verses.text: Yet in thy very many mercies thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them: because thou art a merciful and gracious God.
verses.textLatin: In misericordiis autem tuis plurimis non fecisti eos in consumptionem, nec dereliquisti eos: quoniam Deus miserationum et clemens es tu.

verses.text: Now therefore our God, great, strong and terrible, who keepest covenant and mercy, turn not away from thy face all the labour which hath come upon us, upon our kings, and our princes, and our priests, and our prophets, and our fathers, and all the people from the days of the king of Assur, until this day.
verses.textLatin: Nunc itaque Deus noster magne, fortis et terribilis, custodiens pactum et misericordiam, ne avertas a facie tua omnem laborem, qui invenit nos, reges nostros, et principes nostros, et sacerdotes nostros, et prophetas nostros, et patres nostros, et omnem populum tuum a diebus regis Assur usque in diem hanc.

verses.text: And thou art just in all things that have come upon us: because thou hast done truth, but we have done wickedly.
verses.textLatin: Et tu justus es in omnibus quæ venerunt super nos: quia veritatem fecisti, nos autem impie egimus.

verses.text: Our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept thy law, and have not minded thy commandments, and thy testimonies which thou hast testified among them.
verses.textLatin: Reges nostri, principes nostri, sacerdotes nostri et patres nostri non fecerunt legem tuam, et non attenderunt mandata tua, et testimonia tua quæ testificatus es in eis.

verses.text: And they have not served thee in their kingdoms, and in thy manifold goodness, which thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land, which thou deliveredst before them, nor did they return from their most wicked devices.
verses.textLatin: Et ipsi in regnis suis, et in bonitate tua multa quam dederas eis, et in terra latissima et pingui quam tradideras in conspectu eorum, non servierunt tibi, nec reversi sunt a studiis suis pessimis.

verses.text: Behold we ourselves this day are bondmen: and the land, which thou gavest our fathers, to eat the bread thereof, and the good things thereof, and we ourselves are servants in it.
verses.textLatin: Ecce nos ipsi hodie servi sumus: et terra quam dedisti patribus nostris ut comederent panem ejus, et quæ bona sunt ejus, et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea.

verses.text: And the fruits thereof grow up for the kings, whom thou hast set over us for our sins, and they have dominion over our bodies, and over our beasts, according to their will, and we are in great tribulation.
verses.textLatin: Et fruges ejus multiplicantur regibus quos posuisti super nos propter peccata nostra: et corporibus nostris dominantur, et jumentis nostris secundum voluntatem suam: et in tribulatione magna sumus.

verses.text: And because of all this we ourselves make a covenant, and write it, and our princes, our Levites, and our priests sign it.
verses.textLatin: Super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus fœdus, et scribimus: et signant principes nostri, Levitæ nostri, et sacerdotes nostri.

verses.text: And  the subscribers were Nehemias, Athersatha the son of Hachelai, and Sedecias,
verses.textLatin: Signatores autem fuerunt Nehemias, Athersatha filius Hachelai, et Sedecias,

verses.text: Saraias, Azarias, Jeremias,
verses.textLatin: Saraias, Azarias, Jeremias,

verses.text: Pheshur, Amarias, Melchias,
verses.textLatin: Pheshur, Amarias, Melchias,

verses.text: Hattus, Sebenia, Melluch,
verses.textLatin: Hattus, Sebenia, Melluch,

verses.text: Harem, Merimuth, Obdias,
verses.textLatin: Harem, Merimuth, Obdias,

verses.text: Daniel, Genthon, Baruch,
verses.textLatin: Daniel, Genthon, Baruch,

verses.text: Mosollam, Abia, Miamin,
verses.textLatin: Mosollam, Abia, Miamin,

verses.text: Maazia, Belgia, Semeia: these were priests.
verses.textLatin: Maazia, Belgai, Semeia: hi sacerdotes.

verses.text: And the Levites, Josue the son of Azanias, Bennui of the sons of Henadad, Cedmihel,
verses.textLatin: Porro Levitæ, Josue filius Azaniæ, Bennui de filiis Henadad, Cedmihel,

verses.text: And their brethren, Sebenia, Oduia, Celita, Phalaia, Hanan,
verses.textLatin: et fratres eorum, Sebenia, Odaia, Celita, Phalaia, Hanan,

verses.text: Micha, Rohob, Hasebia,
verses.textLatin: Micha, Rohob, Hasebia,

verses.text: Zachur, Serebia, Sabania,
verses.textLatin: Zachur, Serebia, Sabania,

verses.text: Odaia, Bani, Baninu.
verses.textLatin: Odaia, Bani, Baninu.

verses.text: The heads of the people, Pharos, Phahath Moab, Elam, Zethu, Bani,
verses.textLatin: Capita populi, Pharos, Phahathmoab, Ælam, Zethu, Bani,

verses.text: Bonni, Azgad, Bebai,
verses.textLatin: Bonni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.text: Adonia, Begoai, Adin,
verses.textLatin: Adonia, Begoai, Adin,

verses.text: Ater, Hezecia, Azur,
verses.textLatin: Ater, Hezecia, Azur,

verses.text: Odaia, Hasum, Besai,
verses.textLatin: Odaia, Hasum, Besai,

verses.text: Hareph, Anathoth, Nebai,
verses.textLatin: Hareph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.text: Megphias, Mosollam, Hazir,
verses.textLatin: Megphias, Mosollam, Hazir,

verses.text: Mesizabel, Sadoc, Jeddua,
verses.textLatin: Mesizabel, Sadoc, Jeddua,

verses.text: Pheltia, Hanan, Anaia,
verses.textLatin: Pheltia, Hanan, Anaia,

verses.text: Osee, Hanania, Hasub,
verses.textLatin: Osee, Hanania, Hasub,

verses.text: Alohes, Phalea, Sobec,
verses.textLatin: Alohes, Phalea, Sobec,

verses.text: Rehum, Hasebna, Maasia,
verses.textLatin: Rehum, Hasebna, Maasia,

verses.text: Echaia, Hanan, Anan,
verses.textLatin: Echaia, Hanan, Anan,

verses.text: Melluch, Haran, Baana:
verses.textLatin: Melluch, Haran, Baana.

verses.text: And the rest of the people, priests, Levites, porters, and singing men, Nathinites, and all that had separated themselves from the people of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters.
verses.textLatin: Et reliqui de populo, sacerdotes, Levitæ, janitores, et cantores, Nathinæi, et omnes qui se separaverunt de populis terrarum ad legem Dei, uxores eorum, filii eorum, et filiæ eorum,

verses.text: All that could understand promising for their brethren, with their chief men, and they came to promise, and swear that they would walk in the law of God, which he gave in the hand of Moses the servant of God, that they would do and keep all the commandments of the Lord our God, and his judgments and his ceremonies.
verses.textLatin: omnes qui poterant sapere spondentes pro fratribus suis, optimates eorum, et qui veniebant ad pollicendum et jurandum ut ambularent in lege Dei, quam dederat in manu Moysi servi Dei: ut facerent et custodirent universa mandata Domini Dei nostri, et judicia ejus et cæremonias ejus:

verses.text: And that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons.
verses.textLatin: et ut non daremus filias nostras populo terræ, et filias eorum non acciperemus filiis nostris.

verses.text: And if the people of the land bring in things to sell, or any things for use, to sell them on the sabbath day, that we would not buy them of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day. And that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every hand.
verses.textLatin: Populi quoque terræ, qui important venalia, et omnia ad usum, per diem sabbati ut vendant, non accipiemus ab eis in sabbato et in die sanctificato. Et dimittemus annum septimum, et exactionem universæ manus.

verses.text: And we made ordinances for ourselves, to give the third part of a sicle every year for the work of the house of our God,
verses.textLatin: Et statuemus super nos præcepta, ut demus tertiam partem sicli per annum ad opus domus Dei nostri,

verses.text: For the loaves of proposition, and for the continual sacrifice, and for a continual holocaust on the sabbaths, on the new moons, on the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offering: that atonement might be made for Israel, and for every use of the house of our God.
verses.textLatin: ad panes propositionis, et ad sacrificium sempiternum, et in holocaustum sempiternum in sabbatis, in calendis, in solemnitatibus, et in sanctificatis, et pro peccato: ut exoretur pro Israël, et in omnem usum domus Dei nostri.

verses.text: And we cast lots among the priests, and the Levites, and the people for the offering of wood, that it might be brought into the house of our God by the houses of our fathers at set times, from year to year: to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law of Moses:
verses.textLatin: Sortes ergo misimus super oblationem lignorum inter sacerdotes, et Levitas, et populum, ut inferrentur in domum Dei nostri per domos patrum nostrorum, per tempora, a temporibus anni usque ad annum: ut arderent super altare Domini Dei nostri, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi:

verses.text: And that we would bring the firstfruits of our land, and the firstfruits of all fruit of every tree, from year to year, in the house of our Lord.
verses.textLatin: et ut afferremus primogenita terræ nostræ, et primitiva universi fructus omnis ligni, ab anno in annum, in domo Domini:

verses.text: And the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our oxen, and of our sheep, to be offered in the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God.
verses.textLatin: et primitiva filiorum nostrorum et pecorum nostrorum, sicut scriptum est in lege, et primitiva boum nostrorum et ovium nostrarum, ut offerrentur in domo Dei nostri, sacerdotibus qui ministrant in domo Dei nostri:

verses.text: And that we would bring the firstfruits of our meats, and of our libations, and the fruit of every tree, of the vintage also and of oil to the priests, to the storehouse of our God, and the tithes of our ground to the Levites. The Levites also shall receive the tithes of our works out of all the cities.
verses.textLatin: et primitias ciborum nostrorum, et libaminum nostrorum, et poma omnis ligni, vindemiæ quoque et olei, afferemus sacerdotibus ad gazophylacium Dei nostri, et decimam partem terræ nostræ Levitis. Ipsi Levitæ decimas accipient ex omnibus civitatibus operum nostrorum.

verses.text: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites in the tithes of the Levites, and the Levites shall offer the tithe of their tithes in the house of our God, to the storeroom into the treasure house.
verses.textLatin: Erit autem sacerdos filius Aaron cum Levitis in decimis Levitarum, et Levitæ offerent decimam partem decimæ suæ in domo Dei nostri ad gazophylacium in domum thesauri.

verses.text: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall carry to the treasury the firstfruits of corn, of wine, and of oil: and the sanctified vessels shall be there, and the priests, and the singing men, and the porters, and ministers, and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.textLatin: Ad gazophylacium enim deportabunt filii Israël, et filii Levi, primitias frumenti, vini, et olei: et ibi erunt vasa sanctificata, et sacerdotes, et cantores, et janitores, et ministri: et non dimittemus domum Dei nostri.

verses.text: And  the princes of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: but the rest of the people cast lots, to take one part in ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
verses.textLatin: Habitaverunt autem principes populi in Jerusalem: reliqua vero plebs misit sortem, ut tollerent unam partem de decem qui habitaturi essent in Jerusalem civitate sancta, novem vero partes in civitatibus.

verses.text: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Benedixit autem populus omnibus viris qui se sponte obtulerant ut habitarent in Jerusalem.

verses.text: These therefore are the chief men of the province, who dwelt in Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda. And every one dwelt in his possession, in their cities: Israel, the priests, the Levites, the Nathinites, and the children of the servants of Solomon.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt itaque principes provinciæ qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, et in civitatibus Juda. Habitavit autem unusquisque in possessione sua, in urbibus suis, Israël, sacerdotes, Levitæ, Nathinæi, et filii servorum Salomonis.

verses.text: And in Jerusalem there dwelt some of the children of Juda, and some of the children of Benjamin: of the children of Juda, Athaias the son of Aziam, the son of Zacharias, the son of Amarias, the son of Saphatias, the son of Malaleel: of the sons of Phares,
verses.textLatin: Et in Jerusalem habitaverunt de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin: de filiis Juda, Athaias filius Aziam, filii Zachariæ, filii Amariæ, filii Saphatiæ, filii Melaleel: de filiis Phares,

verses.text: Maasia the son of Baruch, the son of Cholhoza, the son of Hazia, the son of Adaia, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zacharias, the son of the Silonite:
verses.textLatin: Maasia filius Baruch, filius Cholhoza, filius Hazia, filius Adaia, filius Jojarib, filius Zachariæ, filius Silonitis:

verses.text: All these the sons of Phares, who dwelt in Jerusalem, were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
verses.textLatin: omnes hi filii Phares, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, quadringenti sexaginta octo viri fortes.

verses.text: And these are the children of Benjamin: Sellum the son of Mosollam, the son of Joed, the son of Phadaia, the son of Colaia, the son of Masia, the son of Etheel, the son of Isaia.
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt autem filii Benjamin: Sellum filius Mosollam, filius Joëd, filius Phadaia, filius Colaia, filius Masia, filius Etheel, filius Isaia,

verses.text: And after him Gebbai, Sellai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
verses.textLatin: et post eum Gebbai, Sellai, nongenti viginti octo,

verses.text: And Joel the son of Zechri their ruler, and Judas the son of Senua was second over the city.
verses.textLatin: et Joël filius Zechri præpositus eorum, et Judas filius Senua super civitatem secundus.

verses.text: And of the priests Idaia the son of Joarib, Jachin,
verses.textLatin: Et de sacerdotibus, Idaia filius Joarib, Jachin,

verses.text: Saraia the son of Helcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Meraioth, the son of Achitob the prince of the house of God,
verses.textLatin: Saraia filius Helciæ, filius Mosollam, filius Sadoc, filius Meraioth, filius Achitob princeps domus Dei,

verses.text: And their brethren that do the works of the temple: eight hundred twenty-two. And Adaia the son of Jeroham, the son of Phelelia, the son of Amsi, the son of Zacharias, the son of Pheshur, the son of Melchias,
verses.textLatin: et fratres eorum facientes opera templi: octingenti viginti duo. Et Adaia filius Jeroham, filius Phelelia, filius Amsi, filius Zachariæ, filius Pheshur, filius Melchiæ,

verses.text: And his brethren the chiefs of the fathers: two hundred forty-two. And Amassai the son of Azreel, the son of Ahazi, the son of Mosollamoth, the son of Emmer,
verses.textLatin: et fratres ejus principes patrum: ducenti quadraginta duo. Et Amassai filius Azreel, filius Ahazi, filius Mosollamoth, filius Emmer,

verses.text: And their brethren who were very mighty, a hundred twenty-eight: and their ruler Zabdiel son of the mighty.
verses.textLatin: et fratres eorum potentes nimis: centum viginti octo, et præpositus eorum Zabdiel filius potentium.

verses.text: And of the Levites Semeia the son of Hasub, the son of Azaricam, the son of Hasabia, the son of Boni,
verses.textLatin: Et de Levitis, Semeia filius Hasub, filius Azaricam, filius Hasabia, filius Boni,

verses.text: And Sabathai and Jozabed, who were over all the outward business of the house of God, of the princes of the Levites,
verses.textLatin: et Sabathai et Jozabed, super omnia opera quæ erant forinsecus in domo Dei, a principibus Levitarum.

verses.text: And Mathania the son of Micha, the son of Zebedei, the son of Asaph, was the principal man to praise, and to give glory in prayer, and Becbecia the second, one of his brethren, and Abda the son of Samua, the son of Galal, the son of Idithun.
verses.textLatin: Et Mathania filius Micha, filius Zebedei, filius Asaph, princeps ad laudandum et ad confitendum in oratione, et Becbecia secundus de fratribus ejus, et Abda filius Samua, filius Galal, filius Idithun:

verses.text: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
verses.textLatin: omnes Levitæ in civitate sancta ducenti octoginta quatuor.

verses.text: And the porters, Accub, Telmon, and their brethren, who kept the doors: a hundred seventy-two.
verses.textLatin: Et janitores, Accub, Telmon, et fratres eorum, qui custodiebant ostia: centum septuaginta duo.

verses.text: And the rest of Israel, the priests and the Levites were in all the cities of Juda, every man in his possession.
verses.textLatin: Et reliqui ex Israël sacerdotes et Levitæ in universis civitatibus Juda, unusquisque in possessione sua.

verses.text: And the Nathinites, that dwelt in Ophel, and Siaha, and Gaspha of the Nathinites.
verses.textLatin: Et Nathinæi, qui habitabant in Ophel, et Siaha, et Gaspha de Nathinæis.

verses.text: And the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem, was Azzi the son of Bani, the son of Hasabia, the son of Mathania, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, were the singing men in the ministry of the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Et episcopus Levitarum in Jerusalem, Azzi filius Bani, filius Hasabiæ, filius Mathaniæ, filius Michæ. De filiis Asaph, cantores in ministerio domus Dei.

verses.text: For the king’s commandment was concerning them, and an order among the singing men day by day.
verses.textLatin: Præceptum quippe regis super eos erat, et ordo in cantoribus per dies singulos,

verses.text: And Phathahia the son of Mesezebel of the children of Zara the son of Juda was at the hand of the king, in all matters concerning the people,
verses.textLatin: et Phathahia filius Mesezebel, de filiis Zara filii Juda in manu regis, juxta omne verbum populi,

verses.text: And in the houses through all their countries. Of the children of Juda some dwelt at Cariath-Arbe, and in the villages thereof: and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof: and at Cabseel, and in the villages thereof.
verses.textLatin: et in domibus per omnes regiones eorum. De filiis Juda habitaverunt in Cariatharbe et in filiabus ejus: et in Dibon, et in filiabus ejus: et in Cabseel, et in viculis ejus:

verses.text: And at Jesue, and at Molada, and at Bethphaleth,
verses.textLatin: et in Jesue, et in Molada, et in Bethphaleth,

verses.text: And at Hasersual, and at Bersabee, and in the villages thereof,
verses.textLatin: et in Hasersual, et in Bersabee, et in filiabus ejus,

verses.text: And at Siceleg, and at Mochona, and in the villages thereof,
verses.textLatin: et in Siceleg, et in Mochona, et in filiabus ejus,

verses.text: And at Remmon, and at Saraa, and at Jerimuth,
verses.textLatin: et in Remmon, et in Saraa, et in Jerimuth,

verses.text: Zanoa, Odollam, and in their villages, at Lachis and its dependencies, and at Azeca and the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Bersabee unto the valley of Ennom.
verses.textLatin: Zanoa, Odollam, et in villis earum, Lachis et regionibus ejus, et Azeca, et filiabus ejus. Et manserunt in Bersabee usque ad vallem Ennom.

verses.text: And the children of Benjamin, from Geba, at Mechmas, and at Hai, and at Bethel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.textLatin: Filii autem Benjamin, a Geba, Mechmas, et Hai, et Bethel, et filiabus ejus

verses.text: At Anathoth, Nob, Anania,
verses.textLatin: Anathoth, Nob, Anania,

verses.text: Asor, Rama, Gethaim,
verses.textLatin: Asor, Rama, Gethaim,

verses.text: Hadid, Seboim, and Neballat, Lod,
verses.textLatin: Hadid, Seboim, et Neballat, Lod,

verses.text: And Ono the valley of craftsmen.
verses.textLatin: et Ono valle artificum.

verses.text: And of the Levites were portions of Juda and Benjamin.
verses.textLatin: Et de Levitis portiones Judæ et Benjamin.

verses.text: Now  these are the priests and the Levites, that went up with Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Josue: Saraia, Jeremias, Esdras,
verses.textLatin: Hi sunt autem sacerdotes et Levitæ, qui ascenderunt cum Zorobabel filio Salathiel, et Josue: Saraia, Jeremias, Esdras,

verses.text: Amaria, Melluch, Hattus,
verses.textLatin: Amaria, Melluch, Hattus,

verses.text: Sebenias, Rheum, Merimuth,
verses.textLatin: Sebenias, Rheum, Merimuth,

verses.text: Addo, Genthon, Abia,
verses.textLatin: Addo, Genthon, Abia,

verses.text: Miamin, Madia, Belga,
verses.textLatin: Miamin, Madia, Belga,

verses.text: Semeia, and Joiarib, Idaia, Sellum, Amoc, Helcias,
verses.textLatin: Semeia, et Jojarib, Idaia, Sellum, Amoc, Helcias,

verses.text: Idaia. These were the chief of the priests, and of their brethren in the days of Josue.
verses.textLatin: Idaia. Isti principes sacerdotum, et fratres eorum in diebus Josue.

verses.text: And the Levites, Jesua, Bennui, Cedmihel, Sarebia, Juda, Mathanias, they and their brethren were over the hymns:
verses.textLatin: Porro Levitæ, Jesua, Bennui, Cedmihel, Sarebia, Juda, Mathanias, super hymnos ipsi et fratres eorum:

verses.text: And Becbecia, and Hanni, and their brethren every one in his office.
verses.textLatin: et Becbecia atque Hanni, et fratres eorum, unusquisque in officio suo.

verses.text: And Josue begot Joacim, and Joacim begot Eliasib, and Eliasib begot Joiada,
verses.textLatin: Josue autem genuit Joacim, et Joacim genuit Eliasib, et Eliasib genuit Jojada,

verses.text: And Joiada begot Jonathan, and Jonathan begot Jeddoa.
verses.textLatin: et Jojada genuit Jonathan, et Jonathan genuit Jeddoa.

verses.text: And in the days of Joacim the priests and heads of the families were: Of Saraia, Maraia: of Jeremias, Hanania:
verses.textLatin: In diebus autem Joacim erant sacerdotes et principes familiarum: Saraiæ, Maraia: Jeremiæ, Hanania:

verses.text: Of Esdras, Mosollam: and of Amaria, Johanan:
verses.textLatin: Esdræ, Mosollam: Amariæ, Johanan:

verses.text: Of Milicho, Jonathan: of Sebenia, Joseph:
verses.textLatin: Milicho, Jonathan: Sebeniæ, Joseph:

verses.text: Of Haram, Edna: of Maraioth, Helci:
verses.textLatin: Haram, Edna: Maraioth, Helci:

verses.text: Of Adaia, Zacharia: of Genthon, Mosollam:
verses.textLatin: Adaiæ, Zacharia: Genthon, Mosollam:

verses.text: Of Abia, Zechri: of Miamin and Moadia, Phelti:
verses.textLatin: Abiæ, Zechri: Miamin et Moadiæ, Phelti:

verses.text: Of Belga, Sammua of Semaia, Jonathan:
verses.textLatin: Belgæ, Sammua: Semaiæ, Jonathan:

verses.text: Of Joiarib, Mathanai: of Jodaia, Azzi:
verses.textLatin: Jojarib, Mathanai: Jodaiæ, Azzi:

verses.text: Of Sellai, Celai: of Amoc, Heber:
verses.textLatin: Sellai, Celai: Amoc, Heber:

verses.text: Of Helcias, Hasebia: of Idaia, Nathanael.
verses.textLatin: Helciæ, Hasebia: Idaiæ, Nathanaël.

verses.text: The Levites the chiefs of the families in the days of Eliasib, and Joiada, and Johanan, and Jeddoa, were recorded, and the priests in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.textLatin: Levitæ in diebus Eliasib, et Jojada, et Johanan, et Jeddoa, scripti principes familiarum, et sacerdotes in regno Darii Persæ.

verses.text: The sons of Levi, heads of the families were written in the book of Chronicles, even unto the days of Jonathan the son of Eliasib.
verses.textLatin: Filii Levi principes familiarum, scripti in libro verborum dierum, et usque ad dies Jonathan, filii Eliasib.

verses.text: Now the chief of the Levites were Hasebia, Serebia, and Josue the son of Cedmihel: and their brethren by their courses, to praise and to give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, and to wait equally in order.
verses.textLatin: Et principes Levitarum, Hasebia, Serebia, et Josue filius Cedmihel: et fratres eorum per vices suas, ut laudarent et confiterentur juxta præceptum David viri Dei, et observarent æque per ordinem.

verses.text: Mathania, and Becbecia, Obedia, and Mosollam, Telmon, Accub, were keepers of the gates and of the entrances before the gates.
verses.textLatin: Mathania, et Becbecia, Obedia, Mosollam, Telmon, Accub, custodes portarum et vestibulorum ante portas.

verses.text: These were in the days of Joacim the son of Josue, the son of Josedec, and in the days of Nehemias the governor, and of Esdras the priest and scribe.
verses.textLatin: Hi in diebus Joacim filii Josue, filii Josedec, et in diebus Nehemiæ ducis, et Esdræ sacerdotis scribæque.

verses.text: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, and to keep the dedication, and to rejoice with thanksgiving, and with singing, and with cymbals, and psalteries and harps.
verses.textLatin: In dedicatione autem muri Jerusalem, requisierunt Levitas de omnibus locis suis ut adducerent eos in Jerusalem, et facerent dedicationem et lætitiam in actione gratiarum, et cantico, et in cymbalis, psalteriis, et citharis.

verses.text: And the sons of the singing men were gathered together out of the plain country about Jerusalem, and out of the villages of Nethuphati,
verses.textLatin: Congregati sunt autem filii cantorum de campestribus circa Jerusalem, et de villis Nethuphathi,

verses.text: And from the house of Galgal, and from the countries of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singing men had built themselves villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: et de domo Galgal, et de regionibus Geba et Azmaveth: quoniam villas ædificaverunt sibi cantores in circuitu Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the priests and the Levites were purified, and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.textLatin: Et mundati sunt sacerdotes et Levitæ, et mundaverunt populum, et portas, et murum.

verses.text: And I made the princes of Juda go up upon the wall, and I appointed two great choirs to give praise. And they went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dunghill gate.
verses.textLatin: Ascendere autem feci principes Juda super murum, et statui duos magnos choros laudantium. Et ierunt ad dexteram super murum ad portam sterquilinii.

verses.text: And after them went Osaias, and half of the princes of Juda,
verses.textLatin: Et ivit post eos Osaias, et media pars principum Juda,

verses.text: And Azarias, Esdras, and Mosollam, Judas, and Benjamin, and Semeia, and Jeremias.
verses.textLatin: et Azarias, Esdras, et Mosollam, Judas, et Benjamin, et Semeia, et Jeremias.

verses.text: And of the sons of the priests with trumpets, Zacharias the son of Jonathan, the son of Semeia, the son of Mathania, the son of Michaia, the son of Zechur, the son of Asaph,
verses.textLatin: Et de filiis sacerdotum in tubis, Zacharias filius Jonathan, filius Semeiæ, filius Mathaniæ, filius Michaiæ, filius Zechur, filius Asaph,

verses.text: And his brethren Semeia, and Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanael, and Judas, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God: and Esdras the scribe before them at the fountain gate.
verses.textLatin: et fratres ejus Semeia, et Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanaël, et Judas, et Hanani, in vasis cantici David viri Dei: et Esdras scriba ante eos in porta fontis.

verses.text: And they went up over against them by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall of the house of David, and to the water gate eastward:
verses.textLatin: Et contra eos ascenderunt in gradibus civitatis David in ascensu muri super domum David, et usque ad portam aquarum ad orientem.

verses.text: And the second choir of them that gave thanks went on the opposite side, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, and upon the tower of the furnaces, even to the broad wall,
verses.textLatin: Et chorus secundus gratias referentium ibat ex adverso, et ego post eum, et media pars populi super murum, et super turrim furnorum, et usque ad murum latissimum,

verses.text: And above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Emath, and even to the flock gate: and they stood still in the watch gate.
verses.textLatin: et super portam Ephraim, et super portam antiquam, et super portam piscium et turrim Hananeel, et turrim Emath, et usque ad portam gregis: et steterunt in porta custodiæ,

verses.text: And the two choirs of them that gave praise stood still at the house of God, and I and the half of the magistrates with me.
verses.textLatin: steteruntque duo chori laudantium in domo Dei, et ego, et dimidia pars magistratuum mecum.

verses.text: And the priests, Eliachim, Maasia, Miamin, Michea, Elioenai, Zacharia, Hanania with trumpets,
verses.textLatin: Et sacerdotes, Eliachim, Maasia, Miamin, Michea, Elioënai, Zacharia, Hanania in tubis,

verses.text: And Maasia, and Semeia, and Eleazar, and Azzi, and Johanan, and Melchia, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sung loud, and Jezraia was their overseer:
verses.textLatin: et Maasia, et Semeia, et Eleazar, et Azzi, et Johanan, et Melchia, et Ælam, et Ezer. Et clare cecinerunt cantores, et Jezraia præpositus:

verses.text: And they sacrificed on that day great sacrifices, and they rejoiced: for God had made them joyful with great joy: their wives also and their children rejoiced, and the joy of Jerusalem was heard afar off.
verses.textLatin: et immolaverunt in die illa victimas magnas, et lætati sunt: Deus enim lætificaverat eos lætitia magna: sed et uxores eorum et liberi gavisi sunt, et audita est lætitia Jerusalem procul.

verses.text: They appointed also in that day men over the storehouses of the treasure, for the libations, and for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, that the rulers of the city might bring them in by them in honour of thanksgiving, for the priests and Levites: for Juda was joyful in the priests and Levites that assisted.
verses.textLatin: Recensuerunt quoque in die illa viros super gazophylacia thesauri ad libamina, et ad primitias, et ad decimas, ut introferrent per eos principes civitatis in decore gratiarum actionis, sacerdotes et Levitas: quia lætificatus est Juda in sacerdotibus et Levitis adstantibus.

verses.text: And they kept the watch of their God, and the observance of expiation, and the singing men, and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.textLatin: Et custodierunt observationem Dei sui, et observationem expiationis, et cantores, et janitores juxta præceptum David, et Salomonis filii ejus,

verses.text: For in the days of David and Asaph from the beginning there were chief singers appointed, to praise with canticles, and give thanks to God.
verses.textLatin: quia in diebus David et Asaph ab exordio erant principes constituti cantorum in carmine laudantium et confitentium Deo.

verses.text: And all Israel, in the days of Zorobabel, and in the days of Nehemias gave portions to the singing men, and to the porters, day by day, and they sanctified the Levites, and the Levites sanctified the sons of Aaron.
verses.textLatin: Et omnis Israël in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Nehemiæ, dabant partes cantoribus et janitoribus per dies singulos, et sanctificabant Levitas, et Levitæ sanctificabant filios Aaron.

verses.text: And  on that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people: and therein was found written, that the Ammonites and the Moabites should not come in to the church of God for ever:
verses.textLatin: In die autem illo, lectum est in volumine Moysi, audiente populo: et inventum est scriptum in eo, quod non debeant introire Ammonites et Moabites in ecclesiam Dei usque in æternum:

verses.text: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and water: and they hired against them Balaam, to curse them, and our God turned the curse into blessing.
verses.textLatin: eo quod non occurrerint filiis Israël cum pane et aqua, et conduxerint adversum eos Balaam ad maledicendum eis: et convertit Deus noster maledictionem in benedictionem.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated every stranger from Israel.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum audissent legem, separaverunt omnem alienigenam ab Israël.

verses.text: And over this thing was Eliasib the priest, who was set over the treasury of the house of our God, and was near akin to Tobias.
verses.textLatin: Et super hoc erat Eliasib sacerdos, qui fuerat præpositus in gazophylacio domus Dei nostri, et proximus Tobiæ.

verses.text: And he made him a great storeroom, where before him they laid up gifts, and frankincense, and vessels, and the tithes of the corn, of the wine, and of the oil, the portions of the Levites, and of the singing men, and of the porters, and the firstfruits of the priests.
verses.textLatin: Fecit ergo sibi gazophylacium grande, et ibi erant ante eum reponentes munera, et thus, et vasa, et decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, partes Levitarum, et cantorum, et janitorum, et primitias sacerdotales.

verses.text: But in all this time I was not in Jerusalem, because in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon, I went to the king, and after certain days I asked the king:
verses.textLatin: In omnibus autem his non fui in Jerusalem, quia anno trigesimo secundo Artaxerxis regis Babylonis veni ad regem, et in fine dierum rogavi regem.

verses.text: And I came to Jerusalem, and I understood the evil that Eliasib had done for Tobias, to make him a storehouse in the courts of the house of God.
verses.textLatin: Et veni in Jerusalem, et intellexi malum quod fecerat Eliasib Tobiæ, ut faceret ei thesaurum in vestibulis domus Dei.

verses.text: And it seemed to me exceeding evil. And I cast forth the vessels of the house of Tobias out of the storehouse.
verses.textLatin: Et malum mihi visum est valde. Et projeci vasa domus Tobiæ foras de gazophylacio:

verses.text: And I commanded and they cleansed the storehouses: and I brought thither again the vessels of the house of God, the sacrifice, and the frankincense.
verses.textLatin: præcepique et emundaverunt gazophylacia: et retuli ibi vasa domus Dei, sacrificium, et thus.

verses.text: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: and that the Levites, and the singing men, and they that ministered were fled away every man to his own country:
verses.textLatin: Et cognovi quod partes Levitarum non fuissent datæ, et fugisset unusquisque in regionem suam de Levitis, et cantoribus, et de his qui ministrabant:

verses.text: And I pleaded the matter against the magistrates, and said: Why have we forsaken the house of God? And I gathered them together, and I made them to stand in their places.
verses.textLatin: et egi causam adversus magistratus, et dixi: Quare dereliquimus domum Dei? et congregavi eos, et feci stare in stationibus suis.

verses.text: And all Juda brought the tithe of the corn, and the wine, and the oil into the storehouses.
verses.textLatin: Et omnis Juda apportabat decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, in horrea.

verses.text: And we set over the storehouses Selemias the priest, and Sadoc the scribe, and of the Levites Phadaia, and next to them Hanan the son of Zachur, the son of Mathania: for they were approved as faithful, and to them were committed the portions of their brethren.
verses.textLatin: Et constituimus super horrea Selemiam sacerdotem, et Sadoc scribam, et Phadaiam de Levitis, et juxta eos Hanan filium Zachur, filium Mathaniæ: quoniam fideles comprobati sunt, et ipsis creditæ sunt partes fratrum suorum.

verses.text: Remember me, O my God, for this thing, and wipe not out my kindnesses, which I have done relating to the house of my God and his ceremonies.
verses.textLatin: Memento mei, Deus meus, pro hoc, et ne deleas miserationes meas quas feci in domo Dei mei, et in cæremoniis ejus.

verses.text: In those days I saw in Juda some treading the presses on the sabbath, and carrying sheaves, and lading asses with wine, and grapes, and figs, and all manner of burthens, and bringing them into Jerusalem on the sabbath day. And I charged them that they should sell on a day on which it was lawful to sell.
verses.textLatin: In diebus illis vidi in Juda calcantes torcularia in sabbato, portantes acervos, et onerantes super asinos vinum, et uvas, et ficus, et omne onus, et inferentes in Jerusalem, die sabbati. Et contestatus sum ut in die qua vendere liceret, venderent.

verses.text: Some Tyrians also dwelt there, who brought fish, and all manner of wares: and they sold them on the sabbaths to the children of Juda in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Et Tyrii habitaverunt in ea, inferentes pisces, et omnia venalia: et vendebant in sabbatis filiis Juda in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And I rebuked the chief men of Juda, and said to them: What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the sabbath day?
verses.textLatin: Et objurgavi optimates Juda, et dixi eis: Quæ est hæc res mala quam vos facitis, et profanatis diem sabbati?

verses.text: Did not our fathers do these things, and our God brought all this evil upon us, and upon this city? And you bring more wrath upon Israel by violating the sabbath.
verses.textLatin: numquid non hæc fecerunt patres nostri, et adduxit Deus noster super nos omne malum hoc, et super civitatem hanc? et vos additis iracundiam super Israël violando sabbatum.

verses.text: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem were at rest on the sabbath day, I spoke: and they shut the gates, and I commanded that they should not open them till after the sabbath: and I set some of my servants at the gates, that none should bring in burthens on the sabbath day.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem, cum quievissent portæ Jerusalem in die sabbati, dixi: et clauserunt januas, et præcepi ut non aperirent eas usque post sabbatum: et de pueris meis constitui super portas, ut nullus inferret onus in die sabbati.

verses.text: So the merchants, and they that sold all kinds of wares, stayed without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.textLatin: Et manserunt negotiatores, et vendentes universa venalia, foris Jerusalem semel et bis.

verses.text: And I charged them, and I said to them: Why stay you before the wall? if you do so another time, I will lay hands on you. And from that time they came no more on the sabbath.
verses.textLatin: Et contestatus sum eos, et dixi eis: Quare manetis ex adverso muri? si secundo hoc feceritis, manum mittam in vos. Itaque ex tempore illo non venerunt in sabbato.

verses.text: I spoke also to the Levites that they should be purified, and should come to keep the gates, and to sanctify the sabbath day: for this also remember me, O my God, and spare me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.textLatin: Dixi quoque Levitis ut mundarentur, et venirent ad custodiendas portas, et sanctificandam diem sabbati: et pro hoc ergo memento mei, Deus meus, et parce mihi secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum.

verses.text: In those days also I saw Jews that married wives, women of Azotus, and of Ammon, and of Moab.
verses.textLatin: Sed et in diebus illis vidi Judæos ducentes uxores Azotidas, Ammonitidas, et Moabitidas.

verses.text: And their children spoke half in the speech of Azotus, and could not speak the Jews’ language, but they spoke according to the language of this and that people.
verses.textLatin: Et filii eorum ex media parte loquebantur azotice, et nesciebant loqui judaice, et loquebantur juxta linguam populi et populi.

verses.text: And I chid them, and laid my curse upon them. And I beat some of them, and shaved off their hair, and made them swear by God that they would not give their daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for their sons, nor for themselves, saying:
verses.textLatin: Et objurgavi eos, et maledixi. Et cecidi ex eis viros, et decalvavi eos, et adjuravi in Deo ut non darent filias suas filiis eorum, et non acciperent de filiabus eorum filiis suis et sibimetipsis, dicens:

verses.text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin in this kind of thing? and surely among many nations, there was not a king like him, and he was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: and yet women of other countries brought even him to sin.
verses.textLatin: Numquid non in hujuscemodi re peccavit Salomon rex Israël? et certe in gentibus multis non erat rex similis ei, et dilectus Deo suo erat, et posuit eum Deus regem super omnem Israël: et ipsum ergo duxerunt ad peccatum mulieres alienigenæ.

verses.text: And shall we also be disobedient and do all this great evil to transgress against our God, and marry strange women?
verses.textLatin: Numquid et nos inobedientes faciemus omne malum grande hoc ut prævaricemur in Deo nostro, et ducamus uxores peregrinas?

verses.text: And one of the sons of Joiada the son of Eliasib the high priest, was son in law to Sanaballat the Horonite, and I drove him from me.
verses.textLatin: De filiis autem Jojada filii Eliasib sacerdotis magni, gener erat Sanaballat Horonites, quem fugavi a me.

verses.text: Remember them, O Lord my God, that defile the priesthood, and the law of priests and Levites.
verses.textLatin: Recordare, Domine Deus meus, adversum eos qui polluunt sacerdotium, jusque sacerdotale et Leviticum.

verses.text: So I separated from them all strangers, and I appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites, every man in his ministry:
verses.textLatin: Igitur mundavi eos ab omnibus alienigenis, et constitui ordines sacerdotum et Levitarum, unumquemque in ministerio suo:

verses.text: And for the offering of wood at times appointed, and for the firstfruits: remember me, O my God, unto good. Amen.
verses.textLatin: et in oblatione lignorum in temporibus constitutis, et in primitivis: memento mei, Deus meus, in bonum. Amen.

verses.text: Tobias  of the tribe and city of Nephtali, (which is in the upper parts of Galilee above Naasson, beyond the way that leadeth to the west, having on the right hand the city of Sephet,)
verses.textLatin: Salutant te qui mecum sunt omnes: saluta eos qui nos amant in fide. Gratia Dei cum omnibus vobis. Amen.

verses.text: When he was made captive in the days of Salmanasar king of the Assyrians, even in his captivity, forsook not the way of truth,
verses.textLatin: Tobias ex tribu et civitate Nephthali (quæ est in superioribus Galilææ supra Naasson, post viam quæ ducit ad occidentem, in sinistro habens civitatem Sephet)

verses.text: But every day gave all he could get to his brethren his fellow captives, that were of his kindred.
verses.textLatin: cum captus esset in diebus Salmanasar regis Assyriorum, in captivitate tamen positus, viam veritatis non deseruit,

verses.text: And when he was younger than any of the tribe of Nephtali, yet did he no childish thing in his work.
verses.textLatin: ita ut omnia quæ habere poterat, quotidie concaptivis fratribus, qui erant ex ejus genere, impertiret.

verses.text: Moreover when all went to the golden calves which Jeroboam king of Israel had made, he alone fled the company of all,
verses.textLatin: Cumque esset junior omnibus in tribu Nephthali, nihil tamen puerile gessit in opere.

verses.text: And went to Jerusalem to the temple of the Lord, and there adored the Lord God of Israel, offering faithfully all his firstfruits, and his tithes,
verses.textLatin: Denique, cum irent omnes ad vitulos aureos quos Jeroboam fecerat rex Israël, hic solus fugiebat consortia omnium.

verses.text: So that in the third year he gave all his tithes to the proselytes, and strangers.
verses.textLatin: Sed pergebat in Jerusalem ad templum Domini, et ibi adorabat Dominum Deum Israël, omnia primitiva sua et decimas suas fideliter offerens,

verses.text: These and such like things did he observe when but a boy according to the law of God.
verses.textLatin: ita ut in tertio anno proselytis et advenis ministraret omnem decimationem.

verses.text: But when he was a man, he took to wife Anna of his own tribe, and had a son by her, whom he called after his own name,
verses.textLatin: Hæc et his similia secundum legem Dei puerulus observabat.

verses.text: And from his infancy he taught him to fear God, and to abstain from all sin.
verses.textLatin: Cum vero factus esset vir, accepit uxorem Annam de tribu sua, genuitque ex ea filium, nomen suum imponens ei:

verses.text: And when by the captivity he with his wife and his son and all his tribe was come to the city of Ninive,
verses.textLatin: quem ab infantia timere Deum docuit, et abstinere ab omni peccato.

verses.text: (When all ate of the meats of the Gentiles) he kept his soul and never was defiled with their meats.
verses.textLatin: Igitur, cum per captivitatem devenisset cum uxore sua et filio in civitatem Niniven cum omni tribu sua

verses.text: And because he was mindful of the Lord with all his heart, God gave him favour in the sight of Salmanasar the king.
verses.textLatin: (cum omnes ederent ex cibis gentilium), iste custodivit animam suam, et numquam contaminatus est in escis eorum.

verses.text: And he gave him leave to go whithersoever he would, with liberty to do whatever he had a mind.
verses.textLatin: Et quoniam memor fuit Domini in toto corde suo, dedit illi Deus gratiam in conspectu Salmanasar regis,

verses.text: He therefore went to all that were in captivity, and gave them wholesome admonitions.
verses.textLatin: et dedit illi potestatem quocumque vellet ire, habens libertatem quæcumque facere voluisset.

verses.text: And when he was come to Rages a city of the Medes, and had ten talents of silver of that with which he had been honoured by the king:
verses.textLatin: Pergebat ergo ad omnes qui erant in captivitate, et monita salutis dabat eis.

verses.text: And when amongst a great multitude of his kindred, he saw Gabelus in want, who was one of his tribe, taking a note of his hand he gave him the aforesaid sum of money.
verses.textLatin: Cum autem venisset in Rages civitatem Medorum, et ex his quibus honoratus fuerat a rege, habuisset decem talenta argenti:

verses.text: But after a long time, Salmanasar the king being dead, when Sennacherib his son, who reigned in his place, had a hatred for the children of Israel:
verses.textLatin: et cum in multa turba generis sui Gabelum egentem videret, qui erat ex tribu ejus, sub chirographo dedit illi memoratum pondus argenti.

verses.text: Tobias daily went among all his kindred, and comforted them, and distributed to every one as he was able, out of his goods:
verses.textLatin: Post multum vero temporis, mortuo Salmanasar rege, cum regnaret Sennacherib filius ejus pro eo, et filios Israël exosos haberet in conspectu suo,

verses.text: He fed the hungry, and gave clothes to the naked, and was careful to bury the dead, and they that were slain.
verses.textLatin: Tobias quotidie pergebat per omnem cognationem suam, et consolabatur eos, dividebatque unicuique, prout poterat, de facultatibus suis:

verses.text: And when king Sennacherib was come back, fleeing from Judea by reason of the slaughter that God had made about him for his blasphemy, and being angry slew many of the children of Israel, Tobias buried their bodies.
verses.textLatin: esurientes alebat, nudisque vestimenta præbebat, et mortuis atque occisis sepulturam sollicitus exhibebat.

verses.text: But when it was told the king, he commanded him to be slain, and took away all his substance.
verses.textLatin: Denique cum reversus esset rex Sennacherib, fugiens a Judæa plagam quam circa eum fecerat Deus propter blasphemiam suam, et iratus multos occideret ex filiis Israël, Tobias sepeliebat corpora eorum.

verses.text: But Tobias fleeing naked away with his son and with his wife, lay concealed, for many loved him.
verses.textLatin: At ubi nuntiatum est regi, jussit eum occidi, et tulit omnem substantiam ejus.

verses.text: But after forty-five days, the king was killed by his own sons.
verses.textLatin: Tobias vero cum filio suo et cum uxore suo fugiens, nudus latuit, quia multi diligebant eum.

verses.text: And Tobias returned to his house, and all his substance was restored to him.
verses.textLatin: Post dies vero quadraginta quinque occiderunt regem filii ipsius,

verses.text: But  after this, when there was a festival of the Lord, and a good dinner was prepared in Tobias’s house,
verses.textLatin: et reversus est Tobias in domum suam, omnisque facultas ejus restituta est ei.

verses.text: He said to his son: Go, and bring some of our tribe that fear God, to feast with us.
verses.textLatin: Post hæc vero, cum esset dies festus Domini, et factum esset prandium bonum in domo Tobiæ,

verses.text: And when he had gone, returning he told him, that one of the children of Israel lay slain in the street. And he forthwith leaped up from his place at the table, and left his dinner, and came fasting to the body:
verses.textLatin: dixit filio suo: Vade, et adduc aliquos de tribu nostra, timentes Deum, ut epulentur nobiscum.

verses.text: And taking it up carried it privately to his house, that after the sun was down, he might bury him cautiously.
verses.textLatin: Cumque abiisset, reversus nuntiavit ei unum ex filiis Israël jugulatum jacere in platea. Statimque exiliens de accubitu suo, relinquens prandium, jejunus pervenit ad corpus:

verses.text: And when he had hid the body, he ate bread with mourning and fear,
verses.textLatin: tollensque illud portavit ad domum suam occulte, ut dum sol occubuisset, caute sepeliret eum.

verses.text: Remembering the word which the Lord spoke by Amos the prophet: Your festival days shall be turned into lamentation and mourning.
verses.textLatin: Cumque occultasset corpus, manducavit panem cum luctu et tremore,

verses.text: So when the sun was down, he went and buried him.
verses.textLatin: memorans illum sermonem, quem dixit Dominus per Amos prophetam: Dies festi vestri convertentur in lamentationem et luctum.

verses.text: Now all his neighbours blamed him, saying: Once already commandment was given for thee to be slain because of this matter, and thou didst scarce escape the sentence of death, and dost thou again bury the dead?
verses.textLatin: Cum vero sol occubuisset, abiit, et sepelivit eum.

verses.text: But Tobias fearing God more than the king, carried off the bodies of them that were slain, and hid them in his house, and at midnight buried them.
verses.textLatin: Arguebant autem eum omnes proximi ejus, dicentes: Jam hujus rei causa interfici jussus es, et vix effugisti mortis imperium, et iterum sepelis mortuos?

verses.text: Now it happened one day, that being wearied with burying, he came to his house, and cast himself down by the wall and slept,
verses.textLatin: Sed Tobias plus timens Deum quam regem, rapiebat corpora occisorum, et occultabat in domo sua, et mediis noctibus sepeliebat ea.

verses.text: And as he was sleeping, hot dung out of a swallow’s nest fell upon his eyes, and he was made blind.
verses.textLatin: Contigit autem ut quadam die fatigatus a sepultura, veniens in domum suam, jactasset se juxta parietem, et obdormisset,

verses.text: Now this trial the Lord therefore permitted to happen to him, that an example might be given to posterity of his patience, as also of holy Job.
verses.textLatin: et ex nido hirundinum dormienti illi calida stercora inciderent super oculos ejus, fieretque cæcus.

verses.text: For whereas he had always feared God from his infancy, and kept his commandments, he repined not against God because the evil of blindness had befallen him,
verses.textLatin: Hanc autem tentationem ideo permisit Dominus evenire illi, ut posteris daretur exemplum patientiæ ejus, sicut et sancti Job.

verses.text: But continued immoveable in the fear of God, giving thanks to God all the days of his life.
verses.textLatin: Nam cum ab infantia sua semper Deum timuerit, et mandata ejus custodierit, non est contristatus contra Deum quod plaga cæcitatis evenerit ei,

verses.text: For as the kings insulted over holy Job: so his relations and kinsmen mocked at his life, saying:
verses.textLatin: sed immobilis in Dei timore permansit, agens gratias Deo omnibus diebus vitæ suæ.

verses.text: Where is thy hope, for which thou gavest alms, and buriedst the dead?
verses.textLatin: Nam sicut beato Job insultabant reges, ita isti parentes et cognati ejus irridebant vitam ejus, dicentes:

verses.text: But Tobias rebuked them, saying: Speak not so:
verses.textLatin: Ubi est spes tua, pro qua eleemosynas et sepulturas faciebas?

verses.text: For we are the children of saints, and look for that life which God will give to those that never change their faith from him.
verses.textLatin: Tobias vero increpabat eos, dicens: Nolite ita loqui:

verses.text: Now Anna his wife went daily to weaving work, and she brought home what she could get for their living by the labour of her hands.
verses.textLatin: quoniam filii sanctorum sumus, et vitam illam expectamus, quam Deus daturus est his qui fidem suam numquam mutant ab eo.

verses.text: Whereby it came to pass, that she received a young kid, and brought it home:
verses.textLatin: Anna vero uxor ejus ibat ad opus textrinum quotidie, et de labore manuum suarum victum quem consequi poterat, deferebat.

verses.text: And when her husband heard it bleating, he said: Take heed, lest perhaps it be stolen: restore ye it to its owners, for it is not lawful for us either to eat or to touch any thing that cometh by theft.
verses.textLatin: Unde factum est ut hædum caprarum accipiens detulisset domi:

verses.text: At these words his wife being angry answered: It is evident thy hope is come to nothing, and thy alms now appear.
verses.textLatin: cujus cum vocem balantis vir ejus audisset, dixit: Videte, ne forte furtivus sit: reddite eum dominis suis, quia non licet nobis aut edere ex furto aliquid, aut contingere.

verses.text: And with these, and other such like words she upbraided him.
verses.textLatin: Ad hæc uxor ejus irata respondit: Manifeste vana facta est spes tua, et eleemosynæ tuæ modo apparuerunt.

verses.text: Then  Tobias sighed, and began to pray with tears,
verses.textLatin: Atque his et aliis hujuscemodi verbis exprobrabat ei.

verses.text: Saying: Thou art just, O Lord, and all thy judgments are just, and all thy ways mercy, and truth, and judgment:
verses.textLatin: Tunc Tobias ingemuit, et cœpit orare cum lacrimis,

verses.text: And now, O Lord, think of me, and take not revenge of my sins, neither remember my offences, nor those of my parents.
verses.textLatin: dicens: Justus es, Domine, et omnia judicia tua justa sunt, et omnes viæ tuæ, misericordia, et veritas, et judicium.

verses.text: For we have not obeyed thy commandments, therefore are we delivered to spoil and to captivity, and death, and are made a fable, and a reproach to all nations, amongst which thou hast scattered us.
verses.textLatin: Et nunc Domine, memor esto mei, et ne vindictam sumas de peccatis meis, neque reminiscaris delicta mea, vel parentum meorum.

verses.text: And now, O Lord, great are thy judgments, because we have not done according to thy precepts, and have not walked sincerely before thee:
verses.textLatin: Quoniam non obedivimus præceptis tuis, ideo traditi sumus in direptionem, et captivitatem, et mortem, et in fabulam, et in improperium omnibus nationibus in quibus dispersisti nos.

verses.text: And now, O Lord, do with me according to thy will, and command my spirit to be received in peace: for it is better for me to die, than to live.
verses.textLatin: Et nunc Domine, magna judicia tua, quia non egimus secundum præcepta tua, et non ambulavimus sinceriter coram te.

verses.text: Now it happened on the same day, that Sara daughter of Raguel, in Rages a city of the Medes, received a reproach from one of her father’s servant maids,
verses.textLatin: Et nunc Domine, secundum voluntatem tuam fac mecum, et præcipe in pace recipi spiritum meum: expedit enim mihi mori magis quam vivere.

verses.text: Because she had been given to seven husbands, and a devil named Asmodeus had killed them, at their first going in unto her.
verses.textLatin: Eadem itaque die, contigit ut Sara filia Raguelis in Rages civitate Medorum et ipsa audiret improperium ab una ex ancillis patris sui,

verses.text: So when she reproved the maid for her fault, she answered her, saying: May we never see son, or daughter of thee upon the earth, thou murderer of thy husbands.
verses.textLatin: quoniam tradita fuerat septem viris, et dæmonium nomine Asmodæus occiderat eos, mox ut ingressi fuissent ad eam.

verses.text: Wilt thou kill me also, as thou hast already killed seven husbands? At these words she went into an upper chamber of her house: and for three days and three nights did neither eat nor drink:
verses.textLatin: Ergo cum pro culpa sua increparet puellam, respondit ei, dicens: Amplius ex te non videamus filium aut filiam super terram, interfectrix virorum tuorum.

verses.text: But continuing in prayer with tears besought God, that he would deliver her from this reproach.
verses.textLatin: Numquid et occidere me vis, sicut jam occidisti septem viros? Ad hanc vocem perrexit in superius cubiculum domus suæ: et tribus diebus, et tribus noctibus non manducavit, neque bibit:

verses.text: And it came to pass on the third day, when she was making an end of her prayer, blessing the Lord,
verses.textLatin: sed in oratione persistens cum lacrimis deprecabatur Deum, ut ab isto improperio liberaret eam.

verses.text: She said: Blessed is thy name, O God of our fathers: who when thou hast been angry, wilt shew mercy, and in the time of tribulation forgivest the sins of them that call upon thee.
verses.textLatin: Factum est autem die tertia, dum compleret orationem, benedicens Dominum

verses.text: To thee, O Lord, I turn my face, to thee I direct my eyes.
verses.textLatin: dixit: Benedictum est nomen tuum, Deus patrum nostrorum: qui cum iratus fueris, misericordiam facies, et in tempore tribulationis peccata dimittis his qui invocant te.

verses.text: I beg, O Lord, that thou loose me from the bond of this reproach, or else take me away from the earth.
verses.textLatin: Ad te, Domine, faciem meam converto; ad te oculos meos dirigo.

verses.text: Thou knowest, O Lord, that I never coveted a husband, and have kept my soul clean from all lust.
verses.textLatin: Peto, Domine, ut de vinculo improperii hujus absolvas me, aut certe desuper terram eripias me.

verses.text: Never have I joined myself with them that play: neither have I made myself partaker with them that walk in lightness.
verses.textLatin: Tu scis, Domine, quia numquam concupivi virum, et mundam servavi animam meam ab omni concupiscentia.

verses.text: But a husband I consented to take, with thy fear, not with my lust.
verses.textLatin: Numquam cum ludentibus miscui me, neque cum his qui in levitate ambulant, participem me præbui.

verses.text: And either I was unworthy of them, or they perhaps were not worthy of me: because perhaps thou hast kept me for another man.
verses.textLatin: Virum autem cum timore tuo, non cum libidine mea, consensi suscipere.

verses.text: For thy counsel is not in man’s power.
verses.textLatin: Et, aut ego indigna fui illis, aut illi forsitan me non fuerunt digni, quia forsitan viro alii conservasti me.

verses.text: But this every one is sure of that worshippeth thee, that his life, if it be under trial, shall be crowned: and if it be under tribulation, it shall be delivered: and if it be under correction, it shall be allowed to come to thy mercy.
verses.textLatin: Non est enim in hominis potestate consilium tuum.

verses.text: For thou art not delighted in our being lost: because after a storm thou makest a calm, and after tears and weeping thou pourest in joyfulness.
verses.textLatin: Hoc autem pro certo habet omnis qui te colit: quod vita ejus, si in probatione fuerit, coronabitur; si autem in tribulatione fuerit, liberabitur; et si in correptione fuerit, ad misericordiam tuam venire licebit.

verses.text: Be thy name, O God of Israel, blessed for ever.
verses.textLatin: Non enim delectaris in perditionibus nostris: quia post tempestatem tranquillum facis, et post lacrimationem et fletum, exultationem infundis.

verses.text: At that time the prayers of them both were heard in the sight of the glory of the most high God:
verses.textLatin: Sit nomen tuum, Deus Israël, benedictum in sæcula.

verses.text: And the holy angel of the Lord, Raphael was sent to heal them both, whose prayers at one time were rehearsed in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: In illo tempore exauditæ sunt preces amborum in conspectu gloriæ summi Dei:

verses.text: Therefore  when Tobias thought that his prayer was heard that he might die, he called to him Tobias his son,
verses.textLatin: et missus est angelus Domini sanctus Raphaël ut curaret eos ambos, quorum uno tempore sunt orationes in conspectu Domini recitatæ.

verses.text: And said to him: Hear, my son, the words of my mouth, and lay them as a foundation in thy heart.
verses.textLatin: Igitur cum Tobias putaret orationem suam exaudiri ut mori potuisset, vocavit ad se Tobiam filium suum,

verses.text: When God shall take my soul, thou shalt bury my body: and thou shalt honour thy mother all the days of her life:
verses.textLatin: dixitque ei: Audi, fili mi, verba oris mei, et ea in corde tuo quasi fundamentum construe.

verses.text: For thou must be mindful what and how great perils she suffered for thee in her womb.
verses.textLatin: Cum acceperit Deus animam meam, corpus meum sepeli: et honorem habebis matri tuæ omnibus diebus vitæ ejus:

verses.text: And when she also shall have ended the time of her life, bury her by me.
verses.textLatin: memor enim esse debes, quæ et quanta pericula passa sit propter te in utero suo.

verses.text: And all the days of thy life have God in thy mind: and take heed thou never consent to sin, nor transgress the commandments of the Lord our God.
verses.textLatin: Cum autem et ipsa compleverit tempus vitæ suæ, sepelias eam circa me.

verses.text: Give alms out of thy substance, and turn not away thy face from any poor person: for so it shall come to pass that the face of the Lord shall not be turned from thee.
verses.textLatin: Omnibus autem diebus vitæ tuæ in mente habeto Deum: et cave ne aliquando peccato consentias, et prætermittas præcepta Domini Dei nostri.

verses.text: According to thy ability be merciful.
verses.textLatin: Ex substantia tua fac eleemosynam, et noli avertere faciem tuam ab ullo paupere: ita enim fiet ut nec a te avertatur facies Domini.

verses.text: If thou have much give abundantly: if thou have little, take care even so to bestow willingly a little.
verses.textLatin: Quomodo potueris, ita esto misericors.

verses.text: For thus thou storest up to thyself a good reward for the day of necessity.
verses.textLatin: Si multum tibi fuerit, abundanter tribue: si exiguum tibi fuerit, etiam exiguum libenter impertiri stude.

verses.text: For alms deliver from all sin, and from death, and will not suffer the soul to go into darkness.
verses.textLatin: Præmium enim bonum tibi thesaurizas in die necessitatis:

verses.text: Alms shall be a great confidence before the most high God, to all them that give it.
verses.textLatin: quoniam eleemosyna ab omni peccato et a morte liberat, et non patietur animam ire in tenebras.

verses.text: Take heed to keep thyself, my son, from all fornication, and beside thy wife never endure to know a crime.
verses.textLatin: Fiducia magna erit coram summo Deo, eleemosyna omnibus facientibus eam.

verses.text: Never suffer pride to reign in thy mind, or in thy words: for from it all perdition took its beginning.
verses.textLatin: Attende tibi, fili mi, ab omni fornicatione, et præter uxorem tuam numquam patiaris crimen scire.

verses.text: If any man hath done any work for thee, immediately pay him his hire, and let not the wages of thy hired servant stay with thee at all.
verses.textLatin: Superbiam numquam in tuo sensu aut in tuo verbo dominari permittas: in ipsa enim initium sumpsit omnis perditio.

verses.text: See thou never do to another what thou wouldst hate to have done to thee by another.
verses.textLatin: Quicumque tibi aliquid operatus fuerit, statim ei mercedem restitue, et merces mercenarii tui apud te omnino non remaneat.

verses.text: Eat thy bread with the hungry and the needy, and with thy garments cover the naked.
verses.textLatin: Quod ab alio oderis fieri tibi, vide ne tu aliquando alteri facias.

verses.text: Lay out thy bread, and thy wine upon the burial of a just man, and do not eat and drink thereof with the wicked.
verses.textLatin: Panem tuum cum esurientibus et egenis comede, et de vestimentis tuis nudos tege.

verses.text: Seek counsel always of a wise man.
verses.textLatin: Panem tuum et vinum tuum super sepulturam justi constitue, et noli ex eo manducare et bibere cum peccatoribus.

verses.text: Bless God at all times: and desire of him to direct thy ways, and that all thy counsels may abide in him.
verses.textLatin: Consilium semper a sapiente perquire.

verses.text: I tell thee also, my son, that I lent ten talents of silver, while thou wast yet a child, to Gabelus, in Rages a city of the Medes, and I have a note of his hand with me:
verses.textLatin: Omni tempore benedic Deum: et pete ab eo ut vias tuas dirigat, et omnia consilia tua in ipso permaneant.

verses.text: Now therefore inquire how thou mayst go to him, and receive of him the foresaid sum of money, and restore to him the note of his hand.
verses.textLatin: Indico etiam tibi, fili mi, dedisse me decem talenta argenti, dum adhuc infantulus esses, Gabelo, in Rages civitate Medorum, et chirographum ejus apud me habeo:

verses.text: Fear not, my son: we lead indeed a poor life, but we shall have many good things if we fear God, and depart from all sin, and do that which is good.
verses.textLatin: et ideo perquire quomodo ad eum pervenias, et recipias ab eo supra memoratum pondus argenti, et restituas ei chirographum suum.

verses.text: Then  Tobias answered his father, and said: I will do all things, father, which thou hast commanded me.
verses.textLatin: Noli timere, fili mi: pauperem quidem vitam gerimus, sed multa bona habebimus si timuerimus Deum, et recesserimus ab omni peccato, et fecerimus bene.

verses.text: But how I shall get this money, I cannot tell; he knoweth not me, and I know not him: what token shall I give him? nor did I ever know the way which leadeth thither.
verses.textLatin: Tunc respondit Tobias patri suo, et dixit: Omnia quæcumque præcepisti mihi faciam, pater.

verses.text: Then his father answered him, and said: I have a note of his hand with me, which when thou shalt shew him, he will presently pay it.
verses.textLatin: Quomodo autem pecuniam hanc requiram, ignoro: ille me nescit, et ego eum ignoro: quod signum dabo ei? sed neque viam per quam pergatur illuc aliquando cognovi.

verses.text: But go now, and seek thee out some faithful man, to go with thee for his hire: that thou mayst receive it, while I yet live.
verses.textLatin: Tunc pater suus respondit illi, et dixit: Chirographum quidem illius penes me habeo: quod dum illi ostenderis, statim restituet.

verses.text: Then Tobias going forth, found a beautiful young man, standing girded, and as it were ready to walk.
verses.textLatin: Sed perge nunc, et inquire tibi aliquem fidelem virum, qui eat tecum salva mercede sua, ut dum adhuc vivo, recipias eam.

verses.text: And not knowing that he was an angel of God, he saluted him, and said: From whence art thou, good young man?
verses.textLatin: Tunc egressus Tobias, invenit juvenem splendidum stantem præcinctum, et quasi paratum ad ambulandum.

verses.text: But he answered: Of the children of Israel. And Tobias said to him: Knowest thou the way that leadeth to the country of the Medes?
verses.textLatin: Et ignorans quod angelus Dei esset, salutavit eum, et dixit: Unde te habemus, bone juvenis?

verses.text: And he answered: I know it: and I have often walked through all the ways thereof, and I have abode with Gabelus our brother, who dwelleth at Rages a city of the Medes, which is situate in the mount of Ecbatana.
verses.textLatin: At ille respondit: Ex filiis Israël. Et Tobias dixit ei: Nosti viam quæ ducit in regionem Medorum?

verses.text: And Tobias said to him: Stay for me, I beseech thee, till I tell these same things to my father.
verses.textLatin: Cui respondit: Novi: et omnia itinera ejus frequenter ambulavi, et mansi apud Gabelum fratrem nostrum, qui moratur in Rages civitate Medorum, quæ posita est in monte Ecbatanis.

verses.text: Then Tobias going in told all these things to his father. Upon which his father being in admiration, desired that he would come in unto him.
verses.textLatin: Cui Tobias ait: Sustine me obsecro, donec hæc ipsa nuntiem patri meo.

verses.text: So going in he saluted him, and said: Joy be to thee always.
