verses.text: The Lord is my strength and my praise: and he is become my salvation.
verses.textLatin: Fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus, et factus est mihi in salutem.

verses.text: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation is in the tabernacles of the just.
verses.textLatin: Vox exsultationis et salutis in tabernaculis justorum.

verses.text: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength: the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me: the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.
verses.textLatin: Dextera Domini fecit virtutem; dextera Domini exaltavit me: dextera Domini fecit virtutem.

verses.text: I shall not die, but live: and shall declare the works of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Non moriar, sed vivam, et narrabo opera Domini.

verses.text: The Lord chastising hath chastised me: but he hath not delivered me over to death.
verses.textLatin: Castigans castigavit me Dominus, et morti non tradidit me.

verses.text: Open ye to me the gates of justice: I will go in to them, and give praise to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Aperite mihi portas justitiæ: ingressus in eas confitebor Domino.

verses.text: This is the gate of the Lord, the just shall enter into it.
verses.textLatin: Hæc porta Domini: justi intrabunt in eam.

verses.text: I will give glory to thee because thou hast heard me: and art become my salvation.
verses.textLatin: Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, et factus es mihi in salutem.

verses.text: The stone which the builders rejected; the same is become the head of the corner.
verses.textLatin: Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli.

verses.text: This is the Lord’s doing: and it is wonderful in our eyes.
verses.textLatin: A Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris.

verses.text: This is the day which the Lord hath made: let us be glad and rejoice therein.
verses.textLatin: Hæc est dies quam fecit Dominus; exsultemus, et lætemur in ea.

verses.text: O Lord, save me: O Lord, give good success.
verses.textLatin: O Domine, salvum me fac; o Domine, bene prosperare.

verses.text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord. We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini: benediximus vobis de domo Domini.

verses.text: The Lord is God, and he hath shone upon us. Appoint a solemn day, with shady boughs, even to the horn of the altar.
verses.textLatin: Deus Dominus, et illuxit nobis. Constituite diem solemnem in condensis, usque ad cornu altaris.

verses.text: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, and I will exalt thee. I will praise thee, because thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.textLatin: Deus meus es tu, et confitebor tibi; Deus meus es tu, et exaltabo te. Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, et factus es mihi in salutem.

verses.text: O praise ye the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Aleph Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Aleph Beati immaculati in via, qui ambulant in lege Domini.

verses.text: Blessed are they that search his testimonies: that seek him with their whole heart.
verses.textLatin: Beati qui scrutantur testimonia ejus; in toto corde exquirunt eum.

verses.text: For they that work iniquity, have not walked in his ways.
verses.textLatin: Non enim qui operantur iniquitatem in viis ejus ambulaverunt.

verses.text: Thou hast commanded thy commandments to be kept most diligently.
verses.textLatin: Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis.

verses.text: O! that my ways may be directed to keep thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Utinam dirigantur viæ meæ ad custodiendas justificationes tuas.

verses.text: Then shall I not be confounded, when I shall look into all thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Tunc non confundar, cum perspexero in omnibus mandatis tuis.

verses.text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned the judgments of thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Confitebor tibi in directione cordis, in eo quod didici judicia justitiæ tuæ.

verses.text: I will keep thy justifications: O! do not thou utterly forsake me.
verses.textLatin: Justificationes tuas custodiam; non me derelinquas usquequaque.

verses.text: Beth By what doth a young man correct his way? by observing thy words.
verses.textLatin: Beth In quo corrigit adolescentior viam suam? in custodiendo sermones tuos.

verses.text: With my whole heart have I sought after thee: let me not stray from thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: In toto corde meo exquisivi te; ne repellas me a mandatis tuis.

verses.text: Thy words have I hidden in my heart, that I may not sin against thee.
verses.textLatin: In corde meo abscondi eloquia tua, ut non peccem tibi.

verses.text: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Benedictus es, Domine; doce me justificationes tuas.

verses.text: With my lips I have pronounced all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.textLatin: In labiis meis pronuntiavi omnia judicia oris tui.

verses.text: I have been delighted in the way of thy testimonies, as in all riches.
verses.textLatin: In via testimoniorum tuorum delectatus sum, sicut in omnibus divitiis.

verses.text: I will meditate on thy commandments: and I will consider thy ways.
verses.textLatin: In mandatis tuis exercebor, et considerabo vias tuas.

verses.text: I will think of thy justifications: I will not forget thy words.
verses.textLatin: In justificationibus tuis meditabor: non obliviscar sermones tuos.

verses.text: GIMEL. Give bountifully to thy servant, enliven me: and I shall keep thy words.
verses.textLatin: GhimelRetribue servo tuo, vivifica me, et custodiam sermones tuos.

verses.text: Open thou my eyes: and I will consider the wondrous things of thy law.
verses.textLatin: Revela oculos meos, et considerabo mirabilia de lege tua.

verses.text: I am a sojourner on the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.textLatin: Incola ego sum in terra: non abscondas a me mandata tua.

verses.text: My soul hath coveted to long for thy justifications, at all times.
verses.textLatin: Concupivit anima mea desiderare justificationes tuas in omni tempore.

verses.text: Thou hast rebuked the proud: they are cursed who decline from thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Increpasti superbos; maledicti qui declinant a mandatis tuis.

verses.text: Remove from me reproach and contempt: because I have sought after thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Aufer a me opprobrium et contemptum, quia testimonia tua exquisivi.

verses.text: For princes sat, and spoke against me: but thy servant was employed in thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Etenim sederunt principes, et adversum me loquebantur; servus autem tuus exercebatur in justificationibus tuis.

verses.text: For thy testimonies are my meditation: and thy justifications my counsel.
verses.textLatin: Nam et testimonia tua meditatio mea est, et consilium meum justificationes tuæ.

verses.text: DALETH. My soul hath cleaved to the pavement: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Daleth Adhæsit pavimento anima mea: vivifica me secundum verbum tuum.

verses.text: I have declared my ways, and thou hast heard me: teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Vias meas enuntiavi, et exaudisti me; doce me justificationes tuas.

verses.text: Make me to understand the way of thy justifications: and I shall be exercised in thy wondrous works.
verses.textLatin: Viam justificationum tuarum instrue me, et exercebor in mirabilibus tuis.

verses.text: My soul hath slumbered through heaviness: strengthen thou me in thy words.
verses.textLatin: Dormitavit anima mea præ tædio: confirma me in verbis tuis.

verses.text: Remove from me the way of iniquity: and out of thy law have mercy on me.
verses.textLatin: Viam iniquitatis amove a me, et de lege tua miserere mei.

verses.text: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments I have not forgotten.
verses.textLatin: Viam veritatis elegi; judicia tua non sum oblitus.

verses.text: I have stuck to thy testimonies, O Lord: put me not to shame.
verses.textLatin: Adhæsi testimoniis tuis, Domine; noli me confundere.

verses.text: I have run the way of thy commandments, when thou didst enlarge my heart.
verses.textLatin: Viam mandatorum tuorum cucurri, cum dilatasti cor meum.

verses.text: HE Set before me for a law the way of thy justifications, O Lord: and I will always seek after it.
verses.textLatin: He Legem pone mihi, Domine, viam justificationum tuarum, et exquiram eam semper.

verses.text: Give me understanding, and I will search thy law; and I will keep it with my whole heart.
verses.textLatin: Da mihi intellectum, et scrutabor legem tuam, et custodiam illam in toto corde meo.

verses.text: Lead me into the path of thy commandments; for this same I have desired.
verses.textLatin: Deduc me in semitam mandatorum tuorum, quia ipsam volui.

verses.text: Incline my heart into thy testimonies and not to covetousness.
verses.textLatin: Inclina cor meum in testimonia tua, et non in avaritiam.

verses.text: Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: quicken me in thy way.
verses.textLatin: Averte oculos meos, ne videant vanitatem; in via tua vivifica me.

verses.text: Establish thy word to thy servant, in thy fear.
verses.textLatin: Statue servo tuo eloquium tuum in timore tuo.

verses.text: Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: for thy judgments are delightful.
verses.textLatin: Amputa opprobrium meum quod suspicatus sum, quia judicia tua jucunda.

verses.text: Behold I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Ecce concupivi mandata tua: in æquitate tua vivifica me.

verses.text: VAU Let thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord: thy salvation according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Vau Et veniat super me misericordia tua, Domine; salutare tuum secundum eloquium tuum.

verses.text: So shall I answer them that reproach me in any thing; that I have trusted in thy words.
verses.textLatin: Et respondebo exprobrantibus mihi verbum, quia speravi in sermonibus tuis.

verses.text: And take not thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: for in thy words, I have hoped exceedingly.
verses.textLatin: Et ne auferas de ore meo verbum veritatis usquequaque, quia in judiciis tuis supersperavi.

verses.text: So shall I always keep thy law, for ever and ever.
verses.textLatin: Et custodiam legem tuam semper, in sæculum et in sæculum sæculi.

verses.text: And I walked at large: because I have sought after thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Et ambulabam in latitudine, quia mandata tua exquisivi.

verses.text: And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings: and I was not ashamed.
verses.textLatin: Et loquebar in testimoniis tuis in conspectu regum, et non confundebar.

verses.text: I meditated also on thy commandments, which I loved.
verses.textLatin: Et meditabar in mandatis tuis, quæ dilexi.

verses.text: And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments, which I loved: and I was exercised in thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Et levavi manus meas ad mandata tua, quæ dilexi, et exercebar in justificationibus tuis.

verses.text: ZAIN. Be thou mindful of thy word to thy servant, in which thou hast given me hope.
verses.textLatin: Zain Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, in quo mihi spem dedisti.

verses.text: This hath comforted me in my humiliation: because thy word hath enlivened me.
verses.textLatin: Hæc me consolata est in humilitate mea, quia eloquium tuum vivificavit me.

verses.text: The proud did iniquitously altogether: but I declined not from thy law.
verses.textLatin: Superbi inique agebant usquequaque; a lege autem tua non declinavi.

verses.text: I remembered, O Lord, thy judgments of old: and I was comforted.
verses.textLatin: Memor fui judiciorum tuorum a sæculo, Domine, et consolatus sum.

verses.text: A fainting hath taken hold of me, because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.textLatin: Defectio tenuit me, pro peccatoribus derelinquentibus legem tuam.

verses.text: Thy justifications were the subject of my song, in the place of my pilgrimage.
verses.textLatin: Cantabiles mihi erant justificationes tuæ in loco peregrinationis meæ.

verses.text: In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord: and have kept thy law.
verses.textLatin: Memor fui nocte nominis tui, Domine, et custodivi legem tuam.

verses.text: This happened to me: because I sought after thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Hæc facta est mihi, quia justificationes tuas exquisivi.

verses.text: HETH. O Lord, my portion, I have said, I would keep thy law.
verses.textLatin: HethPortio mea, Domine, dixi custodire legem tuam.

verses.text: I entreated thy face with all my heart: have mercy on me according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo; miserere mei secundum eloquium tuum.

verses.text: I have thought on my ways: and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Cogitavi vias meas, et converti pedes meos in testimonia tua.

verses.text: I am ready, and am not troubled: that I may keep thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Paratus sum, et non sum turbatus, ut custodiam mandata tua.

verses.text: The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.textLatin: Funes peccatorum circumplexi sunt me, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.

verses.text: I rose at midnight to give praise to thee; for the judgments of thy justification.
verses.textLatin: Media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi, super judicia justificationis tuæ.

verses.text: I am a partaker with all them that fear thee, and that keep thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Particeps ego sum omnium timentium te, et custodientium mandata tua.

verses.text: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Misericordia tua, Domine, plena est terra; justificationes tuas doce me.

verses.text: TETH. Thou hast done well with thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Teth Bonitatem fecisti cum servo tuo, Domine, secundum verbum tuum.

verses.text: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge; for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Bonitatem, et disciplinam, et scientiam doce me, quia mandatis tuis credidi.

verses.text: Before I was humbled I offended; therefore have I kept thy word.
verses.textLatin: Priusquam humiliarer ego deliqui: propterea eloquium tuum custodivi.

verses.text: Thou art good; and in thy goodness teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Bonus es tu, et in bonitate tua doce me justificationes tuas.

verses.text: The iniquity of the proud hath been multiplied over me: but I will seek thy commandments with my whole heart.
verses.textLatin: Multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum; ego autem in toto corde meo scrutabor mandata tua.

verses.text: Their heart is curdled like milk: but I have meditated on thy law.
verses.textLatin: Coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum; ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum.

verses.text: It is good for me that thou hast humbled me, that I may learn thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Bonum mihi quia humiliasti me, ut discam justificationes tuas.

verses.text: The law of thy mouth is good to me, above thousands of gold and silver.
verses.textLatin: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, super millia auri et argenti.

verses.text: JOD. Thy hands have made me and formed me: give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: JodManus tuæ fecerunt me, et plasmaverunt me: da mihi intellectum, et discam mandata tua.

verses.text: They that fear thee shall see me, and shall be glad : because I have greatly hoped in thy words.
verses.textLatin: Qui timent te videbunt me et lætabuntur, quia in verba tua supersperavi.

verses.text: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are equity: and in thy truth thou hast humbled me.
verses.textLatin: Cognovi, Domine, quia æquitas judicia tua, et in veritate tua humiliasti me.

verses.text: O! let thy mercy be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.textLatin: Fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me, secundum eloquium tuum servo tuo.

verses.text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: for thy law is my meditation.
verses.textLatin: Veniant mihi miserationes tuæ, et vivam, quia lex tua meditatio mea est.

verses.text: Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: but I will be employed in thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Confundantur superbi, quia injuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me; ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis.

verses.text: Let them that fear thee turn to me: and they that know thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Convertantur mihi timentes te, et qui noverunt testimonia tua.

verses.text: Let my heart be undefiled in thy justifications, that I may not be confounded.
verses.textLatin: Fiat cor meum immaculatum in justificationibus tuis, ut non confundar.

verses.text: CAPH. My soul hath fainted after thy salvation: and in thy word I have very much hoped.
verses.textLatin: Caph Defecit in salutare tuum anima mea, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.

verses.text: My eyes have failed for thy word, saying: When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.textLatin: Defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum, dicentes: Quando consolaberis me?

verses.text: For I am become like a bottle in the frost: I have not forgotten thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.

verses.text: How many are the days of thy servant: when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.textLatin: Quot sunt dies servi tui? quando facies de persequentibus me judicium?

verses.text: The wicked have told me fables: but not as thy law.
verses.textLatin: Narraverunt mihi iniqui fabulationes, sed non ut lex tua.

verses.text: All thy statutes are truth: they have persecuted me unjustly, do thou help me.
verses.textLatin: Omnia mandata tua veritas: inique persecuti sunt me, adjuva me.

verses.text: They had almost made an end of me upon earth: but I have not forsaken thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Paulominus consummaverunt me in terra; ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua.

verses.text: Quicken thou me according to thy mercy: and I shall keep the testimonies of thy mouth.
verses.textLatin: Secundum misericordiam tuam vivifica me, et custodiam testimonia oris tui.

verses.text: LAMED. For ever, O Lord, thy word standeth firm in heaven.
verses.textLatin: Lamed In æternum, Domine, verbum tuum permanet in cælo.

verses.text: Thy truth unto all generations: thou hast founded the earth, and it continueth.
verses.textLatin: In generationem et generationem veritas tua; fundasti terram, et permanet.

verses.text: By thy ordinance the day goeth on: for all things serve thee.
verses.textLatin: Ordinatione tua perseverat dies, quoniam omnia serviunt tibi.

verses.text: Unless thy law had been my meditation, I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.
verses.textLatin: Nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est, tunc forte periissem in humilitate mea.

verses.text: Thy justifications I will never forget: for by them thou hast given me life.
verses.textLatin: In æternum non obliviscar justificationes tuas, quia in ipsis vivificasti me.

verses.text: I am thine, save thou me: for I have sought thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Tuus sum ego; salvum me fac: quoniam justificationes tuas exquisivi.

verses.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I have understood thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Me exspectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me; testimonia tua intellexi.

verses.text: I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.textLatin: Omnis consummationis vidi finem, latum mandatum tuum nimis.

verses.text: MEM. O how have I loved thy law, O Lord! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.textLatin: Mem Quomodo dilexi legem tuam, Domine! tota die meditatio mea est.

verses.text: Through thy commandment, thou hast made me wiser than my enemies: for it is ever with me.
verses.textLatin: Super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo, quia in æternum mihi est.

verses.text: I have understood more than all my teachers: because thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.textLatin: Super omnes docentes me intellexi, quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est.

verses.text: I have had understanding above ancients: because I have sought thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Super senes intellexi, quia mandata tua quæsivi.

verses.text: I have restrained my feet from every evil way: that I may keep thy words.
verses.textLatin: Ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos, ut custodiam verba tua.

verses.text: I have not declined from thy judgments, because thou hast set me a law.
verses.textLatin: A judiciis tuis non declinavi, quia tu legem posuisti mihi.

verses.text: How sweet are thy words to my palate! more than honey to my mouth.
verses.textLatin: Quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua! super mel ori meo.

verses.text: By thy commandments I have had understanding: therefore have I hated every way of iniquity.
verses.textLatin: A mandatis tuis intellexi; propterea odivi omnem viam iniquitatis.

verses.text: NUN. Thy word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my paths.
verses.textLatin: Nun Lucerna pedibus meis verbum tuum, et lumen semitis meis.

verses.text: I have sworn and am determined to keep the judgments of thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Juravi et statui custodire judicia justitiæ tuæ.

verses.text: I have been humbled, O Lord, exceedingly: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Humiliatus sum usquequaque, Domine; vivifica me secundum verbum tuum.

verses.text: The free offerings of my mouth make acceptable, O Lord: and teach me thy judgments.
verses.textLatin: Voluntaria oris mei beneplacita fac, Domine, et judicia tua doce me.

verses.text: My soul is continually in my hands: and I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.textLatin: Anima mea in manibus meis semper, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.

verses.text: Sinners have laid a snare for me: but I have not erred from thy precepts.
verses.textLatin: Posuerunt peccatores laqueum mihi, et de mandatis tuis non erravi.

verses.text: I have purchased thy testimonies for an inheritance for ever: because they are the joy of my heart.
verses.textLatin: Hæreditate acquisivi testimonia tua in æternum, quia exsultatio cordis mei sunt.

verses.text: I have inclined my heart to do thy justifications for ever, for the reward.
verses.textLatin: Inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas justificationes tuas in æternum, propter retributionem.

verses.text: SAMECH. I have hated the unjust: and have loved thy law.
verses.textLatin: Samech Iniquos odio habui, et legem tuam dilexi.

verses.text: Thou art my helper and my protector: and in thy word I have greatly hoped.
verses.textLatin: Adjutor et susceptor meus es tu, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.

verses.text: Depart from me, ye malignant: and I will search the commandments of my God.
verses.textLatin: Declinate a me, maligni, et scrutabor mandata Dei mei.

verses.text: Uphold me according to thy word, and I shall live: and let me not be confounded in my expectation.
verses.textLatin: Suscipe me secundum eloquium tuum, et vivam, et non confundas me ab exspectatione mea.

verses.text: Help me, and I shall be saved: and I will meditate always on thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Adjuva me, et salvus ero, et meditabor in justificationibus tuis semper.

verses.text: Thou hast despised all them that fall off from thy judgments; for their thought is unjust.
verses.textLatin: Sprevisti omnes discedentes a judiciis tuis, quia injusta cogitatio eorum.

verses.text: I have accounted all the sinners of the earth prevaricators: therefore have I loved thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Prævaricantes reputavi omnes peccatores terræ; ideo dilexi testimonia tua.

verses.text: Pierce thou my flesh with thy fear: for I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.textLatin: Confige timore tuo carnes meas; a judiciis enim tuis timui.

verses.text: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: give me not up to them that slander me.
verses.textLatin: Ain Feci judicium et justitiam: non tradas me calumniantibus me.

verses.text: Uphold thy servant unto good: let not the proud calumniate me.
verses.textLatin: Suscipe servum tuum in bonum: non calumnientur me superbi.

verses.text: My eyes have fainted after thy salvation: and for the word of thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum, et in eloquium justitiæ tuæ.

verses.text: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy: and teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam, et justificationes tuas doce me.

verses.text: I am thy servant: give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Servus tuus sum ego: da mihi intellectum, ut sciam testimonia tua.

verses.text: It is time, O Lord, to do: they have dissipated thy law.
verses.textLatin: Tempus faciendi, Domine: dissipaverunt legem tuam.

verses.text: Therefore have I loved thy commandments above gold and the topaz.
verses.textLatin: Ideo dilexi mandata tua super aurum et topazion.

verses.text: Therefore was I directed to all thy commandments: I have hated all wicked ways.
verses.textLatin: Propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar; omnem viam iniquam odio habui.

verses.text: PHE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul hath sought them.
verses.textLatin: Phe Mirabilia testimonia tua: ideo scrutata est ea anima mea.

verses.text: The declaration of thy words giveth light: and giveth understanding to little ones.
verses.textLatin: Declaratio sermonum tuorum illuminat, et intellectum dat parvulis.

verses.text: I opened my mouth, and panted: because I longed for thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Os meum aperui, et attraxi spiritum: quia mandata tua desiderabam.

verses.text: Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me, according to the judgment of them that love thy name.
verses.textLatin: Aspice in me, et miserere mei, secundum judicium diligentium nomen tuum.

verses.text: Direct my steps according to thy word: and let no iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.textLatin: Gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum, et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia.

verses.text: Redeem me from the calumnies of men: that I may keep thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Redime me a calumniis hominum ut custodiam mandata tua.

verses.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: and teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Faciem tuam illumina super servum tuum, et doce me justificationes tuas.

verses.text: My eyes have sent forth springs of water: because they have not kept thy law.
verses.textLatin: Exitus aquarum deduxerunt oculi mei, quia non custodierunt legem tuam.

verses.text: SADE. Thou art just, O Lord: and thy judgment is right.
verses.textLatin: Sade Justus es, Domine, et rectum judicium tuum.

verses.text: Thou hast commanded justice thy testimonies: and thy truth exceedingly.
verses.textLatin: Mandasti justitiam testimonia tua, et veritatem tuam nimis.

verses.text: My zeal hath made me pine away: because my enemies forgot thy words.
verses.textLatin: Tabescere me fecit zelus meus, quia obliti sunt verba tua inimici mei.

verses.text: Thy word is exceedingly refined: and thy servant hath loved it.
verses.textLatin: Ignitum eloquium tuum vehementer, et servus tuus dilexit illud.

verses.text: I am very young and despised; but I forget not thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Adolescentulus sum ego et contemptus; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.

verses.text: Thy justice is justice for ever: and thy law is the truth.
verses.textLatin: Justitia tua, justitia in æternum, et lex tua veritas.

verses.text: Trouble and anguish have found me: thy commandments are my meditation.
verses.textLatin: Tribulatio et angustia invenerunt me; mandata tua meditatio mea est.

verses.text: Thy testimonies are justice for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.textLatin: Æquitas testimonia tua in æternum: intellectum da mihi, et vivam.

verses.text: COPH. I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord: I will seek thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Coph Clamavi in toto corde meo: exaudi me, Domine; justificationes tuas requiram.

verses.text: I cried unto thee, save me: that I may keep thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Clamavi ad te; salvum me fac: ut custodiam mandata tua.

verses.text: I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: because in thy words I very much hoped.
verses.textLatin: Præveni in maturitate, et clamavi: quia in verba tua supersperavi.

verses.text: My eyes to thee have prevented the morning: that I might meditate on thy words.
verses.textLatin: Prævenerunt oculi mei ad te diluculo, ut meditarer eloquia tua.

verses.text: Hear thou my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy: and quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.textLatin: Vocem meam audi secundum misericordiam tuam, Domine, et secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.

verses.text: They that persecute me have drawn nigh to iniquity; but they are gone far off from thy law.
verses.textLatin: Appropinquaverunt persequentes me iniquitati: a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.

verses.text: Thou art near, O Lord: and all thy ways are truth.
verses.textLatin: Prope es tu, Domine, et omnes viæ tuæ veritas.

verses.text: I have known from the beginning concerning thy testimonies: that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.textLatin: Initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis, quia in æternum fundasti ea.

verses.text: RES. See my humiliation and deliver me: for I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.textLatin: Res Vide humilitatem meam, et eripe me, quia legem tuam non sum oblitus.

verses.text: Judge my judgment and redeem me: quicken thou me for thy word’s sake.
verses.textLatin: Judica judicium meum, et redime me: propter eloquium tuum vivifica me.

verses.text: Salvation is far from sinners; because they have not sought thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Longe a peccatoribus salus, quia justificationes tuas non exquisierunt.

verses.text: Many, O Lord, are thy mercies: quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.textLatin: Misericordiæ tuæ multæ, Domine; secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.

verses.text: Many are they that persecute me, and afflict me; but I have not declined from thy testimonies.
verses.textLatin: Multi qui persequuntur me, et tribulant me; a testimoniis tuis non declinavi.

verses.text: I beheld the transgressors, and I pined away; because they kept not thy word.
verses.textLatin: Vidi prævaricantes et tabescebam, quia eloquia tua non custodierunt.

verses.text: Behold I have loved thy commandments, O Lord; quicken me thou in thy mercy.
verses.textLatin: Vide quoniam mandata tua dilexi, Domine: in misericordia tua vivifica me.

verses.text: The beginning of thy words is truth: all the judgments of thy justice are for ever.
verses.textLatin: Principium verborum tuorum veritas; in æternum omnia judicia justitiæ tuæ.

verses.text: SIN. Princes have persecuted me without cause: and my heart hath been in awe of thy words.
verses.textLatin: Sin Principes persecuti sunt me gratis, et a verbis tuis formidavit cor meum.

verses.text: I will rejoice at thy words, as one that hath found great spoil.
verses.textLatin: Lætabor ego super eloquia tua, sicut qui invenit spolia multa.

verses.text: I have hated and abhorred iniquity; but I have loved thy law.
verses.textLatin: Iniquitatem odio habui, et abominatus sum, legem autem tuam dilexi.

verses.text: Seven times a day I have given praise to thee, for the judgments of thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Septies in die laudem dixi tibi, super judicia justitiæ tuæ.

verses.text: Much peace have they that love thy law, and to them there is no stumbling-block.
verses.textLatin: Pax multa diligentibus legem tuam, et non est illis scandalum.

verses.text: I looked for thy salvation, O Lord: and I loved thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Exspectabam salutare tuum, Domine, et mandata tua dilexi.

verses.text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies: and hath loved them exceedingly.
verses.textLatin: Custodivit anima mea testimonia tua, et dilexit ea vehementer.

verses.text: I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies: because all my ways are in thy sight.
verses.textLatin: Servavi mandata tua et testimonia tua, quia omnes viæ meæ in conspectu tuo.

verses.text: TAU. Let my supplication, O Lord, come near in thy sight: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Tau Appropinquet deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, Domine; juxta eloquium tuum da mihi intellectum.

verses.text: Let my request come in before thee; deliver thou me according to thy word.
verses.textLatin: Intret postulatio mea in conspectu tuo; secundum eloquium tuum eripe me.

verses.text: My lips shall utter a hymn, when thou shalt teach me thy justifications.
verses.textLatin: Eructabunt labia mea hymnum, cum docueris me justificationes tuas.

verses.text: My tongue shall pronounce thy word: because all thy commandments are justice.
verses.textLatin: Pronuntiabit lingua mea eloquium tuum, quia omnia mandata tua æquitas.

verses.text: Let thy hand be with me to save me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.textLatin: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me, quoniam mandata tua elegi.

verses.text: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my meditation.
verses.textLatin: Concupivi salutare tuum, Domine, et lex tua meditatio mea est.

verses.text: My soul shall live and shall praise thee: and thy judgments shall help me.
verses.textLatin: Vivet anima mea, et laudabit te, et judicia tua adjuvabunt me.

verses.text: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: seek thy servant, because I have not forgotten thy commandments.
verses.textLatin: Erravi sicut ovis quæ periit: quære servum tuum, quia mandata tua non sum oblitus.

verses.text: In  my trouble I cried to the Lord: and he heard me.
verses.textLatin: Ad Dominum cum tribularer clamavi, et exaudivit me.

verses.text: O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, and a deceitful tongue.
verses.textLatin: Domine, libera animam meam a labiis iniquis et a lingua dolosa.

verses.text: What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, to a deceitful tongue?
verses.textLatin: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponatur tibi ad linguam dolosam?

verses.text: The sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals that lay waste.
verses.textLatin: Sagittæ potentis acutæ, cum carbonibus desolatoriis.

verses.text: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar:
verses.textLatin: Heu mihi, quia incolatus meus prolongatus est! habitavi cum habitantibus Cedar;

verses.text: my soul hath been long a sojourner.
verses.textLatin: multum incola fuit anima mea.

verses.text: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.
verses.textLatin: Cum his qui oderunt pacem eram pacificus; cum loquebar illis, impugnabant me gratis.

verses.text: I  have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, from whence help shall come to me.
verses.textLatin: Levavi oculos meos in montes, unde veniet auxilium mihi.

verses.text: My help is from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.textLatin: Auxilium meum a Domino, qui fecit cælum et terram.

verses.text: May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.
verses.textLatin: Non det in commotionem pedem tuum, neque dormitet qui custodit te.

verses.text: Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, that keepeth Israel.
verses.textLatin: Ecce non dormitabit neque dormiet qui custodit Israël.

verses.text: The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection upon thy right hand.
verses.textLatin: Dominus custodit te; Dominus protectio tua super manum dexteram tuam.

verses.text: The sun shall not burn thee by day: nor the moon by night.
verses.textLatin: Per diem sol non uret te, neque luna per noctem.

verses.text: The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: may the Lord keep thy soul.
verses.textLatin: Dominus custodit te ab omni malo; custodiat animam tuam Dominus.

verses.text: May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; from henceforth now and for ever.
verses.textLatin: Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.

verses.text: I  rejoiced at the things that were said to me: We shall go into the house of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Lætatus sum in his quæ dicta sunt mihi: In domum Domini ibimus.

verses.text: Our feet were standing in thy courts, O Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Stantes erant pedes nostri in atriis tuis, Jerusalem.

verses.text: Jerusalem, which is built as a city, which is compact together.
verses.textLatin: Jerusalem, quæ ædificatur ut civitas, cujus participatio ejus in idipsum.

verses.text: For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Illuc enim ascenderunt tribus, tribus Domini: testimonium Israël, ad confitendum nomini Domini.

verses.text: Because their seats have sat in judgment, seats upon the house of David.
verses.textLatin: Quia illic sederunt sedes in judicio, sedes super domum David.

verses.text: Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: and abundance for them that love thee.
verses.textLatin: Rogate quæ ad pacem sunt Jerusalem, et abundantia diligentibus te.

verses.text: Let peace be in thy strength: and abundance in thy towers.
verses.textLatin: Fiat pax in virtute tua, et abundantia in turribus tuis.

verses.text: For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, I spoke peace of thee.
verses.textLatin: Propter fratres meos et proximos meos, loquebar pacem de te.

verses.text: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I have sought good things for thee.
verses.textLatin: Propter domum Domini Dei nostri, quæsivi bona tibi.

verses.text: To  thee have I lifted up my eyes, who dwellest in heaven.
verses.textLatin: Ad te levavi oculos meos, qui habitas in cælis.

verses.text: Behold as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters, As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until he have mercy on us.
verses.textLatin: Ecce sicut oculi servorum in manibus dominorum suorum; sicut oculi ancillæ in manibus dominæ suæ: ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum, donec misereatur nostri.

verses.text: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for we are greatly filled with contempt.
verses.textLatin: Miserere nostri, Domine, miserere nostri, quia multum repleti sumus despectione;

verses.text: For our soul is greatly filled: we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.
verses.textLatin: quia multum repleta est anima nostra opprobrium abundantibus, et despectio superbis.

verses.text: If  it had not been that the Lord was with us, let Israel now say:
verses.textLatin: Nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israël,

verses.text: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, When men rose up against us,
verses.textLatin: nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis: cum exsurgerent homines in nos,

verses.text: perhaps they had swallowed us up alive. When their fury was enkindled against us,
verses.textLatin: forte vivos deglutissent nos; cum irasceretur furor eorum in nos,

verses.text: perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.
verses.textLatin: forsitan aqua absorbuisset nos;

verses.text: Our soul hath passed through a torrent: perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.
verses.textLatin: torrentem pertransivit anima nostra; forsitan pertransisset anima nostra aquam intolerabilem.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.
verses.textLatin: Benedictus Dominus, qui non dedit nos in captionem dentibus eorum.

verses.text: Our soul hath been delivered as a sparrow out of the snare of the fowlers. The snare is broken, and we are delivered.
verses.textLatin: Anima nostra sicut passer erepta est de laqueo venantium; laqueus contritus est, et nos liberati sumus.

verses.text: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.textLatin: Adjutorium nostrum in nomine Domini, qui fecit cælum et terram.

verses.text: They  that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth
verses.textLatin: Qui confidunt in Domino, sicut mons Sion: non commovebitur in æternum, qui habitat

verses.text: in Jerusalem. Mountains are round about it: so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth now and for ever.
verses.textLatin: in Jerusalem. Montes in circuitu ejus; et Dominus in circuitu populi sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.

verses.text: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just: that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.
verses.textLatin: Quia non relinquet Dominus virgam peccatorum super sortem justorum: ut non extendant justi ad iniquitatem manus suas,

verses.text: Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, and to the upright of heart.
verses.textLatin: benefac, Domine, bonis, et rectis corde.

verses.text: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity: peace upon Israel.
verses.textLatin: Declinantes autem in obligationes, adducet Dominus cum operantibus iniquitatem. Pax super Israël!

verses.text: When  the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, we became like men comforted.
verses.textLatin: In convertendo Dominus captivitatem Sion, facti sumus sicut consolati.

verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with gladness; and our tongue with joy. Then shall they say among the Gentiles: The Lord hath done great things for them.
verses.textLatin: Tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum, et lingua nostra exsultatione. Tunc dicent inter gentes: Magnificavit Dominus facere cum eis.

verses.text: The Lord hath done great things for us: we are become joyful.
verses.textLatin: Magnificavit Dominus facere nobiscum; facti sumus lætantes.

verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as a stream in the south.
verses.textLatin: Converte, Domine, captivitatem nostram, sicut torrens in austro.

verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.textLatin: Qui seminant in lacrimis, in exsultatione metent.

verses.text: Going they went and wept, casting their seeds.
verses.textLatin: Euntes ibant et flebant, mittentes semina sua. Venientes autem venient cum exsultatione, portantes manipulos suos.

verses.text: Unless  the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it.
verses.textLatin: Nisi Dominus ædificaverit domum, in vanum laboraverunt qui ædificant eam. Nisi Dominus custodierit civitatem, frustra vigilat qui custodit eam.

verses.text: Unless the Lord keep the city, he watcheth in vain that keepeth it. It is vain for you to rise before light: rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow. When he shall give sleep to his beloved:
verses.textLatin: Vanum est vobis ante lucem surgere: surgite postquam sederitis, qui manducatis panem doloris. Cum dederit dilectis suis somnum,

verses.text: behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.
verses.textLatin: ecce hæreditas Domini, filii; merces, fructus ventris.

verses.text: As arrows in the hand of the mighty, so the children of them that have been shaken.
verses.textLatin: Sicut sagittæ in manu potentis, ita filii excussorum.

verses.text: Blessed is the man that hath filled his desire with them; he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.
verses.textLatin: Beatus vir qui implevit desiderium suum ex ipsis: non confundetur cum loquetur inimicis suis in porta.

verses.text: Blessed  are all they that fear the Lord: that walk in his ways.
verses.textLatin: Beati omnes qui timent Dominum, qui ambulant in viis ejus.

verses.text: For thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.textLatin: Labores manuum tuarum quia manducabis: beatus es, et bene tibi erit.

verses.text: Thy wife as a fruitful vine, on the sides of thy house. Thy children as olive plants, round about thy table.
verses.textLatin: Uxor tua sicut vitis abundans in lateribus domus tuæ; filii tui sicut novellæ olivarum in circuitu mensæ tuæ.

verses.text: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Ecce sic benedicetur homo qui timet Dominum.

verses.text: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion: and mayst thou see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.textLatin: Benedicat tibi Dominus ex Sion, et videas bona Jerusalem omnibus diebus vitæ tuæ.

verses.text: And mayst thou see thy children’s children, peace upon Israel.
verses.textLatin: Et videas filios filiorum tuorum: pacem super Israël.

verses.text: Often  have they fought against me from my youth, let Israel now say.
verses.textLatin: Sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea, dicat nunc Israël;

verses.text: Often have they fought against me from my youth: but they could not prevail over me.
verses.textLatin: sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea: etenim non potuerunt mihi.

verses.text: The wicked have wrought upon my back: they have lengthened their iniquity.
verses.textLatin: Supra dorsum meum fabricaverunt peccatores; prolongaverunt iniquitatem suam.

verses.text: The Lord who is just will cut the necks of sinners:
verses.textLatin: Dominus justus concidit cervices peccatorum.

verses.text: let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Sion.
verses.textLatin: Confundantur, et convertantur retrorsum omnes qui oderunt Sion.

verses.text: Let them be as grass upon the tops of houses: which withereth before it be plucked up:
verses.textLatin: Fiant sicut fœnum tectorum, quod priusquam evellatur exaruit:

verses.text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand: nor he that gathereth sheaves his bosom.
verses.textLatin: de quo non implevit manum suam qui metit, et sinum suum qui manipulos colligit.

verses.text: And they that passed by have not said: The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we have blessed you in the name of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et non dixerunt qui præteribant: Benedictio Domini super vos. Benediximus vobis in nomine Domini.

verses.text: Out  of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord:
verses.textLatin: De profundis clamavi ad te, Domine;

verses.text: Lord, hear my voice. Let thy ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.
verses.textLatin: Domine, exaudi vocem meam. Fiant aures tuæ intendentes in vocem deprecationis meæ.

verses.text: If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: Lord, who shall stand it.
verses.textLatin: Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, Domine, quis sustinebit?

verses.text: For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord. My soul hath relied on his word:
verses.textLatin: Quia apud te propitiatio est; et propter legem tuam sustinui te, Domine. Sustinuit anima mea in verbo ejus:

verses.text: my soul hath hoped in the Lord.
verses.textLatin: speravit anima mea in Domino.

verses.text: From the morning watch even until night, let Israel hope in the Lord.
verses.textLatin: A custodia matutina usque ad noctem, speret Israël in Domino.

verses.text: Because with the Lord there is mercy: and with him plentiful redemption.
verses.textLatin: Quia apud Dominum misericordia, et copiosa apud eum redemptio.

verses.text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.textLatin: Et ipse redimet Israël ex omnibus iniquitatibus ejus.

verses.text: Lord,  my heart is not exalted: nor are my eyes lofty.
verses.textLatin: Domine, non est exaltatum cor meum, neque elati sunt oculi mei, neque ambulavi in magnis, neque in mirabilibus super me.

verses.text: Neither have I walked in great matters, nor in wonderful things above me. If I was not humbly minded, but exalted my soul: As a child that is weaned is towards his mother, so reward in my soul.
verses.textLatin: Si non humiliter sentiebam, sed exaltavi animam meam: sicut ablactatus est super matre sua, ita retributio in anima mea.

verses.text: Let Israel hope in the Lord, from henceforth now and for ever.
verses.textLatin: Speret Israël in Domino, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.

verses.text: O  Lord, remember David, and all his meekness.
verses.textLatin: Memento, Domine, David, et omnis mansuetudinis ejus:

verses.text: How he swore to the Lord, he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:
verses.textLatin: sicut juravit Domino; votum vovit Deo Jacob:

verses.text: If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:
verses.textLatin: Si introiero in tabernaculum domus meæ; si ascendero in lectum strati mei;

verses.text: If I shall give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textLatin: si dedero somnum oculis meis, et palpebris meis dormitationem,

verses.text: Or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.textLatin: et requiem temporibus meis, donec inveniam locum Domino, tabernaculum Deo Jacob.

verses.text: Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata: we have found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.textLatin: Ecce audivimus eam in Ephrata; invenimus eam in campis silvæ.

verses.text: We will go into his tabernacle: we will adore in the place where his feet stood.
verses.textLatin: Introibimus in tabernaculum ejus; adorabimus in loco ubi steterunt pedes ejus.

verses.text: Arise, O Lord, into thy resting place: thou and the ark, which thou hast sanctified.
verses.textLatin: Surge, Domine, in requiem tuam, tu et arca sanctificationis tuæ.

verses.text: Let thy priests be clothed with justice: and let thy saints rejoice.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdotes tui induantur justitiam, et sancti tui exsultent.

verses.text: For thy servant David’s sake, turn not away the face of thy anointed.
verses.textLatin: Propter David servum tuum non avertas faciem christi tui.

verses.text: The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and he will not make it void: of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.
verses.textLatin: Juravit Dominus David veritatem, et non frustrabitur eam: De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.

verses.text: If thy children will keep my covenant, and these my testimonies which I shall teach them: Their children also for evermore shall sit upon thy throne.
verses.textLatin: Si custodierint filii tui testamentum meum, et testimonia mea hæc quæ docebo eos, et filii eorum usque in sæculum sedebunt super sedem tuam.

verses.text: For the Lord hath chosen Sion: he hath chosen it for his dwelling.
verses.textLatin: Quoniam elegit Dominus Sion: elegit eam in habitationem sibi.

verses.text: This is my rest for ever and ever: here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.
verses.textLatin: Hæc requies mea in sæculum sæculi; hic habitabo, quoniam elegi eam.

verses.text: Blessing I will bless her widow: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.textLatin: Viduam ejus benedicens benedicam; pauperes ejus saturabo panibus.

verses.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.
verses.textLatin: Sacerdotes ejus induam salutari, et sancti ejus exsultatione exsultabunt.

verses.text: There will I bring forth a horn to David: I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.
verses.textLatin: Illuc producam cornu David; paravi lucernam christo meo.

verses.text: His enemies I will clothe with confusion: but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.
verses.textLatin: Inimicos ejus induam confusione; super ipsum autem efflorebit sanctificatio mea.

verses.text: Behold  how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity:
verses.textLatin: Ecce quam bonum et quam jucundum, habitare fratres in unum!

verses.text: Like the precious ointment on the head, that ran down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, Which ran down to the skirt of his garment:
verses.textLatin: Sicut unguentum in capite, quod descendit in barbam, barbam Aaron, quod descendit in oram vestimenti ejus;

verses.text: as the dew of Hermon, which descendeth upon mount Sion. For there the Lord hath commanded blessing, and life for evermore.
verses.textLatin: sicut ros Hermon, qui descendit in montem Sion. Quoniam illic mandavit Dominus benedictionem, et vitam usque in sæculum.

verses.text: Behold  now bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Ecce nunc benedicite Dominum, omnes servi Domini: qui statis in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri.

verses.text: Who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God. In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, and bless ye the Lord.
verses.textLatin: In noctibus extollite manus vestras in sancta, et benedicite Dominum.

verses.text: May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, he that made heaven and earth.
verses.textLatin: Benedicat te Dominus ex Sion, qui fecit cælum et terram.

verses.text: Prraise  ye the name of the Lord: O you his servants, praise the Lord:
verses.textLatin: Laudate nomen Domini; laudate, servi, Dominum:

verses.text: You that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.textLatin: qui statis in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri.

verses.text: Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good: sing ye to his name, for it is sweet.
verses.textLatin: Laudate Dominum, quia bonus Dominus; psallite nomini ejus, quoniam suave.

verses.text: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself: Israel for his own possession.
verses.textLatin: Quoniam Jacob elegit sibi Dominus; Israël in possessionem sibi.

verses.text: For I have known that the Lord is great, and our God is above all gods.
verses.textLatin: Quia ego cognovi quod magnus est Dominus, et Deus noster præ omnibus diis.

verses.text: Whatsoever the Lord pleased he hath done, in heaven, in earth, in the sea, and in all the deeps.
verses.textLatin: Omnia quæcumque voluit Dominus fecit, in cælo, in terra, in mari et in omnibus abyssis.

verses.text: He bringeth up clouds from the end of the earth: he hath made lightnings for the rain. He bringeth forth winds out of his stores:
verses.textLatin: Educens nubes ab extremo terræ, fulgura in pluviam fecit; qui producit ventos de thesauris suis.

verses.text: He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man even unto beast.
verses.textLatin: Qui percussit primogenita Ægypti, ab homine usque ad pecus.

verses.text: He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt: upon Pharao, and upon all his servants.
verses.textLatin: Et misit signa et prodigia in medio tui, Ægypte: in Pharaonem, et in omnes servos ejus.

verses.text: He smote many nations, and slew mighty kings:
verses.textLatin: Qui percussit gentes multas, et occidit reges fortes:

verses.text: Sehon king of the Amorrhites, and Og king of Basan, and all the kingdoms of Chanaan.
verses.textLatin: Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, et Og, regem Basan, et omnia regna Chanaan:

verses.text: And gave their land for an inheritance, for an inheritance to his people Israel.
verses.textLatin: et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, hæreditatem Israël populo suo.

verses.text: Thy name, O Lord, is for ever: thy memorial, O Lord, unto all generations.
verses.textLatin: Domine, nomen tuum in æternum; Domine, memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem.

verses.text: For the Lord will judge his people, and will be entreated in favour of his servants.
verses.textLatin: Quia judicabit Dominus populum suum, et in servis suis deprecabitur.

verses.text: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, the works of men’s hands.
verses.textLatin: Simulacra gentium argentum et aurum, opera manuum hominum.

verses.text: They have a mouth, but they speak not: they have eyes, but they see not.
verses.textLatin: Os habent, et non loquentur; oculos habent, et non videbunt.

verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not: neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.textLatin: Aures habent, et non audient; neque enim est spiritus in ore ipsorum.

verses.text: Let them that make them be like to them: and every one that trusteth in them.
verses.textLatin: Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea, et omnes qui confidunt in eis.

verses.text: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron.
verses.textLatin: Domus Israël, benedicite Domino; domus Aaron, benedicite Domino.

verses.text: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: you that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Domus Levi, benedicite Domino; qui timetis Dominum, benedicite Domino.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, who dwelleth in Jerusalem.
verses.textLatin: Benedictus Dominus ex Sion, qui habitat in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Praise the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Praise ye the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Deo deorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Praise ye the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who alone doth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui facit mirabilia magna solus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who made the heavens in understanding: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui fecit cælos in intellectu, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who established the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui firmavit terram super aquas, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who made the great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui fecit luminaria magna, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:

verses.text: The sun to rule the day: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: solem in potestatem diei, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: The moon and the stars to rule the night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: lunam et stellas in potestatem noctis, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who smote Egypt with their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui percussit Ægyptum cum primogenitis eorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui eduxit Israël de medio eorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus,

verses.text: With a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: in manu potenti et brachio excelso, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who divided the Red Sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui divisit mare Rubrum in divisiones, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: And brought out Israel through the midst thereof: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et eduxit Israël per medium ejus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: And overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red Sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et excussit Pharaonem et virtutem ejus in mari Rubro, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who led his people through the desert: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui traduxit populum suum per desertum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui percussit reges magnos, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: And slew strong kings: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et occidit reges fortes, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:

verses.text: Sehon king of the Amorrhites: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: And Og king of Basan: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et Og, regem Basan, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:

verses.text: And he gave their land for an inheritance: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: For an inheritance to his servant Israel: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: hæreditatem Israël, servo suo, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: For he was mindful of us in our affliction: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Quia in humilitate nostra memor fuit nostri, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;

verses.text: And he redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: et redemit nos ab inimicis nostris, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Qui dat escam omni carni, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Give glory to the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.textLatin: Confitemini Deo cæli, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.text: Upon  the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept: when we remembered Sion:
verses.textLatin: Super flumina Babylonis illic sedimus et flevimus, cum recordaremur Sion.

verses.text: On the willows in the midst thereof we hung up our instruments.
verses.textLatin: In salicibus in medio ejus suspendimus organa nostra:

verses.text: For there they that led us into captivity required of us the words of songs. And they that carried us away, said: Sing ye to us a hymn of the songs of Sion.
verses.textLatin: quia illic interrogaverunt nos, qui captivos duxerunt nos, verba cantionum; et qui abduxerunt nos: Hymnum cantate nobis de canticis Sion.

verses.text: How shall we sing the song of the Lord in a strange land?
verses.textLatin: Quomodo cantabimus canticum Domini in terra aliena?

verses.text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand be forgotten.
verses.textLatin: Si oblitus fuero tui, Jerusalem, oblivioni detur dextera mea.

verses.text: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws, if I do not remember thee: If I make not Jerusalem the beginning of my joy.
verses.textLatin: Adhæreat lingua mea faucibus meis, si non meminero tui; si non proposuero Jerusalem in principio lætitiæ meæ.

verses.text: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom, in the day of Jerusalem: Who say: Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.textLatin: Memor esto, Domine, filiorum Edom, in die Jerusalem: qui dicunt: Exinanite, exinanite usque ad fundamentum in ea.

verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, miserable: blessed shall he be who shall repay thee thy payment which thou hast paid us.
verses.textLatin: Filia Babylonis misera! beatus qui retribuet tibi retributionem tuam quam retribuisti nobis.

verses.text: Blessed be he that shall take and dash thy little ones against the rock.
verses.textLatin: Beatus qui tenebit, et allidet parvulos tuos ad petram.

verses.text: I  will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: for thou hast heard the words of my mouth.
verses.textLatin: Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo, quoniam audisti verba oris mei. In conspectu angelorum psallam tibi;

verses.text: I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the angels: I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name. For thy mercy, and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy holy name above all.
verses.textLatin: adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitebor nomini tuo: super misericordia tua et veritate tua; quoniam magnificasti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.

verses.text: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.
verses.textLatin: In quacumque die invocavero te, exaudi me; multiplicabis in anima mea virtutem.

verses.text: May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.
verses.textLatin: Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnes reges terræ, quia audierunt omnia verba oris tui.

verses.text: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Et cantent in viis Domini, quoniam magna est gloria Domini;

verses.text: For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: and the high he knoweth afar off.
verses.textLatin: quoniam excelsus Dominus, et humilia respicit, et alta a longe cognoscit.

verses.text: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and thy right hand hath saved me.
verses.textLatin: Si ambulavero in medio tribulationis, vivificabis me; et super iram inimicorum meorum extendisti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit dextera tua.

verses.text: The Lord will repay for me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of thy hands.
verses.textLatin: Dominus retribuet pro me. Domine, misericordia tua in sæculum; opera manuum tuarum ne despicias.

verses.text: Unto the end, a psalm of David. Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me:
verses.textLatin: In finem, psalmus David. Domine, probasti me, et cognovisti me;

verses.text: thou hast known my sitting down, and my rising up.
verses.textLatin: tu cognovisti sessionem meam et resurrectionem meam.

verses.text: Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: my path and my line thou hast searched out.
verses.textLatin: Intellexisti cogitationes meas de longe; semitam meam et funiculum meum investigasti:

verses.text: And thou hast foreseen all my ways: for there is no speech in my tongue.
verses.textLatin: et omnes vias meas prævidisti, quia non est sermo in lingua mea.

verses.text: Behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: thou hast formed me, and hast laid thy hand upon me.
verses.textLatin: Ecce, Domine, tu cognovisti omnia, novissima et antiqua. Tu formasti me, et posuisti super me manum tuam.

verses.text: Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: it is high, and I cannot reach to it.
verses.textLatin: Mirabilis facta est scientia tua ex me; confortata est, et non potero ad eam.

verses.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy face?
verses.textLatin: Quo ibo a spiritu tuo? et quo a facie tua fugiam?

verses.text: If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: if I descend into hell, thou art present.
verses.textLatin: Si ascendero in cælum, tu illic es; si descendero in infernum, ades.

verses.text: If I take my wings early in the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:
verses.textLatin: Si sumpsero pennas meas diluculo, et habitavero in extremis maris,

verses.text: Even there also shall thy hand lead me: and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.textLatin: etenim illuc manus tua deducet me, et tenebit me dextera tua.

verses.text: And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: and night shall be my light in my pleasures.
verses.textLatin: Et dixi: Forsitan tenebræ conculcabunt me; et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis.

verses.text: But darkness shall not be dark to thee, and night shall be light as the day: the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to thee.
verses.textLatin: Quia tenebræ non obscurabuntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminabitur: sicut tenebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus.

verses.text: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast protected me from my mother’s womb.
verses.textLatin: Quia tu possedisti renes meos; suscepisti me de utero matris meæ.

verses.text: I will praise thee, for thou art fearfully magnified: wonderful are thy works, and my soul knoweth right well.
verses.textLatin: Confitebor tibi, quia terribiliter magnificatus es; mirabilia opera tua, et anima mea cognoscit nimis.

verses.text: My bone is not hidden from thee, which thou hast made in secret: and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.
verses.textLatin: Non est occultatum os meum a te, quod fecisti in occulto; et substantia mea in inferioribus terræ.

verses.text: Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, and in thy book all shall be written: days shall be formed, and no one in them.
verses.textLatin: Imperfectum meum viderunt oculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribentur. Dies formabuntur, et nemo in eis.

verses.text: But to me thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: their principality is exceedingly strengthened.
verses.textLatin: Mihi autem nimis honorificati sunt amici tui, Deus; nimis confortatus est principatus eorum.

verses.text: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: I rose up and am still with thee.
verses.textLatin: Dinumerabo eos, et super arenam multiplicabuntur. Exsurrexi, et adhuc sum tecum.

verses.text: If thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: ye men of blood, depart from me:
verses.textLatin: Si occideris, Deus, peccatores, viri sanguinum, declinate a me:

verses.text: Because you say in thought: They shall receive thy cities in vain.
verses.textLatin: quia dicitis in cogitatione: Accipient in vanitate civitates tuas.

verses.text: Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated thee: and pined away because of thy enemies?
verses.textLatin: Nonne qui oderunt te, Domine, oderam, et super inimicos tuos tabescebam?

verses.text: I have hated them with a perfect hatred: and they are become enemies to me.
verses.textLatin: Perfecto odio oderam illos, et inimici facti sunt mihi.

verses.text: Prove me, O God, and know my heart: examine me, and know my paths.
verses.textLatin: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum; interroga me, et cognosce semitas meas.

verses.text: And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: and lead me in the eternal way.
verses.textLatin: Et vide si via iniquitatis in me est, et deduc me in via æterna.

verses.text: Unto the end, a psalm of David.
verses.textLatin: In finem. Psalmus David.

verses.text: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: rescue me from the unjust man.
verses.textLatin: Eripe me, Domine, ab homine malo; a viro iniquo eripe me.

verses.text: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: all the day long they designed battles.
verses.textLatin: Qui cogitaverunt iniquitates in corde, tota die constituebant prælia.

verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: the venom of asps is under their lips.
verses.textLatin: Acuerunt linguas suas sicut serpentis; venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum.

verses.text: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the wicked: and from unjust men deliver me. Who have proposed to supplant my steps:
verses.textLatin: Custodi me, Domine, de manu peccatoris, et ab hominibus iniquis eripe me. Qui cogitaverunt supplantare gressus meos:

verses.text: the proud have hidden a net for me. And they have stretched out cords for a snare: they have laid for me a stumbling-block by the wayside.
verses.textLatin: absconderunt superbi laqueum mihi. Et funes extenderunt in laqueum; juxta iter, scandalum posuerunt mihi.

verses.text: I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.
verses.textLatin: Dixi Domino: Deus meus es tu; exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ.

verses.text: O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.
verses.textLatin: Domine, Domine, virtus salutis meæ, obumbrasti super caput meum in die belli.

verses.text: Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: they have plotted against me; do not thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.
verses.textLatin: Ne tradas me, Domine, a desiderio meo peccatori: cogitaverunt contra me; ne derelinquas me, ne forte exaltentur.

verses.text: The head of them compassing me about: the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.
verses.textLatin: Caput circuitus eorum: labor labiorum ipsorum operiet eos.

verses.text: Burning coals shall fall upon them; thou wilt cast them down into the fire: in miseries they shall not be able to stand.
verses.textLatin: Cadent super eos carbones; in ignem dejicies eos: in miseriis non subsistent.

verses.text: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.
verses.textLatin: Vir linguosus non dirigetur in terra; virum injustum mala capient in interitu.

verses.text: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, and will revenge the poor.
verses.textLatin: Cognovi quia faciet Dominus judicium inopis, et vindictam pauperum.

verses.text: But as for the just, they shall give glory to thy name: and the upright shall dwell with thy countenance.
verses.textLatin: Verumtamen justi confitebuntur nomini tuo, et habitabunt recti cum vultu tuo.

verses.text: I  have cried to thee, O Lord, hear me: hearken to my voice, when I cry to thee.
verses.textLatin: Domine, clamavi ad te: exaudi me; intende voci meæ, cum clamavero ad te.

verses.text: Let my prayer be directed as incense in thy sight; the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice.
verses.textLatin: Dirigatur oratio mea sicut incensum in conspectu tuo; elevatio manuum mearum sacrificium vespertinum.

verses.text: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth: and a door round about my lips.
verses.textLatin: Pone, Domine, custodiam ori meo, et ostium circumstantiæ labiis meis.

verses.text: Incline not my heart to evil words; to make excuses in sins. With men that work iniquity: and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.
verses.textLatin: Non declines cor meum in verba malitiæ, ad excusandas excusationes in peccatis; cum hominibus operantibus iniquitatem, et non communicabo cum electis eorum.

verses.text: The just man shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head. For my prayer also shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased:
verses.textLatin: Corripiet me justus in misericordia, et increpabit me: oleum autem peccatoris non impinguet caput meum. Quoniam adhuc et oratio mea in beneplacitis eorum:

verses.text: their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up. They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed:
verses.textLatin: absorpti sunt juncti petræ judices eorum. Audient verba mea, quoniam potuerunt.

verses.text: as when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground: Our bones are scattered by the side of hell.
verses.textLatin: Sicut crassitudo terræ erupta est super terram, dissipata sunt ossa nostra secus infernum.

verses.text: But to thee, O Lord, Lord, are my eyes: in thee have I put my trust, take not away my soul.
verses.textLatin: Quia ad te, Domine, Domine, oculi mei; in te speravi, non auferas animam meam.

verses.text: Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of them that work iniquity.
verses.textLatin: Custodi me a laqueo quem statuerunt mihi, et a scandalis operantium iniquitatem.

verses.text: The wicked shall fall in his net: I am alone until I pass.
verses.textLatin: Cadent in retiaculo ejus peccatores: singulariter sum ego, donec transeam.

verses.text: Of understanding for David. A prayer when he was in the cave. (1 Kings 24.)
verses.textLatin: Intellectus David, cum esset in spelunca, oratio. (I Regum 24.)

verses.text: I cried to the Lord with my voice: with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.
verses.textLatin: Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi, voce mea ad Dominum deprecatus sum.

verses.text: In his sight I pour out my prayer, and before him I declare my trouble:
verses.textLatin: Effundo in conspectu ejus orationem meam, et tribulationem meam ante ipsum pronuntio:

verses.text: When my spirit failed me, then thou knewest my paths. In this way wherein I walked, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.textLatin: in deficiendo ex me spiritum meum, et tu cognovisti semitas meas. In via hac qua ambulabam absconderunt laqueum mihi.

verses.text: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me. Flight hath failed me: and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.
verses.textLatin: Considerabam ad dexteram, et videbam, et non erat qui cognosceret me: periit fuga a me, et non est qui requirat animam meam.

verses.text: I cried to thee, O Lord: I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.
verses.textLatin: Clamavi ad te, Domine; dixi: Tu es spes mea, portio mea in terra viventium.

verses.text: Attend to my supplication: for I am brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.textLatin: Intende ad deprecationem meam, quia humiliatus sum nimis. Libera me a persequentibus me, quia confortati sunt super me.

verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the just wait for me, until thou reward me.
verses.textLatin: Educ de custodia animam meam ad confitendum nomini tuo; me exspectant justi donec retribuas mihi.

verses.text: A psalm of David, when his son Absalom pursued him. (2 Kings 17.) Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: hear me in thy justice.
verses.textLatin: Psalmus David, quando persequebatur eum Absalom filius ejus. (II Regum 17.) Domine, exaudi orationem meam; auribus percipe obsecrationem meam in veritate tua; exaudi me in tua justitia.

verses.text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.
verses.textLatin: Et non intres in judicium cum servo tuo, quia non justificabitur in conspectu tuo omnis vivens.

verses.text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: he hath brought down my life to the earth. He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old:
verses.textLatin: Quia persecutus est inimicus animam meam; humiliavit in terra vitam meam; collocavit me in obscuris, sicut mortuos sæculi.

verses.text: and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.
verses.textLatin: Et anxiatus est super me spiritus meus; in me turbatum est cor meum.

verses.text: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: I meditated upon the works of thy hands.
verses.textLatin: Memor fui dierum antiquorum; meditatus sum in omnibus operibus tuis: in factis manuum tuarum meditabar.

verses.text: I stretched forth my hands to thee: my soul is as earth without water unto thee.
verses.textLatin: Expandi manus meas ad te; anima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.

verses.text: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit hath fainted away. Turn not away thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.textLatin: Velociter exaudi me, Domine; defecit spiritus meus. Non avertas faciem tuam a me, et similis ero descendentibus in lacum.

verses.text: Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; for in thee have I hoped. Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: for I have lifted up my soul to thee.
verses.textLatin: Auditam fac mihi mane misericordiam tuam, quia in te speravi. Notam fac mihi viam in qua ambulem, quia ad te levavi animam meam.

verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled:
verses.textLatin: Eripe me de inimicis meis, Domine: ad te confugi.

verses.text: teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God. Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land:
verses.textLatin: Doce me facere voluntatem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu. Spiritus tuus bonus deducet me in terram rectam.

verses.text: for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice. Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble:
verses.textLatin: Propter nomen tuum, Domine, vivificabis me: in æquitate tua, educes de tribulatione animam meam,

verses.text: and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies. And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
